AI.conclusion: 该构造在模块化轻子味、TeV 量级逆跷跷板动力学与高反冲非弹性暗物质之间建立了直接联系，表明共同模量方案可同时满足轻子味约束与 LZ 取向的暗物质参数区间。

title: Relativistic Covariance from Hamiltonian Hydrodynamics in the Chiral Limit
summary: We derive the covariant equations of nondissipative chiral hydrodynamics from their equal-time Hamiltonian formulation and identify the Lie--Poisson structure implicit in the chiral brackets. This structure combines fluid motion with local chiral transformations. For a parity-invariant Hamiltonian quadratic in chiral charge densities and pion gradients, without external backgrounds, we derive and solve the constraints imposed by Lorentz boosts. Their coupled nonlinear sector is equivalent to the linear boost transformation laws of a symmetric tensor, which determine the velocity dependence from rest-frame data. For finite, positive rest-frame coefficients, finite ordinary-fluid energy density and thermodynamic derivatives, and a momentum--velocity relation that can be solved in either direction, the chiral Hamiltonian coefficients remain finite at every fluid speed below light speed if and only if the rest-frame pion propagation speed does not exceed the speed of light. This formulation makes symmetry constraints explicit and provides a starting point for future thermodynamically consistent dissipative extensions.

AI.tldr: 从等时哈密顿量（equal-time Hamiltonian）表述出发推导无耗散手征流体力学（nondissipative chiral hydrodynamics）的协变方程，并识别手征括号（chiral brackets）中隐含的 Lie--Poisson 结构；该结构将流体运动与局部手征变换（local chiral transformations）结合。对无外背景、手征荷密度与π介子梯度二次型的宇称不变哈密顿量，求解洛伦兹助推（Lorentz boosts）约束，得到速度依赖由静止系数据决定的结论。
AI.motivation: 目标是为手征流体建立显式的对称性约束表述，并以此作为后续热力学自洽的耗散推广（dissipative extensions）的出发点。
AI.method: 采用等时哈密顿量表述推导协变方程，识别括号代数背后的 Lie--Poisson 结构；针对宇称不变、关于手征荷密度与π介子梯度为二次型且无外背景的哈密顿量，推导并求解洛伦兹助推所施加的约束，分析其耦合非线性部分与对称张量线性助推变换律（linear boost transformation laws of a symmetric tensor）的等价性。
AI.result: 耦合非线性部分等价于对称张量的线性助推变换律，从而由静止系数据确定速度依赖；在静止系系数有限且为正、普通流体能量密度与热力学导数有限、动量--速度关系可双向求解的条件下，手征哈密顿量系数在所有低于光速的流速下保持有限，当且仅当静止系π介子传播速度不超过光速。
AI.conclusion: 该表述使对称性约束显式化，并为未来热力学自洽的耗散扩展提供起点。

title: Inverse eigenvalue problem for discrete three-diagonal Schroedinger operator and the continuum limit in Tikhonov regularization approach
summary: In the present article the self-contained derivation of main formulas of the inverse eigenvalue problem for the Sturm-Liouville operator is given on the base of its discrete approximation and the subsequent transition to the limit of the continuum coordinate. In doing so, we adhere to Tikhonov concept, where the discrete approximation is performed as a regularization of the ill-posed operator problem. While the continuum limit for the three-diagonal matrix Hamiltonian is impossible as such, following the Tikhonov procedure leads not to a limit for the potential matrix itself, but rather for a certain combination of the matrix elements, and this limit is precisely the desired potential in the continuum case.

AI.tldr: 本文基于离散近似与连续坐标极限，给出了Sturm-Liouville算子逆特征值问题主要公式的自洽推导，并遵循Tikhonov正则化思想处理该病态算子问题。
AI.motivation: 逆特征值问题（inverse eigenvalue problem）属病态（ill-posed）算子问题，直接求解存在困难，因此需要借助离散近似作为正则化手段，并厘清离散到连续极限的过渡方式。
AI.method: 采用Tikhonov概念，将离散近似作为病态算子问题的正则化（regularization）；对三对角矩阵哈密顿量（three-diagonal matrix Hamiltonian）进行离散化，随后取连续坐标极限（continuum coordinate limit）。
AI.result: 三对角矩阵哈密顿量的连续极限本身不存在；遵循Tikhonov步骤得到的并非势矩阵（potential matrix）自身的极限，而是矩阵元某一特定组合的极限。
AI.conclusion: 该矩阵元组合的极限恰好对应连续情形下所期望的势（potential），从而给出Sturm-Liouville算子逆特征值问题主要公式的自洽推导。

title: Vanishing Love Numbers of Kerr-Newman Black Holes
summary: Tidal Love numbers characterize the conservative response of compact objects to external perturbations and provide a powerful probe of their nature. While the static Love numbers of Schwarzschild, Kerr, and Reissner--Nordström black holes remarkably vanish, the tidal response of a generic Kerr--Newman black hole has remained unexplored due to the intrinsic coupling between gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations. Exploiting a recent breakthrough in the separability of these perturbations, we analytically determine the static tidal response of the most general stationary black hole in four-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell theory. For arbitrary multipole order, charge, and spin, we show that the entire matrix of conservative Love numbers vanishes, including the mixed gravito-electromagnetic couplings. We also compute the nonvanishing static dissipative response induced by frame dragging.

AI.tldr: 该论文解析求解了四维Einstein--Maxwell理论中最一般的Kerr--Newman黑洞的静态潮汐响应，证明其保守潮汐Love数矩阵（含引力-电磁混合耦合）整体为零，并计算了由参考系拖曳（frame dragging）引起的非零静态耗散响应。
AI.motivation: 潮汐Love数（tidal Love numbers）刻画致密天体对外部扰动的保守响应，是探测天体本质的有力工具；Schwarzschild、Kerr与Reissner--Nordström黑洞的静态Love数已知为零，但由于引力扰动与电磁扰动之间存在内禀耦合，一般Kerr--Newman黑洞的潮汐响应此前尚未被探索。
AI.method: 利用近期在引力与电磁扰动可分离性（separability）方面的突破，对四维Einstein--Maxwell理论中最一般的稳态黑洞进行解析计算，不受多极阶数（multipole order）、电荷与自旋取值的限制。
AI.result: 对任意多极阶数、电荷与自旋，保守Love数矩阵整体为零，其中包括引力-电磁混合耦合（mixed gravito-electromagnetic couplings）项；同时得到了由参考系拖曳（frame dragging）诱导的非零静态耗散响应（dissipative response）。
AI.conclusion: Kerr--Newman黑洞的静态保守潮汐响应完全消失这一性质可推广至最一般情形，而静态潮汐响应中的非零部分仅来自耗散效应，为以潮汐响应区分黑洞本质提供了理论依据。

title: Direct Observation of Chirality-Dependent Berry Curvature Dipole via Cross-Axial Nonlinear Hall Effect in Trigonal Te
summary: Quantum geometric quantities, such as Berry curvature (BC) and quantum metric, are known to govern the physical and topological properties of materials, making access to these quantities critically important for the comprehensive understanding of the materials. Chiral crystals offer a natural platform in which structural handedness can control quantum geometry and nonlinear transport, but direct experimental access to the quantum geometric quantities has remained elusive. Here, we show that trigonal tellurium (Te) hosts an enantiomer-dependent Berry curvature dipole (BCD) that can be accessed through the measurement of cross-axial nonlinear Hall effect (NHE), unlike previously studied in-plane configurations where the BCD contribution vanishes. Angle-resolved measurements on left- and right-handed Te devices reveal a second-order transverse response whose sign reverses with crystal chirality. The extracted cross-axial nonlinear susceptibility, $χ_{yxz}$, exceeds the in-plane susceptibility, $χ_{xxx}$, by more than two-folds, indicating a strong BCD-driven contribution. First-principles calculations attribute this behavior to a topologically nontrivial hedgehog-like BC texture near the H points and predict a BCD that reverses sign between opposite enantiomers, consistent with experiment. These results establish cross-axial nonlinear Hall transport as a symmetry-selective probe of chirality-controlled quantum geometry in tellurium and related chiral materials.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过交叉轴向非线性霍尔效应（cross-axial nonlinear Hall effect, NHE）测量，在三角相碲（trigonal tellurium, Te）中实现了对映体依赖的贝里曲率偶极（Berry curvature dipole, BCD）探测，建立了手性控制量子几何（quantum geometry）的对称选择性探针。
AI.motivation: 贝里曲率（Berry curvature）与量子度规（quantum metric）等量子几何量决定材料的物理与拓扑性质，但直接实验获取仍具挑战；手性晶体（chiral crystals）可借结构手性调控量子几何与非线性输运，而相关实验探测此前尚未实现。
AI.method: 采用角度分辨测量，对比左手与右手三角相碲器件的交叉轴向非线性霍尔响应；提取交叉轴向非线性极化率 χ_yxz 并与面内 χ_xxx 比较；结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）分析能带几何起源。
AI.result: 左手与右手碲器件呈现二阶横向响应，其符号随晶体手性反转；提取的 χ_yxz 超过面内 χ_xxx 两倍以上，表明存在强烈的 BCD 驱动贡献。第一性原理计算将之归因于 H 点附近拓扑非平庸的刺猬状贝里曲率织构（hedgehog-like BC texture），并预测相反对映体间 BCD 符号反转，与实验一致。
AI.conclusion: 交叉轴向非线性霍尔输运可作为手性调控量子几何的对称选择性探针，适用于碲及相关手性材料。

title: Retarded Green Function For Bopp--Podolsky Electrodynamics in Four-Dimensional De Sitter Spacetime
summary: We study classical Bopp--Podolsky (BP) electrodynamics on four-dimensional de Sitter spacetime, focusing on its transverse retarded Green function and gauge-invariant electromagnetic response. Because de Sitter spacetime is maximally symmetric, its vector Green functions admit a covariant expansion in a finite basis of invariant bitensors, with scalar coefficients depending only on the invariant separation. For conserved sources, the fourth-order field operator factorizes into Maxwell and massive-vector operators, yielding the BP retarded kernel as the difference of their transverse Green functions. Using the invariant bitensor decomposition, we reduce the propagator equations to a hypergeometric master equation and determine the distributional structure of its solution. The common leading short-distance singularity of the Maxwell and massive-vector sectors cancels, leaving a logarithmic master singularity and a softened vector-potential wavefront. After one curl, the gauge-invariant field-strength kernel contains a null-cone delta distribution and a regular timelike tail. The smooth Maxwell master tail is annihilated by the curl, so the interior electromagnetic tail is generated entirely by the massive sector. We also derive an exact horizon-regular static potential, demonstrate the cancellation of the Coulomb divergence, recover the flat-space BP potential, and formulate the generalized Gauss law. On global de Sitter spacetime, the compactness of the spatial sections requires the total charge to vanish; we implement this constraint using an antipodal charge configuration with smooth factorized initial data. The analysis is classical and does not assume a quantum Lee--Wick contour or a preferred de Sitter vacuum.

AI.tldr: 该文在四维德西特时空上研究经典Bopp--Podolsky电动力学，通过不变双张量分解将传播子方程化为超几何主方程，确定推迟格林函数的分布结构与规范不变电磁响应，并给出静态势、广义高斯定律及全局电荷约束。
AI.motivation: Bopp--Podolsky电动力学含四阶场算子，其在弯曲时空（尤其德西特时空）中的因果传播与规范不变响应结构尚需系统刻画。作者旨在不依赖量子Lee--Wick围道或特定德西特真空的前提下，给出经典层面的横向推迟格林函数与电磁尾部分析。
AI.method: 利用德西特时空的最大对称性，将矢量格林函数按不变双张量（invariant bitensors）有限基展开；对守恒源，四阶场算子因式分解为麦克斯韦算子与有质量矢量算子，BP推迟核表示为二者横向格林函数之差；再将传播子方程约化为超几何主方程并分析其解的分布结构。
AI.result: 麦克斯韦与有质量矢量两部分的共同短距领头奇异性相互抵消，仅余对数主奇异及软化的矢势波前；取一次旋度后，场强核含零锥delta分布与规则类时尾部。麦克斯韦主尾部被旋度湮灭，故内部电磁尾部完全由有质量部分生成。此外得到精确的地平线正则静态势，证明库仑发散抵消，恢复平直空间BP势，并建立广义高斯定律。在全局德西特时空上，空间截面的紧致性要求总电荷为零，借由带因子化光滑初值的对跖电荷构型实现。
AI.conclusion: 经典Bopp--Podolsky电动力学在德西特时空上的传播结构可由不变双张量分解与超几何主方程精确描述：短距奇异性抵消、场强核呈零锥delta加类时尾，电磁尾部来源可清晰归因于有质量扇区，且全局紧致性强制总电荷为零。

title: Finite temperature Fredholm determinants for dynamical correlation functions
summary: We study the long-time, large-distance asymptotics of finite-temperature dynamical Fredholm determinants using effective form factors. The method expresses these asymptotics as a functional of an effective phase shift. We determine its two branches on either side of a quadratic stationary point and the transition profile joining them. The profile is expressed through parabolic-cylinder functions. Its connection to the high-temperature Gaussian $β$ ensemble fixes the finite normalization, in agreement with an independent Riemann--Hilbert analysis. We also show that the leading exponential asymptotics suffice to recover the Euler-scale prediction of generalized hydrodynamics for the dynamical structure factor of hard rods.

AI.tldr: 该研究借助有效形状因子（effective form factors）刻画有限温度动力学 Fredholm 行列式的长时、大尺度渐近行为，并确定其在二次驻点两侧的两支渐近及过渡轮廓。
AI.motivation: 有限温度动力学 Fredholm 行列式的长时、大尺度渐近行为尚需系统性刻画，尤其是二次驻点附近的过渡结构及其归一化问题。
AI.method: 将渐近行为表示为有效相移（effective phase shift）的泛函，确定二次驻点两侧的两支解与连接它们的过渡轮廓，并以抛物柱函数（parabolic-cylinder functions）表达该轮廓。
AI.result: 过渡轮廓通过抛物柱函数表达；其与高温高斯 β 系综（Gaussian β ensemble）的联系确定了有限归一化，且与独立的 Riemann–Hilbert 分析一致；主导指数渐近足以恢复硬杆（hard rods）动力学结构因子的广义流体力学（generalized hydrodynamics）Euler 尺度预测。
AI.conclusion: 有效相移泛函方法可统一描述该行列式渐近的两支结构与过渡轮廓，并通过高斯 β 系综固定归一化；同时表明主导指数渐近已足以重现硬杆系统广义流体力学的 Euler 尺度预测。

title: Null-Energy Bounds on Photon-Orbit Instability in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity
summary: We derive a local upper bound on the coordinate-time Lyapunov exponent of unstable circular null orbits in static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity in $n\geq5$ dimensions with nonnegative Gauss--Bonnet coupling. On the regular Einstein branch, the tangential null energy condition suffices; no additional density-pressure inequality is required for the principal result. The bound retains the local matter-density contribution dictated by the field equations. Using the spherical mass relation, we express the departure of its dimensionless coefficient from the Einstein value $n-3$ in terms of the difference between the local density and the enclosed generalized Misner--Sharp mass per areal volume. This gives a sufficient density-contrast criterion for the Einstein optical bound to remain valid at nonzero coupling. Optical Gaussian curvature and tangential null convergence provide geometrical interpretations that distinguish radial tidal instability from the focusing of a null congruence. Vacuum solutions saturate the bound, while a Maxwell field with nonzero charge produces a strictly positive gap. The smooth Einstein limit and explicit vacuum and charged solutions provide consistency checks. A separate matter condition yields a density-free corollary. We also discuss consequences for strong-deflection lensing and test-field eikonal damping within their respective regimes of validity.

AI.tldr: 该文推导了高维静态球对称渐近平坦 Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中不稳定圆零轨道坐标时 Lyapunov 指数的局部上界，并给出其物理解释与充分判据。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于将爱因斯坦引力中已知的光学（Lyapunov／阴影）界推广至含非负 Gauss–Bonnet 耦合的高维情形，判定该界在非零耦合下是否仍然成立，并厘清所需物质条件。
AI.method: 采用局部几何与场方程分析：在正则爱因斯坦分支上，借助协变（切向）零能量条件与球对称质量关系，将无量纲系数的偏离表示为局部密度与广义 Misner–Sharp 质量每面积体积之差；辅以光学高斯曲率与零汇聚焦的几何诠释。
AI.result: 得到坐标时 Lyapunov 指数的局部上界，其保留场方程决定的物质密度项；偏离爱因斯坦值 n−3 的部分由密度差刻画，从而给出光学界在非零耦合下继续成立的密度对比充分判据。真空解饱和该界，含非零电荷的 Maxwell 场产生严格正间隙；另有一密度无关的推论。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet 修正对光学界的影响可由密度对比控制，并区分了径向潮汐不稳定性与零汇聚焦；平滑爱因斯坦极限及显式真空／带电解构成一致性检验，结果对强偏折透镜与检验场 eikonal 阻尼在各自适用范围内具有启示。

title: Atoms that Matter: Largest Materials Datasets Are 99% Redundant, and Local Chemistry Can Guide the Required 1%
summary: General-purpose machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) for materials are now trained on the order of $100$ million structures, assuming transferability requires such scale. We test this premise on OMat24, the largest available materials dataset, by training MACE models on subsets of $6.5$ million atoms, less than $1\%$ of OMat24, selected in three complementary ways: at random, by latent-space clustering of a pretrained MLFF (DIRECT), and by a new model-free method maximizing the diversity of discrete, interpretable local environments (EnvTok). All three models approach the full-data reference MACE-OMAT-0 model to within a few tens of $\mathrm{meV}/\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ in forces, and remain close to or exceed it on formation energies, elastic moduli, heat capacities, Li$^{+}$ migration barriers, and molecular-dynamics stability up to $3000\,$K and $500\,$GPa. This near-independence from the selection strategy shows that chemical environment diversity, not size, defines OMat24's information content: the remaining $99\%$ of structures are largely redundant. Broad sampling of chemical space thus remains essential, but reference labels are needed only for structurally and chemically distinct configurations. Using atomic positions and species, optionally augmented by magnetic moments, EnvTok identifies these before any labelling or training, yielding compact, architecture-independent datasets. This hundredfold reduction makes hybrid-DFT or higher-level relabelling of general-purpose training sets feasible, and frees computational budget for extending environmental coverage and multi-fidelity learning.

AI.tldr: 在 OMat24 数据集上验证“通用机器学习力场（MLFF）需上亿结构”的前提：仅用 650 万原子（不足 1%）训练的 MACE 模型在力、能量及多种性质上接近或超越全量数据参考模型，表明决定信息量的是化学环境多样性而非数据规模。
AI.motivation: 当前通用材料机器学习力场普遍假设可迁移性需要约 1 亿结构的训练规模，作者旨在检验这一前提是否成立，即数据规模是否为可迁移性的必要条件。
AI.method: 在 OMat24（现有最大材料数据集）上，按三种互补方式选取 650 万原子子集：随机采样、基于预训练 MLFF 潜空间聚类的 DIRECT、以及新提出的无模型方法 EnvTok（最大化离散可解释局域环境的多样性），并以此训练 MACE 模型；EnvTok 仅使用原子位置与种类，可选加入磁矩。
AI.result: 三种子集模型在力的误差上均逼近全量参考模型 MACE-OMAT-0（差距在数十 meV/Å 内），并在形成能、弹性模量、热容、Li⁺ 迁移势垒以及最高 3000 K 和 500 GPa 的分子动力学稳定性上接近或超过该参考模型；对选择策略近乎不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 化学环境多样性而非规模决定 OMat24 的信息含量，剩余 99% 结构基本冗余；广泛采样化学空间仍必要，但参考标签只需覆盖结构与化学上不同的构型。EnvTok 可在标注与训练前识别这些构型，生成紧凑且与架构无关的数据集，百倍缩减使混合 DFT 或更高层级的重标注成为可能，并释放算力用于扩展环境覆盖与多保真学习。

title: Dalitz plot binning optimization for the model-independent measurement of the CKM angle $β$ with $B^0 \to D π^+ π^-$, $D \to K_S^0 π^+ π^-$ decays
comment: 23 pages, 12 figures, 5 tables. Machine-readable nominal TD binning and a Python reader are included as ancillary files
summary: A model-independent measurement of the CKM angle $β$ can be performed using a time-dependent analysis of $B^0 \to D π^+ π^-$, $D \to K_S^0 π^+ π^-$ decays, where the Dalitz plots of both the $B$ and $D$ decays are divided into bins. The choice of binning scheme for the $B^0 \to D π^+ π^-$ Dalitz plot directly impacts the statistical sensitivity to $β$. This paper presents an optimization of this binning using a Fisher information-based quality factor $Q^2$ and simulated annealing. The optimized binning improves the sensitivity to $β$ by approximately $10\%$ relative to the equal-phase-difference baseline, as validated by toy Monte Carlo studies without experimental effects. The robustness of this improvement against decay time acceptance, Dalitz plot efficiency, Dalitz plot resolution, and background contributions is also assessed.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对 $B^0 \to D\pi^+\pi^-$、$D\to K_S^0\pi^+\pi^-$ 衰变中模型无关测量 CKM 角 $\beta$ 的分箱方案进行优化，采用基于 Fisher 信息（Fisher information）的品质因子 $Q^2$ 与模拟退火（simulated annealing）方法，使 $\beta$ 的敏感度相对等相位差基线提升约 10%。
AI.motivation: $B^0 \to D\pi^+\pi^-$ 与 $D\to K_S^0\pi^+\pi^-$ 的 Dalitz 图分箱方案会直接影响对 CKM 角 $\beta$ 的统计敏感度，因此需要针对该分箱进行优化以提升测量精度。
AI.method: 采用基于 Fisher 信息（Fisher information）的品质因子 $Q^2$，结合模拟退火（simulated annealing）算法对 $B^0 \to D\pi^+\pi^-$ Dalitz 图的分箱方案进行优化，并通过无实验效应的玩具蒙特卡洛（toy Monte Carlo）研究进行验证。
AI.result: 优化后的分箱方案相对等相位差（equal-phase-difference）基线将对 $\beta$ 的敏感度提升约 10%；在无实验效应的玩具蒙特卡洛研究中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究进一步评估了该改进在衰变时间接受度（decay time acceptance）、Dalitz 图效率（Dalitz plot efficiency）、Dalitz 图分辨率（Dalitz plot resolution）以及本底贡献（background contributions）等实验效应下的稳健性。

title: A first order nonabelian antisymmetric tensor model with hidden higher symmetry
summary: We present a nonabelian complex self-dual antisymmetric tensor model, with gauged internal symmetry, comprising a complex multiplet of massless self-dual antisymmetric tensor fields and its conjugate (interacting with massless Yang-Mills gauge fields). We build the model at the classical level, via a first order formulation, assigning local fields to a component expansion over the Dirac algebra and a basis of internal matrices, with Lorentz and gauge invariance ensured by tracing, and applying an appropriate bilinear form. The full expansion requires auxiliary place-holder fields, which are not potentials, but become curvatures (field strengths) after elimination via their algebraic equations of motion. The component expansion over the Dirac algebra is closed under multiplication by additional internal matrices, which are not gauge group generators, but mix internal components, and link auxiliary curvatures with potentials. The model is shown to be invariant under such transformations, and thus possesses a type of hidden internal symmetry. We analyze the specific case of gauge group $SU(2)\! \times \! U(1)$, and as higher symmetry candidates, we consider both the Lie group $SU(3)$ and the Lie superalgebra $SU(2/1)$ (with the additional matrices acting via Lie brackets, or graded Lie brackets, respectively).

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个非阿贝尔（nonabelian）复自对偶反对称张量模型（complex self-dual antisymmetric tensor model），在经典层面通过一阶形式（first order formulation）建立，并揭示其隐藏的内部对称性，进而讨论 SU(2)×U(1)、SU(3) 与 SU(2/1) 等更高对称性候选。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在建立一个带内部规范对称性（gauged internal symmetry）的复自对偶反对称张量场模型，将无质量自对偶张量场多重态及其共轭与无质量杨-米尔斯规范场（Yang-Mills gauge fields）耦合，以探索此类模型中潜在的隐藏内部对称性及更高对称性结构。
AI.method: 采用一阶形式（first order formulation），在狄拉克代数（Dirac algebra）与内部矩阵基上做分量展开，通过求迹及适当的双线性形式（bilinear form）保证洛伦兹与规范不变性；引入辅助占位场（auxiliary place-holder fields），它们经代数运动方程消去后化为曲率（场强）；并利用非规范群生成元的额外内部矩阵（经李括号或分级李括号作用）研究该展开的乘法封闭性。
AI.result: 模型在经典层面被成功构造，其分量展开在额外内部矩阵乘法下封闭，这些矩阵混合内部分量并将辅助曲率与势场联系起来；模型在该变换下不变，因而具有一类隐藏内部对称性。文中分析了规范群 SU(2)×U(1) 的具体情形，并考察了李群 SU(3) 与李超代数 SU(2/1) 作为更高对称性候选。
AI.conclusion: 所构造的非阿贝尔复自对偶反对称张量模型展现出隐藏内部对称性；额外内部矩阵以李括号（Lie brackets）或分级李括号（graded Lie brackets）方式作用，使 SU(3) 与李超代数 SU(2/1) 成为更高对称性的候选，为后续推广提供了框架。

title: Computation of unknotting numbers: which knot breaks the Bernhard-Jablan Conjecture
summary: We determine $2,540$ unknotting numbers of prime knots with at most $13$ crossings, that are unknown in the KnotInfo snapshot of 9 September 2026. The lower-bound calculations use Heegaard Floer correction-term obstructions and Greene's spanning-tree model. We also give explicit crossing-change constructions for upper bounds. For $959$ alternating knots with range $[2,3]$, we verify that no crossing change in a minimal diagram gives a knot of unknotting number one. We determine the unknotting numbers of all four knots in Brittenham and Hermiller's construction and thereby identify 13n3370 as an explicit counterexample to the original Bernhard-Jablan conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本工作利用 Heegaard Floer 修正项障碍与 Greene 生成树模型给出下界，并结合显式交叉变换构造上界，确定了 KnotInfo（2026年9月9日快照）中缺失的 2,540 个最多 13 交叉素纽结的解结数（unknotting number）。
AI.motivation: KnotInfo 快照中仍存在大量最多 13 交叉素纽结的解结数未知，同时原始 Bernhard-Jablan 猜想（Bernhard-Jablan conjecture）需要具体反例检验，因此有必要系统计算这些未知值并验证相关猜想构造。
AI.method: 下界计算采用 Heegaard Floer 修正项障碍（correction-term obstructions）与 Greene 的生成树模型（spanning-tree model）；上界通过显式交叉变换（crossing-change）构造给出。对 959 个交叉变换范围在 [2,3] 的交错纽结（alternating knots），逐一检验其极小图中不存在可得到解结数为 1 纽结的交叉变换。
AI.result: 确定了 2,540 个此前未知的解结数；对 959 个交错纽结验证了极小图内无交叉变换产生解结数为 1 的纽结；确定了 Brittenham-Hermiller 构造中全部四个纽结的解结数。
AI.conclusion: 综合结果将 13n3370 识别为原始 Bernhard-Jablan 猜想的一个显式反例（counterexample），为解结数的计算与相关猜想提供了新的证据。

title: Einstein Telescope: the triangle in a network and the impact of the relative orientation of detectors
summary: The geometrical configuration of the Einstein Telescope (ET) gravitational-wave observatory is one the most important design choices to be made for this future scientific facility. Two baseline configurations are currently being considered, a single triangle or 2 distant L-shaped detectors tilted by about $45^{\circ}$. In this document we present a study of the scientific performance of the ET baseline configurations in both stand-alone mode and in the presence of either an L-shaped Cosmic Explorer detector with 40-km long arms located in the United States or the existing LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA network. We also include in the study an alternative ET configuration, which is currently not being considered and consists of a triangle plus a distant L-shaped detector. We find that in stand-alone mode this alternative configuration performs significantly better than the other two in both the compact binary coalescence and stochastic gravitational wave background scientific cases. The differences in performance between the ET configurations are reduced in the presence of the considered, additional non-ET detectors. We also show that the impact of possible correlated noise in co-located detectors on the stochastic gravitational-wave background performance can be addressed with the addition of extra detectors. Finally, we study the impact on the ET scientific performance of the relative orientation of the future detectors in the network. We find that, while the configurations that include a triangular ET detector are basically insensitive to this orientation, a balanced compromise for the ET configuration consisting of two L-shaped detectors could be represented by a tilt angle between the two detectors of about $30^{\circ}$.

AI.tldr: 该文评估了爱因斯坦望远镜（Einstein Telescope, ET）不同几何构型在独立运行及与外部探测器联合组网下的科学性能，发现“三角形加远程L形”这一替代构型在独立模式下表现最佳。
AI.motivation: ET的几何构型是其未来科学设施最重要的设计选择之一，当前有两种基线方案（单一三角形，或两个相距较远、倾斜约45°的L形探测器），需系统评估其科学性能以支撑设计决策。
AI.method: 在独立运行模式（stand-alone mode）下，以及与位于美国、臂长40公里的L形宇宙探索者（Cosmic Explorer）或现有LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA网络联合的情形下，比较ET基线构型的科学性能；同时纳入一种当前未被考虑的替代构型（三角形加远程L形探测器），并考察相关噪声（correlated noise）与探测器相对取向的影响。
AI.result: 在独立模式下，替代构型在致密双星并合（compact binary coalescence）与随机引力波背景（stochastic gravitational wave background）两类科学目标上均显著优于其他两种构型；引入额外非ET探测器后，各构型性能差异缩小。协同定位探测器中可能的关联噪声对随机引力波背景性能的影响，可通过增加额外探测器加以缓解。
AI.conclusion: 含三角形ET探测器的构型对网络内探测器相对取向基本不敏感；而由两个L形探测器构成的ET构型，其两探测器间约30°的倾斜角可视为一种平衡的折中方案。

title: Biomolecular condensates and their pathologies: A colloidal, interfacial, and transport perspective
summary: Biomolecular condensates are micron-scale, membraneless compartments that concentrate proteins and nucleic acids by liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Condensates play critical roles in transcription, mRNA metabolism, stress responses, and signaling across the cell, with their dysregulation increasingly correlated with several pathologies spanning neurodegeneration, cancer, cardiometabolic disease, and viral infections. The emergent biology of condensates can be cohesively viewed through the framework of colloidal, interfacial, and transport phenomena. Here we review the condensate literature through this joint lens, treating each condensate as a biological colloid whose behavior is captured by four measurable physical quantities: a Flory--Huggins interaction parameter that determines whether the dense phase forms at all, a partition coefficient that dictates the degree of client molecule accumulation, a viscoelastic relaxation time that sets whether the dense phase responds as a liquid or a solid, and an interfacial tension that governs droplet shape and interfacial dynamics. Each quantity is traced to its physical origin, its measured range in biological condensates, and the techniques that quantify it, for both three-dimensional droplets and two-dimensional membrane-tethered condensates. Interpreting disease as the displacement of these physical quantities from their functional ranges, we reorganize condensate pathologies into a small set of physical failure modes --- saturation concentration dysregulation, aberrant aging and liquid-to-solid transitions, disrupted partitioning, interfacial aggregation, and pathogen hijacking --- and show how the same parameters become design variables for condensate-targeted drugs and engineered coacervate delivery vehicles. The review concludes with open questions at the interface of condensate biology and colloidal and interfacial science.

AI.tldr: 该综述以胶体、界面与输运现象的联合视角审视生物分子凝聚体（biomolecular condensates），将其视为可通过四个可测物理量刻画的生物胶体（biological colloid），并据此把凝聚体相关疾病重组为若干物理失效模式，同时把同一参数视为药物设计与工程化递送载体的设计变量。
AI.motivation: 凝聚体通过液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation, LLPS）浓缩蛋白质与核酸，在转录、mRNA代谢、应激反应与信号传导中起关键作用，其失调与神经退行性变、癌症、心血管代谢疾病及病毒感染等多种病理相关。将凝聚体的涌现生物学统一到胶体、界面与输运框架下，有助于跨领域理解并加以干预。
AI.method: 采用综述方法，以胶体、界面与输运现象的联合视角统摄凝聚体文献，把每个凝聚体视为生物胶体，用四个可测物理量来刻画：决定稠密相能否形成的Flory--Huggins相互作用参数、决定客分子累积程度的分割系数（partition coefficient）、设定稠密相呈液态或固态响应的黏弹性弛豫时间（viscoelastic relaxation time），以及支配液滴形状与界面动力学的界面张力（interfacial tension）。对每个物理量，追溯其物理来源、在生物凝聚体中的测量范围及量化技术，并同时涵盖三维液滴与二维膜锚定凝聚体。
AI.result: 将疾病解释为上述物理量偏离其功能范围，据此把凝聚体病理重组为少量物理失效模式：饱和浓度失调、异常老化与液-固转变（liquid-to-solid transitions）、分割异常、界面聚集以及病原体劫持（pathogen hijacking）；并显示同一参数可作为凝聚体靶向药物与工程化凝聚层递送载体的设计变量。
AI.conclusion: 综述在结尾提出凝聚体生物学与胶体及界面科学交叉界面上的开放问题。

title: Conserved-charge diffusion in hot and dense QCD matter
comment: 11 pages, 7 captioned figures. Submitted for publication
summary: We study the coupled diffusion of baryon number, electric charge, and strangeness in hot and dense quark matter using a three-flavor Nambu-Jona-Lasinio model with self-consistently generated constituent quark masses. The complete diffusion matrix is evaluated within a relaxation-time kinetic approach, including its diagonal and off-diagonal components. We find that the off-diagonal transport coefficients exhibit distinct temperature and baryon-chemical-potential dependence associated with the flavor-dependent composition of the charge carriers. We further investigate generalized charge diffusivities and mobilities obtained from the corresponding susceptibilities. At finite baryon chemical potential, the baryon and strangeness mobility scales cross, reflecting the different density dependence of their transport coefficients and susceptibilities. The results provide model benchmarks for coupled conserved-charge transport in baryon-rich QCD matter.

AI.tldr: 该文在热密夸克物质（quark matter）中，采用三味 Nambu-Jona-Lasinio（NJL）模型与弛豫时间近似（relaxation-time kinetic approach），系统计算重子数、电荷与奇异数（baryon number, electric charge, strangeness）的耦合扩散（coupled diffusion）系数矩阵，并给出模型基准结果。
AI.motivation: 重子数、电荷与奇异数在重子富集（baryon-rich）QCD 物质中同时守恒，其相互耦合的输运行为对理解致密星体与重离子碰撞中的扩散过程具有重要意义，但目前缺乏基于自洽组分夸克质量的系统性模型基准。
AI.method: 使用带自洽生成组分夸克质量（constituent quark masses）的三味 NJL 模型，在弛豫时间近似动力学框架下计算完整扩散矩阵（diffusion matrix），包含对角与非对角输运系数，并结合相应磁化率（susceptibility）推导广义电荷扩散率（diffusivities）与迁移率（mobilities）。
AI.result: 非对角输运系数（off-diagonal transport coefficients）随温度与重子化学势（baryon-chemical-potential）呈现与载流子（charge carriers）味相关组分有关的明显依赖性；在有限重子化学势下，重子迁移率与奇异数迁移率曲线出现交叉，反映其输运系数与磁化率的密度依赖差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果为重子富集 QCD 物质中守恒荷耦合输运（coupled conserved-charge transport）提供模型基准，并揭示非对角输运与迁移率交叉等需在微观输运模拟中加以考虑的特征。

title: Regular-Zero Drinfeld-Sokolov Charges in Doubled Four-Dimensional Chern-Simons Theory
summary: We study classical local conserved charges obtained after finite-defect reduction of doubled four-dimensional Chern--Simons theory. At a finite simple zero, the inhomogeneous derivative term in the affine gauge transformation induced by the twist function vanishes, so the residue evaluations of the two Gaudin currents transform by the ordinary adjoint action. For each simple ideal, we use the Evans-compatible invariant tensors of the principal Drinfeld--Sokolov hierarchy as external algebraic input, construct local circle integrals, and treat the same-zero, distinct-zero, and mixed sectors separately, proving pairwise Poisson commutativity. Under the explicit assumptions of Stedman's simple-pole/simple-zero boundary Hamiltonian, the periodic trivial-monodromy sector, and boundary weights independent of phase-space variables, the reduced Hamiltonian decomposes term by term into finite-pole, infinity, finite-zero, and residual first-class-constraint contributions, which yields conservation of the constructed charges. We distinguish the finite-defect reduced space, the extended space carrying the residual constraint, and the physical quotient. The result is a conditional existence statement for a classical local Abelian Poisson subalgebra; we make no claim of functional independence, maximality, or Liouville completeness. Extensions to higher-order zeros and nontrivial monodromy sectors are outside the scope of this work.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双倍四维 Chern--Simons 理论（doubled four-dimensional Chern--Simons theory）在有限缺陷约化（finite-defect reduction）后所得的经典局部守恒荷（classical local conserved charges），在特定边界与单值性假设下证明其构成一个条件性的局部阿贝尔泊松子代数（local Abelian Poisson subalgebra）。
AI.motivation: 目标是在有限缺陷约化框架下识别可证明两两泊松对易（pairwise Poisson commutativity）的局部守恒荷，从而为经典可积结构提供一个严格但受限的存在性结论。
AI.method: 利用扭转函数（twist function）诱导的仿射规范变换（affine gauge transformation），在有限单零点处非齐次导数项消失使两个 Gaudin 流（Gaudin currents）的留数计算按普通伴随作用（adjoint action）变换；对每个单理想（simple ideal），以主 Drinfeld--Sokolov 层级（principal Drinfeld--Sokolov hierarchy）的 Evans 相容不变张量（Evans-compatible invariant tensors）作为外部代数输入，构造局部圆周积分（local circle integrals），并分同零点、异零点与混合扇区（same-zero, distinct-zero, mixed sectors）讨论，证明两两泊松对易。
AI.result: 在 Stedman 单极点/单零点边界哈密顿量（simple-pole/simple-zero boundary Hamiltonian）、周期平凡单值性扇区（periodic trivial-monodromy sector）与边界权重不依赖相空间变量这三个显式假设下，约化哈密顿量（reduced Hamiltonian）逐项分解为有限极点、无穷远、有限零点及剩余第一类约束（residual first-class-constraint）贡献，由此得到所构造荷的守恒性；同时区分有限缺陷约化空间（finite-defect reduced space）、承载剩余约束的扩展空间（extended space）与物理商空间（physical quotient）。
AI.conclusion: 结论是关于经典局部阿贝尔泊松子代数的一个条件性存在陈述；作者明确不主张函数独立性（functional independence）、极大性（maximality）或 Liouville 完备性（Liouville completeness），并将高阶零点与非平凡单值性扇区的推广排除在本工作范围之外。

title: Spacetimes of maximal proper acceleration and muon mean lifetime
summary: In this paper, it is shown that in spacetimes of maximal proper acceleration, there is a reduction of the mean lifetime of the muon. We consider several candidates for the maximal proper acceleration. For all of them, the induced corrections are small, but for the case when the maximal proper acceleration is identified with the Schwinger's acceleration, the effect is detectable in future muon collider facilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，在具有最大固有加速度（maximal proper acceleration）的时空中，μ子（muon）的平均寿命会缩短；作者考察了若干最大固有加速度候选值，修正总体很小，但当其取为施温格加速度（Schwinger's acceleration）时，该效应在未来μ子对撞机（muon collider）设施中可被探测。
AI.motivation: 论文动机在于探讨最大固有加速度这一时空假设对粒子寿命的物理后果，并为可能的实验检验寻找可行途径，特别是评估该效应能否在现有或未来实验条件下被发现。
AI.method: 方法上，作者在最大固有加速度时空框架内分析μ子平均寿命的变化，并选取多个最大固有加速度候选值，逐一计算由此诱导的寿命修正量及其可探测性。
AI.result: 结果显示，对所列各候选最大固有加速度，诱导的寿命修正均较小；但若将最大固有加速度取为施温格加速度，则该效应对应的修正可在未来的μ子对撞机设施中被探测到。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明，最大固有加速度时空中存在μ子寿命缩短效应；该效应在一般情况下微弱，而施温格加速度情形提供了未来μ子对撞机实验检验该理论的潜在窗口。

title: Mathematical framework for simulation of non-perturbative cavity optomechanics with plate-like dielectrics
summary: Cavity optomechanical models typically treat a sensor either as a perturbative polarizable object in a pre-existing optical field, or solve the field at a fixed equilibrium and linearize in a fixed optical-mode basis. Neither self-consistently determines the spatially resolved cavity field, the optical force, the mechanical equilibrium, and the back-action when a finite-thickness dielectric plate intercepts the entire optical mode and restructures the intracavity field. In this companion paper to [1], we develop that treatment by extending the vacuum two-photon formalism to finite-thickness planar dielectrics, incorporating their Fresnel reflection, internal propagation, optical forces, and mechanical back-action directly into the field equations. We derive the carrier and sideband transfer functions needed to describe the coupled optical-mechanical system, including optomechanical cooling and the response to external perturbations. The result is a systematic starting point for calculating detector response and noise budgets for cavity experiments with intracavity dielectrics, including gravitational wave detectors deploying levitated sensors.

AI.tldr: 该论文将真空双光子形式（vacuum two-photon formalism）推广至有限厚度平面介质（finite-thickness planar dielectrics），自洽地描述腔内介质与光场的耦合光机系统，为含腔内介质（如悬浮传感器）的腔实验提供探测器响应与噪声预算的计算框架。
AI.motivation: 现有腔光机模型（cavity optomechanical models）存在两类不足：或将传感器视为预先存在光场中的微扰极化物体，或在固定平衡态下求解场并在固定光模基（optical-mode basis）中线性化。二者均未自洽地确定有限厚度介质板截断整个光模并重构腔内场时的空间分辨腔场、光力、机械平衡与背作用（back-action）。
AI.method: 作为文献[1]的姊妹论文，将真空双光子形式（vacuum two-photon formalism）推广至有限厚度平面介质（finite-thickness planar dielectrics），把菲涅耳反射（Fresnel reflection）、内部传播、光力与机械背作用（mechanical back-action）直接纳入场方程，并推导描述耦合光机系统所需的载波与边带传递函数（carrier and sideband transfer functions）。
AI.result: 推导出描述耦合光机系统（coupled optical-mechanical system）的载波与边带传递函数，可涵盖光机冷却（optomechanical cooling）以及对外部微扰的响应。
AI.conclusion: 该处理为计算含腔内介质（intracavity dielectrics）的腔实验中的探测器响应与噪声预算（noise budgets）提供了系统性的起点，应用场景包括部署悬浮传感器（levitated sensors）的引力波探测器（gravitational wave detectors）。

title: Pre-pairing and polarization of doped charge carriers in unconventional superconductors
summary: Based on first principles calculations, we show in hole-doped La2-xSrxCuO4, the Sr dopants prefer to form dimers, rather than be isolated as generally believed. Same trend applies to other superconductors such as Na-doped Ca2CuO2Cl2, and electron type Nd2-xCexCuO4. The dimer structure makes the two doped holes (electrons) bound up and form a singlet which is also polarized. Another type of dopant in cuprates is oxygen which behaves similarly. So, we propose that, for all oxide high TC superconductors, the holes (electrons) are pre-paired (Z-pairs) during the preparation of the superconductor. The spontaneously formed Z-pairs are conceptually different from not only the Cooper pairs, but also the Zhang-Rice singlets. The attraction force in a Z-pair originates basically from the strong antiferromagnetic exchange energy. We also found that the on-site Coulomb repulsion (U) is no longer a constant due to doping. Around a doping site, U can reduce its value discontinuously, which plays a key role in stabilizing the Z-pairs against isolated holes (electrons). A Z-pair is a p-wave like localized state which breaks the symmetry of the CuO2 plain and attracts each other along the direction perpendicular to the polarization. The Z-pairs may be popular in all of the unconventional superconductors and the periodic assembly can result in the emergence of coherence states and superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 基于第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），该工作提出空穴掺杂铜氧化物（cuprates）中的掺杂剂倾向于形成二聚体（dimer），使两个掺杂载流子预先配对为 Z-pair，其吸引力源于强反铁磁交换能（antiferromagnetic exchange energy），并可能普遍存在于非常规超导体（unconventional superconductors）中。
AI.motivation: 通常认为掺杂剂在铜氧化物中孤立分布，而掺杂载流子的配对机制多被归结为库珀对（Cooper pairs）或 Zhang-Rice 单态（Zhang-Rice singlets）。该文旨在从第一性原理出发重新审视掺杂剂的分布形态及其与超导电性起源的关系。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），考察空穴掺杂的 La2-xSrxCuO4，并对比 Na 掺杂 Ca2CuO2Cl2 与电子型 Nd2-xCexCuO4，以及氧掺杂铜氧化物中掺杂剂的行为。
AI.result: Sr 掺杂剂倾向形成二聚体（dimer），两个掺杂空穴（电子）被束缚为极化的单态；该二聚体结构使载流子预先配对（Z-pairs），其吸引力主要来自强反铁磁交换能。此外，在位库仑排斥（on-site Coulomb repulsion, U）因掺杂而非常数，在掺杂位点附近可发生不连续降低，从而稳定 Z-pair。Z-pair 为类 p 波（p-wave like）局域态，破坏 CuO2 面的对称性。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出在氧化物高温超导体（oxide high TC superconductors）制备过程中，空穴（电子）即已预先配对为 Z-pair，其概念上不同于库珀对（Cooper pairs）与 Zhang-Rice 单态。Z-pair 可能在所有非常规超导体（unconventional superconductors）中普遍存在，其周期性组装可导致相干态（coherence states）与超导电性的出现。

title: Event Generation for Neutrino and Muon DIS at the LHC
summary: Neutrinos and muons produced in the forward direction of LHC collisions and detected by the FASER and SND@LHC experiments enable a comprehensive deep-inelastic scattering (DIS) programme, covering both neutral and charged currents, at TeV energies. This programme aims to provide stringent constraints on proton and nuclear structure as well as on hadron fragmentation, and to offer novel insight into neutrino interactions at the highest energies achieved in a laboratory. Realising this potential requires accurate and precise simulations of neutral- and charged-current DIS. We systematically compare the predictions of NLO general-purpose Monte Carlo (MC) event generators for neutrino- and muon-initiated DIS at the LHC (Sherpa, Herwig7, and POWHEG) against analytical structure-function calculations (YADISM) and dedicated neutrino simulation packages (GENIE, NuWro, GiBUU). Within this framework, we quantify the role of higher-order QCD corrections, (nuclear) parton distribution functions (PDFs), parton shower and hadronisation modelling, and QED radiation both for inclusive observables and for the FASER fiducial selections. We also present representative applications to the FASER neutrino programme: comparisons with its most recent data from the emulsion and electronic sub-detectors, a study of strange PDF sensitivity in the dimuon final state, and predictions for charged-hadron production in semi-inclusive DIS. Our analysis highlights the agreement of modern event generators for inclusive and differential DIS observables once common settings are adopted, while differences remain for observables sensitive to the hadronic final state.

AI.tldr: 该文系统比较了多种中微子与缪子深度非弹性散射（DIS）模拟工具（NLO蒙特卡洛事件发生器、解析结构函数计算与专用中微子模拟包）在LHC前向FASER/SND@LHC实验条件下的预测，量化了高阶QCD修正、PDF、部分子簇射与强子化、QED辐射等因素的作用，并给出对FASER中微子项目的代表性应用。
AI.motivation: LHC前向产生并由FASER与SND@LHC探测的中微子和缪子，为在TeV能区开展覆盖中性流与带电流的深度非弹性散射（deep-inelastic scattering, DIS）研究提供了条件，可对质子与核结构、强子碎裂（hadron fragmentation）及最高实验室能量下的中微子相互作用给出严格约束。实现该潜力需要精确可靠的模拟，因此有必要系统评估现有模拟工具的预测差异。
AI.method: 将NLO通用蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo, MC）事件发生器（Sherpa、Herwig7、POWHEG）对中微子与缪子引发的DIS的预测，与解析结构函数计算（YADISM）及专用中微子模拟包（GENIE、NuWro、GiBUU）进行系统对比。在统一框架内量化高阶QCD修正、（核）部分子分布函数（(nuclear) parton distribution functions, PDF）、部分子簇射（parton shower）与强子化建模、QED辐射对包容性观测量及FASER基准选择的影响。
AI.result: 在采用共同设置后，现代事件发生器对包容性与微分DIS观测量的预测总体一致；而对强子末态敏感的观测量仍存在差异。文中还给出若干代表性应用：与FASER乳胶及电子子探测器最新数据的比较、双缪子末态中奇异PDF（strange PDF）敏感性的研究，以及半包容DIS中带电强子产额的预测。
AI.conclusion: 该比较框架表明，统一设置下各事件发生器对包容性与微分DIS结果具有良好一致性，但强子末态相关观测量仍需进一步研究。这些结果为FASER中微子物理项目及相关结构函数、碎裂与中微子相互作用研究提供了模拟层面的参考依据。

title: A No-Go Theorem for Nonspherical Bounces with a Single Negative Mode
summary: False vacuum decay is conventionally described by a spherically symmetric bounce with a single negative fluctuation mode. This raises a fundamental question: can the single negative mode requirement itself enforce spherical symmetry, independently of action minimization? For a single real scalar field with a smooth potential in flat spacetime, we rigorously prove that every localized nonspherical saddle with zero initial velocity has at least three negative modes. Additional reflection symmetries further tighten these bounds, as illustrated in a sextic scalar model. Our findings exclude nonspherical bounce candidates with a single negative mode, providing a complementary spectral foundation for the spherical bounce description of false vacuum decay.

AI.tldr: 该文严格证明：在平直时空（flat spacetime）中，对具有光滑势（smooth potential）的单个实标量场（real scalar field），任何零初速的定域非球对称鞍点（localized nonspherical saddle）至少具有三个负模（negative modes），从而排除仅含单一负模的非球对称 bounce 候选解。
AI.motivation: 传统假真空衰变（false vacuum decay）由具单负模的球对称 bounce 描述，由此引出根本性问题：单负模要求本身能否在作用量最小化（action minimization）之外独立地强制球对称性。该研究旨在从谱性质角度回答此问题，为球对称 bounce 提供补充性的谱基础。
AI.method: 研究对象为平直时空中具光滑势的单个实标量场。作者对零初速（zero initial velocity）的定域非球对称鞍点进行严格的负模计数证明，并考察额外反射对称性（reflection symmetries）对负模下界的进一步收紧；以六次标量模型（sextic scalar model）作为示例说明。
AI.result: 证明每个零初速的定域非球对称鞍点至少存在三个负模；附加反射对称性可使该下界进一步收紧，并在六次标量模型中给出具体示例。据此，具单一负模的非球对称 bounce 候选解被排除。
AI.conclusion: 单负模要求在非球对称鞍点上无法成立，球对称 bounce 描述由此获得独立于作用量最小化的互补谱学支撑。该结果不依赖作用量最小化论证，构成对假真空衰变球对称图像的光谱学基础补充。

title: Predictive Holonomy and Minimal Completion of Coarse Dynamics
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures; ancillary symbolic and numerical verification code included
summary: A coarse description of a dynamical system generally fails to evolve autonomously: evolving and coarse-graining in different orders gives different predictions, and the compressed propagator fails the semigroup law. We show that this path dependence is the observable boundary of missing state. For a finite continuous-time Markov chain with generator $L$, coarse channel $C$, and stochastic section $R$ satisfying $CR=I$, define $P=RC$, $Q=I-P$, and $K=CLR$. The exact coarse propagator $T_t=C\mathrm{e}^{tL}R$ obeys a Volterra equation with memory kernel $\mathcal{M}(t)=CLQ\,\mathrm{e}^{tQLQ}\,QLR$. Every memory jet $\mathcal{M}^{(k)}(0)$ is recursively recoverable from the short-time derivatives of $T_t$ alone. The rank of the block Hankel operator $\mathbb{H}_{\infty}=(\mathcal{M}^{(i+j)}(0))_{i,j\geq 0}$ is exactly the smallest number of auxiliary linear state variables required to turn the coarse dynamics into an exact autonomous, time-homogeneous system. A minimal completion is constructible by Ho--Kalman factorization and is unique up to similarity. If $d=\min\{k:\mathcal{M}^{(k)}(0)\neq 0\}$, then every smooth classical $f$-divergence generically scales as $t^{2d+4}$. Exact Markov examples realize exponents $4,6,8$ and closure ranks $1,2,3$. We also derive finite-sample singular-value certificates for hidden predictive coordinates, including a matrix-Bernstein bound with intrinsic-variance control. Finally, histories are identified when they induce the same future law under every admissible intervention, yielding the minimal counterfactual predictive state. The results turn coarse-graining into a constructive state-completion problem and separate ordinary linear realization from the harder requirement of a positive or Markov realization.

AI.tldr: 该文证明粗粒化（coarse-graining）导致的路径依赖与半群律失效，本质上是"缺失状态"的可观测边界；通过 Volterra 记忆核与块 Hankel 算子的秩，量化并构造性补全使粗粒动力学恢复为精确自治系统的辅助状态变量。
AI.motivation: 粗描述的动力系统通常无法自治演化：不同顺序的演化与粗粒化会给出不同预测，压缩传播子也不满足半群律（semigroup law）。作者希望说明这种路径依赖并非技术缺陷，而是缺失状态的观测表现。
AI.method: 针对有限连续时间马尔可夫链（continuous-time Markov chain），取生成元 $L$、粗通道 $C$ 与随机截面 $R$（满足 $CR=I$），定义 $P=RC$、$Q=I-P$、$K=CLR$；推导精确粗传播子 $T_t=Ce^{tL}R$ 所满足的带记忆核 $\mathcal{M}(t)=CLQe^{tQLQ}QLR$ 的 Volterra 方程，并利用短时导数递归恢复记忆矩，借助 Ho--Kalman 分解构造最小补全。
AI.result: 每个记忆矩 $\mathcal{M}^{(k)}(0)$ 均可仅由 $T_t$ 的短时导数递归恢复；块 Hankel 算子 $\mathbb{H}_{\infty}=(\mathcal{M}^{(i+j)}(0))_{i,j\geq 0}$ 的秩恰为使粗动力学成为精确自治、时齐系统所需的最小辅助线性状态变量数，其最小补全可构造且相似意义下唯一。若 $d=\min\{k:\mathcal{M}^{(k)}(0)\neq 0\}$，则任意光滑经典 $f$-散度渐近按 $t^{2d+4}$ 缩放；具体马尔可夫实例可实现指数 $4,6,8$ 与闭合秩 $1,2,3$。此外给出隐藏预测坐标的有限样本奇异值证书（含带内在方差控制的矩阵-Bernstein 界），并以在所有可行干预下产生相同未来法则来定义历史等价类，得到最小反事实预测状态。
AI.conclusion: 结果将粗粒化转化为构造性的状态补全问题，并区分了普通线性实现（linear realization）与更严格的阳性或马尔可夫实现（Markov realization）。

title: Hamiltonian analysis of disformally coupled fermions in scalar-tensor theories
summary: We study disformal transformations of $\mathcal{N}$ scalar fields coupled to a Dirac fermion. The resulting axial coupling generically introduces higher derivatives in the scalar field equations of motion; for field-dependent free functions, these are absent if and only if the disformal transformation acts along a single field-space direction. We show that these higher derivatives do not signal an Ostrogradsky ghost. After the transformation, the fermion registers the derivatives of the matter-frame tetrad only through the axial current, so that every coupling to the derivatives of the scalar fields multiplies a fermion bilinear, which is Grassmann even and nilpotent. Such terms do not contribute to the body of the constraint matrix, and at each level of the Grassmann expansion the field equations are linear, with the principal part of the theory without fermions. Through a Hamiltonian analysis, we show that the number of degrees of freedom is that of the bosonic theory plus that of the fermion, both in the Einstein frame, for free functions depending on the scalar fields and their kinetic matrix, and for minimally coupled fermions in multi-field DHOST theories. The same mechanism applies to disformal transformations with higher derivatives of a single scalar field, for which fermions impose no condition beyond those required by bosonic matter.

AI.tldr: 本文研究耦合 Dirac 费米子的 N 个标量场在 disformal 变换下的性质，证明变换后出现的轴向耦合所引入的高阶导数（higher derivatives）不构成 Ostrogradsky ghost，且自由度数与玻色子理论加费米子之和一致。
AI.motivation: disformal 变换通常会在标量场运动方程中引入高阶导数，此类高阶导数常被视为理论不稳定的信号。本文旨在辨析这一问题的实质，特别是当标量场耦合 Dirac 费米子、并产生轴向耦合（axial coupling）时，高阶导数的物理含义及其对自由度计数的影响。
AI.method: 采用一般性分析结合哈密顿分析（Hamiltonian analysis）。通过考察依赖场的自由函数（field-dependent free functions）条件、单一场空间方向（single field-space direction）的 disformal 变换，以及 Grassmann 展开，分析约束矩阵（constraint matrix）结构与运动方程的主部（principal part）。
AI.result: 变换后费米子仅通过轴向流（axial current）感知物质框架 tetrad 的导数，因此所有标量场导数耦合均乘以费米子双线性（fermion bilinear）项，该双线性项为 Grassmann 偶且幂零（nilpotent）。此类项不贡献约束矩阵体部，且在 Grassmann 展开的每一阶运动方程均为线性，其主部与无费米子理论相同。哈密顿分析表明，自由度数为玻色子理论加费米子之和，在 Einstein frame 中，对依赖标量场及其动能矩阵（kinetic matrix）的自由函数，以及多场 DHOST 理论中的最小耦合费米子均成立。
AI.conclusion: disformal 变换引入的高阶导数并不表示存在 Ostrogradsky ghost。该机制亦适用于带单标量场高阶导数的 disformal 变换，此时费米子不施加超出玻色子物质所需条件之外的新限制。

title: Transport kinetics in excitonic Mott insulator
summary: Indirect excitons (IXs) in a periodic moiré potential in a van der Waals heterostructure form an experimental platform for exploring Bose-Hubbard physics, including the superfluid state and the Mott insulator state. The realization of these collective states requires low-disorder materials. In particular, the localization due to the Mott insulator must be distinguished from disorder-induced localization. We studied the transport kinetics of IXs in a MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure with an anomalously high IX mobility, consistent with superfluidity. This high-mobility transport demonstrates that disorder-induced localization is negligible. We found a remarkable suppression of this efficient IX transport, directly indicating the Mott insulator. As the IX density increases during the excitation pulse, the IX cloud initially expands and then contracts upon entering the Mott insulator phase. The emergence of IX cloud contraction is accompanied by a peak in the IX spatial distribution at the origin. Our simulations reproduce the observed non-monotonic IX transport kinetics, including the temporal expansion and contraction of the IX cloud, as well as the peak in its spatial distribution.

AI.tldr: 该研究在MoSe₂/WSe₂范德华异质结中观测到高迁移率的间接激子（indirect excitons, IXs）输运，并发现随IX密度增加出现的非单调输运行为——IX云先膨胀后收缩，伴随原点处空间分布峰值，被归因于莫特绝缘体（Mott insulator）相的出现。
AI.motivation: 周期性莫尔势（moiré potential）中的间接激子为研究Bose-Hubbard物理（含超流态与莫特绝缘态）提供实验平台，但实现这些集体态需要低无序材料，尤其是必须区分莫特绝缘体导致的局域化与无序诱导的局域化。
AI.method: 测量MoSe₂/WSe₂范德华异质结中间接激子的输运动力学（transport kinetics），并借助数值模拟（simulations）复现观测到的非单调输运行为。
AI.result: 该异质结表现出异常高的IX迁移率，符合超流（superfluidity）特征，表明无序诱导局域化可忽略；同时观测到这一高效输运被显著抑制，直接指示莫特绝缘体。随激发脉冲期间IX密度增加，IX云先膨胀后收缩，收缩出现时伴随原点处IX空间分布峰值。
AI.conclusion: 模拟可复现所观测的非单调IX输运动力学，包括IX云的时间膨胀与收缩及其空间分布峰值；高迁移率与输运抑制的结合为在该平台上识别莫特绝缘体相提供了依据。

title: An end-to-end experimental pipeline for automated track identification for paleo-detectors
summary: Paleo-detectors aim to exploit the damage tracks left in natural minerals by cosmic messengers over geological times to reconstruct past fluxes of energetic particles. For cosmic rays, the expected signal is abundant, and the tracks are micron-scale, so they can be revealed by etching and read out with conventional optical microscopy; what remains challenging is turning a bulk sample into a calibrated track-length spectrum that can be quantitatively confronted with theoretical predictions. In this work we present the experimental pipeline we developed for this purpose within the INFN PRImuS experiment, from sample preparation and automated multi-focus microscopy to track recognition with OptimusPrimus, a two-stage machine-learning algorithm, and to a forward-folding model that propagates geometric sectioning, etching and the measured detection response into simulated spectra. The pipeline was built and validated on chemically etched obsidian where the recovered track-length distribution is statistically compatible with expert annotation. In parallel, we developed and characterized a dry argon-plasma etching protocol for halite, an evaporite mineral of particular interest as a low-background cosmic-ray paleo-detector. Since every stage of the pipeline is mineral-agnostic, with only the trained networks and the detection response to be re-derived from annotated data, we are now applying it to plasma-etched halite with the aim of identifying cosmic-ray-induced tracks.

AI.tldr: 本工作提出一套用于古探测器（paleo-detector）的端到端实验流程，将天然矿物中的宇宙射线损伤径迹转化为可定量对比理论预测的径迹长度谱（track-length spectrum）。
AI.motivation: 宇宙射线（cosmic ray）在天然矿物中留下的损伤径迹信号丰富且为微米尺度，可经刻蚀（etching）并由常规光学显微镜读出；真正的难点在于将块状样品转化为经过校准、可与理论预测定量对比的径迹长度谱。
AI.method: 在 INFN PRImuS 实验框架下开发实验流程，涵盖样品制备、自动化多焦面显微（multi-focus microscopy）、两阶段机器学习算法 OptimusPrimus 的径迹识别，以及将几何切片（geometric sectioning）、刻蚀与实测探测响应前向折叠（forward-folding）为模拟谱的模型。
AI.result: 流程在化学刻蚀的黑曜石（obsidian）上构建并验证，所得径迹长度分布与专家标注在统计上相容；同时开发并表征了针对岩盐（halite）的干式氩等离子体刻蚀（argon-plasma etching）方案。
AI.conclusion: 由于流程各阶段与矿物种类无关（mineral-agnostic），仅需依据标注数据重新推导训练网络与探测响应，目前正将其应用于等离子体刻蚀的岩盐以识别宇宙射线诱导径迹。

title: About P-adic Numbers and Professor Igor Volovich on the Occasion of his 80th Anniversary
comment: To appear in the 2026 Proceedings of the"New Horizons in Mathematical Physics" published by the Steklov Mathematical Institute, Moscow
summary: We recall a 1987 paper written by Volovich and our subsequent work with Okada which established the Feyman rules for the p-adic string and the related non-local field theory which found diverse physical applications. We add some memories of visits to Moscow during 1989-91.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了1987年Volovich关于p进弦（p-adic string）的论文及作者与Okada的后续工作，该工作建立了p进弦的费曼规则（Feynman rules）及相关非局域场论（non-local field theory），后者在多个物理领域获得应用，并附有1989—1991年间莫斯科访问的回忆。
AI.motivation: 该文属于回顾性/纪念性叙述，动机在于追述p进弦与非局域场论这一研究线索的起源与后续发展，并记录相关学术交往的历史背景。
AI.method: 以历史回顾与个人回忆的方式，梳理Volovich 1987年论文以及作者与Okada合作的后续工作，说明其中建立的费曼规则与相关非局域场论框架。
AI.result: 所回顾的工作建立了p进弦的费曼规则及相关的非局域场论，该理论在此后于多个物理方向获得了多样化的应用。
AI.conclusion: p进弦及其相关非局域场论构成一条具有持续物理影响力的研究脉络，且其发展伴随1989—1991年间莫斯科访问所体现的学术交流。

title: SIREN: A nonlinear Rankine-source boundary element solver for the stationary motion of a marine vehicle in calm water
summary: SIREN (Ship Inviscid Resistance and Elevation eNgine) is a Rankine-source panel solver for the steady wave resistance of a ship, in the tradition of Dawson's method. The free-surface condition is linearised about a base flow, and the linearisation is iterated. In the present formulation the base flow is the solution of a Neumann problem on the actual boundary: sources on the entire hull, wet and dry, and on the free surface panels, with impermeability imposed on both, so that the free surface acts as a rigid lid at the position it currently occupies. This replaces the classical double-body flow, whose image about z=0 is meaningful only for a flat surface and a hull cut at z=0, and it removes the need for desingularised free-surface panels. In the non-linear iteration the free-surface panels are moved rigidly in the vertical to the relaxed wave elevation at their centroid, the hull panels are marked wet or dry against the moved surface, and the base flow is recomputed on the moved geometry; impermeability applies to the whole hull regardless of this marking, which is used only to select which panels enter the force integral, and under-relaxation is confined to the passes where the non-linear correction accumulates without being reset. The radiation condition is imposed by a one-row upstream shift of the collocation points, and the wave resistance is obtained by pressure integration and, independently, by transverse wave-cut analysis.

AI.tldr: SIREN（Ship Inviscid Resistance and Elevation eNgine）是一种基于 Rankine 源（Rankine-source）面元法的船舶稳态兴波阻力求解器，沿袭 Dawson 方法传统。其核心创新在于以实际边界上的 Neumann 问题解替代经典双体流（double-body flow）作为基流，并在非线性迭代中刚体移动自由面面元以匹配松弛波高。
AI.motivation: 经典方法采用双体流作为基流，其关于 z=0 的镜像仅在平直自由面与船体于 z=0 处切分时才有意义，且需要去奇异化（desingularised）的自由面面元。本文旨在消除这些限制，构造在真实边界上定义的基流，从而适用于更一般的几何并简化自由面处理。
AI.method: 自由面条件围绕基流线性化并迭代求解。基流为实际边界上的 Neumann 问题解：源分布于整个船体（湿面与干面）及自由面面元上，两者均施加不可穿透条件，使自由面在当前所处位置充当刚性盖（rigid lid）。非线性迭代中，自由面面元随其形心处的松弛波高做垂向刚体平移，船体面元依据移动后的表面标记为湿或干，并在移动后的几何上重算基流。辐射条件（radiation condition）通过配置点单行上游偏移施加，兴波阻力由压力积分与横向波切分析（wave-cut analysis）两种独立途径获得。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量数值结果；所述主要产出为：基流在移动几何上重算，不可穿透条件作用于整个船体（干湿标记仅用于选取进入力积分（force integral）的面元），欠松弛（under-relaxation）仅限用于非线性修正累积且未被重置的迭代轮次，兴波阻力通过压力积分与横向波切分析独立求得。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以真实边界上的 Neumann 基流取代双体流，避免了对平直自由面与 z=0 切分船体的依赖，并省去了自由面面元的去奇异化需求，为稳态兴波阻力计算提供了一种可迭代至非线性的替代框架。

title: Black holes with dark matter halos and a positive cosmological constant: Energy conditions and signatures
summary: We study static, spherically symmetric black holes surrounded by dark matter halos in the presence of a positive cosmological constant. Assuming vanishing radial pressure, we derive the constraints imposed by the null, weak, strong, and dominant energy conditions on the halo matter. The halo is confined to a finite radial interval separated from both horizons, and the total mass is bounded above by the Nariai value. We construct a Hernquist-type profile and study black hole images, showing that a positive cosmological constant can substantially change the images. We also compute scalar quasinormal modes of the Hernquist-type spacetime. When the dark matter mass is sufficiently small, the relative difference of a selected mode is approximately linear in the compactness of the matter halo, i.e., the ratio of mass parameter $M_{\text{DM}}$ and scale parameter $a$, with a coefficient that depends on the cosmological constant.

AI.tldr: 在正宇宙学常数（cosmological constant）下研究被暗物质晕（dark matter halo）包围的静态球对称黑洞，导出晕物质需满足的各能量条件（energy conditions）约束，并构建 Hernquist 型轮廓分析黑洞成像与标量准正规模（quasinormal modes）。
AI.motivation: 探究正宇宙学常数与暗物质晕共存时对黑洞时空结构、能量条件及可观测特征的影响，填补暗物质晕—黑洞—宇宙学常数三者结合情形下的分析空白。
AI.method: 假设径向压强为零，推导零、弱、强与主导能量条件（null, weak, strong, dominant energy conditions）对晕物质的限制；构建 Hernquist 型密度轮廓，计算黑洞图像与标量准正规模。
AI.result: 晕被限制在远离两个视界（horizons）的有限径向区间内，总质量存在上界即 Nariai 值；正宇宙学常数可显著改变黑洞图像；当暗物质质量足够小时，所选模式的相对差异近似线性依赖于晕的致密度（compactness），即质量参数 \(M_{\text{DM}}\) 与尺度参数 \(a\) 之比，其系数依赖于宇宙学常数。
AI.conclusion: 正宇宙学常数与暗物质晕共同对黑洞时空施加可量化的约束，并在成像与准正规模中留下可辨识的印记，其中准正规模频移与晕致密度呈近线性关系。

title: Large Out-of-plane Polarization in Two-dimensional Bi2O3 Monolayers Predicted by an AI-driven Inverse-design Workflow
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) polar oxides with built-in electric fields offer promising opportunities for nanoscale electronics, optoelectronics, and surface charge engineering. However, their discovery remains challenging due to the enormous structural complexity of nonlayered oxide networks. Here, we combine inverse structural design with a machine-learning interatomic potential and first-principles calculations to explore 2D oxide configurations. Using Bi2O3 as a representative system, we identify two previously unreported polar monolayers with tetragonal and orthorhombic symmetries. Both structures exhibit vertically separated Bi and O sublayers, giving rise to pronounced intrinsic polarity with Berry-phase 2D polarizations of 34.12 and 37.15 pC/m, respectively. Notably, the o-Bi2O3 monolayer exhibits one of the largest reported out-of-plane polarizations among 2D oxides. Both monolayers exhibit dynamical stability, finite-temperature structural integrity, and wide band gaps (~3.8 eV). The large polarization originates from dimensionality-induced reconstruction of the nonlayered Bi-O network, which breaks local coordination symmetry and produces out-of-plane charge redistribution, while the stereochemically active Bi 6s2 lone pair further favors asymmetric Bi-O bonding. These findings suggest dimensionality-induced local-coordination symmetry breaking as a promising design motif for high-polarization 2D oxides, and demonstrate the utility of combining inverse design with machine-learning-assisted screening to explore unconventional polar phases in nonlayered oxide networks.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合逆向结构设计、机器学习原子间势与第一性原理计算，在非层状Bi2O3网络中预测出两种此前未报道的极性单层（四方与正交相），其面外极化分别达34.12与37.15 pC/m，并具备动力学与热稳定性及约3.8 eV的宽带隙。
AI.motivation: 二维极性氧化物（2D polar oxides）内建电场在纳米电子学、光电子学与表面电荷工程中具有潜力，但非层状氧化物网络（nonlayered oxide networks）结构复杂度极高，导致此类材料的发现困难。
AI.method: 以Bi2O3为代表性体系，将逆向结构设计（inverse structural design）与机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potential）及第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）相结合，用于探索二维氧化物构型。
AI.result: 识别出两种未报道的极性单层，分别为四方（tetragonal）与正交（orthorhombic）对称性；二者均具有垂直分离的Bi与O亚层，本征极性显著，Berry相位（Berry-phase）二维极化分别为34.12与37.15 pC/m，其中o-Bi2O3单层属已报道二维氧化物中面外极化最大者之一；两者均表现出动力学稳定性、有限温度下的结构完整性与约3.8 eV的宽带隙。
AI.conclusion: 大极化的来源是维度诱导的非层状Bi-O网络重构，其打破局域配位对称性并产生面外电荷重分布，同时立体化学活性的Bi 6s2孤对电子进一步促进不对称Bi-O成键；结果提示维度诱导的局域配位对称性破缺可作为高极化二维氧化物的设计准则，并证明逆向设计与机器学习辅助筛选相结合在探索非层状氧化物网络中非常规极性相方面的有效性。

title: Charged Lepton Flavor Violation: A Theory Overview
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Contribution to CLFV 2026 proceedings
summary: We present a theory-oriented overview of the significance of charged-lepton flavor violation -- one of the cleanest windows onto physics beyond the Standard Model. We also summarize the current experimental landscape and illustrate how different measurements can diagnose the underlying new physics.

AI.tldr: 该文以理论视角综述带电轻子味破坏（charged-lepton flavor violation）的意义，指出其是探测标准模型（Standard Model）之外物理的最干净窗口之一；同时总结当前实验现状，并说明不同测量如何诊断潜在的新物理（new physics）。
AI.motivation: 摘要将带电轻子味破坏视为通往标准模型之外物理的“最干净窗口之一”，构成研究的核心动因。该主题的理论重要性是本文综述的出发点。
AI.method: 采用理论导向的综述（theory-oriented overview）方式：梳理带电轻子味破坏的理论意义，汇总当前实验格局，并阐述不同测量对新物理的判别能力。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值或实验数据，仅说明已总结现有实验现状（current experimental landscape），并展示多种测量可用于诊断潜在新物理。
AI.conclusion: 带电轻子味破坏是探测标准模型之外物理的重要且干净的探针；不同实验测量可作为诊断底层新物理性质的手段。摘要未提供进一步的具体结论。

title: TheoPhysEval: Assessing AI agents at autonomous theoretical physics problem solving
summary: We present a suite of 50 unpublished research-level theoretical physics problems with verifiable answers. Without AI assistance, a typical problem in our collection could be solved by a world expert in about a day or less but would take considerably longer for experts in adjacent specialties. We test the ability of off-the-shelf AI agents to tackle these problems autonomously, without human hints. When given access to tools available in a realistic setting, including the ability to search the literature and write scripts for numerical and symbolic work, the best-performing agent, GPT-6-Astra harnessed in Codex, obtains the final answers with a near-perfect accuracy of 98% at an average cost under USD 3 per problem. On average, agents show only small changes in accuracy when denied web search and access to background research papers, suggesting significant memorization of the literature. These results suggest that state-of-the-art agents can accurately perform concrete calculations required across theoretical physics research. We comment on the broader implications of these findings and discuss possible explanations for the current lack of agent-led breakthroughs in theoretical physics despite their outstanding problem-solving abilities.

AI.tldr: 该研究发布 50 道未公开的理论物理（theoretical physics）研究级问题（含可验证答案），并测试现成 AI 智能体（AI agents）在无人工提示下的自主解题能力。最优智能体 GPT-6-Astra（Codex 环境）达到 98% 准确率，单题平均成本低于 3 美元；禁用联网检索时准确率仅有小幅下降，提示存在显著的文献记忆（memorization of the literature）。结论认为当前顶尖智能体已能准确完成理论物理研究所需的计算，但尚未带来智能体主导的突破。
AI.motivation: 论文意在评估现成 AI 智能体在真实科研条件下自主解决理论物理研究级问题的能力，而非仅限于标准考试或基准题库。同时试图解释：尽管智能体解题能力突出，为何尚未出现由智能体主导的理论物理突破。
AI.method: 构建并发布 50 道未公开的理论物理研究级问题，均具可验证答案；参照标准为世界级专家约一天或更短时间内可解，邻近细分领域专家所需时间明显更长。测试采用现成智能体在无人工提示（without human hints）条件下自主作答，并提供贴近真实场景的工具，包括文献检索与数值/符号计算脚本编写；另设剥夺网络检索与背景研究论文访问的对照条件。
AI.result: 最佳表现的智能体 GPT-6-Astra 在 Codex 环境下取得接近完美的 98% 准确率，单题平均成本低于 3 美元。在禁用网络检索与背景论文访问时，智能体准确率平均仅出现小幅变化，作者据此推断其存在显著的文献记忆（memorization of the literature）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，最先进的智能体（state-of-the-art agents）能够准确执行理论物理研究中的具体计算任务。作者进一步评论这些发现的更广泛影响，并探讨为何在解题能力出色的情况下，当前仍缺乏智能体主导的理论物理突破。

title: Equivariant Seiberg-Witten equations on Hermitian symmetric spaces
summary: We formulate and solve a $G$-equivariant analogue of the Seiberg-Witten equations on any irreducible Hermitian symmetric space $G/K$. We use a canonical $K$-invariant form to define a twisted Hodge operator generalising self-duality to higher dimensions. The resulting equivariant Seiberg-Witten equations arise, for a compact $G/K$, as conditions for the absolute minima of an energy functional. Their linear part has a representation theoretic interpretation: the same Weyl group data control the highest-weight realisation of the positive Dirac kernel in the compact case and its discrete-series realisation on the non-compact dual. This space of harmonic spinors collapses almost entirely by the quadratic conditions of the monopole equation. In the compact case, the equivariant moduli set, when non-empty, is a single gauge class, identifying with the $G$-invariant part of Bradlow's trichotomy for vortices, while in the non-compact case, every irreducible solution sits outside the discrete series.

AI.tldr: 本文在任意不可约 Hermitian 对称空间 $G/K$ 上建立并求解了 Seiberg-Witten 方程的 $G$-等变（$G$-equivariant）类比，借助典范 $K$-不变形式定义扭曲 Hodge 算子，将自对偶性推广到高维。
AI.motivation: Seiberg-Witten 方程原本定义于四维，其自对偶结构依赖维度；本文旨在将其推广至不可约 Hermitian 对称空间 $G/K$ 这一更广的高维几何框架，并利用等变性（equivariance）赋予方程表示论意义。
AI.method: 采用典范 $K$-不变形式（canonical $K$-invariant form）构造扭曲 Hodge 算子（twisted Hodge operator），以推广自对偶性；对紧致情形，将等变 Seiberg-Witten 方程刻画为某能量泛函（energy functional）的绝对极小条件，并用 Weyl 群数据与最高权实现（highest-weight realisation）、离散系列实现（discrete-series realisation）作表示论解释。
AI.result: 线性部分的调和旋量空间（harmonic spinors）几乎被单极子方程（monopole equation）的二次条件完全消去。紧致情形下，非空的等变模空间（equivariant moduli set）为单一规范类，与 Bradlow 三分法（Bradlow's trichotomy）中涡旋（vortices）的 $G$-不变部分相对应；非紧致情形下，每个不可约解均位于离散系列之外。
AI.conclusion: 等变 Seiberg-Witten 方程在紧致与非紧致 Hermitian 对称空间上均可求解，其解空间受二次条件高度约束，并分别由 Bradlow 三分法与离散系列（discrete series）情形所刻画。

title: Exact radial stability threshold for a Minkowski-Schwarzschild thin shell
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to Physics Letters B
summary: We study the stability of a thin shell of ordinary matter that separates a flat interior from a Schwarzschild exterior, which is the simplest model of a subluminal warp drive. The matter content of the shell is fixed by the junction conditions and satisfies all the standard energy conditions except very close to the horizon. For a shell made of causal matter we find an exact radius below which it cannot be stable under radial perturbations. We then place a black hole inside the shell and show that this radius grows with the black hole mass, so that the flat interior is the most favourable case. Since such shells are known to be unstable to non-radial perturbations, our result marks the boundary of the region in which any stabilising mechanism would have to operate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究亚光速曲速引擎（subluminal warp drive）的最简模型——分离平直内部与史瓦西外部（Schwarzschild exterior）的薄壳（thin shell）稳定性，给出因果物质薄壳在径向微扰（radial perturbations）下保持稳定的精确半径下限，并指出该半径随内部黑洞质量增大而增大。
AI.motivation: 薄壳模型是亚光速曲速引擎的最简单实现，但其稳定性尚不明确；已有工作表明此类薄壳对非径向微扰（non-radial perturbations）不稳定，因此需要界定任何稳定机制可能起作用的区域边界。
AI.method: 采用薄壳的 junction conditions 确定壳层物质内容，并检验能量条件（energy conditions）；随后对因果物质（causal matter）构成的薄壳施加径向微扰，解析求解其稳定性的临界半径；进一步在壳内放置黑洞，考察临界半径与黑洞质量的依赖关系。
AI.result: 壳层物质满足除视界（horizon）极近区域外的全部标准能量条件；对因果物质薄壳，存在一个精确半径，低于该半径时壳层无法在径向微扰下保持稳定；当壳内存在黑洞时，该半径随黑洞质量增大，故平直内部（无黑洞）为最有利情形。
AI.conclusion: 该精确半径标定了任何稳定机制必须发挥作用的区域边界；由于此类薄壳对非径向微扰已知不稳定，稳定化方案只能在上述半径范围之外或依赖额外机制。

title: Fluctuation-based evaluation of thermal conductivity using deviational phonon Monte Carlo simulations
summary: We develop a fluctuation based Monte Carlo method for evaluating thermal conductivity within the phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) framework. Starting from the energy based variance reduced formulation of the BTE, we derive a relation between the spatial spreading of deviational phonon energy and the macroscopic heat conduction equation. The resulting formulation expresses thermal conductivity in terms of the mean square displacement of deviational phonon particles, without imposing thermal reservoirs. Consequently, thermal conductivity along multiple directions can be evaluated from a single simulation. The method is demonstrated for crystalline silicon at room temperature in bulk, square nanowires, and anisotropic polycrystalline nanostructures. The calculated thermal conductivities agree with theoretical predictions, including the size dependence induced by phonon boundary scattering and the mode-resolved contributions. For anisotropic polycrystalline structures, the method simultaneously resolves the directional thermal conductivities and captures their dependence on grain morphology. These results demonstrate the validity of the proposed fluctuation-based approach for evaluating thermal conductivity across different transport regimes and structural configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于涨落（fluctuation）的蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）方法，在声子玻尔兹曼输运方程（phonon Boltzmann transport equation, BTE）框架内计算热导率，无需热库即可由单次模拟获得多方向热导率。
AI.motivation: 旨在发展一种免设热库（thermal reservoirs）的热导率评估手段，以便在多种输运区间与结构构型下统一计算热导率，并克服多方向测量需多次模拟的限制。
AI.method: 从BTE的基于能量的方差缩减（variance reduced）表述出发，推导偏离声子能量空间扩散与宏观热传导方程之间的关系，将热导率表示为偏离声子粒子均方位移（mean square displacement）的函数。
AI.result: 在室温块体、方形纳米线（square nanowires）与各向异性多晶纳米结构（anisotropic polycrystalline nanostructures）的晶体硅（crystalline silicon）上验证；结果与理论预测一致，包括声子边界散射（phonon boundary scattering）引起的尺寸依赖与模式分辨贡献，并可同时解析各向异性多晶结构的方向热导率及其对晶粒形貌的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该基于涨落的方法在多种输运区间与结构构型下评估热导率是有效的。

title: Implications for new physics solutions to the LSND and MiniBooNE anomalies after MicroBooNE results
summary: Over the past couple of decades, the Liquid Scintillator Neutrino Detector (LSND) and MiniBooNE (MB) neutrino experiments have provided statistically significant evidence of persistent and as yet unexplained electron-like event excesses. The MicroBooNE experiment, with sensitive particle identification capabilities designed to shed light on these anomalous results, has conducted a number of analyses to test whether the excess is due to photons, electrons or $e^+e^-$ pair productions, all of which give almost identical signals in LSND and MB. Recent MicroBooNE searches, in addition to checking Standard Model (SM) processes, have focused on proposed new physics scenarios involving new mediators and dark portals beyond the SM. We study the consequences and effects of these analyses for the many theoretical proposals put forth to generate the three types of signals above in order to understand the observed excesses. We discuss which classes of solutions are allowed, disallowed or require further scrutiny involving theoretical and experimental efforts. We give an example of a new solution that survives the restrictions imposed by MicroBooNE results and other existing bounds. We point out that a light ($m\leq 30$ MeV) dark neutral spin zero mediator with dominantly pseudoscalar couplings, decaying to an $e^+e^-$ pair, can account for the observations. We indicate that if such a model is realised, it may point to the possibility that neutrinos are Dirac particles, and that there are dark Heavy Neutral Leptons (HNLs) of mass ${\cal O}(100)$ MeV. We discuss issues related to CP violation and ultra-violet completion of these models. Finally we stress that a search for the excess in incoherent scattering channels in MicroBooNE and SBND could help clarify the physics behind these persistent anomalies.

AI.tldr: 本文基于 LSND 与 MiniBooNE 中持续存在的电子类事件超出，以及 MicroBooNE 最新对光子、电子与 e⁺e⁻ 对产生三类解释的检验，系统评估既有理论方案的存活状况，并提出一种可存活的新解释。
AI.motivation: LSND 与 MiniBooNE 长期报告统计显著的、尚未解释的电子类事件超出，而 MicroBooNE 具备灵敏的粒子鉴别（particle identification）能力，可用于区分光子、电子与 e⁺e⁻ 对产生等近乎简并的信号来源，从而对大量理论方案形成新的约束，亟需评估这些方案的存废。
AI.method: 采用理论分析与实验约束对照的方式，考察 MicroBooNE 各项分析结果对旨在产生上述三类信号的众多理论提议的影响，并讨论哪些解被允许、被排除或需进一步的理论与实验审查；随后给出一个满足 MicroBooNE 限制及其他现有界限的新解示例。
AI.result: 指出一个质量较轻（m ≤ 30 MeV）、以赝标量耦合（pseudoscalar couplings）为主并衰变为 e⁺e⁻ 对的中性暗标量媒介粒子（dark neutral spin zero mediator）可以解释相关观测；若该模型成立，可能暗示中微子为狄拉克粒子（Dirac particles），并存在质量约为 O(100) MeV 的暗重中性轻子（Heavy Neutral Leptons, HNLs）。
AI.conclusion: 论文还讨论了与 CP 破坏（CP violation）及这些模型的紫外完备化（ultra-violet completion）相关的问题，并强调在 MicroBooNE 与 SBND 中开展非相干散射（incoherent scattering）通道的超出搜寻，有助于澄清这些持续异常背后的物理。

title: Out-of-time-order hydrodynamics and scrambling
summary: Hydrodynamics as an effective field theory (EFT) has been immensely successful for predicting the behaviour of time-ordered correlation functions in the long-time, large-distance regime. In this paper, we analyse the predictions of hydrodynamics for scrambling as probed by out-of-time order correlators (OTOCs). To do so, we consider an all-derivative order generalisation of the Schwinger-Keldysh EFT of hydrodynamics extended to a four-fold time contour required to capture OTOCs. A crucial ingredient of the construction is a local SL(2,R) symmetry, which has previously been suggested as a mechanism for scrambling. We also derive this exact EFT from the microscopic formulation of the maximally chaotic low-temperature limit of the SYK lattice, thereby determining all transport coefficients for this model. As a novel application, we compute the OTOC of energy currents, find that its exponential growth saturates the chaos bound, and match it to expectations based on a shockwave (or scramblon) effective description. Our work shows that the universality of hydrodynamics degrees of freedom extends beyond traditional time-ordered correlators to more complex observables such as OTOCs.

AI.tldr: 本文将流体力学（hydrodynamics）作为有效场论（EFT）推广至乱序时间关联函数（OTOC），构建含局部SL(2,R)对称性的四重时间围道Schwinger-Keldysh EFT，并从SYK晶格微观模型导出全部输运系数，计算能量流OTOC并发现其指数增长饱和混沌上界。
AI.motivation: 流体力学EFT在长时间、大尺度极限下对时间有序关联函数（time-ordered correlators）的预测极为成功，但其对乱序（scrambling）及OTOC的适用性尚不明确，本文旨在检验流体力学自由度对OTOC这类更复杂可观测量的普适性。
AI.method: 将Schwinger-Keldysh流体力学EFT推广到全导数阶（all-derivative order），并扩展至捕捉OTOC所需的四重时间围道；构造中引入局部SL(2,R)对称性作为乱序机制；同时从SYK晶格最大混沌低温极限的微观表述导出该精确EFT，从而确定模型全部输运系数。
AI.result: 计算了能量流（energy currents）的OTOC，其指数增长饱和混沌上界（chaos bound），并与基于冲击波（shockwave）或scramblon有效描述的预期相符。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明流体力学自由度的普适性可从传统时间有序关联函数延伸至OTOC等更复杂可观测量。

title: An Explicit Bound for the First Dirichlet Eigenvalue via Two Moments
summary: Let $(M^n,g)$, $n\ge2$, be a compact connected Riemannian manifold with smooth nonempty boundary, $\operatorname{Ric}_M\ge(n-1)Kg$ for $K>0$, and nonnegative outward boundary mean curvature. We derive an explicit algebraic lower bound $B_η$ for the first Dirichlet eigenvalue from Kasue's mixed inradius model. With $R$ the inradius and $s=4KR^2/π^2$, the bound involves one square root and approximates the model eigenvalue with relative error $O_n(s^4)$ as $s\downarrow0$ for fixed $n$. The construction uses the first two moments of a positive representation of the averaged model potential and a sharp pointwise corrector estimate. For the chosen spectral transfer, the first two moments determine an optimal bound. We also show that the model eigenvalue is the geometric infimum at fixed $(n,K,R)$. For $0<s<1$, it is approached by smooth collapsing balls with sectional curvature at least $K$ and totally geodesic boundary. At the maximal inradius, the model value is attained by the round hemisphere. The bound strictly improves the variance refinement throughout $0<s\le1$. We also give a direct algebraic comparison with an optimized power-test benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文在紧致带边黎曼流形上，由 Kasue 混合内半径模型导出第一 Dirichlet 特征值（first Dirichlet eigenvalue）的显式代数下界 $B_\eta$，并证明该界在给定 $(n,K,R)$ 下与几何下确界的关系。
AI.motivation: 研究目标是刻画 Ricci 曲率下界与边界平均曲率非负条件下，第一 Dirichlet 特征值的定量下界，并将 Kasue 混合内半径模型与谱估计联系起来。
AI.method: 设 $(M^n,g)$ 紧致连通、边界光滑非空，$\operatorname{Ric}_M\ge(n-1)Kg$（$K>0$）、外法向边界平均曲率非负。构造依赖内半径 $R$ 与 $s=4KR^2/\pi^2$ 的代数下界 $B_\eta$，运用平均模型势正表示的前两阶矩（first two moments）与尖锐逐点修正估计（sharp pointwise corrector estimate）。
AI.result: 所得界含一个平方根，当 $s\downarrow0$（$n$ 固定）时以相对误差 $O_n(s^4)$ 逼近模型特征值；在该谱转移下前两阶矩给出最优界。模型特征值是固定 $(n,K,R)$ 下的几何下确界，$0<s<1$ 时由截面曲率至少 $K$ 且边界全测地的光滑塌缩球逼近，最大内半径情形由圆半球达到。该界在 $0<s\le1$ 内严格改进 variance refinement。
AI.conclusion: 该下界在渐近意义下近似最优，并与几何极值构型（塌缩球、圆半球）一致；同时给出与优化 power-test 基准的显式代数比较，说明其在全参数区间内优于既有方差改进。

title: Classical and quantum scattering of massive Klein--Gordon fields in asymptotically flat spacetimes
summary: We use microlocal tools to define distinguished incoming and outgoing vacuum states of the quantum theory of massive Klein--Gordon fields in non-trapping asymptotically flat spacetimes, including radiative perturbations of Minkowski space. The asymptotic vacuum states satisfy the Hadamard condition, and the incoming and outgoing particle representations are unitarily equivalent, or in other words the quantum S-matrix is well-defined. These results are based on a description of scattering of classical fields which keeps track of the asymptotic distinction between positive- and negative-frequency solutions of the Klein--Gordon equation. Our emphasis is on developing the theory without recourse to explicit asymptotics for classical waves.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用微局部分析（microlocal analysis）工具，在非捕获（non-trapping）渐近平坦时空（包括闵可夫斯基空间的辐射扰动）中，为有质量克莱因-戈尔登场（massive Klein–Gordon fields）的量子理论定义了入态与出态真空，并证明量子S矩阵良定义。
AI.motivation: 在弯曲时空（curved spacetime）中定义量子场论的散射理论（scattering theory）存在困难，尤其是如何刻画具有明确物理意义的渐近真空态（asymptotic vacuum states）及粒子表示。该研究旨在为非捕获渐近平坦时空中的有质量Klein–Gordon场建立严格的散射框架，摆脱对经典波显式渐近行为（explicit asymptotics）的依赖。
AI.method: 采用微局部分析（microlocal tools）构造经典场散射描述，区分Klein–Gordon方程解的正频与负频（positive- and negative-frequency solutions）的渐近特征，并据此定义量子理论中的入态与出态真空态；重点在于不依赖经典波的显式渐近展开来发展理论。
AI.result: 所定义的渐近真空态满足哈达玛条件（Hadamard condition）；入态与出态的粒子表示（particle representations）是酉等价的（unitarily equivalent）。
AI.conclusion: 由此量子S矩阵（quantum S-matrix）在该类时空中是良定义的（well-defined），为弯曲时空量子场论中的散射问题提供了基于微局部方法的严格表述。

title: Soft-to-Rigid: Shape Continuation as an Alternative Search for Packing Congruent Shapes
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code, data, every run, replays and the research ledger: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/soft-to-rigid ; site: https://yoheinakajima.github.io/soft-to-rigid/
summary: Searches for dense packings of congruent shapes move rigid pieces. Hardening starts each piece as its inscribed disk and deforms it into the target shape while the container is compressed. We ask whether it is a search worth running alongside existing ones, and test it at matched budget and comparable tuning against rigid starts, growth, simulated annealing and perturbation--compression on seven families of squares, triangles, hexagons and disks in squares, triangles and circles (188 instances), scoring each method by the lowest container size it reaches. Hardening is not a better default: tuned rigid starts reach the lowest size most often. It is a different search. On squares in a square it reaches packings the other four methods miss, including Trump's n = 11 and Wainwright's n = 19 in 32 runs per method, and in a targeted follow-up campaign at ten times the budget (16 runs per method) it is the only one to reach the best known packings for n = 17 and n = 26, while annealing alone reaches n = 27. In exploratory ablations, compressing disks and then switching to polygons at once, or growing rigid polygons along hardening's area schedule, shows no detectable difference from rigid starts, and hardening's unique packings contain more tilted pieces. The bias costs elsewhere: hardening is worse on triangles and on four families held out from all development, where the short-pilot policy we tested showed no detected advantage over always starting rigid. Shape continuation is an alternative search that reaches different packings, worth keeping beside rigid ones; we did not show that splitting a fixed budget between them pays, and we have no test that predicts where it helps. Search campaigns were planned before they ran, with amendments, exploratory analyses and post-hoc checks identified separately; every run is replayable and every number is generated from an event log.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验"硬化（hardening）"——将刚体初始化为其内切圆盘并逐步形变为目标形状——是否值得作为致密堆积（dense packing）搜索的常规方法。在匹配预算与调参条件下与四种既有方法对比，结论是硬化并非更优的默认选择，而是一种能到达不同堆积的替代搜索。
AI.motivation: 刚性起步等现有搜索方法可能受初始构型偏置限制，作者希望评估形变连续的"硬化"策略是否可作为并行搜索手段。研究动机为检验该新搜索是否值得与现有方法同时运行，而非宣称其优越性。
AI.method: 以正方形、三角形、六边形和圆盘在正方形、三角形、圆形内的七类族共188个实例为测试集，在匹配预算与可比调参下，将硬化与刚性起步（rigid starts）、生长（growth）、模拟退火（simulated annealing）及扰动—压缩（perturbation--compression）对比，评价指标为所达到的最小容器尺寸。
AI.result: 调参后的刚性起步最常达到最小尺寸；硬化在正方形内正方形问题上可达到其他四种方法遗漏的堆积，包括32次运行中的Trump n=11与Wainwright n=19，并在十倍预算的后续专项中唯一达到n=17与n=26的已知最优堆积，退火单独达到n=27。消融显示压缩圆盘后转多边形、或按硬化面积调度生长刚性多边形，与刚性起步无可检测差异；硬化的独特堆积含更多倾斜构件。其偏置在三角形及四个留出族上造成劣势，短程试点策略未见优于始终刚性起步。
AI.conclusion: 形状延拓（shape continuation）是一种能到达不同堆积的替代搜索，值得与刚性方法并存；但未证明在固定预算下二者拆分更优，也缺乏预测其适用场景的检验。所有搜索活动均在运行前规划，改进、探索性分析与事后检验分别标识，每次运行可回放，数据均来自事件日志。

title: Anomaly Detection in Bunch Oscillations for Early Warning of Sudden Beam Loss at SuperKEKB
summary: Sudden beam loss (SBL) events at the SuperKEKB collider result in the loss of a large fraction of the stored beam within just a few revolutions, on a timescale comparable to or shorter than the 20-30 μs latency of the existing abort system. Such events have damaged collimators and threaten Belle II subdetectors. Bunch Oscillation Recorders (BORs) capture transverse bunch positions at each revolution, which often show sizable oscillations that precede significant beam current loss. We test whether these precursors can be detected earlier than a charge-based reference that mimics the existing abort sensors. We apply several oscillation-based anomaly detection algorithms to 208 SBL events recorded in the low-energy ring during the 2024 run period, ranging from simple rolling statistics to machine learning models trained to forecast bunch oscillation. On 173 events not used for training or calibration, the best-balanced model (DeepLSTM) triggers before the charge-based reference in 86-90% of events across five training seeds, with a mean lead time of 25-30 μs. The only trigger classified as a false alarm fires on an oscillation that begins about 60 turns before the abort and persists until the beam is lost, making it more likely an early precursor than a spurious trigger. These results establish bunch oscillations as a viable early abort trigger and motivate a shadow-mode deployment to measure the false-alarm rate in continuous operation.
