AI.tldr: SuperKEKB 对撞机在 2024 运行期记录的 208 例突失束（SBL）事件中，束团横向振荡先于束流大量损失出现；基于振荡的异常检测算法（含 DeepLSTM）可在电荷信号触发前 86-90% 的事件中提前报警，平均提前 25-30 μs，从而确立束团振荡作为一种可行的早期中止触发依据。
AI.motivation: 突失束事件在数圈之内即损失大部分储存束流，其时标与现有中止系统 20-30 μs 的延迟相当或更短，已造成准直器损伤并威胁 Belle II 子探测器，因此需要更早的触发手段。束团振荡记录仪（BOR）所捕获的横向束团位置常显示出先于显著束流损失的大幅振荡，这构成潜在前兆信号。
AI.method: 研究将该前兆信号与模拟现有中止传感器的电荷基准信号进行比较，检验其能否更早触发。对 2024 运行期低能环记录的 208 例 SBL 事件，采用多类基于振荡的异常检测算法，从简单滑动统计到用于预测束团振荡的机器学习模型（如 DeepLSTM）。
AI.result: 在未用于训练或标定的 173 例事件上，表现最均衡的模型（DeepLSTM）在五个训练随机种子下于 86-90% 的事件中先于电荷基准触发，平均提前时间为 25-30 μs。唯一被判定为误报的触发所响应的振荡约在触发起 60 圈前出现并持续至束流损失，因此更可能属早期前兆而非虚假触发。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明束团振荡可作为可行的早期中止触发依据，并支持开展影子模式（shadow-mode）部署以在连续运行中测量误报率。

title: Metric and dilaton information from high-overtone quasinormal modes of analytic Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton black holes
summary: Black-hole interiors are hidden from exterior observers, yet their geometry can enter the high-overtone spectrum of linear perturbations. We study how this spectrum encodes metric and supporting-matter information in analytic Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton black holes. Coupling a neutral spectator to the dilaton at fixed UV dimension provides a matter-sensitive channel alongside the momentum response. For real-endpoint spacelike connections, the momentum response and mass-label dependence separate the metric exponents from the signed dilaton slope. Near the causal threshold, a complex endpoint controls the spectral family: the mass profiles approach a common value, producing a shared fractional correction, while regular propagation retains label dependence. This mechanism is present at criticality without an inner horizon and continues locally into timelike interiors. Exterior numerical spectra support the reconstruction and the leading complex-endpoint responses. Local scaling and probe coupling set the candidate responses, while wave connection determines their imprint on the exterior spectrum.

AI.tldr: 本文研究解析 Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton 黑洞中，高泛音线性扰动谱如何编码度规与支撑物质信息，并借助中立旁观场与 dilaton 耦合实现物质敏感通道与谱重构。
AI.motivation: 黑洞内部对外部观测者不可见，但其几何信息可进入线性扰动的高泛音谱（high-overtone spectrum）。作者旨在探究该谱如何携带度规指数与支撑物质（如 dilaton 斜率）的信息，从而提供一种从外部谱反推内部结构的途径。
AI.method: 在解析 Einstein–Maxwell–dilaton 黑洞背景下，将中立旁观场（neutral spectator）在固定紫外维度（UV dimension）与 dilaton 耦合，形成物质敏感通道；分析动量响应（momentum response）与质量标签依赖，区分时空及类时内部中的实端点与复端点波连接（wave connection）情形。
AI.result: 对于实端点类空连接（real-endpoint spacelike connections），动量响应与质量标签依赖可将度规指数与带符号 dilaton 斜率分离；在因果阈值附近，复端点控制谱族，质量分布趋近共同值并产生共享分数修正，而规则传播保留标签依赖。该机制在无内视界（inner horizon）的临界情形下依然存在，并局部延续至类时内部；外部数值谱支持重构与主导复端点响应。
AI.conclusion: 局部标度（local scaling）与探针耦合决定候选响应，而波连接方式决定其对外部谱的印记，表明黑洞内部几何与物质信息可通过高泛音谱的响应特征被外部重构。

title: Prelocality No-Go Theorems and Exactly Solvable Relational History Hamiltonians
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Ancillary finite-matrix verification scripts included
summary:
Exact permutation covariance does not itself supply a sparse metric geometry. For permutation-covariant, full-support $k$-body interaction orbits, the incident interaction norm scales as $\binom{N-1}{k-1}|J_N|\|h\|$; such orbits cannot have uniformly finite range in metrics of diverging diameter. A permutation-invariant Hamiltonian diagonal in the graph basis has ground-state multiplicity at least $N!/|\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$ whenever $G$ is a ground graph. We give a quantitative version for approximately symmetric energies, together with fixed-radius connectivity and unitary-isometry obstructions. The trace-distance asymmetry of an arbitrary state also bounds its probability of selecting one labeled graph.
  We then construct two exactly solvable finite relational history Hamiltonians. A cyclic clock with a reversible incidence update has a unique ground state; gauge reduction yields a cycle Laplacian with a rank-one pin and the exact gap $Δ_{N,L}=E_* (1-\cosθ_L)$, where $\tan(Lθ_L/2)=1/\sinθ_L$ and $0<θ_L<π/L$. In particular, $Δ_{N,L}/E_*=π^2/(2L^2)-2π^2/L^3+O(L^{-4})$, independently of the number of vertices. In an alternative order-free architecture, one clock qubit per unordered pair gives commuting four-local terms, $2^N$ ground states and a size-independent gap $E_*(1-1/\sqrt2)$. A fixed-weight control penalty selects $\binom Nq$ ground states without reducing the gap. These exact finite results expose clock and locality resource tradeoffs; they do not establish an emergent geometric phase.

AI.tldr: 置换协变性（permutation covariance）本身不提供稀疏度量几何（sparse metric geometry）：满支撑 k-体相互作用轨道（full-support k-body interaction orbits）的关联相互作用范数随 $\binom{N-1}{k-1}$ 增长，因而在直径发散的度量中无法具有一致有限作用范围。论文进一步构造了两个可精确求解的有限关系历史哈密顿量（relational history Hamiltonians），给出显式基态简并度与能隙公式，揭示时钟资源与局域性之间的权衡，但未建立涌现几何相（emergent geometric phase）。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在澄清置换对称性（permutation symmetry）与稀疏、有限作用范围的度量几何之间是否存在必然联系，并探究在置换协变框架下构造可精确求解、可控简并度与能隙的关系历史模型的可行性与资源代价。
AI.method: 分析路径为：推导满支撑 k-体相互作用轨道的关联相互作用范数下界 $\binom{N-1}{k-1}|J_N|\|h\|$，给出图基（graph basis）对角置换不变哈密顿量基态简并度下界 $N!/|\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$ 及其近似对称能量的定量版本、固定半径连通性与酉等距（unitary-isometry）障碍，并用迹距离（trace distance）不对称性约束状态选择单一标记图的概率。随后构造两类精确可解模型：带可逆关联更新（reversible incidence update）的循环时钟模型，经规范约化（gauge reduction）得到带秩一钉扎的循环拉普拉斯量；以及每个无序对配一时钟比特的无序架构，含对易四局域项与固定权重控制惩罚。
AI.result: 第一类模型具有唯一基态，其精确能隙为 $Δ_{N,L}=E_*(1-\cosθ_L)$，其中 $\tan(Lθ_L/2)=1/\sinθ_L$、$0<θ_L<π/L$，渐近展开为 $Δ_{N,L}/E_*=π^2/(2L^2)-2π^2/L^3+O(L^{-4})$，且与顶点数无关。第二类无序架构给出对易四局域项、$2^N$ 个基态与与尺寸无关的能隙 $E_*(1-1/\sqrt2)$；固定权重控制惩罚可选出 $\binom Nq$ 个基态而不降低能隙。
AI.conclusion: 精确有限结果揭示了时钟资源与局域性之间的权衡关系；论文明确声明这些结果不构成对涌现几何相（emergent geometric phase）的证明。

title: Quasiperiodic oscillations as probes of rotating black holes in exponential dark matter environments
summary: We construct the rotating counterpart of a black hole embedded in a dark-matter halo with the exponential-sphere profile $ρ=ρ_0e^{-r/r_0}$, using the Newman--Janis algorithm in the Azreg-Aïnou form, and study its imprints on test-particle motion and quasiperiodic oscillations (QPOs). We derive closed-form orbital and epicyclic frequencies valid for any Kerr-like metric with a mass function and show that, to first order, the halo enters them only through its central density, acting as an effective cosmological constant $Λ_{eff}=8πρ_0$; the corrections are therefore universal for all cored profiles. The halo moves the innermost stable circular orbit outward and produces an outer boundary of stable orbits, while the sign of the frequency shift depends on the assumed equation of state of the halo. Fitting the relativistic precession model to the simultaneous QPO triplets of GRO~J1655$-$40 and XTE~J1859+226 with Markov-chain Monte Carlo sampling yields spins and emission radii consistent with Kerr and $ρ_0M^2<2.9\times10^{-5}$ and $3.0\times10^{-5}$ (95\%), respectively. In physical units these limits exclude only ultra-dense dark cores, $ρ_0\gtrsim10^{11}$~g\,cm$^{-3}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了嵌入指数球状暗物质晕（dark-matter halo）的旋转黑洞解，并研究其对测试粒子运动与准周期振荡（quasiperiodic oscillations, QPOs）的印记。结果表明晕的效应在一阶上仅通过中心密度以等效宇宙学常数（effective cosmological constant）形式进入，且由GRO J1655−40与XTE J1859+226的QPO观测给出极弱的上限。
AI.motivation: 在黑洞周围存在暗物质晕的物理情形下，需要检验暗物质分布如何影响强场轨道动力学及可观测的QPO信号。既有Kerr度规描述无法包含晕的贡献，因此需要构造相应旋转解并量化其可观测效应。
AI.method: 采用Azreg-Aïnou形式的Newman-Janis算法，从指数球状密度剖面ρ=ρ₀e^{−r/r₀}构造旋转黑洞解。推导适用于任意含质量函数（mass function）的Kerr-like度规的闭式轨道频率与径向/垂直本轮频率（epicyclic frequencies），并将相对论进动模型（relativistic precession model）用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（Markov-chain Monte Carlo, MCMC）采样拟合至GRO J1655−40和XTE J1859+226的同步QPO三联体。
AI.result: 一阶展开下晕仅通过中心密度进入轨道频率，表现为等效宇宙学常数Λ_eff=8πρ₀，故修正对所有core型剖面具有普适性。晕使最内稳定圆轨道（innermost stable circular orbit, ISCO）外移并产生稳定轨道的外边界，而频率移动的符号取决于所假设的晕状态方程（equation of state）。QPO拟合给出与Kerr一致的spin与发射半径，并得到ρ₀M²<2.9×10⁻⁵与3.0×10⁻⁵（95%置信度），对应物理单位下仅排除ρ₀≳10¹¹ g cm⁻³的超致密暗核。
AI.conclusion: 暗物质晕对Kerr-like黑洞轨道频率的修正在一阶上由中心密度主导，具有对core剖面的普适性；现有QPO观测对晕密度的限制较弱，仅能排除超致密暗核，尚不足以约束更常见的暗物质晕参数。

title: Quantum Geometry and Pair Breaking in Intra- and Intervalley Superconductivity of Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: The observation of superconductivity emerging from a spin- and valley-polarized normal state in rhombohedral graphene raises a basic puzzle: intravalley Cooper pairs involve states that are not generically degenerate because of trigonal warping, and therefore lack the particle--particle nesting underlying the conventional Cooper instability. While recent model studies suggest that nontrivial band geometry can strongly promote chiral pairing, how this geometric enhancement competes with realistic band-structure-induced pair breaking remains unclear. Here we study Kohn--Luttinger superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral tetralayer graphene using a DFT-fitted multiorbital tight-binding model, retaining the full Bloch-wave-function form factors in both RPA screening and the projected Cooper interaction. We separate the superconducting instability into three contributions: the symmetry-resolved form-factor-dressed interaction, the Cooper-pair phase space determined by the symmetrized pair dispersion, and the energy mismatch generated by trigonal warping. We find that the Bloch form factors strongly favor intravalley pairing, with a leading predominantly $p_x-ip_y$ instability and a substantially larger maximum $T_c$ than the intervalley reference state. At the same time, trigonal-warping-induced mismatch cuts off the Cooper logarithm and confines intravalley superconductivity to a much narrower region of the phase diagram. The dominant instability occurs near pair-Lifshitz transitions and primarily in reconstructed annular or three-lobed Fermi-surface regimes. Our results show that superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene is controlled by the combined effects of quantum-geometry-dressed interactions, pair fermiology, and trigonal-warping-induced pair breaking.

AI.tldr: 该研究用 DFT 拟合的多轨道紧束缚模型（multiorbital tight-binding model）结合 RPA 屏蔽与投影 Cooper 相互作用，分析电子掺杂菱面体四层石墨烯（rhombohedral tetralayer graphene）中的 Kohn–Luttinger 超导。结果显示 Bloch 波形因子（Bloch form factors）强烈偏好谷内配对，主导不稳定性为 p_x-ip_y 手性配对，但三角翘曲（trigonal warping）引起的能量失配截断 Cooper 对数并压缩谷内超导相区。
AI.motivation: 菱面体石墨烯中自旋与谷极化正常态涌现的超导性构成基本谜题：三角翘曲使谷内 Cooper 对不具简并性，缺乏常规 Cooper 不稳定性（Cooper instability）所依赖的粒子–粒子嵌套（particle–particle nesting）。尽管模型研究提示非平凡能带几何（band geometry）可促进手性配对（chiral pairing），但几何增强与真实能带结构导致的配对破坏（pair breaking）之间如何竞争尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用 DFT 拟合的多轨道紧束缚模型研究电子掺杂菱面体四层石墨烯中的 Kohn–Luttinger 超导，在 RPA 屏蔽（RPA screening）与投影 Cooper 相互作用中保留完整 Bloch 波函数波形因子。将超导不稳定性分解为三项贡献：对称性分辨的波形因子修饰相互作用、由对称化配对色散决定的 Cooper 对相空间、以及三角翘曲产生的能量失配。
AI.result: Bloch 波形因子强烈偏向谷内配对，主导不稳定性为以 p_x-ip_y 为主的手性配对，其最高 T_c 显著大于谷间参考态。三角翘曲引起的失配截断 Cooper 对数，使谷内超导局限于相图中远更狭窄的区域。主导不稳定性出现在配对 Lifshitz 转变（pair-Lifshitz transitions）附近，主要位于重构的环形或三瓣费米面（Fermi-surface）区域。
AI.conclusion: 菱面体石墨烯中的超导性由量子几何修饰相互作用（quantum-geometry-dressed interactions）、配对费米学（pair fermiology）与三角翘曲诱导配对破坏三者的联合效应所控制。

title: Neutrino Tridents and $W$-boson production at the Muon Collider
summary: Muon colliders are exceptionally intense sources of multi-TeV neutrinos, allowing even relatively small detectors to record large rates of neutrino interactions. In addition to serving as neutrino-ion collider for precision measurements of neutrino deep inelastic scattering, this setup allow to study even rare neutrino processes with at high statistics. In this study, we investigate the feasibility of measuring neutrino trident and on-shell W-boson production, predicting over one million trident events and one hundred thousand W-boson events in a 100 kg silicon-based active target over ten years and allowing to detect these processes for the first time. We further show that these measurements could constrain new vector and axial-vector interactions beyond projected DUNE sensitivities and provide unprecedented constraints on the high-x photon distribution through W-boson production near threshold. We also discuss strategies for signal-background discrimination and the resulting detector requirements.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估在μ子对撞机（muon collider）产生的高强度多TeV中微子束中，利用100 kg硅基主动靶（silicon-based active target）探测中微子三叉（neutrino trident）与壳上W玻色子（on-shell W-boson）产生的可行性。
AI.motivation: μ子对撞机是极强的多TeV中微子源，即使探测器体积较小也可记录大量中微子相互作用，从而为高统计量研究稀有中微子过程提供条件；此前此类过程尚未被探测到，且其可用于探索超出标准模型的新相互作用。
AI.method: 研究基于μ子对撞机作为中微子-离子对撞机（neutrino-ion collider）的设定，针对中微子深度非弹性散射（deep inelastic scattering）与稀有过程进行统计预估，并讨论信号-背景甄别（signal-background discrimination）策略及相应的探测器需求。
AI.result: 预测在100 kg硅基主动靶中十年内可记录超过一百万例三叉事件与十万例W玻色子事件，有望首次探测这些过程；这些测量可对超出DUNE预期灵敏度（projected DUNE sensitivities）的新矢量与轴矢量相互作用（vector and axial-vector interactions）给出限制，并通过近阈W玻色子产生对高x光子分布（high-x photon distribution）提供前所未有的约束。
AI.conclusion: 在μ子对撞机中微子束实验条件下，中微子三叉与壳上W玻色子产生具备可观测性，并可用于新物理检验与质子光子分布的精确约束。

title: Modular Flow and Holographic Timelike Entanglement Entropy in AdS and Flat Holography
summary:
Timelike entanglement entropy provides a useful probe of holographic theoris, yet an explicit bulk realization of the modular flow underlying its timelike extremal curve construction has so far been lacking. We construct modular flows associated with spacelike and timelike intervals in AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$ and extend this framework to flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$. Beginning with the boundary symmetry generators, we explicitly derive the boundary modular flows and extend them into the bulk, providing a systematic procedure that relates bulk modular flows to the extremal curves and holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy.
  For spacelike intervals, the resulting bulk modular flows determine the extremal curves, whose integrated line elements reproduce the standard holographic entanglement entropy. We then generalize this approach to timelike intervals, explicitly constructing the modular flows whose fixed points reproduce the extremal spacelike and timelike curves which gives the holographic timelike entanglement entropy. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction of the modular flow associated with a timelike extremal curve for a timelike interval.
  The same procedure is then carried over to flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$, which give rise to the holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy. Finally, we show that the flat space results obtained in this work can be recovered from their AdS$_3$ counterparts in the flat space limit.

AI.tldr: 该文在 AdS₃/CFT₂ 中显式构造了与类空及类时间隔对应的模流（modular flow），并将其拓展至 flat₃/CCFT₂，从而首次给出与类时极值曲线（timelike extremal curve）相关联的模流显式构造，为全息类时纠缠熵（holographic timelike entanglement entropy）提供了体（bulk）实现。
AI.motivation: 类时纠缠熵可用于探测全息理论，但其类时极值曲线构造背后的模流一直缺乏显式的体实现。该工作即针对这一缺失展开。
AI.method: 从边界对称性生成元出发，显式推导边界模流并延拓至体（bulk），建立体模流与极值曲线及全息（类时）纠缠熵之间的系统对应程序；随后将该程序迁移至 flat₃/CCFT₂，并考察平空间极限。
AI.result: 类空间隔情形下，体模流决定的极值曲线的线元积分重现标准全息纠缠熵；类时间隔情形下，所构造模流的不动点重现给出全息类时纠缠熵的类空与类时极值曲线。据作者所知，这是首次为类时间隔显式构造与类时极值曲线相关的模流。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在 AdS₃/CFT₂ 与 flat₃/CCFT₂ 中一致地导出全息（类时）纠缠熵，且平空间结果可由其 AdS₃ 对应结果在平空间极限下恢复。

title: Pseudo-spectral methods in gravitational lensing: Spin precession in loop quantum black hole spacetimes
comment: 24 pages, 5 figures in main texts, 1 illustration figure in appendix; comments welcome
summary: Gravitational lensing is usually treated as an initial value problem: for a given impact parameter of an unbound orbit, one computes the resulting deflection angle. In this paper we advocate the inverse point of view. For a prescribed deflection angle, the orbit is selected by two boundary conditions at spatial infinity, so that the lensing problem becomes a well-defined two-point boundary value problem, with the impact parameter playing the role of a nonlinear eigenvalue. We show that pseudo-spectral methods based on Chebyshev collocation solve this boundary value problem accurately at modest computational cost, and that the parallel transport equations governing the spin precession of the particle reduce to a single linear system on the same grid. As a concrete application, we compute the spin precession of massive particles in backward scattering off two black hole spacetimes from loop quantum gravity: the covariant effective metric and the self-dual loop quantum black hole. All equations are written for a general static, spherically symmetric line element with three free functions, so that both spacetimes are handled on the same footing. We find that the quantum corrections are most pronounced for slowly moving particles, while in the ultra-relativistic limit the universal spin flip is always recovered. The flip itself is universal, but the rate at which it is approached is not: the derivative of $\cosξ$ with respect to the particle speed at $v=1$ is a strong-field quantity in every backward channel and depends clearly on the quantum parameters of both spacetimes. The framework is not restricted to the models studied

AI.tldr: 该文将引力透镜（gravitational lensing）由传统的初值问题（initial value problem）重构为两点边值问题（two-point boundary value problem），以冲击参数（impact parameter）作为非线性本征值，并用基于 Chebyshev 配置点的伪谱法（pseudo-spectral methods）高效求解，进而计算两类圈量子引力黑洞时空中大质量粒子的自旋进动（spin precession）。
AI.motivation: 传统引力透镜研究以给定冲击参数的无界轨道初值问题为出发点，计算偏转角。作者主张采用逆向视角：对给定偏转角，通过空间无穷远处的两个边界条件选取轨道，从而将透镜问题转化为定义良好的两点边值问题，并使冲击参数充当非线性本征值（nonlinear eigenvalue）。
AI.method: 采用基于 Chebyshev 配置点（Chebyshev collocation）的伪谱法（pseudo-spectral methods）求解该边值问题，并指出控制粒子自旋进动的平行移动方程（parallel transport equations）可在同一网格上约化为一个线性系统。所有方程针对含三个自由函数的通用静态球对称线元（static, spherically symmetric line element）书写，使两类时空可在同一框架下处理。
AI.result: 作为具体应用，计算了来自圈量子引力（loop quantum gravity）的两类黑洞时空——协变有效度规（covariant effective metric）与自对偶圈量子黑洞（self-dual loop quantum black hole）——中反向散射（backward scattering）下大质量粒子的自旋进动。结果显示：量子修正对慢速运动粒子最为显著，而在超相对论极限（ultra-relativistic limit）下普遍的自旋翻转（spin flip）总能被恢复；翻转本身具有普适性，但趋近速率不普适——$\cos\xi$ 对粒子速度的导数在 $v=1$ 处是各反向通道中的强场量（strong-field quantity），并明显依赖于两类时空的量子参数。
AI.conclusion: 将引力透镜视为以冲击参数为非线性本征值的两点边值问题，配合伪谱数值方法，可准确且计算成本适中地求解该问题，并统一处理自旋进动方程。该框架并不局限于所研究的模型。

title: Exotic metallic phase in a heterotic Kondo lattice: violation of Luttinger's theorem and absence of Kondo gap
summary: Fermi surface transformation accompanied by quantum phase transition is widely observed in correlated electron systems including heavy fermion materials and van der Waals quantum heterostructures. The unified Anderson lattice description for this phenomenon suggests that their interacting ground states in the case of electron half filling always destabilize the metallic phase in the strong Kondo-coupling regime. We examine this issue within the paramagnetic phase of a Kondo lattice system with a heterotic layered structure. In the weak Kondo-coupling regime, the system exhibits a fractional Dirac liquid involving the massless or massive Dirac fermions and a charge neutral spinon Fermi surface. In the strong Kondo-coupling regime, the spinons hybridize with the Dirac fermions resulting in an intermediate nearly-flat hybridizing band together with the conduction and valence heavy fermion bands, yielding a large electric Fermi surface. Absence of the Kondo gap between these bands is observed depending on the stacking configurations of the layered structure. In particular, the system remains metallic even at the exact half filling in this regime and Luttinger's theorem is violated across the critical point. Implications of these results on the van der Waals quantum heterostructures are briefly discussed.

AI.tldr: 在具有异质层状结构的近藤晶格（Kondo lattice）顺磁相中，弱近藤耦合区出现分数化狄拉克液体，强耦合区则形成含近平坦杂化带的近藤重费米子金属，且在精确半填充下仍保持金属性并违反 Luttinger 定理。
AI.motivation: 费米面（Fermi surface）转变伴随量子相变（quantum phase transition）在重费米子材料与范德华量子异质结构（van der Waals quantum heterostructures）中被广泛观测。统一的 Anderson 晶格（Anderson lattice）描述表明，电子半填充下强近藤耦合区会破坏金属相，本文旨在检验这一问题。
AI.method: 在异质层状结构的近藤晶格（Kondo lattice）系统的顺磁相（paramagnetic phase）框架内，分别考察弱近藤耦合与强近藤耦合两个区域，分析动量空间中费米子与自旋子（spinon）的杂化行为。
AI.result: 弱耦合区呈现分数化狄拉克液体（fractional Dirac liquid），包含无质量或有质量狄拉克费米子（Dirac fermions）与电荷中性自旋子费米面；强耦合区自旋子与狄拉克费米子杂化，形成中间近平坦杂化带及导带、价带重费米子带（heavy fermion bands），产生大电性费米面。是否出现近藤能隙（Kondo gap）依赖于层状堆叠构型；该区域内在精确半填充下系统仍为金属，且跨临界点时违反 Luttinger 定理。
AI.conclusion: 层状近藤晶格系统在半填充强耦合区可保持金属相，与统一 Anderson 晶格描述的预期不同；该结果对范德华量子异质结构中的费米面转变与量子相变行为具有参考意义。

title: Lepton Flavour Universality in Semileptonic $\bar B_{(s)} \to D_{(s)}^{(\ast)}$ Transitions
summary: Using continuum Schwinger function methods, we deliver parameter-free pointwise predictions for the complete set of twelve Standard Model (SM) $\bar B_{(s)} \to D_{(s)}^{(\ast)}$, i.e., $b\to c$, semileptonic transition form factors on the entire kinematically accessible domain. Therewith, we calculate SM theory values for the decay-rate ratios of $τ$ and $μ$ final states: $\{ R(D) \, , \, R(D)^\ast \} = \{ 0.290(11) \, , \, 0.267(5) \}$, $\{ R(D_{s}) \, , \, R(D_{s}^{\ast}) \} = \{ 0.283(11) \, , \, 0.251(5) \}$. The former is consistent with an existing average of SM estimates, but disagrees with the experimental average by $2.8σ$. Comparing transitions with light quark and strange quark spectators, we find a $2.3σ$ signal for violation of SU$(3)$ flavour symmetry, expressed at the 5% level in $D_{(s)}^\ast$ final states. It is induced by Higgs boson couplings into the strong interaction and modulated by phenomena deriving from emergent features of the strong interaction.

AI.tldr: 基于连续 Schwinger 函数方法（continuum Schwinger function methods）给出标准模型（Standard Model, SM）下全部 12 个 $\bar B_{(s)} \to D_{(s)}^{(\ast)}$ 半轻子跃迁形状因子的无参数逐点预测，并据此计算 $\tau$ 与 $\mu$ 末态的衰变率比值；结果显示 $R(D)$ 与 SM 平均值一致但与实验平均值相差 $2.8\sigma$，并发现 SU(3) 味对称性破缺的 $2.3\sigma$ 信号。
AI.motivation: 论文动机在于对 $b\to c$ 半轻子跃迁给出无自由参数、覆盖整个运动学可及区域的形状因子预测，并借此检验标准模型对 $\tau$ 与 $\mu$ 末态衰变率比值的描述，以及考察轻夸克与奇异夸克旁观者情形下的 SU(3) 味对称性（flavour symmetry）。
AI.method: 采用连续 Schwinger 函数方法（continuum Schwinger function methods），对 12 个标准模型（SM）$\bar B_{(s)} \to D_{(s)}^{(\ast)}$（即 $b\to c$）半轻子跃迁形状因子进行无参数（parameter-free）逐点计算，并在此基础上求取 $\tau$ 与 $\mu$ 末态衰变率比值。
AI.result: 得到 $\{ R(D), R(D)^\ast \} = \{ 0.290(11), 0.267(5) \}$，$\{ R(D_{s}), R(D_{s}^{\ast}) \} = \{ 0.283(11), 0.251(5) \}$；前者与现有 SM 估计平均值一致，但与实验平均值相差 $2.8\sigma$。对比轻夸克与奇异夸克旁观者跃迁，发现 SU(3) 味对称性破缺的 $2.3\sigma$ 信号，在 $D_{(s)}^\ast$ 末态中表现为 5% 水平。
AI.conclusion: 该 SU(3) 味对称性破缺由希格斯玻色子（Higgs boson）与强相互作用的耦合所诱导，并受强相互作用涌现特征（emergent features）相关现象的调制；所得 $R(D)$ 值与 SM 平均值吻合，而与实验平均值的 $2.8\sigma$ 偏离有待进一步理解。

title: On the analytic continuation and asymptotic behaviour of the two-point function in massless $φ^4$-theory in Euclidean de Sitter space
summary: For the two-point function of the massless, minimally-coupled, real scalar field in Euclidean de Sitter space with $λφ^4$-interaction, we compute the leading-logarithmic terms in the invariant distance of the two-point function to $O(λ^2)$, which counts as the fifth subleading order (N$^5$LO) in the $\sqrtλ$-expansion. We show that the analytic continuation to Lorentzian signature coincides with the expansion of the analogous quantity computed in the stochastic formalism. We determine the large-order behaviour of the stochastic series expansion and prove its Borel summability, which suggests that the Euclidean theory can be used to extract the late-time behaviour of massless correlation functions in Lorentzian de Sitter space.

AI.tldr: 在欧几里得德西特空间（Euclidean de Sitter space）中，计算了无质量最小耦合实标量场（massless, minimally-coupled, real scalar field）在 λφ⁴ 相互作用下两点函数（two-point function）至 O(λ²) 的对数项（leading-logarithmic terms），对应 √λ 展开的第五次次领头阶（N⁵LO）。结果与随机形式（stochastic formalism）相应量在洛伦兹号差（Lorentzian signature）下的解析延拓一致，且随机级数可 Borel 求和。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在联系欧几里得德西特空间中的微扰计算与随机形式（stochastic formalism），以理解无质量关联函数在洛伦兹德西特空间中的晚期行为（late-time behaviour）。
AI.method: 对 λφ⁴ 相互作用的无质量最小耦合实标量场两点函数，计算其在不变量距离（invariant distance）下至 O(λ²) 的对数项，即 √λ 展开的 N⁵LO；并将结果解析延拓至洛伦兹号差，与随机形式展开比较，同时分析随机级数的大阶行为（large-order behaviour）。
AI.result: 欧几里得计算解析延拓至洛伦兹号差后，与随机形式中同类量的展开相符；确定了随机级数展开的大阶行为，并证明其 Borel 可求和性（Borel summability）。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果提示欧几里得理论（Euclidean theory）可用于提取洛伦兹德西特空间中无质量关联函数的晚期行为。

title: Example of exponential many collisions of identical hard disks in the plane
summary: Let $ \operatorname{MaxCol}(n,d) $ denote the maximal number of nonsimultaneous elastic collisions among $n$ identical hard balls moving freely in $\mathbb{R}^d$. We give a planar construction with exponential lower bound with respect to $n$: $ \operatorname{MaxCol}(n,2)\geq 2^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}, \quad n\geq3 $.

AI.tldr: 该文研究 $n$ 个相同硬球（identical hard balls）在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中自由运动时不同时发生的弹性碰撞（nonsimultaneous elastic collisions）的最大次数 $\operatorname{MaxCol}(n,d)$，并构造出平面上具有指数下界的例子：$\operatorname{MaxCol}(n,2)\geq 2^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$（$n\geq3$）。
AI.motivation: 硬球系统的碰撞计数是硬球动力学（hard ball dynamics）中的基本问题，确定碰撞次数随粒子数增长的上限与可达下界具有理论意义。摘要未展开具体动机，仅指出研究目标是 $\operatorname{MaxCol}(n,d)$ 这一量的界。
AI.method: 方法为构造性证明：给出一个平面（planar）构型（construction），使 $n$ 个相同硬球在 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 中自由运动时产生大量非同时弹性碰撞，从而导出指数级下界。
AI.result: 得到平面情形下的指数下界：$\operatorname{MaxCol}(n,2)\geq 2^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$，对任意 $n\geq3$ 成立。摘要未给出更高维 $d>2$ 的结果，也未给出上界。
AI.conclusion: 平面硬球系统的非同时弹性碰撞次数可随粒子数 $n$ 呈指数增长，即 $\operatorname{MaxCol}(n,2)$ 至少有 $2^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$ 的量级。

title: Kantowski Sachs Cosmological Model with Radiation and Generalized Chaplygin Gas
comment: The paper has 26 pages and 14 figures
summary: In the present paper we study the evolution of a homogeneous and anisotropic Kantowski Sachs cosmological model coupled with radiation and a generalized Chaplygin gas. Our main objective is verifying if this model evolves to a homogeneous and isotropic Friedmann Robertson Walker cosmological model, which is the more accepted model to describe our present Universe. If this is the case, we may imagine that the Kantowski Sachs cosmological model could had been an early stage of our Universe.

AI.tldr: 本文研究均匀且各向异性的康德-萨克斯（Kantowski-Sachs）宇宙学模型与辐射及广义查普雷金气体（generalized Chaplygin gas）耦合的演化，旨在检验该模型是否演化为均匀各向同性的弗里德曼-罗伯逊-沃克（Friedmann-Robertson-Walker, FRW）模型，从而判断康德-萨克斯模型是否可能为宇宙早期阶段。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于检验该各向异性模型能否演化为被广泛接受的、描述当前宇宙的均匀各向同性 FRW 模型；若成立，则可设想康德-萨克斯模型曾是我们宇宙的早期阶段。
AI.method: 摘要仅说明所研究的对象为一个均匀且各向异性的康德-萨克斯宇宙学模型，并与辐射和广义查普雷金气体相耦合；未提供具体求解方法或分析手段的细节。
AI.result: 摘要未报告明确的演化结果或定量结论。
AI.conclusion: 摘要仅陈述研究目的与可能的推论设想，未给出明确结论；即若模型确实演化至 FRW 模型，则可推测康德-萨克斯模型可能对应宇宙的早期阶段。

title: Optoelectronically Enabled Simultaneous and Decoupled Navigation and Selective Pairing of Electrically Driven Janus Particles for Multi-Agent Microrobotics
summary: Self-propelled Janus particles are promising active agents for microscale manipulation and microrobotic applications. However, when powered by a global external energy source, such as an electric, magnetic, or optical field, all particles respond simultaneously, preventing their independent and concurrent control. Achieving parallel, decoupled control without continuous particle-specific feedback, while preserving intrinsic self-propulsion, remains a significant challenge. Here, we present an optoelectronic (OE) strategy for simultaneously and independently controlling electrically driven, self-propelled metallo-dielectric Janus particles (JPs) using spatially programmable virtual electrodes. These electrodes are generated by projecting a single predefined illumination pattern from a digital micromirror device onto a photoconductive surface. The resulting confinement landscape enables multiple JPs to follow distinct trajectories without continuous monitoring, feedback, or pattern reconfiguration. We demonstrate controlled pairing of JPs with passive polystyrene particles and biological cells. For automated multi-agent operation, an image-based assignment framework identifies optimal agent-target pairs, excludes intersecting trajectories, and generates a single composite pattern for simultaneous, selective pair formation without real-time updating. Finally, we demonstrate independent manipulation of multiple magnetically rolling JPs under a globally applied magnetic field. Overall, this programmable open-loop strategy provides a versatile framework for multi-agent microrobotic manipulation, with potential applications in in-vitro micromanipulation and microfluidic systems.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种光电（optoelectronic, OE）策略，利用空间可编程的虚拟电极（virtual electrodes）对电驱动的自推进金属-介电Janus粒子（Janus particles, JPs）实现并行且解耦的控制，无需连续反馈或图案重构。
AI.motivation: 自推进Janus粒子在微尺度操控与微机器人应用中具有潜力，但在电、磁、光等全局外场驱动下所有粒子同时响应，难以实现独立且并行的控制；在不依赖连续粒子级反馈的前提下实现解耦控制并保留本征自推进仍具挑战。
AI.method: 将数字微镜器件（digital micromirror device）投影的单一预设光照图案投射到光电导表面，生成空间可编程虚拟电极，从而形成限定势场（confinement landscape）引导多个JPs沿不同轨迹运动；并提出基于图像的分配框架（image-based assignment framework）筛选最优“智能体-目标”配对、排除相交轨迹并生成单一复合图案。
AI.result: 在所构建的势场中，多个JPs无需连续监测、反馈或图案重构即可沿各自轨迹运动；实现了JPs与被动聚苯乙烯（polystyrene）粒子及生物细胞的可控配对，并通过复合图案完成同步、选择性的配对形成且无需实时更新；同时在全球施加磁场下实现了多个磁性滚动JPs的独立操控。
AI.conclusion: 该可编程开环（open-loop）策略为多智能体微机器人操控提供了通用框架，在体外微操控（in-vitro micromanipulation）与微流控（microfluidic）系统中具有应用潜力。

title: FINESSE: A Versatile Beamline for Fundamental Interactions with Neutrons at the European Spallation SourcE
summary: FINESSE (A Versatile Beamline for \textbf{F}undamental \textbf{I}nteractions with \textbf{N}eutrons at the \textbf{E}uropean \textbf{S}pallation \textbf{S}ourc\textbf{E}) is a proposed versatile beamline for fundamental interactions with neutrons at the European Spallation Source. Building on the HIBEAM design studies, FINESSE extends the original concept into a dual-guide beamline capable of operating either in a high-flux configuration or in a low-background configuration within a single ESS beam port. The high-flux branch is optimized for rare-process searches, including neutron--antineutron oscillations, neutron--sterile-neutron transitions, axion-like-particle searches, neutron charge measurements, and rare neutron decays. The low-background branch is designed for precision measurements requiring strong suppression of prompt and line-of-sight backgrounds, with a cryogenic neutron electric-dipole-moment experiment used as a benchmark case. A baseline exchangeable-guide concept has been developed in which only short guide sections inside the ESS bunker are exchanged, while the upstream extraction system and chopper positions remain fixed. A staged implementation, Short FINESSE, would use the upstream section of the high-flux beamline together with a compact magnetically controlled experimental region, enabling an early physics and R\&D programme before completion of the full facility. This paper summarizes the scientific case, beamline concept, guide simulations, chopper and timing system, magnetic-field control, detector developments, and staged implementation strategy. FINESSE would establish a long-term particle-physics infrastructure at ESS, providing a beamline for both discovery-driven searches and precision neutron measurements throughout the lifetime of the facility.

AI.tldr: FINESSE 是欧洲散裂中子源（European Spallation Source, ESS）上提出的双导束（dual-guide）中子束线，可在单一束端口内切换高通量与低本底两种配置，分别服务于稀有过程搜寻与精密测量，并规划了分阶段实施的 Short FINESSE 方案。
AI.motivation: 该束线旨在 ESS 上建立长期粒子物理（particle physics）基础设施，以同时支撑发现导向的稀有过程搜寻与精密中子测量。其设计延续并拓展了 HIBEAM 的原始概念。
AI.method: 采用双导束束线设计，可运行于高通量或低本底配置；提出基线可更换导束（exchangeable-guide）概念，仅更换 ESS 掩体内短导束段，上游引出系统与斩波器（chopper）位置保持固定。工作涵盖导束模拟、斩波器与定时系统、磁场控制及探测器研制。
AI.result: 高通量分支面向中子—反中子振荡（neutron–antineutron oscillations）、中子—惰性中子转变、类轴子粒子（axion-like-particle）搜寻、中子电荷测量与稀有中子衰变；低本底分支面向需强烈抑制瞬发与视线本底的精密测量，并以低温中子电偶极矩（neutron electric-dipole-moment）实验为基准案例。Short FINESSE 将利用高通量束线上游段与紧凑磁控实验区，在全设施建成前开展早期物理与研发（R&D）计划。
AI.conclusion: FINESSE 有望在 ESS 全寿命期内提供兼具发现驱动搜寻与精密中子测量的束线，从而确立长期粒子物理基础设施。

title: New analytic Janus and $S^4$ solutions for $\mathcal{N}=2^*$
summary: We construct a three-parameter family of regular analytic supergravity solutions which are dual to (a) the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ gauge theory on the four-sphere, and (b) $\mathrm{U}(1)^2$-invariant Janus interfaces in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with or without the $\mathcal{N}=2^*$ mass turned on. To this end we employ a five-dimensional supergravity model coupled to six scalars which arises as a certain consistent truncation of type IIB supergravity on $S^5$. The curved domain wall solutions feature a hidden integral of motion which allows for their analytic treatment. We relate the three parameters of the solution to field theory sources and vevs and show how regularity of the solutions restricts their range. We briefly discuss the holographic evaluation of the one-point function of the field theory Lagrangian for our family of Janus solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一类三参数的正则解析超引力解，其全息对偶同时涵盖四维球面上的 𝒩=2* 规范理论以及 𝒩=4 SYM 中的 U(1)² 不变 Janus 界面（含或不含 𝒩=2* 质量）。构造基于五维超引力耦合六个标量的模型，并利用隐藏的运动积分实现解析处理。
AI.motivation: 已有 Janus 界面与 𝒩=2* 理论的全息对偶解多依赖数值方法，缺乏可解析处理的解族。本文旨在构造一类同时描述球面 𝒩=2* 规范理论与 U(1)² 不变 Janus 界面的正则解析解，以提供可控的全息研究平台。
AI.method: 采用 IIB 型超引力（type IIB supergravity）在 S⁵ 上约化所得到的五维超引力模型，耦合六个标量；该模型为一类一致截断（consistent truncation）。求解曲面畴壁（curved domain wall）解，借助其隐藏的运动积分（hidden integral of motion）实现解析求解，并将三个参数对应到场论源（sources）与真空期望值（vevs）。
AI.result: 获得三参数族的正则解析超引力解，可对偶于四维球面上的 𝒩=2* 规范理论，以及带或不带 𝒩=2* 质量的 𝒩=4 SYM 中 U(1)² 不变 Janus 界面。解的正则性（regularity）对三参数的取值范围构成限制。文中并简要讨论了该 Janus 解族中场论拉格朗日量单点函数（one-point function）的全息计算。
AI.conclusion: 该三参数解族为 𝒩=2* 球面理论与 Janus 界面提供统一的解析全息描述，并将解参数与场论源、vevs 及正则性约束相联系，为后续全息关联函数的解析计算奠定基础。

title: Adiabatic particle production in a time-dependent accelerated frame
summary: We study a massive scalar field in flat spacetime written in a time-dependent accelerated frame whose fixed-coordinate observers have maximal proper acceleration at $t=0$ and become asymptotically inertial without forming a horizon. The Klein-Gordon equation separates into a modified Mathieu equation in time and a confining Schrödinger problem in space with a discrete spectrum. We impose an adiabatic vacuum at the instant of maximal acceleration and compute the particle number in the inertial future. For the zeroth-order adiabatic state it falls as the inverse eighth power of the initial mode frequency, and raising the adiabatic order cancels successive terms of the endpoint expansion, in analogy with the switching transients of finite-time detectors. Analytic continuation of the spatial eigenfunctions gives the out modes in closed form and an exact expression for the particle number, which is entirely the mismatch at $t=0$ between the initial state and the out vacuum. The spectrum is algebraic rather than Planckian.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在无事件视界的时变加速参照系中大质量标量场（massive scalar field）的粒子激发，将克莱因-戈尔登方程分解为时间方向的修正马修方程（modified Mathieu equation）与空间方向的束缚薛定谔问题，并在绝热真空（adiabatic vacuum）初态下计算惯性未来的粒子数。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于考察具有最大固有加速度、但渐近趋于惯性且不形成视界（horizon）的时变加速参照系中量子场的粒子产生，以区别于依赖视界的常规加速效应（如安鲁效应）图像。
AI.method: 方法上，在平直时空（flat spacetime）中引入时变加速参照系；将克莱因-戈尔登方程分离为时间方向的修正马修方程与空间方向具有离散谱（discrete spectrum）的束缚薛定谔问题；在最大加速度瞬时施加绝热真空，并通过空间本征函数的解析延拓（analytic continuation）以闭式给出外模式（out modes）与粒子数的精确表达式，同时讨论绝热阶数（adiabatic order）对端点展开的抵消作用。
AI.result: 结果显示，零阶绝热态的粒子数随初始模式频率的负八次幂衰减；提高绝热阶数可逐项抵消端点展开的贡献，类比有限时间探测器（finite-time detectors）的开关瞬态（switching transients）。所得粒子数谱为代数型（algebraic）而非普朗克型（Planckian）。
AI.conclusion: 结论指出，粒子数完全源于 t=0 时刻初始态与外真空（out vacuum）之间的失配（mismatch），即该效应的本质是初始时刻的态失配，而非热谱型辐射。

title: Surface Granular flows: Two Related Examples
summary: Granular surface flows are common in industrial practice and natural systems, however, theoretical description of such flows is at present incomplete. Two prototype systems involving surface flow are compared: heap formation by pouring at a point and rotating cylinders. Continuum models for analysis of these flows are reviewed, and experimental results for quasi-2d systems are presented. Experimental results in both systems are well described by continuum models.

AI.tldr: 颗粒表面流（granular surface flows）在工业与自然系统中普遍存在，但理论描述尚不完善。本文对比点源倾泻成堆与旋转圆筒两类原型系统，综述连续介质模型（continuum models）并给出准二维（quasi-2d）实验，结果表明两类系统的实验现象均可由连续介质模型良好描述。
AI.motivation: 颗粒表面流在工业实践与自然系统中十分常见，然而目前对其的理论描述仍不完整，因此需要借助原型系统与连续介质模型加以刻画和验证。
AI.method: 选取两类涉及表面流的原型系统进行对比：点源倾泻形成的颗粒堆（heap formation by pouring at a point）与旋转圆筒（rotating cylinders）；同时综述用于分析此类流动的连续介质模型，并给出准二维系统的实验结果。
AI.result: 两类原型系统的实验结果均与连续介质模型吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 连续介质模型能够有效描述点源成堆与旋转圆筒两类颗粒表面流系统，为该类流动提供了可行的理论分析框架。

title: Parton and nuclear dynamics at large $x$: the CJ26 global QCD analysis
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Proceedings of DIS2026, Bologna, Italy, 4-8 May 2026
summary: We present the new CTEQ-JLab global QCD analysis, called CJ26, that simultaneously fits parton distribution functions of the proton and nuclear effects in deuteron targets. This work includes, for the first time in a global fit, the full set of JLab 6 GeV inclusive DIS measurements and the first published JLab 12 GeV data. The analysis focuses on the large-$x$ region, and carefully treats the interplay between higher-twist effects and off-shell corrections in low-energy proton and deuteron target data. We discuss their effect on quark and gluon distributions, and highlight the importance of quantifying the experimental correlated systematic uncertainty to achieve fits of the highest accuracy. We also outline how upcoming data may help unravel the nuclear and partonic dynamics in light nuclei. The extracted next-to-leading order parton distributions are available on the CJ web pages in LHAPDF format for general use, accompanied by leading- and higher-twist structure functions calculated with the simultaneously fitted PDFs, higher-twist corrections, and off-shell corrections. This write up clarifies several points that became clearer while finalizing the CJ26 paper and can be read as a companion to the latter.

AI.tldr: CJ26 是一个新的 CTEQ-JLab 全局 QCD 分析（global QCD analysis），首次在全局拟合中同时处理质子部分子分布函数（parton distribution functions, PDFs）与氘核靶中的核效应，并纳入完整的 JLab 6 GeV 与首批 12 GeV 深度非弹性散射（inclusive DIS）数据。
AI.motivation: 分析聚焦于大 $x$ 区域，需要厘清低能质子与氘核靶数据中高扭效应（higher-twist effects）与离壳修正（off-shell corrections）之间的相互作用，并提升拟合精度。
AI.method: 采用全局 QCD 拟合方法，同时拟合质子 PDFs 与氘核核效应，首次纳入完整的 JLab 6 GeV 深度非弹性散射测量及首批已发表的 JLab 12 GeV 数据，并着重处理高扭效应与离壳修正的相互影响，同时量化实验关联系统不确定度（correlated systematic uncertainty）。
AI.result: 给出了这些效应对夸克与胶子分布的影响，并指出量化实验关联系统不确定度对于实现最高精度拟合的重要性；提取的次领头阶（next-to-leading order, NLO）部分子分布及配套的领头阶与高扭结构函数（structure functions）以 LHAPDF 格式在 CJ 网页公开。
AI.conclusion: 该文澄清了在最终完成 CJ26 论文过程中变得更为明确的若干要点，可作为 CJ26 论文的配套读物；并概述了未来数据如何有助于揭示轻核中的核与部分子动力学。

title: Holographic Pseudo Entropy from the Rindler Method in AdS and Flat Space
summary: Via the Rindler method, we study holographic timelike entanglement entropy (TEE) for a general timelike interval in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ and flat$_3$/CCFT$_2$. The TEE is the pseudo entropy of a timelike interval. In the bulk, the imaginary part of the TEE comes from a timelike geodesic, but in the Rindler picture this geodesic has not been identified. After a Rindler transformation to a rotating BTZ black hole, the two spacelike extremal curves lie on the inner and outer horizons, and exchanging $l_u\leftrightarrow \ell l_φ$ takes one to the other. We find the geometric meaning of the timelike extremal curve: a geodesic stretched between the two horizons. Its length, $iπ\ell$, is independent of the interval, and it alone produces the imaginary part $iπc/6$. We follow the same procedure in flat space holography, where the spacelike curve sits on the cosmological horizon and the timelike curve lies between the cosmological horizon and timelike infinity. Evaluating the holographic TEE for a timelike interval in CCFT$_2$ on the plane, we find that, in contrast with the cylinder, the real and imaginary parts are equal.

AI.tldr: 借助 Rindler 方法研究 AdS₃/CFT₂ 与 flat₃/CCFT₂ 中一般类时间隔的全息类时纠缠熵（timelike entanglement entropy, TEE），指出其虚部源自连接内外视界（或宇宙视界与类时无穷远）的类时极值曲线，长度恒为 iπℓ，独立于间隔。
AI.motivation: 类时间隔的 TEE 可视为伪熵（pseudo entropy），其体内部虚部来自类时测地线（timelike geodesic），但在 Rindler 图景中该测地线此前尚未被识别，因此需要明确其几何对应并推广至平直空间全息。
AI.method: 采用 Rindler 方法（Rindler method），对 AdS₃/CFT₂ 与 flat₃/CCFT₂ 中的一般类时间隔作 Rindler 变换，映射为旋转 BTZ 黑洞，使两条类空极值曲线（spacelike extremal curves）分别位于内、外视界，并通过 l_u ↔ ℓl_φ 的交换相互对应；平直空间情形采用相同步骤。
AI.result: AdS₃ 情形下，类时极值曲线的几何意义为横跨两视界之间的测地线，其长度为 iπℓ，与间隔无关，且单独给出虚部 iπc/6。平直空间全息中，类空曲线位于宇宙视界（cosmological horizon）上，类时曲线位于宇宙视界与类时无穷远之间。对平面上的 CCFT₂ 类时间隔求值，与柱面情形相反，实部与虚部相等。
AI.conclusion: Rindler 方法可统一刻画 AdS₃ 与平直空间全息中类时间隔 TEE 的几何结构，明确了类时极值曲线的视界间定位及其恒定长度；平面 CCFT₂ 中实虚部相等的特征与柱面结果形成对比。

title: Harmonic Reduction of Spin-Coupled Grover Walks on Hypercubes via Quantum Bernoulli Noises
summary: We consider spin-coupled Grover walks on hypercubes within the framework of quantum Bernoulli noises (QBN). We identify parity-dependent harmonic subspaces generated by the central Hamming layers: in even dimension they give a fixed-point subspace, whereas in odd dimension the walk reduces on the harmonic subspace to an explicit eight-dimensional reduced dynamics. Using symmetric-group representation theory, we characterize the corresponding isotypic structure and determine the reduced spectrum. The harmonic reduction also yields explicit long-time probability behavior and shows that the resulting states may occupy an asymptotically vanishing fraction of the hypercube while still spanning its full Hamming diameter.

AI.tldr: 在量子伯努利噪声（quantum Bernoulli noises, QBN）框架下，研究超立方体（hypercube）上的自旋耦合 Grover 行走（spin-coupled Grover walks），识别由中心汉明层（central Hamming layers）产生的宇称依赖调和子空间，并借助对称群表示论刻画其同型结构与约化谱。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在将自旋耦合 Grover 行走置于量子伯努利噪声框架中，并揭示超立方体中心汉明层所诱导的调和子空间结构，从而理解维度奇偶性对行走动力学与长期概率行为的影响。
AI.method: 方法包括：构造 QBN 框架下的自旋耦合 Grover 行走；识别宇称依赖的调和子空间（偶维为不动点子空间，奇维约化为显式八维约化动力学）；运用对称群表示论（symmetric-group representation theory）刻画同型结构（isotypic structure）并确定约化谱。
AI.result: 偶维情形下，中心汉明层产生不动点子空间；奇维情形下，行走在调和子空间上约化为显式的八维动力学。通过表示论得到同型结构与约化谱，并给出长期概率行为的显式结果：所得状态可占据超立方体的渐近消失比例，但仍跨越完整的汉明直径（Hamming diameter）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，QBN 框架下的自旋耦合 Grover 行走具有宇称依赖的调和约化结构，其长期概率行为呈现“占据比例渐近消失”与“跨越全汉明直径”并存的特征。

title: Dirac stars in modified $F(R)$ gravity
summary: We study Dirac mini-stars in modified $R^2$ gravity, where gravity is sourced by both linear and nonlinear spinor fields. Two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) profiles of the mini-star mass are constructed as functions of the spinor frequency (for the 2D profiles) and the central value of the spinor field (for the 3D profiles) in general relativity and modified gravity for various values of the spinor nonlinearity parameter. We show that the modification of gravity alters the properties of these configurations, while increasing the nonlinearity parameter within the framework of $R^2$ gravity significantly changes the profiles of the spinor and metric functions, the effective energy density, and the dependence of the total mass on the oscillation frequency. The most pronounced changes occur at large values of the nonlinearity parameter.

AI.tldr: 该论文在修正的 $R^2$ 引力（modified $R^2$ gravity）框架下研究由线性与非线性旋量场（spinor fields）作为引力源的狄拉克迷你星（Dirac mini-stars），构建其质量的二维与三维分布，并考察引力修正与旋量非线性参数对结构性质的影响。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探讨引力理论修正与旋量场非线性如何共同影响狄拉克迷你星这类自引力旋量构型的性质，通过对比广义相对论（general relativity）与修正引力下的结果来揭示引力修正的作用。
AI.method: 在 $R^2$ 修正引力中，以线性与非线性旋量场为引力源，针对不同旋量非线性参数取值，分别在广义相对论与修正引力下构建迷你星质量的二维分布（作为旋量频率的函数）与三维分布（作为旋量场中心值的函数）。
AI.result: 引力修正改变了这些构型的性质；在 $R^2$ 引力框架内增大非线性参数会显著改变旋量与度规函数（metric functions）的分布、有效能量密度（effective energy density）以及总质量对振荡频率的依赖关系，且最显著的变化出现在非线性参数取值较大时。
AI.conclusion: 表明 $R^2$ 引力修正与旋量非线性共同决定了狄拉克迷你星的结构与质量特征，非线性参数越大，效应越为突出。

title: A Fisher-Geometric Approach to Supercell Pair Distribution Function Refinement
summary: Refining atomistic supercells against powder pair distribution functions (PDFs) requires optimizing many coupled atomic coordinates using a much smaller set of radial measurements. Reverse-mode differentiation makes gradients accessible for large systems, but standard first-order optimizers do not explicitly use coupled PDF sensitivities to precondition coordinate updates. We introduce a matrix-free, Fisher-geometric approach that pulls the information metric of the observation likelihood back onto atomic coordinates. The resulting update weights collective displacements according to their PDF response and experimental uncertainty. Under isotropic damping, the update is obtained by solving a damped linear system over $M$ PDF channels, using automatic differentiation to evaluate Jacobian--vector and vector--Jacobian products without constructing the full Jacobian or coordinate curvature matrix. For Gaussian measurement errors, the update recovers classical Levenberg--Marquardt refinement while avoiding dense coordinate-space factorization. The same computational framework accommodates correlated Gaussian errors and robust likelihood-based updates. This approach combines likelihood-aware collective updates with matrix-free backpropagation for direct second-order refinement of large atomistic supercells.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无矩阵（matrix-free）的 Fisher 几何方法，将观测似然的信息度量回拉至原子坐标，实现大规模原子超胞对粉末对分布函数（PDF）的二阶精修，无需构造完整雅可比矩阵。
AI.motivation: 用远少于坐标数的径向测量数据精修超胞时，标准一阶优化器未显式利用耦合的 PDF 敏感性来预条件坐标更新，因此需要兼顾梯度可计算性与二阶信息利用的方法。
AI.method: 构建无矩阵的 Fisher 几何框架，把观测似然的信息度量（information metric）拉回到原子坐标上；在等向阻尼下通过求解 M 个 PDF 通道的阻尼线性系统得到更新量，并用自动微分（automatic differentiation）计算 Jacobian–向量与向量–Jacobian 乘积，避免构造完整雅可比或坐标曲率矩阵。
AI.result: 更新量按集合位移的 PDF 响应与实验不确定度加权；在高斯测量误差下可恢复经典 Levenberg–Marquardt 精修，同时避免稠密坐标空间分解；同一计算框架亦可处理相关高斯误差与基于稳健似然的更新。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将似然感知的集合式更新与无矩阵反向传播（backpropagation）结合，实现对大型原子超胞的直接二阶精修。

title: Cryogenic characterisation of the FBK NUV-HD-cryo Silicon Photomultipliers for the DarkSide-20k dark matter experiment
summary: Liquid Argon Time Projection Chambers (TPCs) are highly promising detectors for dark matter searches due to their uniform response, scalability to large target masses, and compatibility with ultra-low background conditions. The DarkSide-20k (DS-20k) experiment, currently under construction at Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare (INFN) Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (LNGS), aims to achieve unprecedented sensitivity to Weakly Interacting Massive Particles (WIMPs), approaching the neutrino fog. At the heart of the detector is a dual-phase TPC filled and surrounded by low-radioactivity argon from underground sources (i.e. Underground Argon (UAr)), functioning both as the WIMP target and detection medium. The experiment employs Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) NUV-HD-cryo Silicon Photomultipliers (SiPMs) as the chosen photon sensors for its optical planes. Key SiPM properties such as dark noise rate, gain and direct crosstalk were measured using specialized test setups at 77 K. The photon detection efficiency (PDE) was measured under vacuum at 77 K over the wavelength range 350-820 nm. Secondary photon emission, which can give rise to external optical crosstalk, was measured under vacuum at 86 K over the wavelength range 550-1020 nm.

AI.tldr: 该摘要介绍了 DarkSide-20k（DS-20k）液氩时间投影室（Liquid Argon Time Projection Chamber, TPC）暗物质探测实验，并报告其硅光电倍增器（Silicon Photomultiplier, SiPM）在低温下的关键性能测量。
AI.motivation: 液氩 TPC 因响应均匀、可扩展至大靶质量且兼容超低本底条件，被视为极具前景的暗物质探测手段；DS-20k 旨在以空前的灵敏度探测弱相互作用大质量粒子（Weakly Interacting Massive Particle, WIMP），逼近中微子雾（neutrino fog）。
AI.method: DS-20k 采用双相 TPC，内部及周围填充来自地下源的低放射性氩（Underground Argon, UAr），兼作 WIMP 靶与探测介质；光学平面选用 FBK NUV-HD-cryo 硅光电倍增器，并利用专用装置在 77 K 下测量暗噪声率、增益与直接串扰，在真空中于 77 K、350-820 nm 波段测量光子探测效率（PDE），于 86 K、550-1020 nm 波段测量可致外部光学串扰的二次光子发射。
AI.result: 测得相关 SiPM 特性：77 K 下的暗噪声率、增益与直接串扰；77 K 真空条件下 350-820 nm 的 PDE；86 K 真空条件下 550-1020 nm 的二次光子发射。
AI.conclusion: 上述低温 SiPM 性能测量为 DS-20k 光学平面所用光子传感器的特性刻划提供了实验依据，服务于该实验对 WIMP 的高灵敏度探测目标。

title: Love at First Loop: Quantum Deformability of Near-Extremal Black Holes
summary: The static Love numbers of black holes vanish in classical, four-dimensional, asymptotically flat General Relativity. We study how this changes for the response of near-extremal Reissner--Nordström black holes to a minimally coupled massless scalar, at energies where the Schwarzian mode of the near-horizon throat fluctuates strongly. The black hole then responds as a quantum system with a spectrum of states. Its static response is a polarizability, given by virtual transitions between them. For $\ell=0$ the static Love number vanishes, by the shift symmetry of the scalar, but for multipoles $\ell\geq1$ the static Love numbers are nonzero: the finite rotational energy of the spin-$\ell$ intermediate states spoils the cancellation responsible for the classical result. Since the throat no longer has a classical geometry from which to read off a tidal response, we define it through the retarded Green's function, and compute its full frequency dependence at leading order in $r_+ω$. Its conservative part requires renormalization: the near-horizon theory fixes the coefficient of its logarithm, and with it a dependence on the energy that no local term can remove, while its finite local terms are matching data of the four-dimensional theory. The dissipative part is finite and scheme independent. For $\ell\geq1$, it vanishes at low frequencies when the energy is below the rotational gap, while at the gap threshold it becomes non-analytic in frequency and produces a late-time $t^{-3/2}$ tail.

AI.tldr: 在近极端 Reissner–Nordström 黑洞中，当近视界喉部的 Schwarzian 模强烈涨落时，其静态 Love 数（Love number）不再为零：除 $\ell=0$ 外，$\ell\geq1$ 的多极静态 Love 数非零，源于自旋-$\ell$ 中间态旋转能破坏了经典抵消机制。
AI.motivation: 经典四维渐近平坦广义相对论（General Relativity）中黑洞静态 Love 数消失，本文探究该结论在近极端 Reissner–Nordström 黑洞与最小耦合无质量标量场响应中的量子修正。
AI.method: 在喉部 Schwarzian 模涨落强烈的能标下，将黑洞视为具有态谱的量子系统，以虚跃迁给出的极化率（polarizability）刻画其静态响应；由于喉部不再具备可读取潮汐响应的经典几何，改由推迟格林函数（retarded Green's function）定义响应，并在 $r_+\omega$ 领头阶计算其完整频率依赖。
AI.result: $\ell=0$ 时静态 Love 数因标量移位对称性（shift symmetry）而消失；$\ell\geq1$ 时非零。保守部分需重整化（renormalization）：近视界理论确定其对数项系数并引入不可由局域项消除的能量依赖，而有限局域项为四维理论的匹配数据；耗散部分有限且与方案无关，在能量低于旋转间隙（rotational gap）时低频消失，在间隙阈值处对频率呈非解析行为并产生晚期 $t^{-3/2}$ 尾。
AI.conclusion: 近极端黑洞的静态 Love 数在量子情形下一般非零，其响应由近视界量子态谱主导；保守部分携带可重整化的对数能量依赖，耗散部分在间隙阈值产生非解析频率行为与 $t^{-3/2}$ 晚期尾，均依赖喉部量子理论而非经典几何。

title: Cetraro lectures on integrable systems and moduli spaces of curves
summary: In these lecture notes we review some constructions and results on the relation between topology of the moduli space of stable curves and integrable systems of evolutionary PDEs.

AI.tldr: 本讲义综述稳定曲线模空间（moduli space of stable curves）的拓扑与演化型偏微分方程（evolutionary PDEs）可积系统之间关系的若干构造与结果。
AI.motivation: 摘要以综述（lecture notes）形式呈现，说明其动机在于梳理并回顾该交叉领域已有的构造与结果，联结模空间拓扑与可积系统两个方向。
AI.method: 采用讲义式综述方法，围绕稳定曲线模空间的拓扑与演化型偏微分方程可积系统之间的关联，整理相关构造（constructions）与结果（results）。摘要未给出具体技术细节。
AI.result: 综述了稳定曲线模空间拓扑与演化型偏微分方程可积系统之间关系的若干构造与结果；摘要未列明具体定理或公式。
AI.conclusion: 该领域存在稳定曲线模空间拓扑与演化型 PDE 可积系统之间的联系，本讲义对此类构造与结果进行了回顾性整合；摘要未提供进一步结论。

title: Stable manifolds of heteroclinic chains in Hořava-Lifshitz cosmology
summary: We consider vacuum spatially homogeneous models in Hořava-Lifshitz gravity, which are expected to describe generic singularities for these modified gravity theories. These models perturb the well-known Bianchi models in general relativity (GR) by a parameter $v\in (0,1)$, in which GR occurs at $v=1/2$. We show that all periodic heteroclinic chains of Bianchi type II orbits are robust for small perturbations of GR, i.e. they exist for any $v\approx 1/2$. Moreover, we prove the existence of a stable manifold for each heteroclinic chain within a Cantor set for the supercritical case, $v\in (1/2,1)$. In particular, we discuss the heteroclinic chains of periods three and four in detail.

AI.tldr: 该文研究 Hořava-Lifshitz 引力中真空空间均匀模型，证明 Bianchi II 型轨道的周期异宿链在 GR 小扰动下稳健，并在超临界情形下于 Cantor 集中构造稳定流形。
AI.motivation: Hořava-Lifshitz 引力被认为是描述修改引力理论中一般奇点（singularities）的框架，而空间均匀模型可刻画此类奇点结构，因此需要理解其对广义相对论（general relativity, GR）Bianchi 模型的扰动行为。
AI.method: 以参数 v∈(0,1) 对 GR 的 Bianchi 模型作扰动，其中 GR 对应 v=1/2；分析 Bianchi II 型轨道的周期异宿链（periodic heteroclinic chains），并在超临界情形 v∈(1/2,1) 下研究其稳定流形（stable manifold），重点讨论周期三与周期四的链。
AI.result: 所有 Bianchi II 型轨道的周期异宿链对 GR 的小扰动均稳健，即对任意 v≈1/2 都存在；在超临界情形 v∈(1/2,1) 下，证明每条异宿链在某个 Cantor 集内存在稳定流形；并具体讨论了周期三与周期四的异宿链。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 Hořava-Lifshitz 引力中空间均匀真空模型的奇点结构与 GR 的 Bianchi 模型在小扰动下具有连续性，并在超临界区域呈现出 Cantor 集型的稳定结构。

title: Enhancing Quasi-Two-Dimensional Electronic Structure in Bi2O2Se via Chlorine Substitution
summary: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. However, its strong ionic interlayer bonding of Se layers fundamentally restricts the full potential of this otherwise promising quasi-two-dimensional (2D) material. In this work, we demonstrate chlorine substitution as an effective strategy to introduce van der Waals gaps and modify the electronic structure of the system. Through comprehensive transport and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements on Bi6O6Se2Cl2 single crystal, an optimal Cl-doping compound, we show that the key electronic features, including indirect band gap, high electron mobility, and carrier effective mass, are well preserved, while the 2D character of the system is sufficiently enhanced. First-principles calculations attribute this selective tunability to the unique spatial separation between conductive Bi-O layers and dopant Se/Cl layers, which enables independent optimization of interlayer coupling and intralayer transport. Remarkably, our theoretical calculations combined with experimental observations project a broad bandgap engineering across a wide range (0.8 ~ 3.5 eV) within the Bi2O2Se system. Our findings not only expand the application potential of Bi2O2Se-based materials in optoelectronics, nanoelectronics, and fundamental research but also highlight spatial decoupling as a viable strategy for modifying detailed electronic structure of quasi-2D quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出氯（Cl）取代策略，在Bi2O2Se体系中引入范德华间隙（van der Waals gaps）并调控电子结构；在Bi6O6Se2Cl2单晶中，关键电子特征得以保留，同时二维特性显著增强，并预测可实现0.8 ~ 3.5 eV的宽带隙工程。
AI.motivation: Bi2O2Se（bismuth oxyselenide）是下一代电子学与量子现象研究的重要半导体候选，但其Se层间强离子键（ionic interlayer bonding）限制了该准二维（quasi-2D）材料的潜力。
AI.method: 采用氯取代（chlorine substitution）引入范德华间隙并修饰电子结构；对最优Cl掺杂化合物Bi6O6Se2Cl2单晶开展综合输运（transport）与角分辨光电子能谱（angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, ARPES）测量，并结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。
AI.result: 关键电子特征（间接带隙（indirect band gap）、高电子迁移率（high electron mobility）与载流子有效质量（carrier effective mass））得到良好保留，体系的二维特性充分增强；理论计算与实验观测共同预示在Bi2O2Se体系中可实现0.8 ~ 3.5 eV的宽带隙工程。
AI.conclusion: 该发现拓展了Bi2O2Se基材料在光电子学（optoelectronics）、纳米电子学（nanoelectronics）与基础研究中的应用潜力，并表明空间解耦（spatial decoupling）是修饰准二维量子系统精细电子结构的可行策略。

title: Signature of GW from the Hidden Sector in light of the Recent LZ Event
summary: The LZ collaboration has recently reported a single nuclear-recoil event at $E_R=248\pm23_\text{stat}\pm23_\text{sys}$ keV, observed in a 2.84 tonne-year exposure with a local significance of $3.4σ$, pointing towards an inelastic dark matter (DM) interpretation. We explain this event within a gauged $U(1)_X$ hidden-sector model, spontaneously broken by a singlet scalar whose vacuum expectation value (VEV) gives rise to: \textit{(i)} gauge boson mass, \textit{(ii)} a small Majorana mass for the vector-like singlet fermion, the DM candidate, charged under the new symmetry, which splits the fermion into two pseudo-Dirac states (mass splitting proportional to the scalar VEV) thus resulting in a purely off-diagonal vector current, \textit{(iii)} the frequency and the amplitude of the GW signal arising from the hidden sector symmetry breaking via first-order phase transition (FOPT). The symmetry-breaking scale thus provides a multi-messenger probe connecting terrestrial direct-detection kinematics at the LZ and early-universe FOPT thermodynamics while obtaining thermal DM relic abundance. We delineate the viable parameter space compatible with the LZ event, correct relic density, and detectable GW signals in the low frequency regimes at future interferometers like $μ{\rm ARES}$ and THEIA while satisfying existing cosmological, astrophysical, and terrestrial bounds.

AI.tldr: 该文在规范 $U(1)_X$ 隐藏扇区（hidden sector）模型中解释 LZ 合作组报告的单个核反冲事件，通过单态标量自发破缺同时生成规范玻色子质量、费米暗物质的小马约拉纳质量（导致赝狄拉克劈裂与纯非对角矢量流）以及一阶相变（FOPT）引力波信号，为地面直接探测与早期宇宙 thermodynamics 提供多信使探针。
AI.motivation: LZ 合作组以 $3.4\sigma$ 局域显著性报告了 $E_R=248\pm23_\text{stat}\pm23_\text{sys}$ keV 的单个核反冲事件，暗示非弹性暗物质（inelastic dark matter）解释。该文旨在为这一事件提供具有早期宇宙可观测预言的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用规范 $U(1)_X$ 隐藏扇区模型，由单态标量自发破缺；其真空期望值（VEV）同时赋予规范玻色子质量、矢量型单态费米子（暗物质候选，带新对称性荷）一个小马约拉纳质量，使费米子劈裂为两个赝狄拉克态（劈裂正比于标量 VEV），从而产生纯非对角矢量流。并对该隐藏扇区一阶相变的引力波频率与振幅进行计算，结合热退耦 relics 丰度分析。
AI.result: 标量场的对称破缺能标同时连接 LZ 的地面直接探测运动学与早期宇宙 FOPT thermodynamics，并获得热暗物质遗迹丰度（relic abundance）；文中刻画了同时符合 LZ 事件、正确遗迹丰度以及 μARES 与 THEIA 等未来干涉仪低频段可探测引力波信号的可行参数空间，且满足现有宇宙学、天体物理与地面限制。
AI.conclusion: 对称破缺能标构成连接地面直接探测与早期宇宙一阶相变的多信使探针，该 $U(1)_X$ 隐藏扇区模型可在满足多重实验与观测 bounds 的前提下，同时解释 LZ 核反冲事件并提供可被未来低频引力波干涉仪检验的预言。

title: Gauge-Invariant Brout--Englert--Higgs Mechanism without Spontaneous Breaking of Local Gauge Symmetry: A Quantum-Reference-Frame Formulation
summary: The Brout--Englert--Higgs (BEH) mechanism can be formulated in gauge-invariant relational terms without assigning physical spontaneous breaking to a local gauge redundancy. We treat the gauge orientation of the Higgs field as dynamical internal reference data and describe the gauge connection relative to this Higgs frame. On a regular patch where the frame exists, the Higgs kinetic term induces a positive-semidefinite mass-squared quadratic form on the gauge-orbit directions and reproduces the standard tree-level vector masses. A complete Higgs frame yields a gauge-invariant relational connection, whereas a partial frame is defined only up to a stabilizer group $H$ and produces Higgs stiffness only along the coset directions $G/H$. In quantum field theory the normalized frame and relational connection are nonpolynomial composite variables; physical masses are therefore characterized through suitably renormalized gauge-invariant composite correlators, or through fully dressed operators in residual-charged sectors. Applying this construction to the electroweak theory, we show that the Higgs frame relationalizes the $SU(2)_L$ redundancy while leaving a residual electromagnetic $U(1)_{\rm em}$ Gauss law: $W^\pm$ and charged fermionic modes require electromagnetic dressing, whereas neutral channels admit local gauge-invariant interpolators. This formulation connects Higgs dressings, FMS composites, and internal quantum-reference-frame language while keeping local mass generation distinct from global symmetry realization and topological obstructions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在规范不变（gauge-invariant）的关系型框架下重构 Brout–Englert–Higgs（BEH）机制，将 Higgs 场的规范取向视为动力学内部参考系数据，从而在不把自发破缺归于局部规范冗余的前提下再现树级矢量玻色子质量。
AI.motivation: 传统 BEH 机制表述常将自发对称性破缺（spontaneous symmetry breaking）赋予局部规范冗余，概念上存在张力；该文旨在区分局部质量生成（local mass generation）与全局对称性实现及拓扑障碍，寻求一种规范不变的关系型表述。
AI.method: 将 Higgs 场规范取向当作动力学内部参考系，用相对该 Higgs 参考系（Higgs frame）的方式描述规范联络（gauge connection）。在参考系存在的正则区域上，由 Higgs 动能项导出规范轨道方向上正半定的质量平方二次型；完整参考系给出规范不变关系型联络，部分参考系仅在陪集方向 G/H 上定义并产生 Higgs 刚度。量子场论层面，归一化参考系与关系型联络为非多项式复合变量，故物理质量通过重整化的规范不变复合关联函数或残余带电扇区的全修饰算符刻画。
AI.result: 该构造在正则区域再现标准树级矢量质量。应用于电弱理论时，Higgs 参考系将 SU(2)_L 冗余关系化，同时保留残余电磁 U(1)_em 高斯定律：W^± 与带电费米子模式需要电磁修饰（electromagnetic dressing），而中性通道则允许局部规范不变插值算符。
AI.conclusion: 该表述将 Higgs 修饰、FMS 复合算符与内部量子参考系语言联系起来，并在保持局部质量生成与全局对称性实现、拓扑障碍相区分的同时，提供 BEH 机制的规范不变关系型图像。

title: Classical Communication Helps Single-Shot Quantum Compression
comment: 23 pages, no figures, comments are welcome
summary: Free classical communication can yield an unbounded single-shot saving in quantum compression, even though it leaves the asymptotic rate of an i.i.d. source unchanged. At every fixed error in $(0,1)$, we exhibit sources whose unassisted compression cost is arbitrarily large, yet a single qubit suffices with classical communication and no preshared entanglement. We establish this separation by determining the exact optimal source fidelity for compression through an $m$-dimensional noiseless quantum channel, with and without free classical communication, while preserving correlations with an inaccessible reference. Without classical assistance, the optimal fidelity is exactly the Ky Fan norm $\|ρ\|_{(m)}$, the sum of the $m$ largest eigenvalues of the source state. With classical assistance, we obtain an explicit spectral threshold formula and a protocol attaining it. Classical communication strictly improves fidelity whenever $m$ is smaller than the source rank. The corresponding compression costs are two smoothed versions of the log-rank entropy, also called max-entropy: trace-distance smoothing under local operations and quadratic smoothing under LOCC. For i.i.d. copies of a fixed source with positive entropy variance, however, the two costs have identical first-, second-, and third-order asymptotic terms. For nonlattice spectra, we determine the constant-order advantage: classical communication saves $\log_2(e)-1$ bits per block asymptotically, and the ratio of assisted to unassisted minimum communication dimensions converges to $2/e$.

AI.tldr: 免费的经典通信（classical communication）在量子压缩（quantum compression）中可带来无界的单次（single-shot）节省，尽管不改变 i.i.d. 源的渐近速率。通过确定经 m 维无噪声量子信道、在保持与不可访问参考系统关联条件下的精确最优源保真度（source fidelity），论文建立了有/无经典通信情形之间的分离。有辅助时的压缩代价为 LOCC 下 log-rank 熵（max-entropy）的二次平滑版本，无辅助时为迹距离平滑版本；对 i.i.d. 源两者的一、二、三阶展项相同。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于厘清免费经典通信（classical communication）对量子压缩（quantum compression）的作用：它不影响 i.i.d. 源的渐近速率，但作者希望刻画其在单次（single-shot）情形下能带来的节省幅度。为此需在有/无经典辅助两种设定下比较压缩代价与保真度（fidelity）。
AI.method: 方法为确定通过 m 维无噪声量子信道压缩时的精确最优源保真度，同时保持与不可访问参考系统（inaccessible reference）的关联，并分别考察无经典辅助（仅局部操作）与有免费经典辅助（LOCC）两种情形。分析中引入谱阈值公式及达到该阈值的具体协议，并以 log-rank 熵（max-entropy）的平滑版本刻画压缩代价。
AI.result: 无经典辅助时，最优保真度恰为 Ky Fan 范数（Ky Fan norm）‖ρ‖_(m)，即源态前 m 个最大特征值之和；有经典辅助时得到显式谱阈值公式及达到它的协议。当 m 小于源秩（source rank）时经典通信严格提升保真度。对应压缩代价为 log-rank 熵（max-entropy）的两种平滑形式：局部操作下为迹距离平滑，LOCC 下为二次平滑；但对具有正熵方差（entropy variance）的固定源 i.i.d. 副本，两者的一、二、三阶渐近项完全相同。对非格谱（nonlattice spectra），经典通信每块渐近节省 log₂(e)−1 比特，且有辅助与无辅助最小通信维度之比收敛到 2/e。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明免费经典通信可在单次压缩中获得无界节省，且该分离由精确最优保真度与谱阈值刻画；其收益体现在 log-rank 熵的不同平滑方式上，但在 i.i.d. 源的低阶渐近中消失，仅在非格谱情形留下常数阶优势。

title: On the Mathematical Foundations of Gravitational Decoupling in General Relativity
comment: 17 pages, no figures, comments are welcome
summary: We study the algebraic and geometric structures of gravitational decoupling within a fixed class of globally static, spherically symmetric spacetimes with non-vanishing areal-radius differential. We show that (minimal and extended) geometric deformations of the seed metric define a groupoid of partial transformations. We also draw a connection between the geometric deformation procedures and disformal transformations. It is shown that every admissible minimal geometric deformation admits a disformal representation using the areal radius as an auxiliary scalar. For extended deformations, we derive a necessary condition and exhibit a global obstruction that persists under diffeomorphisms preserving the areal radius and the static Killing direction up to constant normalization. Finally, we verify that the disformal construction reproduces the standard minimal geometric deformation source equations and separate conservation law, including anisotropic seeds.

AI.tldr: 该文在全局静态球对称时空（globally static, spherically symmetric spacetimes）框架下，刻画引力解耦（gravitational decoupling）的代数与几何结构，证明几何形变构成部分变换群胚（groupoid of partial transformations），并建立其与共形变换（disformal transformations）的联系。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在厘清引力解耦中几何形变（geometric deformation）程序的代数与几何本质，并揭示其与共形变换框架的潜在对应关系。该类时空限定为全局静态、球对称且面积半径微分非零。
AI.method: 将种子度规（seed metric）的最小与扩展几何形变视为部分变换，构造其群胚结构；建立几何形变程序与共形变换之间的关联，并将面积半径（areal radius）用作辅助标量场以给出共形表示。对扩展形变，推导必要条件并分析在保持面积半径与静态Killing方向（static Killing direction，至多相差常数归一化）的微分同胚下的整体障碍。
AI.result: 证明每一可容许的最小几何形变（minimal geometric deformation）均可用面积半径作为辅助标量获得共形表示；对扩展形变（extended deformation）给出必要条件，并展示一个在保持面积半径与静态Killing方向的微分同胚下持续存在的整体障碍（global obstruction）。
AI.conclusion: 共形构造可重现标准最小几何形变的源方程（source equations）与独立守恒律（separate conservation law），包括各向异性种子（anisotropic seeds）情形，从而支持所提出对应关系的自洽性。

title: Chemical-Potential-Dependent Superconducting Spectroscopy on Bi2Te3/NbSe2 Heterostructures
summary: High-resolution scanning tunneling spectroscopy performed at dilution refrigerator temperatures was employed to investigate the superconducting properties of topological insulator/superconductor (Bi2Te3/NbSe2) heterostructures. Coherence peaks with inner kinks or inner peaks, deviating from the conventional single s-wave spectral line shape, were observed in both 5 quintuple-layer (5QL) and 7QL Bi2Te3 thin films. Based on the combination of chemical-potential-dependent spectroscopic measurements and model simulations, we conclude that these spectral features arise from contributions of bulk and surface states in Bi2Te3 by selectively proximity-coupled to a single superconducting gap from NbSe2, rather than inheriting the complicated superconductor's order parameter of NbSe2.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用稀释制冷温度下的高分辨扫描隧道谱，观测拓扑绝缘体/超导体（Bi2Te3/NbSe2）异质结中偏离常规单s波谱型的相干峰内拐点/内峰结构，并通过化学势依赖测量与模型模拟归因于Bi2Te3体态与表面态选择性近邻耦合单一超导能隙。
AI.motivation: 拓扑绝缘体/超导体异质结中近邻诱导超导（proximity-induced superconductivity）的谱学特征来源尚需澄清，特别是谱型偏离常规单s波（s-wave）形式时，其究竟源于Bi2Te3自身态贡献还是继承NbSe2复杂序参量存在争议。
AI.method: 采用稀释制冷温度下的高分辨扫描隧道谱（scanning tunneling spectroscopy, STS）测量Bi2Te3/NbSe2异质结，覆盖5个五元层（quintuple-layer, 5QL）与7QL Bi2Te3薄膜，并结合化学势依赖的谱学测量（chemical-potential-dependent spectroscopic measurements）与模型模拟（model simulations）进行分析。
AI.result: 在5QL与7QL Bi2Te3薄膜中均观测到具有内拐点（inner kinks）或内峰（inner peaks）的相干峰（coherence peaks），其谱型偏离常规单s波谱线形状。
AI.conclusion: 这些谱学特征源于Bi2Te3体态（bulk states）与表面态（surface states）选择性近邻耦合（selectively proximity-coupled）至NbSe2的单一超导能隙，而非继承NbSe2复杂的超导序参量（order parameter）。

title: Femtoscopic parameters of pion emission sources in EPOS4 Au+Au collisions from 7.7 to 200 GeV
summary: Three-dimensional femtoscopy probes the space-time structure of particle-emitting sources in relativistic heavy-ion collisions. The collision-energy dependence of Lévy source parameters may reveal the evolution of strongly interacting matter and possible signatures of the QCD phase diagram. We previously studied the excitation function of three-dimensional Lévy source parameters for pion pairs in Au+Au collisions with EPOS4, analyzing the pair-distance distribution \(D(ρ)\) through one-dimensional projections. Here, we analyze the full three-dimensional source distribution and correlation function directly. We construct \(D(ρ_{\rm out},ρ_{\rm side},ρ_{\rm long})\) as a 3D histogram, transform it into \(C(q_{\rm out},q_{\rm side},q_{\rm long})\) using a Fast Fourier Transform, and fit the correlation function with the analytic Lévy formula. This approach can reduce biases arising when one-dimensional projections are used to describe a non-elliptical source. We apply the method across the RHIC Beam Energy Scan range and compare the extracted energy dependence with results from the projection-based method and recent UrQMD calculations. We focus on the out-side observables \(R_{\rm diff}^{2}=R_{\rm out}^{2}-R_{\rm side}^{2}\) and \(R_{\rm out}/R_{\rm side}\), whose different energy dependences in EPOS4 and UrQMD may illuminate the roles of emission duration and source dynamics. This work establishes a direct three-dimensional framework for comparison with future femtoscopic measurements and for exploring possible non-monotonic structures associated with the QCD phase diagram.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种直接分析三维源分布与关联函数的方法，以避免一维投影描述非椭圆源时引入的偏差，并在 RHIC 束流能量扫描（Beam Energy Scan）范围内研究 Lévy 源参数的碰撞能量依赖性。
AI.motivation: 三维飞秒关联（femtoscopy）可探测相对论重离子碰撞中粒子发射源的时空结构，而 Lévy 源参数对碰撞能量的依赖可能揭示强相互作用物质演化及 QCD 相图（QCD phase diagram）的可能信号。此前的 EPOS4 研究仅通过一维投影分析对距分布 D(ρ)。
AI.method: 构建三维直方图 D(ρ_out, ρ_side, ρ_long)，利用快速傅里叶变换（Fast Fourier Transform）将其转换为关联函数 C(q_out, q_side, q_long)，并用解析 Lévy 公式拟合该关联函数。该方法应用于 RHIC 束流能量扫描范围内的 π 介子对。
AI.result: 将提取的能量依赖性与基于投影的方法及近期 UrQMD 计算结果进行比较，重点关注 out-side 观测量 R_diff^2 = R_out^2 − R_side^2 与 R_out/R_side。EPOS4 与 UrQMD 中这些量呈现不同的能量依赖行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了直接的三维框架，可用于与未来飞秒关联测量比较，并探索与 QCD 相图相关的可能非单调结构；out-side 观测量的能量依赖性差异或有助于阐明发射持续时间与源动力学的作用。

title: Yang-Baxter deformed sigma models on $\mathrm{SU}(N)/\mathrm{SO}(N)$
summary: We study Yang--Baxter deformations of two-dimensional sigma models on compact symmetric spaces $\mathrm{SU}(N)/\mathrm{SO}(N)$, with particular emphasis on their ultraviolet behavior. We claim that the ultraviolet fixed point is described by the $\mathrm{SO}(N,\mathbb C)/\mathrm{SO}(N,\mathbb R)$ non-compact WZW model together with $N-1$ compact free bosons. We determine the leading correction to this fixed point and identify it with the perturbation generated by the corresponding screening currents. We also extend our construction to the broader class of symmetric spaces of maximal rank.

AI.tldr: 该文研究 $\mathrm{SU}(N)/\mathrm{SO}(N)$ 等紧致对称空间上二维 sigma 模型的 Yang–Baxter 形变，重点考察其紫外行为，并主张紫外不动点由非紧 WZW 模型加 $N-1$ 个紧致自由玻色子描述。
AI.motivation: 论文聚焦于二维 sigma 模型经 Yang–Baxter 形变后的紫外（ultraviolet）性质，尤其是 $\mathrm{SU}(N)/\mathrm{SO}(N)$ 这类紧致对称空间（compact symmetric spaces）情形，并进一步推广至最大秩对称空间。
AI.method: 在紧致对称空间 $\mathrm{SU}(N)/\mathrm{SO}(N)$ 上构造 Yang–Baxter 形变（Yang–Baxter deformations），并分析其重整化群流向；通过确定对不动点的领头修正，将其识别为由相应 screening currents 生成的微扰。方法被推广至更广泛的最大秩对称空间（symmetric spaces of maximal rank）。
AI.result: 主张紫外不动点由 $\mathrm{SO}(N,\mathbb{C})/\mathrm{SO}(N,\mathbb{R})$ 非紧 WZW 模型（non-compact WZW model）与 $N-1$ 个紧致自由玻色子（compact free bosons）共同描述，并给出该不动点的领头修正及其与 screening currents 的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: Yang–Baxter 形变的紫外行为可由非紧 WZW 模型与紧致自由玻色子的组合刻画，且该构造可扩展至最大秩对称空间这一更广类别。

title: Global Well-Posedness and Uniform Long-Time Control for a Class of Periodic NLS-Dysthe Equations
summary:
We study a class of periodic NLS-Dysthe (NLS-Dy) equations, also referred to as higher-order nonlinear Schrödinger equations (HNLS), of the form $i\partial_t u+a\partial_x^2u+b|u|^2u+i\varepsilon(c\partial_x^3u+d|u|^2\partial_xu+eu^2\partial_x\overline{u})=0$ with $ x\in\mathbb T$, $a,b,c,d,e\in\mathbb R$, $abc
eq0$, and $\varepsilon>0$. For $0<\varepsilon\ll1$, equations of this type arise as higher-order modulation models for some nonlinear dispersive PDEs, including the Klein-Gordon equation and the Serre-Green-Naghdi equation modeling the evolution of nonlinear shallow water waves.
  We prove local well-posedness in $H^s(\mathbb T)$ for $s>3/2$ for arbitrary admissible coefficients, and establish an $H^1$ continuation criterion for $s\ge2$. In the parameter regime $e
eq0$, a lower-order conservation law provides uniform $H^1$ control and, together with the continuation criterion, yields global well-posedness for $s\ge2$. This result does not require the non-resonance condition appearing in Takaoka's periodic theory, while the condition $e
eq0$ naturally arises in the modulation setting considered here.
  Finally, motivated by the long-time regime relevant for modulation, we establish uniform long-time control without imposing a smallness assumption on the initial datum. Using the conservation laws of cubic NLS and their invariance under the commuting complex mKdV flow, we obtain uniform $H^s$ bounds on time intervals of order $\varepsilon^{-1}$ for integer $s\ge2$. For non-integer real $s\ge2$, the maximal $H^s$ solution exists on the same time scale, while uniform control is obtained at a lower regularity, with a loss of less than one derivative.

AI.tldr: 本文研究环面上一类带三阶色散与非线性导数项的周期 NLS-Dysthe（NLS-Dy）方程（即高阶非线性薛定谔方程，higher-order nonlinear Schrödinger equations），证明在 H^s(𝕋)（s>3/2）中的局部适定性（local well-posedness），并在 e≠0 时给出 s≥2 的全局适定性（global well-posedness），进而在无初始数据小性假设下建立 ε^{-1} 时间尺度的长时间一致控制。
AI.motivation: 该方程作为 Klein-Gordon 方程与 Serre-Green-Naghdi 方程等非线性色散 PDE 的高阶调制模型（modulation models）出现，其调制背景自然产生 e≠0 的参数条件。作者希望摆脱 Takaoka 周期理论中的非共振条件（non-resonance condition），并针对调制相关的长时间尺度给出无需初始数据小性的分析框架。
AI.method: 在环面 x∈𝕋 上考察含参数 a,b,c,d,e 与小参数 ε 的方程（abc≠0，0<ε≪1）。通过 H^s(𝕋)（s>3/2）的局部适定性证明与 s≥2 的 H^1 延拓准则（continuation criterion）建立基本框架；在 e≠0 区间利用低阶守恒律（conservation law）获得一致的 H^1 控制。长时间控制则借助三次 NLS（cubic NLS）的守恒律及其在相交换的复 mKdV 流（complex mKdV flow）下的不变性。
AI.result: 对任意容许系数证明 H^s(𝕋)（s>3/2）的局部适定性，并对 s≥2 建立 H^1 延拓准则；在 e≠0 时由低阶守恒律给出一致 H^1 控制，结合延拓准则得到 s≥2 的全局适定性与 H^1 一致界，且不依赖 Takaoka 理论中的非共振条件。长时间方面：在时间尺度 ε^{-1} 上，整数 s≥2 时得到一致的 H^s 界；非整数 s≥2 时极大 H^s 解存在于同一时间尺度，而一致控制只能在较低正则性下获得，损失小于一阶导数。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，调制模型中自然出现的条件 e≠0 足以替代先前周期理论所需的非共振假设，从而在 H^1 层面实现全局控制；同时，利用 NLS 守恒律与复 mKdV 流的相交换性，可在不要求初始数据小的前提下获得调制相关时间尺度上的长时间一致界。非整数正则性下的一致控制需付出小于一阶导数的正则性损失，反映了该方法的固有代价。

title: Tidal Excitation of Relativistic Stars
comment: 32pages, 9 figures with appendix. Comments are welcome
summary: How a relativistic star responds to a time-dependent tide has lacked a first-principles counterpart of the Newtonian normal-mode expansion. In general relativity, the tidal field is gauge sensitive, radiative modes are non-Hermitian and incomplete, and the direct and late-time responses are intrinsically nonmodal. In this work we present, to our knowledge, the first causal relativistic theory that treats all of these components on equal footing. We first develop the spectral decomposition of the retarded Green function of the matched stellar interior--Schwarzschild exterior, which classifies four separate regimes in time domain: acausal region, prompt wave, surface-reflected wave, and mode+tail. The prompt signal is identical to that of a Schwarzschild black hole with the same mass, which is combined with the surface-reflected wave to be referred as the "direct part". With the Green function and a complex bilinear form on the full metric--fluid phase space, we decompose the linear response of a nonrotating perfect-fluid star into direct, quasinormal-mode, and late-time-tail sectors. Crucially, every sector admits an explicit first-order driven evolution equation: discrete bilinear projections determine the dynamically evolving quasinormal-mode amplitudes, while continuum projections of the same tidal source onto branch-cut states determine the direct and tail amplitudes. The result is a complete modal--nonmodal decomposition of the spacetime and fluid perturbations, which is physically described by the dynamics of a discrete and a continuous-frequency set of oscillators. We verify the decomposition numerically under generic time-dependent tidal driving and discuss applications to black hole perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个因果性相对论理论，将含时潮汐场（tidal field）作用于相对论星的响应统一处理，建立了时空与流体扰动的完整模—非模分解（modal–nonmodal decomposition），并数值验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 相对论星对含时潮汐的响应一直缺乏类似牛顿正常模展开（Newtonian normal-mode expansion）的第一性原理对应物；在广义相对论（general relativity）中，潮汐场具有规范敏感性（gauge sensitive），辐射模非厄米且不完备，直接响应与晚期响应本质上是非模的。
AI.method: 先构建匹配的星体内部—Schwarzschild外部推迟格林函数（retarded Green function）的谱分解，将时域分为非因果区、瞬发波、表面反射波与模+尾四区；再结合全度量—流体相空间上的复双线性形式（complex bilinear form），把线性响应分解为直接、准正模（quasinormal-mode）与晚期尾（late-time-tail）三部分；每个部分均具有显式的一阶驱动演化方程。
AI.result: 瞬发信号与同质量 Schwarzschild 黑洞相同，并与表面反射波合称“直接部分”；离散双线性投影给出动态演化的准正模振幅，连续投影到支割态（branch-cut states）给出直接与尾振幅；在一般含时潮汐驱动下数值验证了该分解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了时空与流体扰动的完整模—非模分解，物理上可描述为由离散与连续频率振子集合的动力学，并讨论了其在黑洞扰动（black hole perturbations）中的应用。

title: Magnon Klein paradox
summary: By considering the energy transport of spin wave, we show that, like the electron Klein paradox, there is no magnon Klein paradox for reflectivity. Heuristically, this can be understood according to the fact that, even if the ground state is unstable, any energy-carrying wave cannot have greater-than-one reflectivity off a passive interface, which will violate the conservation of energy. The magnon Klein paradox discussed in the literature is derived from assigning a wrong sign to the transmitted spin wave.

AI.tldr: 本文通过考察自旋波（spin wave）的能量输运，论证并不存在磁振子克莱因佯谬（magnon Klein paradox）的反射率表现，认为文献中所谓磁振子克莱因佯谬源于对透射自旋波符号的错误赋予。
AI.motivation: 电子克莱因佯谬（electron Klein paradox）中存在类似现象，因此文献讨论了磁振子（magnon）是否存在对应的克莱因佯谬，本文旨在澄清该问题。
AI.method: 以自旋波的能量输运为出发点，对磁振子在不涉及克莱因佯谬情形下的反射率进行分析，并结合能量守恒进行启发式（heuristic）论证。
AI.result: 即使基态不稳定，携带能量的波在被动界面（passive interface）处的反射率也不能大于 1，否则将违反能量守恒；据此不存在磁振子克莱因佯谬。
AI.conclusion: 文献中讨论的磁振子克莱因佯谬来自给透射自旋波赋予错误符号，因此该佯谬并不成立。

title: HEPTABench: A framework for portable and controlled agentic evaluations in high energy physics
comment: 45 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Public code available
summary: Quantifying the capability and reliability of agentic systems in high-energy physics (HEP) requires repeated evaluations under controlled configurations. Establishing whether changes to models, tools, or harnesses improve performance also requires these components to be varied independently. We present the High Energy Physics Tool-and-Agent Benchmarking (HEPTABench) framework for portable and controlled evaluations of agentic systems, with separately configurable tasks, scaffolding, models, providers, harnesses, and domain capabilities. The framework combines HEP benchmark tasks and scientific rubrics with experiment execution and versioned tool interfaces. To support inspection, reproducibility, and post-hoc grading, the framework prioritizes recording and reporting complete experiment specifications, agent trajectories, and experiment artifacts. We demonstrate the framework in two benchmark campaigns. The first campaign evaluates a forward long-lived-particle reach calculation across four frontier coding-agent systems, comparing their built-in coding tools with the same tools supplemented by HEP domain tools. We show that including these HEP domain tools improves numerical accuracy and reduces trial-to-trial dispersion for every tested system. In a complementary campaign covering eight symbolic two-body decay tasks, we show that adding symbolic domain tools increases the fraction of successful trials for Claude Haiku 4.5 from $8\%$ to $79\%$, while GPT-5.5 succeeds in every trial with built-in tools alone. Through systematic evaluation of agentic systems, HEPTABench enables the identification of factors that improve the accuracy and reliability of their scientific work.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HEPTABench 框架，用于对高能物理（high-energy physics, HEP）中的智能体系统（agentic systems）进行可移植、可控的重复评测，通过独立配置任务、脚手架、模型、提供方、执行框架与领域能力，量化其能力与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 量化 HEP 智能体系统的能力与可靠性需要在受控配置下进行重复评测；判断模型、工具或执行框架（harness）的改动是否提升性能，也要求这些组件可被独立变化。现有评测难以同时满足可移植性与组件独立性。
AI.method: 框架将 HEP 基准任务与科学评分标准（scientific rubrics）同实验执行及版本化工具接口结合，任务、脚手架、模型、提供方、执行框架与领域能力均可分别配置。为支持检查、可复现性与事后评分（post-hoc grading），框架优先记录并报告完整实验规格、智能体轨迹（agent trajectories）与实验产物。
AI.result: 在两个基准活动中验证：其一针对前向长寿命粒子（long-lived-particle）射程计算，比较四个前沿编码智能体系统的内置编码工具与补充 HEP 领域工具后的表现，结果显示加入 HEP 领域工具后每个被测系统的数值精度提升、试验间离散度（trial-to-trial dispersion）降低。其二覆盖八个符号化两体衰变任务，加入符号领域工具后 Claude Haiku 4.5 的成功试验比例从 8% 提升至 79%，而 GPT-5.5 仅用内置工具即在每次试验中成功。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性评测智能体系统，HEPTABench 可识别提升其科研工作准确性与可靠性的因素。

title: Type I-II/II-I vortices from dimension-six self-interaction
summary: We show that adding a dimension-six self-interaction to the Abelian-Higgs or Ginzburg Landau model results in a remarkable and rich structure of multi-vortex solutions. Besides the standard type I (attractive) and type II (repulsive) regimes, separated by the Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfeld limit (BPS), we identify two new possibilities: type I-II vortices, which attract at short distances and repel at long distances; and type II-I vortices, with the opposite behaviour. Specifically, within the type II-I regime, multi-vortex solutions form chunks of the Abrikosov lattice or clusters. Conversely, in the I-II regime, axially symmetric multi-vortices are stable; nevertheless, depending on the model parameters and topological charge (winding number), they can be either the ground state or not.

AI.tldr: 在阿贝尔-希格斯（Abelian-Higgs）或金兹堡-朗道（Ginzburg-Landau）模型中引入六维自相互作用（dimension-six self-interaction），可获得丰富的多涡旋（multi-vortex）解结构：除由 BPS 极限分隔的标准 I 型（吸引）与 II 型（排斥）区域外，还存在 I-II 型与 II-I 型涡旋。
AI.motivation: 传统阿贝尔-希格斯/金兹堡-朗道模型仅给出 I 型（吸引）与 II 型（排斥）两种涡旋相互作用区域，二者由博戈莫尔内-普拉萨德-索末菲极限（Bogomol'nyi-Prasad-Sommerfeld limit, BPS）分隔。本文旨在通过引入额外相互作用项，探索超越该二分类的涡旋相行为。
AI.method: 在阿贝尔-希格斯或金兹堡-朗道模型中添加六维自相互作用项，并分析其所产生的多涡旋解及其相互作用性质。
AI.result: 识别出两种新区域：I-II 型涡旋（短距离吸引、长距离排斥）与 II-I 型涡旋（行为相反）。在 II-I 区域内，多涡旋解形成阿布里科索夫晶格（Abrikosov lattice）的块状结构或团簇；在 I-II 区域内，轴对称多涡旋稳定，依模型参数与拓扑荷（topological charge，即缠绕数 winding number）不同，可为基态或非基态。
AI.conclusion: 引入六维自相互作用显著拓展了涡旋解的分类与相图，产生兼具短程/长程相反相互作用的多涡旋结构，并导致晶格块、团簇及轴对称稳定组态等多样化基态行为。

title: On best approximation and estimates of Bohr--Favard type on the sphere for functions with bounded Laplacian
summary:
We determine the best constants in estimates of the $L^\infty$ norm of functions on the sphere with bounded Laplacian whose first spherical harmonic components vanish. In every dimension $d\geq2$, these constants are expressed through weighted $L^1$ extremal polynomials. On $S^2$ the constant is an explicit positive series, and the best coefficient of $n^{-2}$ is $7ζ(3)/4$. On $S^3$ the best coefficient of $n^{-2}$ is a positive integral involving the Hörmander--Bernhardsson extremal function.
