We point out a cosmological restriction on the Majorana mass of bulk neutrinos leading to mass $\gtrsim 100~{\rm GeV}$. This avoids the over-production of Kaluza-Klein neutrino towers in the early universe thus resolving the cosmological neutrino catastrophe of extra dimension scenarios. If the mass of the bulk neutrino is at the lower end of this bound, it can potentially also explain the recently observed Fermi halo excess on gamma rays through the evaporation of long-lived 5d (i.e. dark) black holes through Hawking radiation to bulk neutrinos, which promptly decay into standard model particles.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，在暗维度（dark dimension）体空间中、受 $B-L$ 规范对称性（gauge symmetry）荷作用的惰性马约拉纳中微子（sterile Majorana neutrino），其马约拉纳质量（Majorana mass）须 $\gtrsim 100~{\rm GeV}$，以避免早期宇宙中 Kaluza-Klein 中微子塔（Kaluza-Klein neutrino towers）的过度产生，从而化解额外维度（extra dimension）场景的宇宙学中微子灾难（cosmological neutrino catastrophe）。
AI.motivation: 额外维度场景中体空间中微子的 Kaluza-Klein 塔在早期宇宙易被过度产生，构成所谓“宇宙学中微子灾难（cosmological neutrino catastrophe）”，需要对体中微子质量施加宇宙学限制。同时，近期观测到的费米伽马射线晕过量（Fermi halo excess）也需寻找物理解释。
AI.method: 基于暗维度体空间中受 $B-L$ 规范对称性（gauge symmetry）荷作用的惰性马约拉纳中微子（sterile Majorana neutrino）框架，进行宇宙学分析，推导马约拉纳质量（Majorana mass）的下限；并考察该质量处于下限附近时与 5d（即暗）黑洞（5d dark black holes）霍金辐射（Hawking radiation）蒸发的关联。
AI.result: 体中微子的马约拉纳质量（Majorana mass）须满足 $\gtrsim 100~{\rm GeV}$，由此避免 Kaluza-Klein 中微子塔（Kaluza-Klein neutrino towers）的过度产生，化解额外维度（extra dimension）场景的宇宙学中微子灾难（cosmological neutrino catastrophe）。若质量处于该下限附近，可通过长寿 5d（暗）黑洞经霍金辐射（Hawking radiation）蒸发为体中微子、后者迅即衰变为标准模型（standard model）粒子，来解释近期观测到的费米伽马射线晕过量（Fermi halo excess）。
AI.conclusion: 对体空间马约拉纳中微子质量施加的宇宙学下限（$\gtrsim 100~{\rm GeV}$）可同时化解额外维度场景的中微子灾难，并在质量接近下限时，为费米伽马射线晕过量（Fermi halo excess）提供经由 5d 暗黑洞霍金辐射（Hawking radiation）蒸发体中微子的候选解释。

title: Superlattice-Stabilized Fractional Chern Insulators in a "Berry Basin" Model
summary: The discovery of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene, following their discovery in the isolated topological flat band in twisted MoTe$_2$, motivates a search for the conditions under which an electronic band can host a topological correlated state. In this Letter we introduce a ``Berry basin" model which captures the essential features of rhombohedral graphene: a dispersive band with a flat bottom, momentum-space winding of a ``layer" degree of freedom, and Coulomb interactions, while also including periodic potentials, enabling controlled studies of the interplay of quantum geometry, superlattice modulation, and electron-electron interactions in producing correlated topological states beyond the isolated topological band paradigm. While integer Chern insulators emerge at strong coupling without a superlattice potential, stabilizing the fractional state requires nonzero potential for all interaction strengths we access. We provide insight into the greater robustness of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene when electrons are polarized away from the moiré interface. Our results establish a new class of systems that host robust fractional Chern insulators and provide a controlled numerical platform to test competing theories of interacting topological phases.

AI.tldr: 该文提出“Berry basin”模型，用于刻画菱面体堆叠石墨烯（rhombohedral graphene）中兼具色散带与平带底、层自由度动量空间缠绕及库仑相互作用的核心特征，从而系统研究量子几何、超晶格调制与电子相互作用协同产生拓扑关联态的机制。结果表明整数陈绝缘体（Chern insulator）可在无超晶格势的强耦合下出现，而分数态稳定需非零超晶格势。
AI.motivation: 在MoTe$_2$孤立拓扑平带中发现整数与分数陈绝缘体后，菱面体石墨烯中同类态的发现促使研究者追问：电子能带在何种条件下可承载拓扑关联态（topological correlated state）。既有孤立拓扑平带范式不足以涵盖具有色散分量与层自由度缠绕的体系，需要可控的理论模型来厘清量子几何、超晶格势与相互作用的作用。
AI.method: 引入“Berry basin”模型：包含具有平带底的色散带（dispersive band with a flat bottom）、层（layer）自由度的动量空间缠绕、库仑相互作用（Coulomb interactions），并加入周期性势（periodic potentials），以可控方式研究量子几何、超晶格调制与电子-电子相互作用的相互竞争与协同。
AI.result: 在无超晶格势的强耦合条件下可出现整数陈绝缘体；而在所考察的全部相互作用强度范围内，分数陈绝缘体的稳定均需非零超晶格势。此外，当电子极化偏离莫尔界面（moiré interface）时，菱面体石墨烯中的整数与分数陈绝缘体表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了一类可承载鲁棒分数陈绝缘体的新体系，并提供可控的数值平台，用以检验关于相互作用拓扑相（interacting topological phases）的竞争性理论，同时超越孤立拓扑平带范式。

title: Small perturbations of the $2d$ classical Heisenberg model
comment: 45 pages. 3 Figures. AI was not used in this paper except for bibliography and a simulation. Results were announced in April 2026
summary:
Polyakov predicted in 1975 ([Pol75) that the spin $O(3)$-model (or classical Heisenberg model) should have exponential decay of correlations at all positive temperatures on $\mathbb{Z}^2$.
  Our main result is as follows: if we replace the Euclidean scalar product \begin{align*} \langle σ_i , σ_j\rangle = σ_i^x σ_j^x + σ_i^y σ_j^y + σ_i^z σ_j^z \end{align*} by the $λ$-modified scalar product \begin{align*} \langle σ_i , σ_j\rangle_λ:= σ_i^x σ_j^x + σ_i^y σ_j^y + λσ_i^z σ_j^z \end{align*} we show that for all $λ\in(-1,1)$, the $\mathbb{S}^2$ valued spin system with Gibbs measure $\exp(β\sum_{i\sim j} \langle σ_i,σ_j\rangle_λ)$ has power-law decay of correlations if $β$ is chosen large enough.
  This is the first evidence that arbitrary small smooth modifications of the classical Heisenberg model produce a BKT phase in $2d$. It was proved in the 1970s and 80s that there exist arbitrary small smooth modifications of the classical Heisenberg model which produce instead an Ising phase. In these work, they considered the regime $λ>1$ while in this paper, we consider the regime $λ<1$ which cannot be analyzed via reflection positivity and chessboard estimate.
  The two main ingredients used in our proof are the stability of the BKT phase under percolation type disorder ([DG25]) and weak regularity type properties of the groundstates or $\mathbb{S}^2$-valued harmonic maps associated to our $λ$-energy functional. This analytic step is interesting on its own. Finally, the exponential and power-law decay regime should be separated by a curve $λ\mapsto β_c(λ)$. We prove a rigorous lower bound in the case of the $λ$-anisotropic hemisphere model $\mathbb{S}^2_+$ which matches with RG flow predictions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 上 $O(3)$ 自旋模型（spin $O(3)$-model / 经典 Heisenberg 模型）在 $\lambda$-修正标量积下的相变行为。作者证明当 $\lambda\in(-1,1)$ 且 $\beta$ 充分大时，系统呈现幂律相关衰减（power-law decay of correlations），首次给出微小光滑修正可产生二维 BKT 相（BKT phase）的证据，并给出 $\lambda$-各向异性半球模型下临界曲线 $\beta_c(\lambda)$ 的严格下界。
AI.motivation: Polyakov 于 1975 年预测经典 Heisenberg 模型在所有正温度下相关呈指数衰减。既有 1970–80 年代工作证明存在任意小的光滑修正（$\lambda>1$ 区域）产生 Ising 相，但该机制依赖反射正性（reflection positivity）与棋盘估计（chessboard estimate），无法处理 $\lambda<1$ 区域。本文旨在填补 $\lambda<1$ 情形的空白，探明微小光滑修正能否诱导 BKT 相。
AI.method: 将欧氏标量积替换为 $\lambda$-修正标量积 $\langle\sigma_i,\sigma_j\rangle_\lambda=\sigma_i^x\sigma_j^x+\sigma_i^y\sigma_j^y+\lambda\sigma_i^z\sigma_j^z$，考察 $\mathbb{S}^2$ 取值自旋系统在 Gibbs 测度 $\exp(\beta\sum_{i\sim j}\langle\sigma_i,\sigma_j\rangle_\lambda)$ 下的行为。证明依赖两个主要工具：BKT 相在渗流型无序（percolation type disorder）下的稳定性（引 [DG25]），以及 $\lambda$-能量泛函对应的基态或 $\mathbb{S}^2$ 值调和映射（harmonic maps）的弱正则性（weak regularity）性质。
AI.result: 对任意 $\lambda\in(-1,1)$，当 $\beta$ 充分大时，$\mathbb{S}^2$ 值自旋系统呈现幂律相关衰减。指数衰减与幂律衰减区域应由曲线 $\lambda\mapsto\beta_c(\lambda)$ 分隔；在 $\lambda$-各向异性半球模型 $\mathbb{S}^2_+$ 情形下证明了 $\beta_c(\lambda)$ 的严格下界，且该下界与重整化群（RG flow）预测相符。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个表明经典 Heisenberg 模型的任意小光滑修正可在二维产生 BKT 相的证据，说明 $\lambda<1$ 区域的行为与 $\lambda>1$ 的 Ising 相机制形成对照。所建立的调和映射弱正则性分析具有独立意义，半球模型的临界下界结果与重整化群预测一致。

title: Evidence for Hierarchical Turbulent Scaling in Nearby Star-Forming Galaxies
summary: We find recurring signatures of intermittency in molecular-gas velocities from cloud to galactic scales. In 31 selected galaxies from PHANGS-ALMA, velocity-centroid exponents through sixth order show nonlinear order dependence and nearly linear relations between consecutive exponents across galaxies. Positive estimated offsets from single-exponent scaling occur in all 52 galaxies with a valid power law fit and 99 of 100 clouds. A generalized She-Leveque hierarchy accommodates these signatures, supporting a hierarchical description of turbulent scaling in molecular gas across these environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究在分子气体速度场中发现从云尺度到星系尺度普遍存在的间歇性（intermittency）特征，并通过广义She-Leveque层级（generalized She-Leveque hierarchy）加以描述。
AI.motivation: 旨在检验分子气体湍流速度场在不同尺度上是否呈现间歇性（intermittency）的标度特征，从而判断湍流标度是否具有层级式（hierarchical）结构。
AI.method: 基于PHANGS-ALMA中选取的31个星系，计算速度质心（velocity-centroid）最高至六阶的指数，考察其阶数依赖性与相邻指数间的关系；并对全部具有有效幂律拟合（power law fit）的52个星系及100个云中的99个进行偏移估计，同时检验广义She-Leveque层级（generalized She-Leveque hierarchy）的适用性。
AI.result: 速度质心指数呈现非线性阶数依赖，且相邻指数之间跨星系近似线性；在52个有效拟合星系与100个云中的99个中，均出现相对单指数标度（single-exponent scaling）的正偏移（positive offsets）。
AI.conclusion: 广义She-Leveque层级可容纳上述特征，支持在这些环境中分子气体湍流标度具有层级式描述（hierarchical description）的结论。

title: Local Suppression of Superconductivity in Niobium Films by Focused Silicon Ion Implantation
summary: Magnetic flux trapped in a superconducting circuit shifts the critical currents of nearby Josephson junctions and disturbs the operation of the circuit. The usual remedy is a moat etched through the ground plane to hold the flux away from the logic. We report direct write silicon ion implantation with a focused ion beam as a way to make moats without etching the film, by locally suppressing superconductivity in niobium (Nb). Single implanted lines were written across Nb electrodes in films of three thicknesses over two orders of magnitude in ion fluence, and the transition temperature, resistance, and critical current density of each line were measured. The transition temperature of the line falls with fluence while the surrounding Nb is unchanged, and the critical current density falls by about two orders of magnitude before the line becomes resistive at 4.2 K. The product of the critical current and the resistance of the lines follows a single power law in reduced temperature. This gives an estimate of the critical current of a line at any temperature from its transition temperature and resistance. A time dependent Ginzburg-Landau simulation indicates that an implanted region can capture and hold a vortex. From these results we suggest a starting ion energy and fluence for implanted moats in a 100 nm Nb ground plane at 4.2 K and estimate the equivalent broad beam fluence.

AI.tldr: 利用聚焦离子束（focused ion beam）直接写入硅离子注入，在铌（Nb）薄膜中局域抑制超导性，从而在不刻蚀薄膜的前提下制备“护城河（moat）”结构以隔离磁通。
AI.motivation: 超导电路中被捕获的磁通会移动邻近约瑟夫森结（Josephson junction）的临界电流并干扰电路工作，传统解决方案是刻蚀接地平面形成护城河将磁通阻挡在逻辑区之外，本文寻求避免刻蚀的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用聚焦离子束进行硅离子注入的直接写入，在三种厚度的铌薄膜与两个数量级的离子注量（ion fluence）范围内，跨铌电极写入单条注入线，并测量其转变温度、电阻与临界电流密度；同时用时变金兹堡-朗道（time dependent Ginzburg-Landau）模拟考察注入区对涡旋（vortex）的捕获。
AI.result: 注入线的转变温度随注量增加而下降，而周围铌保持不变；临界电流密度下降约两个数量级后在4.2 K下变为阻性。临界电流与电阻的乘积在约化温度下遵循单一幂律，由此可从转变温度与电阻估算任意温度下的临界电流；模拟表明注入区能够捕获并保持涡旋。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述结果，作者为100 nm铌接地平面在4.2 K下的注入护城河给出了起始离子能量与注量的建议，并估算了等效的宽束注量（broad beam fluence）。

title: Valley-resolved high harmonics probe symmetry breaking beyond the Dirac cone
summary: Low-energy electrons in graphene obey an emergent, rotationally invariant Dirac equation, while the honeycomb lattice enters only through higher-order, symmetry-breaking corrections, the leading one being trigonal warping. This provides a unique solid-state arena to address a cornerstone challenge in quantum gravity: how to detect ultraviolet symmetry-breaking granular corrections, suppressed by a fundamental scale, atop an emergent infrared relativistic continuum. We show that intense counter-rotating $ω$-$2ω$ fields and valley-resolved high-harmonic generation (HHG) provide such a probe. Within a family of models that interpolates continuously between the isotropic Dirac cone and nearest-neighbour graphene at fixed Fermi velocity, the valley contrast of the harmonic yield vanishes identically in the symmetric theory, grows linearly with the warping coupling, and its valley-even counterpart appears only at second order, as expected from effective-field-theory power counting. The stronger the laser, the farther it drives electrons from the Dirac points, so the laser intensity plays the role of the collision energy. For the fourth harmonic, the leading warping correction alone accounts for the valley contrast of real graphene up to fundamental intensities of about $10^{11}$ W/cm$^2$, below the damage threshold of monolayer graphene, whereas the fifth harmonic already reveals higher-order lattice corrections at intensities around $10^{10}$ W/cm$^2$. The two harmonics, which rotate in opposite directions, are emitted by opposite valleys. Valley-resolved harmonics are far more sensitive than the residual valley populations, making them a practical detector of lattice-scale physics hidden beneath an emergent Dirac theory.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出利用反向旋转的 ω-2ω 强激光场与谷分辨高次谐波产生（valley-resolved high-harmonic generation, HHG）来探测石墨烯中隐藏于涌现狄拉克理论（emergent Dirac theory）之下的紫外晶格对称性破缺修正。结果表明，谷对比度在对称理论中严格为零、随三角翘曲（trigonal warping）耦合线性增长，可作为晶格尺度物理的实用探针。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯低能电子遵循涌现的旋转不变狄拉克方程，蜂窝晶格仅通过高阶对称性破缺项（首要为三角翘曲）体现，这为量子引力（quantum gravity）中的核心难题——如何在涌现的红外相对论连续谱之上探测被基本标度压制的紫外对称性破缺修正——提供了独特固态平台。目前尚缺乏可实际操作的高灵敏度探测手段。
AI.method: 采用在固定费米速度（Fermi velocity）下于各向同性狄拉克锥与最近邻石墨烯之间连续插值的一组模型，施加高强度反向旋转 ω-2ω 场并计算谷分辨高次谐波产生。通过有效场论（effective field theory）幂次计数分析各阶晶格修正对谐波产额谷对比度的贡献，并以激光强度类比碰撞能量。
AI.result: 在对称理论中谐波产额的谷对比度恒为零，并随翘曲耦合线性增长；其谷偶成分仅在二阶出现，符合有效场论幂次计数预期。激光越强，电子被驱离狄拉克点越远。对第四次谐波，仅领头翘曲修正即可解释真实石墨烯的谷对比度，直至约 10^11 W/cm^2 的基本强度，低于单层石墨烯损伤阈值；而第五次谐波在约 10^10 W/cm^2 时已揭示更高阶晶格修正。两个旋向相反的谐波分别由相反谷发射。
AI.conclusion: 谷分辨谐波对晶格尺度物理的灵敏度远高于残余谷布居，可作为探测隐藏于涌现狄拉克理论之下的晶格尺度物理的实用探测器。该方案以可及的激光强度将量子引力式的紫外修正探测问题转化为凝聚态可测量。

title: Regularity theory for lattice based harmonic maps and low temperature Gibbs measures of the spin-$O(N)$ model
summary:
The purpose of this note is twofold. First, we revisit the classical regularity theory of harmonic maps in the setting of maps defined on a lattice $\mathbb{Z}^d$ instead of $\mathbb{R}^d$ or some other manifold. The target space of our harmonic maps will be spheres $\mathbb{S}^{N-1}, N\geq 2$. A harmonic map $σ: \mathbb{Z}^d \to \mathbb{S}^{N-1}$ is a map which in any finite subgraph $Λ$ minimizes the internal Dirichlet energy $\frac 1 2 \sum_{i \sim j \in Λ} \|σ_i -σ_j\|^2$ given the boundary condition $σ_{|\partial Λ}$.
  One key difference between our setting and the continuum is that our main Hölder regularity statement in a large domain $Λ\subset \mathbb{Z}^{d=2}$ does not require any regularity assumption on the map $σ$ restricted to the boundary of the domain. For example, when $d=2$ and $N=3$, the Hölder regularity induced in the bulk of the domain holds uniformly in all boundary configurations $σ\in (\mathbb{S}^{2})^{\partial Λ}$ (this is in contrast with the continuum which requires extensions in suitable Sobolev spaces).
  The fact we obtain results uniformly in the boundary conditions allows us to extend our results for positive temperatures. Namely, as $T \searrow 0$, we obtain a local regularity theory for all infinite volume Spin $O(N)$ Gibbs measures, at least when $d=2$ and $N\geq 3$.
  We also discuss implications of our analysis in dimensions $d\geq 3$.

AI.tldr: 本文将调和映射（harmonic maps）的经典正则性理论移植到格点 $\mathbb{Z}^d$ 上，目标空间为球面 $\mathbb{S}^{N-1}$。核心差异在于：在 $d=2$ 情形下，Hölder 正则性对边界条件无任何正则性要求，且对边界配置一致成立，由此可推广至正温度下 $O(N)$ 自旋 Gibbs 测度的局部正则性理论。
AI.motivation: 经典调和映射正则性理论通常定义在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 或流形上，需要边界映射具备适当 Sobolev 空间中的延拓。作者希望在格点框架下重新审视该理论，以放宽对边界正则性的要求，并为统计力学中的自旋 Gibbs 测度提供低温柔性分析工具。
AI.method: 将调和映射定义为在任意有限子图 $\Lambda$ 上、给定边界条件 $\sigma|_{\partial\Lambda}$ 时最小化内部 Dirichlet 能量 $\frac{1}{2}\sum_{i\sim j\in\Lambda}\|\sigma_i-\sigma_j\|^2$ 的映射 $\sigma:\mathbb{Z}^d\to\mathbb{S}^{N-1}$，并研究其在 $d=2$、大区域 $\Lambda$ 中的 Hölder 正则性。
AI.result: 在 $d=2$ 时，Hölder 正则性在区域内部成立，且对所有边界配置 $\sigma\in(\mathbb{S}^2)^{\partial\Lambda}$ 一致（例如 $N=3$ 情形），无需对边界映射作正则性假设——这与连续情形需 Sobolev 延拓形成对比。由此可将结果推广到正温度：当 $T\searrow 0$ 时，得到所有无限体积自旋 $O(N)$ Gibbs 测度的局部正则性理论（至少在 $d=2$、$N\geq 3$ 时）。
AI.conclusion: 该分析在格点设定下给出了与边界条件一致的正则性结果，并为低温 $O(N)$ Gibbs 测度提供局部正则性理论；作者还讨论了该分析在维度 $d\geq 3$ 情形下的意义。

title: Transition-Metal Chalcogenide Nanowires: A First-Principles Study of Stability, Electronic Structure, and Mechanical Response
summary: Subnanometer transition-metal chalcogenide nanowires provide a one-dimensional platform in which electronic functionality and mechanical response can be tuned through chemical composition. Here, density functional theory calculations are combined with machine-learning force-field (MLFF) molecular dynamics to investigate MoS, MoSe, MoTe, WS, WSe, and WTe nanowires. The optimized structures are dynamically stable within the harmonic approximation, and their electronic character evolves systematically across the chalcogen series: MoS, MoSe, WS, and WSe are metallic, whereas MoTe and WTe are semiconducting, with HSE06 band gaps of 0.52 and 0.20 eV, respectively. The effective axial stiffness decreases from sulfides to selenides and tellurides, consistent with the increase in metal--chalcogen bond length; using a circular effective cross section, the corresponding Young moduli range from 392 to 718 GPa. All six nanowires have negative formation energies relative to the selected elemental reference phases. MLFF trajectories extending to 2.5 ns at 300 K preserve the one-dimensional morphology and local atomic order, providing evidence of finite-temperature dynamical stability on the simulated time scale. The corresponding MLFF molecular-dynamics energy traces are shown in. We further examine the response of the nanowires to axial strain and curvature, including strain-induced band-gap modulation in the tellurides. These results establish composition and mechanical deformation as complementary routes for tuning the electronic and mechanical properties of ultrathin transition-metal chalcogenide nanowires and support their further investigation as components of flexible nanoelectronic systems.

AI.tldr: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）与机器学习力场（MLFF）分子动力学，系统研究六种亚纳米过渡金属硫族化合物纳米线（MoS、MoSe、MoTe、WS、WSe、WTe）的结构稳定性、电子结构与力学响应，表明化学组分与机械形变可作为调控其性质的互补途径。
AI.motivation: 亚纳米过渡金属硫族化合物纳米线提供了一维平台，可通过化学组分调控电子功能与力学响应；论文旨在系统刻画该系列纳米线的结构与性质演化规律，并评估其作为柔性纳米电子系统组件的潜力。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论（density functional theory, DFT）计算与机器学习力场（machine-learning force-field, MLFF）分子动力学模拟，考察六种纳米线的优化结构、谐近似下的动力学稳定性、电子性质（含HSE06带隙）、轴向刚度与杨氏模量，并进一步分析轴向应变与弯曲的响应（含碲化物中应变诱导的带隙调制）。
AI.result: 优化结构在谐近似（harmonic approximation）下动力学稳定；电子性质随硫族元素系统性演化：MoS、MoSe、WS、WSe为金属性，MoTe与WTe为半导体，HSE06带隙分别为0.52与0.20 eV。有效轴向刚度由硫化物到硒化物、碲化物递减，与金属—硫族键长增加一致；以圆形有效截面估算的杨氏模量范围为392–718 GPa。六种纳米线相对所选元素参考相均具有负形成能。300 K下延展至2.5 ns的MLFF轨迹保持一维形貌与局域原子有序，表明在所模拟时间尺度上具有有限温动力学稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 组分与机械形变构成调控超薄过渡金属硫族化合物纳米线电子与力学性质的互补路径，支持将其作为柔性纳米电子系统组件开展进一步研究。

title: Iterated Graph Systems (III): Alexander-Orbach conjecture on hierarchical lattices
summary: Can the Alexander-Orbach conjecture hold on hierarchical lattices? We construct Gromov-Hausdorff-Prokhorov scaling limits of critical percolation clusters on hierarchical lattices in the chemical metric and determine the typical spectral dimensions of the associated diffusions. These dimensions are dense in $(1,2)$; however, outside a narrow region in dimension space, we prove that the Alexander-Orbach conjecture fails on every hierarchical lattice under consideration.

AI.tldr: 该文研究层级格（hierarchical lattice）上临界渗流团簇（critical percolation cluster）的标度极限，确定其扩散的典型谱维数（spectral dimension），并证明在维数空间某窄区域之外，Alexander-Orbach 猜想（Alexander-Orbach conjecture）对所考察的每一类层级格均不成立。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是 Alexander-Orbach 猜想在层级格上是否仍然成立，即随机分形上扩散的谱维数与分形维数之间是否存在普适关系。摘要通过构造层级格上临界渗流团簇的标度极限来检验这一猜想的适用范围。
AI.method: 在化学度量（chemical metric）下，构造层级格上临界渗流团簇的 Gromov-Hausdorff-Prokhorov 标度极限（Gromov-Hausdorff-Prokhorov scaling limit），并据此确定相关扩散过程的典型谱维数（typical spectral dimension）。
AI.result: 所得到的谱维数在区间 (1,2) 中稠密（dense）；且在维数空间中一个窄区域之外，研究证明 Alexander-Orbach 猜想在每一个所考察的层级格上均不成立。
AI.conclusion: Alexander-Orbach 猜想在层级格上不具有普遍性：除维数空间中一个窄区域外，该猜想普遍失效。这表明该猜想的成立与否依赖于具体的维数参数范围。

title: Revisiting Critical Higgs Inflation: Electroweak Couplings, CMB Observables, and Perturbative Unitarity
summary: We revisit the scenario of critical Higgs inflation, in which inflation is driven by the Standard Model Higgs boson with parameters chosen close to a critical point, giving rise to an inflection point in its potential. After reviewing this model, we perform a systematic study of its viability centered around three criteria: (1) consistency with electroweak-scale measurements, (2) ability to reproduce the cosmic microwave background (CMB) observables, and (3) sensitivity of the model predictions to unknown UV physics, based on a breakdown of perturbative unitarity. We first show that compliance with electroweak-scale measurements is controlled by the parameters in the Higgs potential at inflationary scales, also updating the literature values. We then demonstrate how for any choice of potential parameters, agreement with the CMB observables can be achieved through the choice of the nonminimal coupling, in both metric and Palatini formulations of gravity. However, we also find that there exist no regions of parameter space, in either the metric or Palatini formulations, in which compliance with all three physical criteria is possible. While this does not exclude the possibility of the Higgs field driving inflation, it means that predictions for any observable are in principle sensitive to the details of the model's UV completion.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视临界希格斯暴胀（critical Higgs inflation）情景，围绕电弱尺度测量一致性、CMB 可观测量重现能力以及对未知 UV 物理的敏感性三条判据进行系统研究，发现度规（metric）与帕拉蒂尼（Palatini）表述下均不存在同时满足全部三条判据的参数空间。
AI.motivation: 临界希格斯暴胀以标准模型希格斯玻色子驱动暴胀，其势能因参数接近临界点而出现拐点（inflection point），该情景的可行性需要系统检验。作者希望明确该模型在电弱测量、宇宙微波背景（cosmic microwave background, CMB）观测及紫外（ultraviolet, UV）物理敏感性三方面的自洽程度。
AI.method: 先回顾该模型并更新希格斯势在暴胀尺度上参数的文献取值，用以刻画与电弱尺度测量的一致性；随后在度规（metric）与帕拉蒂尼（Palatini）两种引力表述下，通过选取非最小耦合（nonminimal coupling）使任意势参数组合都能与 CMB 可观测量相符；并以微扰幺正性（perturbative unitarity）破缺为判据，评估模型预言对未知 UV 物理的敏感性。
AI.result: 与电弱尺度测量的一致性由暴胀尺度上的希格斯势参数控制；对于任意势参数选择，均可通过调整非最小耦合在两种引力表述下实现与 CMB 观测量的符合。但两种表述中都不存在同时满足全部三条物理判据的参数空间区域。
AI.conclusion: 结果并不排除希格斯场驱动暴胀的可能性，但意味着任何可观测量的预言原则上都对该模型 UV 完成（UV completion）的具体细节敏感。

title: Dispersion of low-energy optical excitations in NiPS$_3$ explained by singlet polaron theory
summary: Optical and resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) experiments in the van der Waals antiferromagnet NiPS$_3$ have revealed narrow excitonic resonances near 1.5 eV whose microscopic origin remains under debate. In this work we study the momentum dependence of these excitations using the singlet-polaron theory (SPT) previously developed for NiPS$_3$. Within its framework, we calculate the spectral function of the corresponding effective model and extract the dispersion of the resulting quasiparticles. The theory naturally predicts two singlet excitations whose dynamics arise from their propagation in the zig-zag antiferromagnetic background ($S=1$) coupled to two-magnon processes. We show that the dispersion of the lowest-energy quasiparticle agrees very well with the excitonic dispersion measured by RIXS, reproducing both its overall shape and bandwidth along high-symmetry directions of the Brillouin zone. Our results provide a consistent interpretation of the optical excitations in terms of dispersive singlet polarons, and suggest that similar mechanisms may govern excitonic dynamics in other layered van der Waals antiferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 基于单态极化子理论（singlet-polaron theory, SPT）计算 NiPS₃ 中激子激发的动量依赖，理论预测的两个单态激发色散与 RIXS 实验测得的最低能激子色散高度一致。
AI.motivation: 范德华反铁磁体 NiPS₃ 中约 1.5 eV 的窄激子共振（excitonic resonances）虽已被光学与共振非弹性 X 射线散射（resonant inelastic X-ray scattering, RIXS）观测到，但其微观起源仍存争议，尤其是这些激发的动量依赖尚未获得一致解释。
AI.method: 采用此前为 NiPS₃ 建立的单态极化子理论（SPT），计算相应有效模型（effective model）的谱函数（spectral function），并提取所得准粒子（quasiparticle）的色散关系。
AI.result: 理论自然给出两个单态激发，其动力学源于在 S=1 的锯齿状反铁磁背景（zig-zag antiferromagnetic background）中传播并与双磁振子过程（two-magnon processes）耦合；最低能准粒子的色散与 RIXS 测得的激子色散吻合良好，在布里渊区（Brillouin zone）高对称方向上同时重现了整体形状与带宽。
AI.conclusion: 结果以可色散的单态极化子（dispersive singlet polarons）对 NiPS₃ 的光学激发给出了一致解释，并提示类似机制可能支配其他层状范德华反铁磁体中的激子动力学。

title: Dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in rotating QED$_3$: critical flavor number and the occupation-reweighting channel
summary: We study dynamical chiral symmetry breaking in $(2{+}1)$-dimensional QED on a rigidly rotating disc, $ΩR<1$, within the rainbow Schwinger--Dyson framework. At zero temperature the rotation response of the condensate vanishes identically, so $N_c^{\rm SD}(Ω,T{=}0)=N_c^{\rm SD}(0)=2.60\pm0.01$ (using three operational definitions). At finite temperature, rotation suppresses the condensate through a dominant occupation-reweighting channel, $\hatκ_{\rm occ}=-1.55$, accounting for $\ge 99.995\%$ of the linearized total response at the reference parameters, with self-consistent feedback amplifying it by $26.5$. The screening channel is reported at fixed regularization, $\hatκ_{\rm scr}(\varepsilon = 0.01)=-0.97$; its $\varepsilon \to 0$ behavior is logarithmically divergent. The crossover flavor $N^{*}(Ω)$ falls monotonically at fixed temperature (a corollary). The critical flavor number is unchanged by rotation at $T=0$ (theorem). Together these results set the finite-temperature reference for the model.

AI.tldr: 在刚性旋转圆盘上的 (2+1) 维 QED 中，采用 rainbow Schwinger–Dyson 框架研究动力学手征对称性破缺（dynamical chiral symmetry breaking）。零温下凝聚体对旋转的响应恒为零，临界味数保持不变；有限温下旋转通过占据重加权通道主导压制凝聚体。
AI.motivation: 研究旋转对 (2+1) 维 QED 动力学手征对称性破缺的影响，并厘清零温与有限温下临界味数（critical flavor number）对旋转的依赖关系。
AI.method: 在刚性旋转圆盘几何（ΩR<1）中，于 rainbow Schwinger–Dyson 框架内计算凝聚体对旋转的响应，并分解为占据重加权（occupation-reweighting）与屏蔽（screening）两个通道，使用三种操作性定义确定临界味数。
AI.result: 零温下旋转响应恒为零，故 N_c^SD(Ω,T=0)=N_c^SD(0)=2.60±0.01。有限温下占据重加权通道为主导，ĥκ_occ=-1.55，占参考参数下线性化总响应的 ≥99.995%，自洽反馈使其放大 26.5 倍；屏蔽通道在固定正则化下为 ĥκ_scr(ε=0.01)=-0.97，其 ε→0 行为对数发散。固定温度下交叉味数 N*(Ω) 单调下降。
AI.conclusion: 旋转在 T=0 时不影响临界味数（定理），而交叉味数随旋转单调下降为一推论；这些结果共同为该模型设定了有限温参考基准。

title: Semiclassical Moser--Trudinger type inequalities for orthonormal families in $\mathbb{R}^2$
summary: For $H^1(\mathbb{R}^2)$-orthonormal families $\{u_n\}_{n=1}^N$ with one-body density $ρ=\sum_{n=1}^N |u_n|^2$, we prove the whole-space endpoint Moser--Trudinger inequality $$ \int_{\mathbb{R}^2}\frac{e^{4πρ(x)}-1-4πρ(x)}{ρ(x)}\,dx \le C\left(N-1+\int_{\mathbb{R}^2}ρ(x)\,dx\right), $$ where the integrand on the left-hand side is defined to be zero on $\{x: ρ(x)=0\}$. We develop a heat-semigroup refinement of Rumin's density method to treat both the endpoint coefficient $4π$ and the whole-space setting. Our inequality is sharp in two respects: the optimality of the coefficient $4π$ and the linear growth in the rank $N$. Moreover, through a semiclassical analysis of the density generated by normalized Dirichlet eigenfunctions, we establish the collective asymptotic behaviors of the quantities appearing in the inequality in various regimes. These semiclassical behaviors show that the rank-dependent term $N-1$ on the right-hand side is indispensable.

AI.tldr: 本文在全空间 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 上证明了针对 $H^1$ 正交归一族的端点 Moser–Trudinger 不等式，右侧含秩 $N-1$ 与总质量的线性组合，并通过半经典分析论证该不等式的尖锐性。
AI.motivation: Moser–Trudinger 不等式在端点情形与全空间设置下的精确形式具有挑战性；已有密度方法多处理系数或全空间之一，需同时兼顾端点系数 $4\pi$ 与全空间结构。
AI.method: 发展 Rumin 密度方法的热半群（heat-semigroup）改进版本，以同时处理端点系数 $4\pi$ 与全空间情形；并对归一化 Dirichlet 特征函数生成密度的进行半经典分析（semiclassical analysis）。
AI.result: 对一维体密度 $\rho=\sum_{n=1}^N|u_n|^2$ 证明 $\int_{\mathbb{R}^2}\frac{e^{4\pi\rho}-1-4\pi\rho}{\rho}\,dx \le C(N-1+\int\rho\,dx)$（在 $\rho=0$ 处被积函数取零）；该不等式在系数 $4\pi$ 最优性与关于秩 $N$ 的线性增长两方面均尖锐。
AI.conclusion: 半经典行为表明右侧依赖秩的项 $N-1$ 不可省略，说明该不等式在结构上是必要的。

title: MRI Turbulence versus $α$-Viscosity in Circumbinary Disks: Implications for Gravitational-Wave Dephasing and Accretion Variability
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to ApJ. Comments Welcome
summary: Our understanding of gas torques on massive black hole binaries (MBHBs) relies on hydrodynamical (HD) simulations of circumbinary disks (CBDs) in which an $α$-viscosity models angular momentum transport. However, CBDs around MBHBs near merger are hot, magnetized plasmas where transport is driven by magnetohydrodynamical (MHD) turbulence sustained by the magnetorotational instability (MRI). We test how well an $α$-viscosity captures MRI turbulence with 3D global Athena++ simulations of a locally isothermal CBD around an equal-mass, circular MBHB, run in HD and MHD from the same initial torus on identical grids, so that only the transport mechanism differs. Excising the region within twice the binary separation, $r<2~a_{\rm bin}$, allows $1000$ orbits of evolution, several times longer than previous MHD simulations. Both disks deliver the same accretion rate, and the gas beyond $2~a_{\rm bin}$ exerts a positive torque in both, yet the MHD torque is $3.5$ times larger and $3$ times more variable. Near the midplane, transport is similar in the disk body but three times weaker in MHD at the cavity edge, where $2$-$3$ times more mass piles up in a more eccentric cavity, raising the torque. The accretion rate is modulated mainly at twice the binary frequency in HD, but by a persistent lump at the cavity edge and its beat with the binary in MHD. The outer-disk torque therefore implies a contribution to the gas-induced phase shift in the gravitational-wave signal of LISA binaries $3.5$ times larger than in $α$-disk models, and a different variability signature for LSST and Roman.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过三维全局磁流体力学（MHD）模拟，对比α黏度模型对磁旋转不稳定性（MRI）驱动湍流的刻画能力，发现二者在环双星盘（CBD）中的气体力矩、吸积调制与空腔结构上存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 对环绕大质量黑洞双星（MBHB）气体力矩的理解长期依赖以α黏度描述角动量输运的流体力学（HD）模拟，但并合附近的环双星盘（CBD）实为高温磁化等离子体，其输运由磁旋转不稳定性（MRI）驱动的磁流体力学（MHD）湍流主导。因此有必要检验α黏度模型能否有效替代MRI湍流。
AI.method: 采用三维全局Athena++模拟，对等质量、圆轨道大质量黑洞双星周围的局部等温环双星盘，在同一初始环面与相同网格下分别运行HD与MHD，二者仅输运机制不同。通过切除双星间距两倍以内区域（r<2 a_bin），实现1000个轨道周期的演化，长于此前的MHD模拟。
AI.result: 两种盘给出相同的吸积率，且2 a_bin以外的气体均施加正力矩，但MHD力矩约为α盘模型的3.5倍且变率高达3倍。中面附近盘体输运相似，但在空腔边缘MHD输运弱三倍，质量堆积多2-3倍且空腔更偏心，从而抬升力矩。吸积率调制在HD中主要为双星频率的两倍，而在MHD中由空腔边缘的持续团块及其与双星的拍频主导。
AI.conclusion: 外盘力矩表明，MHD条件下气体对LISA双星引力波信号相位偏移的贡献比α盘模型大约3.5倍，并为LSST与Roman呈现不同的变率特征。α黏度模型无法完整刻画MRI湍流及其对气体力矩的影响。

title: Framework for an AI-Ready ARPES Community Database
summary: Condensed matter stands to gain profoundly from widespread adoption of artificial intelligence (AI). However, its current means of data organization impedes this endeavor. As a premier measure of electronic structure underlying material properties, Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES) has accumulated over four decades of spectra, yet the community's publication-centered workflow preserves only a highly selected fraction of its experimental record. A shared data ecosystem could transform these fragmented measurements and their contexts into a persistent, collective scientific memory, creating immediate value for reproducibility and reuse while laying the foundation for AI-enabled discovery. In this Perspective, we report outcomes of a recent community workshop and propose a practical path toward such an ecosystem. Its benefits unfold along three timescales. In the near term, standardized, searchable, and citable datasets strengthen analysis pipelines independently of AI. In the intermediate future, community-validated tools operating across laboratories could enable broader reuse and increasingly closed-loop automated experiments. In the long term, a diverse corpus of measured electronic spectra could support foundation models for quantum matter. Looking forward, a diverse corpus of measured electronic spectra could support foundation models for quantum matter and new discoveries. We discuss lessons from existing scientific databases, the current state of AI in ARPES, as well as areas of community convergence on data organization, access, credit, governance, and a staged pilot program.

AI.tldr: 该展望（Perspective）文章基于近期社区研讨会成果，指出现有以论文为中心的发布流程导致角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）数据高度碎片化，主张构建共享数据生态系统（data ecosystem），并规划分阶段推进的实践路径。
AI.motivation: 凝聚态物理（condensed matter）有望从人工智能（AI）的广泛应用中深度受益，但其当前的数据组织方式构成障碍。作为材料物性所依赖电子结构（electronic structure）的首要表征手段，ARPES 已积累逾四十年的谱学数据，然而社区以论文为中心的流程仅保留了实验记录中经高度筛选的一小部分。
AI.method: 文章报告近期一次社区研讨会的成果，提出构建共享数据生态系统的实践路径，并讨论既有科学数据库的经验、AI 在 ARPES 中的应用现状，以及社区在数据组织、访问、贡献认定（credit）、治理与分阶段试点项目等方面达成的共识领域。
AI.result: 所提生态系统的收益沿三个时间尺度展开：近期，标准化、可检索、可引用的数据集可在不依赖 AI 的前提下强化分析流程；中期，经社区验证、跨实验室运行的工具可实现更广泛的复用与日益闭环的自动化实验；长期，多样化的实测电子谱语料可支撑量子物性（quantum matter）的基础模型（foundation models）。
AI.conclusion: 共享数据生态系统可将碎片化测量及其语境转化为持久、集体的科学记忆，既为可复现性与复用带来即时价值，也为 AI 驱动的发现奠定基础；其落地需要社区在数据组织、访问、贡献认定、治理及分阶段试点上协同推进。

title: Axionic Casimir Torque
summary: In the canonical Casimir effect, the quantum vacuum is isotropic, and the minimization of vacuum energy drives only a linear attractive force between the plates. However, the introduction of an axion gradient breaks this rotational symmetry. It can be demonstrated that these asymmetric zero-point fluctuations exert a macroscopic mechanical twist on the plates proportional to $\vec{b}^2 \sin (2\vartheta)$ where $\vec{b}$ is the spatial axion gradient and $\vartheta$ is the angle between the axion gradient and the normal to the plates.

AI.tldr: 摘要指出，轴子梯度（axion gradient）破坏量子真空的各向同性，使卡西米尔效应（Casimir effect）中的零点涨落对平行板施加与 \(\vec{b}^2\sin(2\vartheta)\) 成正比的宏观机械扭转。
AI.motivation: 典型卡西米尔效应（Casimir effect）中量子真空（quantum vacuum）为各向同性，真空能（vacuum energy）最小化仅产生板间线性吸引力，缺乏角向与扭转类响应。引入轴子梯度（axion gradient）以打破旋转对称性，从而探索非对称零点涨落（zero-point fluctuations）能否产生新的宏观力学效应。
AI.method: 基于对含轴子梯度的真空零点涨落的理论分析：以空间轴子梯度 \(\vec{b}\) 与板法线夹角 \(\vartheta\) 为参数，考察对称性被破坏后真空能最小化所导致的力学响应形式。
AI.result: 这些非对称零点涨落对平行板产生宏观机械扭转（mechanical twist），其大小正比于 \(\vec{b}^2\sin(2\vartheta)\)，体现出对轴子梯度与板法线夹角的双角依赖。
AI.conclusion: 轴子梯度的存在可将卡西米尔效应从单一的线性吸引力拓展为具有角向依赖的宏观扭转效应，表明旋转对称性破缺在量子真空力学中可产生可观测的力矩型响应。

title: Asymptotic analysis of the confluent Dotsenko-Fateev system
summary: The Dotsenko-Fateev equation is a third-order linear ordinary differential equation studied in two-dimensional conformal field theory. We study the confluent Dotsenko-Fateev system, a rank-three system of linear ordinary differential equations obtained by confluence from a first-order system equivalent to the Dotsenko-Fateev equation. It has an irregular singular point at infinity, and its solutions admit double integral representations of confluent Selberg type. Using these representations, we construct sectorial fundamental solution matrices around infinity, establish their asymptotic expansions, and determine the associated Stokes matrices explicitly. We further study three aspects of the confluent Dotsenko-Fateev system: its equivalence to the degree-two polynomial reduction of the Schrödinger equation for the quantum Painlevé equation of type V, its realization as a restriction of a confluent version of the linear Pfaffian system associated with Appell's hypergeometric function $F_4$, and its reduction to the trivial rank-one equation via integral transforms and a quadratic change of the independent variable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从 Dotsenko-Fateev 方程（Dotsenko-Fateev equation）经合流（confluence）得到的三阶线性常微分方程组——合流 Dotsenko-Fateev 系统，利用其合流 Selberg 型（confluent Selberg type）双重积分表示构造无穷远处的扇形基本解矩阵，显式确定其渐近展开与 Stokes 矩阵（Stokes matrices），并揭示该系统与量子 Painlevé V 方程对应 Schrödinger 方程二次多项式约化、Appell 超几何函数（Appell's hypergeometric function）F_4 的合流线性 Pfaff 系统（linear Pfaffian system）限制及经积分变换约化为秩一方程三方面的联系。
AI.motivation: Dotsenko-Fateev 方程是二维共形场论（two-dimensional conformal field theory）中的三阶线性常微分方程，其合流形式在无穷远处具有不规则奇点，相关的渐近分析与 Stokes 现象（Stokes phenomenon）尚待刻画。同时，该系统的积分表示与若干经典可积结构（量子 Painlevé 方程、Appell 超几何函数）之间的关系值得厘清。
AI.method: 将等价于一阶系统形式的 Dotsenko-Fateev 方程通过合流（confluence）构造秩三线性常微分方程组；借助其合流 Selberg 型双重积分表示，构造无穷远处的扇形基本解矩阵（sectorial fundamental solution matrices），建立渐近展开并显式确定相联系的 Stokes 矩阵。进一步通过分析其与量子 Painlevé V 方程对应 Schrödinger 方程二次多项式约化（degree-two polynomial reduction）的等价性、作为 Appell 超几何函数 F_4 的合流线性 Pfaff 系统限制的实现，以及经积分变换与自变量二次变换约化为平凡秩一方程这三条途径进行研究。
AI.result: 成功构造了无穷远处的扇形基本解矩阵，得到了相应的渐近展开式，并显式确定了相关的 Stokes 矩阵。同时建立了合流 Dotsenko-Fateev 系统的三重刻画：与量子 Painlevé V 方程对应 Schrödinger 方程二次多项式约化等价；可实现为 Appell 超几何函数 F_4 的合流线性 Pfaff 系统的限制；并可经积分变换与自变量二次变换约化为平凡的秩一方程。
AI.conclusion: 合流 Dotsenko-Fateev 系统的合流 Selberg 型双重积分表示为研究其不规则奇点处的渐近行为与 Stokes 结构提供了有效工具；该系统同时联系量子 Painlevé V 方程、Appell 超几何函数 F_4 的合流 Pfaff 系统及秩一平凡方程，在二维共形场论与可积系统理论之间构成一个统一的框架。

title: Quantum Reference Frames in terms of Tetrads
summary:
We adapt to the context of quantum theory the treatment, familiar in relativity theory, of a reference frame as a tetrad. Since a tetrad is a set of four orthonormal vectors at a spacetime point, it encodes a timelike direction, three orthogonal spatial directions, and units; and so it gives a configuration in spacetime (a spatial orientation and state of motion) of an idealized infinitesimal apparatus (``rulers and a clock"). So a natural ``first guess" is that the state of a quantum reference frame should be an assignment of complex amplitudes to a set of tetrads. We develop this idea, in terms of bundles over spacetime of bases of the tangent spaces.
  This paper is a companion to two other papers. It emphasises the main conceptual aspects of our proposal, while the other two papers give physical details. It also explains the main contrast between those two papers. Namely: (i) the first considers a single spacetime geometry, so that a quantum reference frame, on our proposal, gives a superposition of perspectives on that geometry; while (ii) the second considers the spacetime manifold with no geometry given a priori, which will imply that a quantum reference frame, on our proposal, can describe a superposition of perspectives on a superposition of geometries---not ``just" a superposition of perspectives on a single geometry. The main mathematical idea for representing this contrast will be choosing between (i) the orthonormal frame bundle, for a given spacetime geometry; (ii) the frame bundle in the usual sense of containing all bases of all spacetime points' tangent spaces.

AI.tldr: 该文将相对论中把参考系视为四元标架（tetrad）的处理方式推广到量子理论：量子参考系（quantum reference frame）的状态可视为对一族四元标架赋予复振幅，并以时空切空间基底的丛（bundle）形式加以表述。本文侧重概念层面，并与两篇姊妹论文形成对照。
AI.motivation: 相对论中参考系常被刻画为时空点上的四元标架，而量子理论中参考系的状态尚需类似的几何化处理。作者希望把这一熟悉的处理方式迁移到量子语境，从而刻画量子参考系的时空构型与视角。
AI.method: 以时空上切空间基底的丛（bundle of bases of the tangent spaces）为数学框架，把量子参考系状态表示为对四元标架集合赋予复振幅。通过比较（i）给定时空几何下的正交标架丛（orthonormal frame bundle）与（ii）通常意义下包含各时空点切空间全部基底的标架丛（frame bundle），来区分两种情形。
AI.result: 该提议区分两种情形：在单一时空几何下，量子参考系给出对该几何的视角叠加（superposition of perspectives）；在未先验给定几何的时空流形上，量子参考系可描述对几何叠加的视角叠加，而非仅对单一几何的视角叠加。上述区分由正交标架丛与一般标架丛的选择来体现。
AI.conclusion: 本文是两篇姊妹论文的伴随论文，着重阐述提议的主要概念面向，并说明两篇姊妹论文之间的核心差异；物理细节由那两篇论文给出。

title: Nonequilibrium framework for first-order phase transitions
summary: The first-order phase transition is central to electroweak baryogenesis and gravitational wave generation, yet thermal equilibrium effective potential analyses cannot describe the real-time non-equilibrium dynamics of the phase transition process. We use the Schwinger-Keldysh closed-time-path formalism of real-time finite-temperature field theory to study these effects. For the $φ^6$ model, we derive the effective action and the corresponding Langevin equation. We further extend the formalism to the two scalar fields case, obtaining the coupled Langevin equations. These results provide a theoretical framework for the bubble nucleation simulation of the non-equilibrium phase transition process, laying the foundation for reliable predictions of baryogenesis and gravitational wave signals.

AI.tldr: 该文利用实时有限温场论的 Schwinger-Keldysh 闭时间路径（closed-time-path）形式，研究电弱相变中的非平衡动力学，导出了 $φ^6$ 模型的有效作用量与朗之万方程（Langevin equation），并推广至双标量场情形。
AI.motivation: 一阶相变（first-order phase transition）对电弱重子生成（electroweak baryogenesis）与引力波（gravitational wave）产生至关重要，但热平衡有效势分析无法描述相变过程的实时非平衡动力学，故需引入实时非平衡场论方法。
AI.method: 采用实时有限温场论中的 Schwinger-Keldysh 闭时间路径形式。针对 $φ^6$ 模型导出有效作用量与相应的朗之万方程，并进一步将形式推广到双标量场情形，得到耦合朗之万方程（coupled Langevin equations）。
AI.result: 导出了 $φ^6$ 模型的有效作用量与朗之万方程，以及双标量场情形下的耦合朗之万方程。
AI.conclusion: 结果为非平衡相变过程的气泡成核（bubble nucleation）模拟提供理论框架，为重子生成与引力波信号的可靠预言奠定基础。

title: Half-space polynuclear growth: a multipoint Fredholm--Pfaffian formula
summary: We derive a Fredholm-Pfaffian formula for the one-time multi-point transition probabilities of half-space polynuclear growth with any nonnegative boundary nucleation rate and general deterministic upper semi-continuous initial profiles. We prove the formula by showing that it satisfies an integral Kolmogorov equation with a unique bounded solution. We also discuss the formal 1:2:3 scaling limit of the kernel and its relation to the half-space KPZ fixed point.

AI.tldr: 该论文为半空间多核生长（half-space polynuclear growth）模型推导出单时刻多点转移概率（one-time multi-point transition probabilities）的 Fredholm-Pfaffian 公式，适用于任意非负边界成核率（boundary nucleation rate）与一般确定性上半连续初始剖面（upper semi-continuous initial profiles）。
AI.motivation: 摘要未明确说明研究动机，仅指出所处理对象的广泛性：将结果推广至任意非负边界成核率与一般确定性上半连续初始剖面。
AI.method: 证明思路为验证所给出的表达式满足带唯一有界解的积分 Kolmogorov 方程（integral Kolmogorov equation with a unique bounded solution）。此外，论文讨论了该核（kernel）的形式 1:2:3 标度极限（formal 1:2:3 scaling limit）及其与半空间 KPZ 不动点（half-space KPZ fixed point）的关系。
AI.result: 获得半空间多核生长单时刻多点转移概率的 Fredholm-Pfaffian 公式，并在积分 Kolmogorov 方程意义下完成证明。
AI.conclusion: 结论为所推导公式的正确性（经由唯一有界解的积分 Kolmogorov 方程验证），以及该核的形式 1:2:3 标度极限与半空间 KPZ 不动点之间存在关联。

title: Three-dimensional reconstruction of weakly scattering objects from single-defocus 4D-STEM data
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) atomic-structure analysis is of central importance in (scanning) transmission electron microscopy (STEM). STEM techniques to reconstruct 3D structure include tilt-series or defocus-series annular dark-field, best suited to heavier atomic species, and dynamical-scattering-model inversion applied to single-defocus four-dimensional (4D) STEM data, requiring computationally expensive post-experiment analysis. In this study, we propose a 3D-structure linear inversion (3D LINV) STEM algorithm, which enables a fast and direct reconstruction of 3D structures from a single-defocus 4D-STEM dataset. This method is based on solving linear equations relating the measured 4D-STEM data and the unknown 3D specimen potential under the thick weak phase object approximation. We show the capabilities of 3D LINV STEM through systematic 4D-STEM simulations across various observation parameters such as specimen thickness, partial coherence, and shot noise, and through an experimental demonstration of 3D structure reconstruction of a stacked freestanding membrane with atomic-scale lateral resolution and nanometre-scale depth resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三维结构线性反演（3D LINV）STEM 算法，可从单离焦四维 STEM（4D-STEM）数据快速直接重建三维原子结构，并通过系统仿真与实验验证其性能。
AI.motivation: 三维原子结构分析在（扫描）透射电子显微镜（(S)TEM）中至关重要；现有方法如倾转系列或离焦系列环形暗场成像更适合较重原子，而基于动力学散射模型反演的单一离焦 4D-STEM 方法则需计算昂贵的实验后分析。
AI.method: 基于厚弱相位物体近似（thick weak phase object approximation），求解关联所测 4D-STEM 数据与未知三维样品势的线性方程组，从而实现单离焦 4D-STEM 数据集的快速直接三维结构重建。
AI.result: 通过覆盖样品厚度、部分相干性（partial coherence）与散粒噪声（shot noise）等多种观测参数的系统 4D-STEM 仿真，以及堆叠自支撑薄膜（stacked freestanding membrane）的实验重建，展示了 3D LINV STEM 的能力，达到原子级横向分辨率与纳米级深度分辨率。
AI.conclusion: 3D LINV STEM 提供了一种快速、直接的三维结构重建途径，在仿真与实验层面均具可行性，并具备原子级横向与纳米级深度分辨能力。

title: Entanglement and parametric resonance in coupled oscillator systems
summary: We study a system of two quadratically-coupled harmonic oscillators, prepared respectively in the ground state and in a coherent state. This toy model can describe for instance the dynamics of one mode of a quantum field evolving in a harmonically-oscillating classical background. In such situations, it is well-known that, depending on the background oscillation amplitude and coupling strength, the system may exhibit parametric resonance. Using the Feynman-Vernon influence functional, we analyze the interplay between parametric resonance and quantum entanglement by perturbatively computing the purity of the mixed state resulting from tracing over one of the oscillators. We find a runaway behavior of the quantum entanglement between the two oscillators, as well as a rapid breakdown of the validity of perturbation theory, in regions of parametric instability. This provides a quantitative confirmation of various statements in the literature and is highly relevant to questions pertaining to the validity of the semiclassical approximation in coupled quantum-classical systems.

AI.tldr: 该文研究两个二次耦合谐振子系统（分别处于基态与相干态），借助费曼-弗农影响泛函微扰计算约化态的纯度，揭示在参量共振（parametric resonance）区域量子纠缠出现失控增长，且微扰论迅速失效。
AI.motivation: 该玩具模型可描述量子场某一模式在谐振经典背景中的演化，此类体系中参量共振的出现依赖于背景振幅与耦合强度，而参量共振与量子纠缠之间的相互作用此前仅有定性论述。研究旨在为文献中相关论断提供定量验证，并关联量子-经典耦合系统中半经典近似（semiclassical approximation）有效性问题。
AI.method: 采用费曼-弗农影响泛函（Feynman-Vernon influence functional）框架，对两个二次耦合谐振子进行微扰计算，通过对其中一个振子求偏迹（partial trace）获得混合态的纯度（purity），以此量化纠缠。
AI.result: 在参量不稳定（parametric instability）区域内，两振子间量子纠缠呈现失控（runaway）行为，同时微扰论的有效性迅速崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 结果定量确认了文献中关于参量共振与纠缠关系的多种论断，对量子-经典耦合体系中半经典近似适用性的相关议题具有高度相关性。

title: Entanglement Sudden Death in Gapped Ground States
summary: Spatial sudden death of entanglement refers to the disappearance of quantum correlations between subsystems after a certain distance called the entanglement length. Specifically, given a density matrix $ρ_{ABC}$ on a tripartite system $ABC$ with $B$ spatially separating $A$ and $C$, the entanglement length is the distance $\ell(A,C)$ after which the reduced density matrix $ρ_{AC}$, given by tracing out the $B$ subsystem, is separable. We show in the case of gapped ground states in any dimension that the entanglement length is finite on finite subsystems. Restricting to one-dimensional systems, we prove that normal matrix product states have a finite entanglement length independent of $A$ and $C$, and that a finite pure state with such uniform entanglement length has a matrix product state representation with bond dimension independent of $A$ and $C$. Consequently, in one dimension, entanglement length distinguishes matrix product states from all other pure states.

AI.tldr: 该文研究“纠缠的空间突然死亡（spatial sudden death of entanglement）”，即三方系统 ABC 中当 B 空间分隔 A 与 C 时，部分迹除 B 后 ρ_AC 变为可分（separable）的临界距离即纠缠长度。作者证明有能隙基态（gapped ground states）在任何维度下有限子系统的纠缠长度有限，并在一维情形下证明纠缠长度可区分矩阵乘积态（matrix product state）与其他纯态。
AI.motivation: 摘要指出纠缠长度的概念刻画了量子关联随距离的消失，但其在一般多体系统特别是不同维度和不同态类中的行为尚未明确。研究动机在于厘清纠缠长度在有限子系统上的有限性，并借此区分具有特定张量网络结构的态与一般纯态。
AI.method: 采用对三方系统密度矩阵 ρ_ABC（B 空间分隔 A 与 C）取偏迹得到 ρ_AC 的框架定义纠缠长度 ℓ(A,C)，并针对有能隙基态在任意维度及一维系统展开证明，涉及归一化矩阵乘积态与键维度（bond dimension）的表示分析。
AI.result: 在任何维度的有能隙基态中，有限子系统的纠缠长度均为有限。在一维系统中，正规则矩阵乘积态具有不依赖于 A 与 C 的有限纠缠长度；反之，具有此种均匀纠缠长度的有限纯态可用键维度不依赖于 A 与 C 的矩阵乘积态表示。
AI.conclusion: 在一维情形下，纠缠长度可作为判别性指标，将矩阵乘积态与所有其他纯态区分开来。

title: Weyl's theorem and the theoretical origin of Boson peak in two-dimensional scalar spring network
summary: The origin of the anomalous low-frequency vibrational density of states (VDOS) universally observed in amorphous solids has been debated for decades. In this work, we model amorphous solids as a zero-temperature scalar spring network, the simplest model that captures both the amorphous structure and the features of the anomalous VDOS. Using this scalar network, we mathematically demonstrate that disorder can lead to a shift of the VDOS toward low frequencies, thereby accumulating the anomalous part there. Disorder is defined through the topological connectivity of the network. The validity and universality of the theoretical framework are general and valuable for real-world scenarios because it rests only on Weyl's theorem for Hermitian matrices and is free of perturbation and phenomenological assumptions. This work strips away complex factors and reveals, at the level of mathematical principles, a profound and clean mechanism for the origin of the anomalous VDOS in amorphous solids.

AI.tldr: 将非晶固体建模为零温标量弹簧网络，借助厄米矩阵的Weyl定理从数学原理上证明无序可导致振动态密度（VDOS）向低频移动并积累异常部分。
AI.motivation: 非晶固体中普遍观测到的低频异常振动态密度（vibrational density of states, VDOS）的起源已被争论数十年，其物理机制尚缺乏不依赖微扰与唯象假设的干净解释。
AI.method: 把非晶固体建模为零温标量弹簧网络（zero-temperature scalar spring network），以网络的拓扑连通性（topological connectivity）定义无序，并基于厄米矩阵（Hermitian matrices）的Weyl定理进行数学推导，不引入微扰论或唯象假设。
AI.result: 数学上证明无序可导致VDOS向低频方向发生移动，从而使异常部分在低频处累积。该理论框架的有效性与普适性仅依赖于Weyl定理，因而适用于真实体系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作剥离复杂因素，在数学原理层面揭示了非晶固体低频异常VDOS起源的一个深刻而简洁的机制。

title: (Sharp arithmetic) localization beyond transversality
summary: We prove sharp arithmetic localization for one-dimensional quasiperiodic potentials with jump discontinuities, beyond uniform transversality. Our results include every non-constant $C^1$ monotone sampling function, even with arbitrarily large flat regions, and also certain non-monotone potentials. A key new mechanism is a symbolic unique-continuation principle: first-return words to the region where $f'>0$ have no common Dirichlet resonance, forcing eigenfunction mass to transfer away from flat or negatively sloped regions and recovering quantitative monotonicity of finite-volume eigenvalue branches.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了一维准周期势（quasiperiodic potentials）在跳跃间断情形下的精确算术局域化（sharp arithmetic localization），突破了均匀横截性（uniform transversality）的限制，核心新机制是符号唯一延拓原理（symbolic unique-continuation principle）。
AI.motivation: 既有局域化结果通常依赖均匀横截性条件，难以处理采样函数（sampling function）存在平坦区域或非单调的势。本文旨在将算术局域化的适用性推广至带跳跃间断的更一般势。
AI.method: 通过建立符号唯一延拓原理（symbolic unique-continuation principle）：考察返回导数 f'>0 区域的首次返回词（first-return words），证明其不存在共同的 Dirichlet 共振（Dirichlet resonance），从而迫使本征函数质量（eigenfunction mass）从平坦或负斜率区域转移出去，并恢复有限体积本征值分支（finite-volume eigenvalue branches）的定量单调性。
AI.result: 结果覆盖所有非恒定 C^1 单调采样函数，包括具有任意大平坦区域的函数，同时亦适用于某些非单调势，实现了超越均匀横截性的精确算术局域化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，借助符号化的唯一延拓机制，可在较弱的正则性与横截性假设下获得精确算术局域化，扩展了一维准周期算子谱理论的适用范围。

title: Programmable memristive circuits for reconfigurable collective pseudomagnetic ordering, transport, and learning
summary: Programmable hardware typically uses fixed architectures, whereas complex physical systems obtain diverse behavior by connecting reusable local elements through different interaction rules. Memristive devices combine writable states with nonlinear dynamics, but translating these local properties into reconfigurable collective order and symmetry-governed transport remains challenging. Here we develop modular circuits configured through programmable connections between identical memristive units. Experiments establish binary conductance states as Ising-type pseudospins and show that signed feedback between units selects uniform or staggered pseudospin order. Circuit-model simulations then examine controllable domain-wall motion and pattern recovery. A symmetry encoder combines measured conductance patterns with sublattice labels and a selected symmetry rule to configure a fixed transport layer, implementing circuit analogs of ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, and altermagnetic transport symmetries. Although the antiferromagnetic and altermagnetic encodings share a compensated pattern, their distinct voltage spreading illustrates how programmed circuit symmetry affects transport. Device-calibrated simulations show that memristive dynamics generates history-dependent features for reservoir computing. By separating local memory from programmable interactions, symmetry encoding and task-specific readout, this architecture provides a modular route from device dynamics to collective order, symmetry-dependent transport, and learning.

AI.tldr: 该工作基于相同忆阻单元（memristive units）构建模块化电路，通过可编程连接实现伊辛型赝自旋（Ising-type pseudospins）的集体有序与对称性调控传输，进而实现铁磁、反铁磁与交错磁（altermagnetic）传输对称性的电路类比，并用于储备池计算（reservoir computing）。
AI.motivation: 可编程硬件通常采用固定架构，而复杂物理系统通过不同相互作用规则连接可复用局部元件获得多样行为。忆阻器件兼具可写状态与非线性动力学，但如何将局部性质转化为可重构的集体有序与对称性主导的传输仍是难题。
AI.method: 构建由相同忆阻单元经可编程连接配置的模块化电路；实验将二值电导态确立为伊辛型赝自旋，并通过单元间带符号反馈选择均匀或交错赝自旋序。采用电路模型仿真研究可操控畴壁（domain-wall）运动与图案恢复，并以对称性编码器（symmetry encoder）结合电导图案、子晶格标签与选定对称规则配置固定传输层。
AI.result: 实验确立了二值电导态的伊辛型赝自旋行为，带符号反馈可选取均匀或交错赝自旋序；仿真展示了可控畴壁运动与图案恢复。对称编码器实现了铁磁、反铁磁与交错磁传输对称性的电路类比；虽然后两者共享补偿图案，但其电压扩散差异表明编程电路对称性影响传输。经器件校准的仿真显示忆阻动力学可产生用于储备池计算的历史依赖特征。
AI.conclusion: 通过将局部记忆与可编程相互作用、对称性编码及任务特定读出分离，该架构提供了从器件动力学通往集体有序、对称依赖传输与学习的模块化路径。

title: Global synchronization in time-varying directed higher-order networks
summary: Global synchronization has been largely investigated in static higher-order networks and little attention has been brought to directed, temporal higher-order networks. We hereby make a step in this direction by studying the emergence of global synchronization in periodically fast switching systems with directed higher-order interactions. By working in the framework of the Master Stability Function, we show that the linearized dynamics includes two time-dependent Jacobian matrices, both evolving on the timescale of the synchronous solution, together with a generalized Laplacian evolving on a fast switching timescale, resulting from the hypergraph time evolution. To address this two-timescale structure, we establish a fast-switching stability criterion for directed balanced higher-order structures. The latter condition allows to decouple the parallel and transverse perturbations to the synchronization manifold. By relying on the average theory for dynamical systems, we are able to prove exponential stability of global synchronization in the fast switching higher-order network. The proposed theory is then illustrated by using a higher-order Stuart--Landau model, which provides a natural benchmark for the theory. Directionality can move Laplacian eigenvalues into instability regions off the real axis, hence destabilizing synchronization; our results nevertheless reveal that temporal switching can counteract this destabilizing effect and restore global synchronization when the directed structures alternate sufficiently rapidly, even though the instantaneous directed higher-order structures are individually unstable.

AI.tldr: 该文研究周期性快速切换的有向高阶网络（directed higher-order networks）中的全局同步（global synchronization），基于主稳定性函数（Master Stability Function）框架建立快速切换稳定性判据，并证明在平衡有向高阶结构下全局同步的指数稳定性。
AI.motivation: 已有全局同步研究多集中于静态高阶网络（static higher-order networks），对有向、时序高阶网络（directed, temporal higher-order networks）关注甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白，探讨快速切换与有向高阶相互作用共同作用下同步的发生机制。
AI.method: 在主稳定性函数框架下，指出线性化动力学包含两个随时间演化的雅可比矩阵（Jacobian matrices），并含一个在快速切换时间尺度上演化的广义拉普拉斯矩阵（generalized Laplacian）。针对该双时间尺度（two-timescale）结构，提出适用于有向平衡高阶结构的快速切换稳定性判据，据此解耦同步流形（synchronization manifold）上的平行与横向微扰，并借助动力系统平均理论（average theory）进行稳定性分析。
AI.result: 证明了快速切换高阶网络中全局同步的指数稳定性（exponential stability）。以高阶 Stuart--Landau 模型作为基准验证该理论；结果显示方向性（directionality）可使拉普拉斯特征值偏离实轴进入不稳定区域从而破坏同步，但时间切换可抵消该效应：当有向结构切换足够快时，即使各瞬时结构单独不稳定，仍能恢复全局同步。
AI.conclusion: 快速时间切换能够克服有向高阶结构的方向性所导致的失稳效应，在瞬时结构各自不稳定的条件下仍可重构全局同步。该工作为有向时序高阶网络的同步分析提供了理论框架与稳定性判据。

title: The Promise of Gravitational-Wave Astronomy
comment: Invited review for the Focus Point on Surprises from Major New Telescopes (https://link.springer.com/collections/bdijcibaac)
summary: We review the promise of upcoming gravitational-wave (GW) observations in addressing some of the important open questions in astrophysics and cosmology. A decade after the first direct detection of GWs, the field is entering a transformative phase driven by progressive detector upgrades and the anticipated advent of space-based and next-generation ground-based observatories. These instruments will not only push the distance horizon of GW observations to cosmological redshifts, but will dramatically extend the accessible frequency band, opening entirely new source classes that lie beyond the reach of current detectors. The source landscape is rich enough that surprises are likely. This review surveys our current understanding across this landscape and offers some perspective on the discoveries that upcoming GW observations are poised to deliver.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了即将到来的引力波（gravitational-wave, GW）观测在解决天体物理与宇宙学重要开放问题方面的前景，指出该领域正因探测器升级及空间与下一代地面观测台的到来而进入变革阶段。
AI.motivation: 首例引力波直接探测已过去十年，探测器持续升级以及空间基与下一代地面观测台的预期出现，推动该领域进入变革阶段，亟需梳理其在天体物理与宇宙学开放问题上的潜力。
AI.method: 采用综述（review）方式，围绕当前对引力波源景观（source landscape）的理解展开梳理，并展望未来观测可能带来的发现。
AI.result: 未来仪器将把引力波观测的距离视野推进至宇宙学红移（cosmological redshifts），并大幅拓展可及频段（frequency band），开启当前探测器无法触及的全新源类（source classes）；源景观足够丰富，出现意外发现的可能性较高。
AI.conclusion: 即将到来的引力波观测有望在解决天体物理与宇宙学重要开放问题上作出贡献，并可能带来超出预期的发现。

title: Microscopic foundation for orbitronics: orbital exchange interactions, orbital-dependent transport, and orbital switching
summary: Recent experiments highlighted the essential role of the orbital degrees of freedom underlying current-induced magnetic dynamics. However, a microscopic picture of how orbital angular momenta are transferred between itinerant and localized electrons, and the way it feeds back into transport, remains elusive. Here we develop a theoretical framework for the orbital exchange interactions by generalizing the Anderson-Kondo model to incorporate the orbitals of conduction bands. Illustrating with the $p$-orbitals, we determine the way electrons acquire orbital polarization and its influence on the transport properties, uncovering the orbital counterparts of phenomena analogous to spin filtering and tunnel magnetoresistance. Reciprocally, we demonstrate that orbital-polarized currents can exert torques on localized magnetic moments without having to convert into spin currents, which enables electrical switching of magnetization even when spin polarization becomes inactive. These striking discoveries lay a microscopic foundation for orbitronics and reveal critical mechanisms for orbital manipulations of magnetic order.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过将 Anderson-Kondo 模型（Anderson-Kondo model）推广至包含导带轨道自由度，建立轨道交换相互作用（orbital exchange interactions）的理论框架，揭示轨道极化（orbital polarization）与输运之间的双向耦合，并提出无需自旋电流转换的轨道力矩（orbital torque）机制。
AI.motivation: 近期实验凸显轨道自由度（orbital degrees of freedom）在电流诱导磁动力学中的关键作用，但巡游电子与局域电子之间轨道角动量（orbital angular momentum）如何转移、又如何反馈至输运，尚缺乏微观图像。该文旨在填补这一微观理论空白。
AI.method: 将 Anderson-Kondo 模型推广以纳入导带轨道（orbitals of conduction bands），并以 p 轨道（p-orbitals）为例进行具体求解，从而确定电子获得轨道极化的方式及其对输运性质的影响，同时考察轨道极化电流对局域磁矩的作用。
AI.result: 研究揭示与自旋过滤（spin filtering）和隧穿磁电阻（tunnel magnetoresistance）类似现象的轨道对应物；并证明轨道极化电流（orbital-polarized currents）可在不转换为自旋电流的前提下对局域磁矩施加力矩，从而在自旋极化失效时仍可实现磁化的电学翻转（electrical switching of magnetization）。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为轨道电子学（orbitronics）奠定微观基础，并揭示通过轨道自由度操控磁序的关键机制。

title: Models for dagger $(\infty,1)$-categories III: Univalent flagged dagger $(\infty,1)$-categories and unitarily complete dagger Segal anima
summary: We identify the $(\infty,1)$-category presented by the dagger Bergner, dagger Joyal, and dagger Rezk models of Parts I and II with that of univalent flagged dagger $(\infty,1)$-categories. We first construct a realization--nerve adjunction between reversal simplicial anima and Hermitian flags. We prove that its nerve restricts to an equivalence between flagged dagger $(\infty,1)$-categories and dagger Segal anima, under which univalence corresponds to unitary completeness. We then construct the adjunctions for univalentization and Hermitian completion and identify univalentization with unitary completion.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Part I、II 中由 dagger Bergner、dagger Joyal 与 dagger Rezk 模型呈现的 $(\infty,1)$-范畴，与 univalent flagged dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴的 $(\infty,1)$-范畴相认同，并通过实现-神经伴随函子建立该等价。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在确立 dagger 高阶范畴的多种模型（dagger Bergner、dagger Joyal、dagger Rezk）与 univalent flagged dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴之间的等同关系，并厘清 univalence 与 unitary completeness 之间的对应。
AI.method: 首先在反转单纯形 anima（reversal simplicial anima）与 Hermitian flags 之间构造实现-神经伴随函子（realization–nerve adjunction）；证明其神经限制为 flagged dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴与 dagger Segal anima 之间的等价，在此等价下 univalence 对应 unitary completeness；随后构造 univalentization 与 Hermitian completion 的伴随函子，并识别 univalentization 即 unitary completion。
AI.result: dagger Bergner、dagger Joyal、dagger Rezk 模型所呈现的 $(\infty,1)$-范畴被认同为 univalent flagged dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴的 $(\infty,1)$-范畴；神经限制给出 flagged dagger $(\infty,1)$-范畴与 dagger Segal anima 的等价，其中 univalence 对应 unitary completeness。
AI.conclusion: univalentization 被识别为 unitary completion，从而在 dagger 高阶范畴语境下统一了 univalence 与 unitary completeness 两种概念，并借助实现-神经伴随函子完成上述模型的等同。

title: Spectrally enhanced gravitational redshift signals in photonic interferometry
summary: Quantum mechanics and general relativity are remarkably successful, yet their joint predictions remain beyond direct experimental reach. Photonic interferometers operating in a gravitational field offer a promising route to test this regime: gravitational redshift differentiates photon propagation between vertically separated arms, leading to a predicted phase shift and reduction in interference visibility. These effects are minute on laboratory scales, motivating existing proposals to consider large interferometer areas to accumulate them geometrically. Indeed, such schemes typically require kilometre-scale optical paths to produce appreciable interferometric signals. Here, we propose a strategy that replaces geometric accumulation with spectral enhancement by coupling the two interferometer arms to optical scatterers based on ultranarrow atomic transitions. These transitions serve as local spectral references: gravitational redshift changes the photon's detuning from each resonance, producing large differences in reflection amplitude and hence substantial visibility loss and interferometric phase shift already for centimetre-scale height differences. We quantify the experimental requirements and assess the feasibility of implementation with current or near-term technology. Our proposal thus opens a route to tabletop optical tests of the interplay between quantum mechanics and general relativity.

AI.tldr: 该文提出以超窄原子跃迁（ultranarrow atomic transitions）作为局域光谱参考（local spectral reference）的光学散射体（optical scatterer），将干涉仪两臂耦合，用光谱增强（spectral enhancement）替代几何积累（geometric accumulation），从而在厘米尺度高度差下即可产生可观测的引力红移（gravitational redshift）效应。
AI.motivation: 量子力学（quantum mechanics）与广义相对论（general relativity）各自极为成功，但其联合预言尚无法直接实验检验。引力场中的光子干涉仪（photonic interferometers）是检验该领域的可行途径，然而相关效应在实验室尺度极其微弱，现有方案通常需要千米级光程实现几何积累才能获得可观的干涉信号。
AI.method: 提出以光谱增强替代几何积累的策略：将干涉仪两臂耦合至基于超窄原子跃迁的光学散射体，使其充当局域光谱参考；引力红移改变光子相对各共振的失谐（detuning），从而引起反射幅度的显著差异。文中量化了实验要求，并评估了以当前或近期技术实现的可行性。
AI.result: 在仅厘米尺度的高度差下，即可产生显著的干涉可见度（interference visibility）损失与干涉相位移动（interferometric phase shift），无需依赖千米级光程的几何积累。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为量子力学与广义相对论相互作用的桌面级光学检验（tabletop optical tests）开辟了一条新路径。

title: Matrix-product-state GPLHR for non-Hermitian many-body eigenproblems
summary: Computing multiple eigenstates of non-Hermitian many-body operators plays an important role in investigating excitation spectra, spectral properties, and relaxation dynamics in interacting and open quantum systems. However, this task is challenging because the eigenvectors are generally nonorthogonal and the Hilbert space dimension grows exponentially with system size. Here, we formulate the generalized preconditioned locally harmonic residual (GPLHR) method in a matrix product state (MPS) framework to efficiently compute multiple targeted right eigenstates whose eigenvalues lie near a specified shift in the complex plane. Successive randomized compression (SRC) is employed to accelerate operator applications. We test the method on transcorrelated and complex Hubbard chains, an interacting non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain, and a Liouvillian model. The results demonstrate that GPLHR combined with MPS provides an efficient and accurate approach for computing multiple eigenstates of non-Hermitian many-body operators.

AI.tldr: 该工作将广义预处理局部调和残差（generalized preconditioned locally harmonic residual, GPLHR）方法置于矩阵乘积态（matrix product state, MPS）框架中，用于高效求解非厄米多体算符在复平面上指定移位附近的多个目标右本征态，并借助逐次随机压缩（successive randomized compression, SRC）加速算符作用。
AI.motivation: 计算非厄米多体算符的多个本征态对于研究相互作用与开放量子系统的激发谱、谱性质及弛豫动力学具有重要意义，但本征矢一般非正交且希尔伯特空间维度随系统规模指数增长，使该任务极具挑战。
AI.method: 在矩阵乘积态（matrix product state, MPS）框架下构建广义预处理局部调和残差（generalized preconditioned locally harmonic residual, GPLHR）方法，以计算复平面上指定移位附近的本征值对应的多个目标右本征态；并采用逐次随机压缩（successive randomized compression, SRC）加速算符应用。
AI.result: 在转相关与复 Hubbard 链、相互作用非厄米 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链以及 Liouvillian 模型上进行测试，结果表明 GPLHR 与 MPS 结合可高效且准确地计算非厄米多体算符的多个本征态。
AI.conclusion: GPLHR 结合 MPS 为非厄米多体算符多个本征态的计算提供了一种高效、准确的途径。

title: Self-Interacting Dark Matter: From Particle Physics Theories to Structure Formation Simulations
summary: We develop a unified theory-to-simulation framework for self-interacting dark matter (SIDM), connecting microscopic dark-sector physics to nonlinear structure formation. We systematize particle-physics ingredients of representative SIDM models and map microscopic parameters and interactions onto structure-formation simulation inputs. These include internal-state populations and reaction networks, velocity- and angle-dependent cross sections, inelastic and dissipative energy exchange, decay rates and recoil kinematics, and modifications to cosmological initial conditions. The numerical framework builds on the efficient, scalable SIDM infrastructure introduced in our companion work for the moving-mesh code AREPO-2, providing substantial performance gains over AREPO-1. We implement isotropic and anisotropic self-scattering with constant or velocity-dependent cross sections, multi-state and inelastic reactions, and dissipative scattering, complemented by a dedicated dark-matter decay module. For strongly forward-peaked interactions, the anisotropic hybrid SIDM scheme combines frequent small-angle drag-diffusion with explicit rare large-angle scattering, achieving speed-ups of up to $\sim100\times$ relative to fully anisotropic Monte Carlo in the tested configurations. We validate the implementations through beam-lattice deflection experiments, thermalization and uniform-box decay tests, isolated-halo gravothermal core-collapse simulations, and cosmological box and zoom-in simulations. These tests recover analytical predictions, establish consistency between equivalent numerical treatments, and reproduce published inelastic and dissipative SIDM benchmarks. The resulting modular framework connects dark-sector models to nonlinear astrophysical predictions, enabling exploration of microscopic interactions beyond standard isotropic, elastic SIDM.

AI.tldr: 该工作建立了一个统一的自相互作用暗物质（self-interacting dark matter, SIDM）从理论到模拟的框架，将暗部门（dark sector）微观物理映射为非线性结构形成模拟的输入，并在 AREPO-2 moving-mesh 代码上实现多种散射与衰变模块，通过了系统验证。
AI.motivation: 标准各向同性、弹性 SIDM 之外的微观相互作用（如非弹性、耗散、速度与角度依赖的截面）缺乏统一的模拟工具，难以将暗部门粒子物理与非线性天体物理预言相衔接。
AI.method: 系统整理代表性 SIDM 模型的粒子物理要素，将微观参数与相互作用映射为结构形成模拟输入，包括内态布居与反应网络、速度与角度依赖截面、非弹性与耗散能量交换、衰变率与反冲运动学以及宇宙学初始条件修正；基于 companion work 的 AREPO-2 SIDM 基础设施，实现各向同性与各向异性散射、多态与非弹性反应、耗散散射及专用暗物质衰变模块。
AI.result: 对于强前向峰化相互作用，各向异性混合 SIDM 方案结合频繁小角度 drag-diffusion 与显式稀有的大角度散射，在测试配置中相对完全各向异性 Monte Carlo 获得最高约 100 倍加速；通过 beam-lattice 偏转实验、热化与均匀盒衰变测试、孤立晕 gravothermal core-collapse 模拟以及宇宙学盒与 zoom-in 模拟完成验证。
AI.conclusion: 验证结果复现了解析预言，确认等价数值处理之间的一致性，并重现了已发表的非弹性与耗散 SIDM 基准；该模块化框架将暗部门模型与非线性天体物理预言相连，支持探索标准各向同性弹性 SIDM 之外的微观相互作用。

title: Kinetic SDEs and kinetic Fokker-Planck equations with critical Morrey-type drifts, and local blow-ups
summary: We develop a Sobolev theory for the kinetic Fokker-Planck equation subject to a singular Morrey-form $L^\infty+M^q_K$ force field which can produce local blow-ups due to strong attraction to a submanifold. Our approach is based on the fractional representation for the Duhamel series of the equation and on establishing kinetic Adams-type estimates. Accordingly, we construct weak solutions of Brownian-driven kinetic SDEs in a critical Morrey set-up, obtain kinetic Krylov-type estimates and a strongly continuous Feller propagator, and establish uniqueness criteria for a large class of weak solutions.

AI.tldr: 该论文为受奇异 Morrey 型 $L^\infty+M^q_K$ 力场作用的动理学 Fokker-Planck 方程（kinetic Fokker-Planck equation）建立 Sobolev 理论，该力场可因对子流形的强吸引而产生局部爆破。
AI.motivation: 研究对象为带有奇异 Morrey 型力场的动理学 Fokker-Planck 方程，此类力场因对子流形的强吸引可能引发局部爆破，而现有理论难以在该框架下处理相关问题，故需建立相应的 Sobolev 理论。
AI.method: 方法基于方程 Duhamel 级数（Duhamel series）的分数阶表示（fractional representation），并建立动理学 Adams 型估计（kinetic Adams-type estimates）。
AI.result: 在临界 Morrey 框架（critical Morrey set-up）下构造了布朗驱动的动理学 SDE（Brownian-driven kinetic SDEs）的弱解，得到动理学 Krylov 型估计（kinetic Krylov-type estimates）与强连续 Feller 传播子（strongly continuous Feller propagator），并建立了一大类弱解的唯一性判据（uniqueness criteria）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为奇异 Morrey 型力场下的动理学 Fokker-Planck 方程提供了 Sobolev 理论，并在弱解构造、估计、传播子性质与唯一性方面取得系统性结果。

title: Hypergeometric solutions to coupled Klein-Gordon equations in cosmology with small-field excursions
summary: The Klein-Gordon equation is a second order differential equation that appears in a variety of applications in mathematics, physics and engineering. This equation is often solved using numerical methods, since a general analytical solution is unattainable. However, one can find very useful analytical solutions for some special cases. In cosmology, the Klein-Gordon equation of a field can explain the physics of inflation and has important consequences on understanding the origin and evolution of the universe. An analytical solution to the Klein-Gordon equation in cosmology has been obtained in the small-field excursion approximation, and it turns out that the solution can be written in terms of the confluent hypergeometric limit function. In this work, we derive this result again while showing the details of the calculations and then generalize to the case of two coupled Klein-Gordon equations. We show that the solution of this coupled system can be written in terms of Kummer's hypergeometric limit function while considering minimal assumptions. We carry out a full numerical calculation of the coupled system and compare it to the results from the analytical expressions.

AI.tldr: 本文重述宇宙学中小场偏移近似下克莱因-戈尔登方程（Klein-Gordon equation）的解析解推导细节，并将其推广至两个耦合方程的情形，解以合流超几何极限函数（confluent hypergeometric limit function）与Kummer超几何极限函数表示，并通过全数值计算进行对照验证。
AI.motivation: 克莱因-戈尔登方程为二阶微分方程，广泛出现于数学、物理与工程领域，通常只能借助数值方法求解，仅在特殊情形下可获得解析解。宇宙学中该方程可用于解释暴胀（inflation）物理，并对理解宇宙起源与演化具有重要意义，因此有必要给出更完整、可推广的解析处理。
AI.method: 在小场偏移近似（small-field excursion approximation）下，重新推导宇宙学中单场克莱因-戈尔登方程的解析解，展示其计算细节；随后在尽量少的假设下，将该方法推广到两个耦合克莱因-戈尔登方程（coupled Klein-Gordon equations）构成的系统，并给出相应的解析表达。
AI.result: 单场情形的解析解可写成合流超几何极限函数（confluent hypergeometric limit function）形式；耦合系统的解可写成Kummer超几何极限函数（Kummer's hypergeometric limit function）形式。研究还对耦合系统进行了完整数值计算，并与解析表达式的结果进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过补充推导细节并推广至耦合系统，说明在小场偏移近似与极少附加假设下，耦合克莱因-戈尔登方程仍可获得超几何函数形式的解析解，且数值计算与解析结果相互对照，为宇宙学暴胀相关分析提供了可用的解析工具。

title: Extended-range percolation on lattices with cubic and non-compact neighborhoods in three dimensions
summary: Using MC simulations based on an efficient single-cluster growth algorithm, we investigate two types of three-dimensional extended-range percolation models, namely cubic and complex (non-compact) neighborhoods. We obtain high-precision percolation thresholds $p_c$ for approximately 100 distinct structures and further explore the relationship between these thresholds and the topology of the lattices, which includes the total coordination number $z$, the number of sites $z_i$ and these sites' distance to the central site $r_i$ of the given neighborhood in the $i$th coordination zone. Both bond and site percolation are analyzed for cubic neighborhoods on the SC lattice. For bond percolation, the asymptotic value of $zp_c$ tends to Bethe-lattice behavior ($zp_c\sim1$), and finite-$z$ correction is found to be consistent with $zp_{c}-1\sim a_{1}z^{-x}$, where $x=(d-1)/d$. For site percolation, the value of $zp_c$ varies non-monotonically, exhibiting an initial increase followed by a decrease with the coordination number $z$. Linear fitting leads to $zp_c\sim2.5987(1)$ for large $z$, predicting a value of continuum percolation threshold of aligned cubes $η_c=0.324838(12)$ using $zp_c=2^{d}η_c$. We then examine site percolation for non-compact neighborhoods extending to the fifth coordination zone on SC, FCC, and BCC lattices. Through a comparison of the three indices of $z$, $ξ=\sum_iz_ir_i^2/i$, and $ζ=\sum_iz_ir_i$, we find that $ζ$ is effective in removing the degeneracy. The results obtained show power-law dependence $p_c\propto(ζ/K)^{-γ}$ with $γ_{\mathrm{SC}}^ζ=0.703(12)$, $γ_{\mathrm{FCC}}^ζ=0.728(10)$, and $γ_{\mathrm{BCC}}^ζ=0.699(12)$ for SC, FCC, and BCC lattices, and $p_c\proptoζ^{-γ}$ with $γ^ζ=0.719(9)$ independent of the underlying lattice. The number $K$ indicates lattice connectivity.

AI.tldr: 采用高效单团簇生长算法（single-cluster growth algorithm）的蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo, MC）模拟，系统研究三维扩展邻域（extended-range）渗流模型（cubic 与 non-compact 两类邻域），获得约 100 种结构的高精度渗流阈值，并揭示阈值与晶格拓扑参量之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 扩展邻域渗流中，渗流阈值（percolation threshold）与晶格拓扑之间的关系尚需系统刻画；已有指标（如配位数 z、ξ）在描述非紧凑邻域时可能无法消除简并，因此需要考察能有效表征邻域结构的新参量。
AI.method: 基于高效单团簇生长算法的蒙特卡洛模拟，计算约 100 种不同结构的三维扩展邻域渗流阈值 p_c；对 SC 晶格上 cubic 邻域同时分析键渗流（bond percolation）与座渗流（site percolation）；并比较 z、ξ=∑_i z_i r_i²/i 与 ζ=∑_i z_i r_i 三个拓扑指标；进一步在 SC、FCC、BCC 晶格上考察延伸至第五配位区（coordination zone）的非紧凑邻域座渗流。
AI.result: 键渗流中 zp_c 的渐近值趋于 Bethe 晶格行为（zp_c∼1），有限 z 修正符合 zp_c−1∼a₁z^{−x}，x=(d−1)/d。座渗流中 zp_c 随配位数 z 先增后减，呈非单调变化；大 z 下线性拟合得 zp_c∼2.5987(1)，并预测对齐立方体的连续渗流阈值 η_c=0.324838(12)。在 SC、FCC、BCC 上发现 ζ 可有效消除简并；得到幂律关系 p_c∝(ζ/K)^{−γ}，γ_SC^ζ=0.703(12)、γ_FCC^ζ=0.728(10)、γ_BCC^ζ=0.699(12)，以及不依赖底层晶格的 p_c∝ζ^{−γ}，γ^ζ=0.719(9)。
AI.conclusion: 三维扩展邻域渗流的阈值可由拓扑参量标度描述：键渗流体现 Bethe 晶格渐近行为与特定有限尺寸修正，座渗流阈值随配位数非单调变化；相比 z 与 ξ，ζ 能有效消除非紧凑邻域的简并，并给出与底层晶格无关的幂律标度形式，其中 K 表征晶格连通性。

title: Cosmic Colliders in Binary Blazars Probing Ultra-High-Energy Particle Physics
summary: While terrestrial colliders and fixed-target cosmic-ray interactions are bounded at center-of-mass (CM) energies $\sqrt{s} \lesssim \mathcal{O}(10^5)\,\text{GeV}$, we demonstrate that bound sub-parsec binary blazars form broad-band, beam-beam hadronic ``Cosmic Colliders'', overcoming such limitation. Driven by modest jet misalignments ($θ_{\rm mis} \sim 1^\circ - 6^\circ$), co-streaming proton beams collide at CM energies reaching $\sqrt{s} \sim 10^{10}\,\text{GeV}$ - six orders of magnitude above the Large Hadron Collider. Operating in a strictly optically thin regime ($τ_{pp} \ll 1$), the system performs a continuous CM energy scan, probing asymptotic QCD scaling, gluon saturation, and Froissart unitarity, while opening a possible high-sensitivity window into physics beyond the Standard Model. Secondary PeV-EeV neutrinos and sub-TeV $γ$-rays fall directly within reach of current and planned observatories such as LHAASO, CTAO, IceCube, and GRAND, establishing binary blazars as laboratories for physics at the ultimate energy limit.

title: Enabling Polyspectra via Stochastic Realizations of Inverse Decay Curvature Perturbations in Axion Inflation
summary: Current and upcoming galaxy-redshift surveys offer a promising path for constraining inflationary physics. These constraints are often imposed by relating correlations of the primordial curvature perturbation to the late-time galaxy correlation functions. The primordial correlators can either be computed analytically, or via realizations of the primordial curvature perturbations that are initialized on a grid and evolved numerically according to the classical equations of motion. In this work we take a hybrid approach, initializing the fields in the Bunch-Davies vacuum; and then imposing time evolution through direct numerical integration. Our method efficiently generates realizations of the inverse decay primordial curvature perturbations for axion inflation---an inflationary model in which a pseudoscalar inflaton field couples to a $U(1)$ gauge field via a Chern-Simons interaction. Depending on the choice of parameter $ξ\in\{2, 2.5, 3\}$, which controls gauge field particle production in this model, our method generates realizations with an average runtime of a few hours on 1 CPU core. We compute the power spectrum and bispectrum from these realizations and find a surprisingly large discrepancy between our result and previous work that used an approximation for the gauge field mode functions---up to a factor of $\sim4$ difference for the bispectrum in the case of $ξ=2$. This new method enables not only rapid computation of higher order polyspectra, but also generation of initial conditions for large-scale structure analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合方法，通过 Bunch-Davies 真空初始化与直接数值积分，高效生成轴子暴胀中逆衰变原初曲率扰动（primordial curvature perturbation）的实现，并据此计算功率谱与双谱。
AI.motivation: 星系红移巡天（galaxy-redshift surveys）为约束暴胀物理提供了途径，其约束依赖原初曲率扰动关联与晚期星系关联函数的联系；而原初关联函数可通过解析计算或数值演化实现来获得，需要兼顾效率与精度。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：在 Bunch-Davies 真空（Bunch-Davies vacuum）中初始化场，再通过直接数值积分施加时间演化。该方法用于生成轴子暴胀（axion inflation）中逆衰变原初曲率扰动的实现，其中赝标量暴胀子通过 Chern-Simons 相互作用与 $U(1)$ 规范场耦合，参数 $ξ\in\{2,2.5,3\}$ 控制规范场粒子产生。
AI.result: 在单核 CPU 上平均运行数小时即可生成实现；据其计算功率谱（power spectrum）与双谱（bispectrum），发现与先前采用规范场模函数近似的工作存在显著差异，$ξ=2$ 时双谱差异可达约 4 倍。
AI.conclusion: 该新方法既支持高阶多谱（polyspectra）的快速计算，也可为大尺度结构（large-scale structure）分析生成初始条件。

title: Non-Hermitian Two-Kink Control of Corner States in Twisted Chern Bilayers
summary: Corner states are bound by boundary-mass defects, but this geometric anchoring restricts their spatial and internal control. Focusing on twisted bilayers assembled from Chern insulators with opposite Chern numbers, we show that a mass-phase kink carried by a non-Hermitian interlayer mass and an independent imaginary-momentum kink separate the spectral, in-plane, and interlayer control of mass-defect corner states. The mass-phase kink creates the parent corner pole and fixes its energy and intrinsic decay, while directed interlayer tunneling encodes its layer polarization. The imaginary-momentum texture instead reshapes the closed-boundary envelope and redistributes stationary right-state weight between corners. A twisted Qi--Wu--Zhang bilayer verifies this division on arbitrary, including concave, boundaries. A $30^\circ$ twisted Haldane dodecagon realizes twelve finite-energy parent states whose in-gap spectral manifold persists while boundary patterns redistribute its normalized right-subspace weight toward six, three, two, or one target corners. The two kinks therefore cooperate or compete while keeping spectral ancestry, spatial weight, and layer character distinct, thereby establishing a unified framework for controlling mass-defect corner states across disparate boundary geometries and mass textures.

AI.tldr: 通过引入非厄米层间质量（non-Hermitian interlayer mass）与虚动量纹理（imaginary-momentum texture）两类扭结，论文将质量缺陷角态（mass-defect corner states）的能谱、面内空间权重与层极化控制解耦，并在扭转 Qi–Wu–Zhang 与 Haldane 十二边形体系中验证。
AI.motivation: 角态（corner states）通常由边界质量缺陷束缚，这种几何锚定限制了其空间与内部自由度的独立调控。论文旨在突破该限制，实现对质量缺陷角态的能谱、空间分布与层特性的分离控制。
AI.method: 以相反陈数（Chern numbers）的 Chern 绝缘体组成的扭转双层为平台，构造两类独立扭结：非厄米层间质量携带的质量相扭结（mass-phase kink），与独立的虚动量扭结（imaginary-momentum kink）；并以扭转 Qi–Wu–Zhang 双层及 30° 扭转 Haldane 十二边形进行验证。
AI.result: 质量相扭结产生母角极点（parent corner pole）并固定其能量与本征衰减，定向层间隧穿编码层极化；虚动量纹理重塑闭合边界包络，并在角间重新分配稳态右态（right-state）权重。30° 扭转 Haldane 十二边形实现十二个有限能母态，其带内谱流形保持，边界模式将归一化右子空间权重重新分配至六、三、二或一个目标角。
AI.conclusion: 两类扭结可协同或竞争，同时保持谱系来源、空间权重与层特征的相互区分，从而建立跨不同边界几何与质量纹理统一调控质量缺陷角态的框架。

title: Fresnel scattering for open waveguide networks
summary: This paper concerns the Helmholtz scattering problem for open waveguide networks, extending the analysis from [arXiv:2302.04353, arXiv:2310.05816, arXiv:2401.04674] to plane-wave incident data. We first reduce the problem to a Fredholm second-kind integral equation on an infinite interface. This produces an integral representation of the solution to the original scattering problem, which is then used to obtain detailed asymptotic estimates of the solution at infinity. To leading order and away from the waveguides, the scattered field is itself a plane wave. Its amplitude and phase shift exhibit a jump across a critical polar angle depending on the direction of the incident plane-wave. Our estimates also imply that the scattered field is outgoing in a weak sense, allowing us to establish a uniqueness result. We conclude by calculating the waveguide-mode contributions to the scattered field in a perturbative regime.

AI.tldr: 本文将开放波导网络（open waveguide networks）的 Helmholtz 散射问题（Helmholtz scattering problem）从既有工作推广至平面波入射数据（plane-wave incident data），通过化归为无穷界面上的第二类 Fredholm 积分方程（Fredholm second-kind integral equation）获得解的积分表示与无穷远处渐近估计。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在将作者此前针对开放波导网络散射问题的分析（见 arXiv:2302.04353、arXiv:2310.05816、arXiv:2401.04674）拓展到平面波入射数据情形。此举可刻画平面波入射下散射场在无穷远处的行为及其唯一性。
AI.method: 首先将问题化归为无穷界面上的第二类 Fredholm 积分方程（Fredholm second-kind integral equation），由此得到原散射问题解的积分表示（integral representation）。基于该表示推导解在无穷远处的渐近估计（asymptotic estimates），并在微扰区（perturbative regime）中计算波导模式（waveguide-mode）对散射场的贡献。
