AI.method: 构建自驱动粒子（self-propelled particles）的极简视觉感知驱动模型，粒子仅通过有限视锥（vision cone）内的纯位置信息进行内聚转向（cohesive steering），不包含速度对齐（velocity alignment）与物理体积排斥（volume exclusion）。将相互作用范围由原研究的短程与距离无关极限推广至中间尺度，并进一步考察更大视觉角下的组织形态。
AI.result: 中间视觉范围内呈现出丰富的态图（state diagram），兼具两种极限情形的特征并涌现出定性新集体态：除气体（gas）、向列带（nematic-band）与极性队列（polar file）态外，还发现活性泡沫（active foams）——由动态演化的粒子流维持、贯穿系统的分形态网络，且仅源于非互易视觉交互（non-reciprocal vision-based interactions），在短程与长程视觉极限中均不出现。对于更大视觉角，系统自组织为凝聚体（condensates）、环（rings）与多扭曲丝状体（multi-twist filaments）等聚集体形态。
AI.conclusion: 有限视觉范围构成一独特中间区制（intermediate regime），可同时继承短程与距离无关极限的特征并催生全新集体态；非互易视觉交互是活性泡沫出现的必要机制。相互作用范围与各向异性感知之间存在强耦合，共同决定集体组织的形态多样性。

title: Eigenstate transitions and critical transport in 3D Aubry-André model
summary: We numerically study spectral and wave-function properties, as well as time evolution, in finite-size commensurate approximations of the 3D Aubry-André model. We explicitly show, through scaling analysis, the existence of two critical points. One of the critical points is a localization-delocalization transition in real-space, similar to the critical point in the 3D Anderson model. The other is a localization-delocalization transition in a dual momentum space, which does not have any analog in the 3D Anderson model. We estimate their values from spectral measures, such as the gap ratio and the spectral form factor, as well as from wave-function measures, such as the inverse participation ratio and the participation entropy. Additionally, we demonstrate that both critical points exhibit hallmarks of critical points between quantum ergodicity and localization. First, the eigenstates and the eigenspectrum at the critical point fulfill the mutual universal relation between the eigenspectrum compressibility $χ$ and the eigenstate fractal dimension $d^{(1)}$ [S. Jiricek et al., Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. 123, e2518027123 (2026)]. Second, the dynamics of the wave packet at the critical point is governed by the critical dynamical exponent $z$, characterized by the spectral fractal dimension and the dimensionality of the lattice [M. Hopjan and L. Vidmar, Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 060401 (2025)]. Thus, similarly to the 3D Anderson model, the critical dynamical exponent is sub-diffusive with the value of $z=3$.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过数值方法研究三维 Aubry-André 模型（3D Aubry-André model）有限尺寸公度近似中的谱、波函数及时间演化性质，借助标度分析（scaling analysis）明确证实存在两个临界点：一个对应实空间中的局域-离域转变（localization-delocalization transition），类似三维 Anderson 模型；另一个对应对偶动量空间（dual momentum space）中的局域-离域转变，在 Anderson 模型中无对应物。两类临界点均呈现量子遍历性与局域化之间临界点的特征。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探究三维 Aubry-André 模型中是否存在区别于三维 Anderson 模型的临界行为，特别是是否可能存在动量空间中的额外局域-离域转变，并检验此类临界点是否具备量子遍历性-局域化转变的普适标志。
AI.method: 采用数值方法，在三维 Aubry-André 模型的有限尺寸公度近似中计算谱性质与波函数性质，并研究时间演化；通过标度分析确定临界点位置。所用谱度量包括能隙比（gap ratio）与谱形状因子（spectral form factor），波函数度量包括逆参与比（inverse participation ratio）与参与熵（participation entropy）。
AI.result: 标度分析明确显示存在两个临界点：其一为实空间中的局域-离域转变，与三维 Anderson 模型临界点相似；其二为对偶动量空间中的局域-离域转变，在三维 Anderson 模型中无类比。两类临界点均满足本征谱压缩率（compressibility）χ 与本征态分形维数（fractal dimension）d^(1) 之间的普适互易关系，且波包动力学由临界动力学指数（critical dynamical exponent）z 支配，其值为 z=3，呈现亚扩散（sub-diffusive）特征。
AI.conclusion: 三维 Aubry-André 模型存在实空间与对偶动量空间两个局域-离域转变临界点，后者无 Anderson 模型对应物。两临界点均表现出量子遍历性与局域化之间临界点的标志性特征，且与三维 Anderson 模型类似，其临界动力学指数为亚扩散的 z=3。

title: Cellular Algebra of $A_2$ webs
summary: We introduce a diagram algebra $\mathcal{K}_L$ based on Kuperberg's $A_2$-webs and prove a Schur--Weyl duality $\mathcal{K}_L \cong \operatorname{End}_{U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)}((V^+ \oplus V^-)^{\otimes L})$, where $V^\pm$ are the fundamental representations of $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)$. Thus, $\mathcal{K}_L$ is a natural $A_2$ analogue of the Temperley--Lieb algebra. We construct an explicit cellular structure for $\mathcal{K}_L$, with the web basis as its cellular basis and cell modules indexed by dominant $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)$-weights. The bases of these modules are parametrized by dominant lattice paths via a recursive growth algorithm. Using this structure, we determine local generators of $\mathcal{K}_L$ and establish web formulations of the first and second fundamental theorems of invariant theory. In particular, we show that the braid-group image, augmented by local idempotents, does not generate $\mathcal{K}_L$, and identify an additional local generator. Finally, we derive a bimodule decomposition of $(V^+ \oplus V^-)^{\otimes L}$, yielding a complete set of irreducible $\mathcal{K}_L$-modules for formal or generic $q$.

AI.tldr: 论文基于 Kuperberg 的 \(A_2\)-网（\(A_2\)-webs）引入图代数 \(\mathcal{K}_L\)，证明其与 \(U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)\) 张量幂的端omorphism代数之间的 Schur--Weyl 对偶（Schur--Weyl duality），并证明它是 Temperley--Lieb 代数的自然 \(A_2\) 类比。
AI.motivation: \(\mathcal{K}_L\) 被视为 Temperley--Lieb 代数在 \(A_2\) 情形下的自然类比，研究目标在于为这一 \(A_2\) 图代数建立 Schur--Weyl 对偶、胞腔结构（cellular structure）及不变量理论等代数框架。
AI.method: 通过 Kuperberg 的 \(A_2\)-网构造图代数 \(\mathcal{K}_L\)，证明 Schur--Weyl 对偶 \(\mathcal{K}_L \cong \operatorname{End}_{U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)}((V^+ \oplus V^-)^{\otimes L})\)；为 \(\mathcal{K}_L\) 构造显式胞腔结构，以网基（web basis）为胞腔基，胞腔模（cell modules）由支配 \(U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_3)\)-权（dominant weights）标号，其基通过递归生长算法（recursive growth algorithm）用支配格路径（dominant lattice paths）参数化。
AI.result: 借助该结构确定 \(\mathcal{K}_L\) 的局部生成元（local generators），建立不变量理论第一与第二基本定理（first and second fundamental theorems of invariant theory）的网表述；证明辫群像（braid-group image）经局部幂等元（local idempotents）增广后仍不能生成 \(\mathcal{K}_L\)，并识别出一个额外局部生成元；最后得到 \((V^+ \oplus V^-)^{\otimes L}\) 的双模分解（bimodule decomposition），给出形式或一般 \(q\) 下 \(\mathcal{K}_L\) 的完整不可约模集。
AI.conclusion: \(\mathcal{K}_L\) 具备以网基为胞腔基的胞腔结构，其胞腔模可由支配格路径参数化；辫群像加局部幂等元不足以生成 \(\mathcal{K}_L\)，需引入额外局部生成元；双模分解给出形式或一般 \(q\) 下完整的不可约 \(\mathcal{K}_L\)-模集。

title: Epitaxial Oxide Thin Films with High Entropy and Anomalous Crystallinity
summary: Pulsed laser deposition (PLD) expands the compositional and structural possibilities of high-entropy oxide (HEO) thin films through far-from-equilibrium growth and kinetic arrest of metastable configurations. This review connects growth kinetics and epitaxial constraints to the roles of individual cations in shaping the resulting films. We focus primarily on rock salt MgCoNiCuZnO and its derivatives, with selected fluorite, spinel, and perovskite examples illustrating broader applicability. In MgCoNiCuZnO, Co valence and Cu coordination illustrate how chemistry and growth conditions jointly enable lattice tuning and coherent nanostructure formation, while aliovalent and size-misfit additions expand the accessible defect and compositional landscapes. These coupled degrees of freedom underpin anomalous crystallinity, the coexistence of extensive chemical disorder with exceptional crystalline quality and epitaxial order, including full coherence in selected systems, particularly rock salts grown on MgO. This combination opens opportunities to discover and engineer functional configurations in high-quality single-layer films and heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦脉冲激光沉积（pulsed laser deposition, PLD）制备高熵氧化物（high-entropy oxide, HEO）薄膜，将生长动力学与外延约束同各阳离子作用相联系，揭示化学无序与高结晶质量可共存。
AI.motivation: PLD通过远离平衡（far-from-equilibrium）生长与亚稳构型的动力学冻结（kinetic arrest），拓展了HEO薄膜的组分与结构空间，因此有必要梳理生长动力学与外延约束如何塑造薄膜中各类阳离子的作用。
AI.method: 以岩盐（rock salt）结构MgCoNiCuZnO及其衍生物为主要研究对象，并辅以萤石（fluorite）、尖晶石（spinel）与钙钛矿（perovskite）实例说明普适性，将生长动力学与外延约束同阳离子行为进行关联分析。
AI.result: 在MgCoNiCuZnO中，Co价态与Cu配位表明化学性质与生长条件可协同实现晶格调控与共格纳米结构（coherent nanostructure）形成；异价（aliovalent）与尺寸失配掺杂则扩展了缺陷与组分空间。
AI.conclusion: 这些耦合自由度导致反常结晶性（anomalous crystallinity），即广泛的化学无序与优异结晶质量和外延有序共存，部分体系（如MgO上生长的岩盐）实现完全共格（full coherence），为高质量单层薄膜与异质结构中的功能构型设计提供机会。

title: On the coincidence of discrete and continuous definitions of Entanglement of Formation
comment: 14 pages, preliminary vesion, any comments are welcome
summary:
It is proved that every Borel ensemble of pure states on a separable bipartite Hilbert space with finite average entanglement admits a countable ensemble with the same barycenter and arbitrarily small additional average entanglement. Consequently, the discrete and continuous versions of the Entanglement of Formation coincide on the whole space of states of infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system (with infinite values allowed).
  The main idea of the proof (realized with the AI-assistance) is the identification of a Borel ensemble of pure bipartite states with a Borel probability measure on the unit sphere of the space of Hilbert--Schmidt operators followed by dividing the support of this measure into appropriate cells and replacing each cell by its conditional barycenter. The resulting countable ensemble is obtained by a recursive construction.

AI.tldr: 证明可分双部希尔伯特空间上任意有限平均纠缠的 Borel 纯态系综可被可数系综逼近（重心相同、附加平均纠缠任意小），从而推出无限维双部量子系统中形成纠缠的离散与连续定义在整个态空间上一致（允许无穷值）。
AI.motivation: 旨在确立无限维双部量子系统（infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system）中形成纠缠（Entanglement of Formation）的离散版本与连续版本是否在整个态空间上一致。
AI.method: 将 Borel 纯态系综等同于 Hilbert–Schmidt 算子空间单位球上的 Borel 概率测度（Borel probability measure），把该测度的支撑集划分为适当的胞元（cells），以每胞元的条件重心（conditional barycenter）替代之，并通过递归构造（recursive construction）得到可数系综；证明过程借助 AI 辅助完成。
AI.result: 每个有限平均纠缠的 Borel 纯态系综都存在一个可数系综，二者重心（barycenter）相同，且附加平均纠缠可任意小。
AI.conclusion: 在无限维双部量子系统的整个态空间上，形成纠缠的离散定义与连续定义相重合（允许取无穷值）。

title: Quantum Localization in Geometric Complex Networks
summary: Quantum localization, the phenomenon by which wave diffusion is halted, here understood as the superposition of propagating waves, can have many different origins, such as onsite random potentials in Anderson localization. However, some systems exhibit complex geometries and could potentially reproduce similar results without external potentials. In this work, we study how localization of single particle states is affected by the underlying topology of a simple but highly predictive complex network model: the geometric soft configuration model $\mathbb S^1$. By tuning the model's temperature and heterogeneity parameters, we are able to generate different structural patterns and focus on the transition from a small-world to a non-small-world regime. Our study suggests that small-world networks tend to have extended states, which spread the whole system's size, in contrast to non-small-world networks which tend to localize, showing how complex connectivity can play the role assigned to random energetic disorder.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究复杂网络拓扑对单粒子态局域化（localization）的影响，以几何软构型模型（geometric soft configuration model）S¹ 为对象，发现小世界（small-world）网络倾向支持扩展态，而非小世界网络倾向局域化。
AI.motivation: 量子局域化传统上源于外部无序势（如 Anderson 局域化中的格点随机势），但具有复杂几何结构的系统可能在不依赖外势的情况下产生类似效应。因此需要考察网络拓扑本身能否扮演随机能量无序的角色。
AI.method: 采用简单且具高度预测性的复杂网络模型——几何软构型模型 S¹；通过调节该模型的温度（temperature）与异质性（heterogeneity）参数生成不同结构模式，并聚焦从小世界到非小世界（non-small-world）区域的转变，研究单粒子态的局域化行为。
AI.result: 小世界网络倾向于具有扩展态（extended states），其波函数可延伸至整个系统尺度；相反，非小世界网络倾向于局域化（localize）。这表明复杂连接性（complex connectivity）可承担通常由随机能量无序所扮演的角色。
AI.conclusion: 网络拓扑可作为局域化的独立机制来源：连通结构的改变在小世界与非小世界转变中驱动了态从扩展到局域的转换，为无需外部势的局域化提供了基于复杂网络的解释框架。

title: Superdiffusive Invariance Principle for the two-dimensional Asymmetric Simple Exclusion Process
summary:
We consider the Asymmetric Simple Exclusion Process (ASEP) at its critical dimension $d=2$, started from the Bernoulli product measure with density $ρ\in (0,1)$. We first derive the sharp $\log(t)^{2/3}$ divergence of the bulk diffusivity, predicted via mode-coupling theory in [H. van Beijeren, R. Kutner, H. Spohn, Phys. Rev. Lett., 1985], including the exact prefactor, thereby removing the subleading diverging multiplicative corrections in the Tauberian bounds of [H.-T. Yau, Ann. of Math., 2004]. More importantly, we establish an invariance principle for the density fluctuation field on the corresponding superdiffusive scales. On the time scale $τ$, we rescale space by $\sqrtτ \log(τ)^{1/3}$ in the direction of the drift and by $\sqrtτ$ in the transverse direction, and prove functional convergence of the rescaled fluctuation process to the solution of a conservative stochastic heat equation with additive noise. This is the same explicit Gaussian Fixed Point obtained in [G. Cannizzaro, Q. Moulard, F. Toninelli, arXiv:2501.00344, 2025] for the two-dimensional Stochastic Burgers Equation (SBE). We also deduce a superdiffusive central limit theorem for the second-class particle under the same anisotropic rescaling. The result holds for any finite-range jump kernel with nonzero drift and uniaxial asymmetry.
  This is the first space-time scaling limit result for a nonequilibrium interacting particle system at the critical dimension, where Gaussian fluctuations emerge despite logarithmic corrections to the scaling. The proof uses an approximate fluctuation-dissipation relation, which is obtained by combining a sharp quantitative comparison between the ASEP and SBE generators with refined estimates on the SBE Ansatz. An additional key novelty is a tightness argument that overcomes the limitations of the Itô trick on superdiffusive scales.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维临界维数（critical dimension）$d=2$ 下非对称简单排他过程（Asymmetric Simple Exclusion Process, ASEP）的涨落行为，首次在平衡态临界维数下建立非平衡相互作用粒子系统的时空标度极限（space-time scaling limit），证明在超扩散尺度（superdiffusive scales）上密度涨落场收敛到具有加性噪声的守恒随机热方程，即与二维随机Burgers方程（Stochastic Burgers Equation, SBE）相同的显式高斯不动点（Gaussian Fixed Point）。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在刻画ASEP在临界维数$d=2$下的异常扩散与涨落标度行为，验证模耦合理论（mode-coupling theory）关于体扩散率（bulk diffusivity）对数发散的预测并获得精确前因子，同时消除已有Tauberian界中的次领头发散修正。更重要的动机是填补临界维数下非平衡相互作用粒子系统时空标度极限结果的空白，并揭示对数修正下仍出现高斯涨落的机制。
AI.method: 方法核心是建立近似涨落-耗散关系（approximate fluctuation-dissipation relation），通过将ASEP生成元与SBE生成元进行精确定量比较，并结合对SBE试探解（Ansatz）的精细估计实现。此外，作者提出一个新的紧性（tightness）论证，以克服Itô技巧在超扩散尺度上的局限性。所考虑模型为具有非零漂移与单轴不对称性的任意有限程跳跃核（finite-range jump kernel）。
AI.result: 作者首先推导出体扩散率的尖锐$\log(t)^{2/3}$发散及其精确前因子，与1985年模耦合理论预测一致，并去除了Yau（2004）Tauberian界中的次领头乘性修正。进而证明：在时间尺度$\tau$上，沿漂移方向空间按$\sqrt{\tau}\log(\tau)^{1/3}$、横向按$\sqrt{\tau}$重整后，涨落过程泛函收敛至带加性噪声的守恒随机热方程的解，该解与二维SBE的显式高斯不动点相同。由此推出同一各向异性重整下第二类粒子（second-class particle）的超扩散中心极限定理（central limit theorem）。
AI.conclusion: 该结果是临界维数下非平衡相互作用粒子系统的首个时空标度极限结果，表明即使标度存在对数修正，涨落仍呈高斯性。研究同时将ASEP的宏观涨落与二维SBE的普适不动点联系起来，所发展的近似涨落-耗散关系与超扩散尺度紧性论证为处理临界维数下的奇异标度问题提供了新工具。

title: Probing the wave-vector gap in nanoscale magnonics
summary: Short-wavelength spin waves are central to miniaturizing magnonic devices and to studying exchange-dominated magnetization dynamics. Yet the wave-vector range between roughly 30 and 300 radians per micrometre has remained difficult to access experimentally, posing challenges for both excitation and detection. This Perspective reviews recent advances in emerging measurement techniques and discusses prospects for their future development. Optical and microwave techniques are restricted to the vicinity of the Brillouin-zone centre. Inelastic neutron, electron and resonant hard x-ray scattering cover the full Brillouin zone but lack the energy resolution needed for low-frequency magnons at intermediate wave vectors. This Perspective examines five emerging approaches that are beginning to close this gap: Mie-enhanced Brillouin light scattering, colour-centre magnetometry, magnon momentum microscopy, extreme-ultraviolet transient-grating spectroscopy, and time-resolved scanning transmission x-ray microscopy. For each, we discuss the physical principle, demonstrated capabilities, current limitations and prospects for development. Compared side by side, the techniques give complementary access to magnon frequencies, local stray fields, real-space dynamics and momentum-space distributions, and they differ in their sensitivity to coherent and incoherent excitations. We therefore discuss the main advantages and use cases of each technique and consider the practical requirements for addressing different scientific questions. We highlight opportunities for further development, including higher sensitivity, improved spatial and temporal resolution, and broader frequency and wave-vector coverage. Together, these advances could enable, for example, systematic studies of nonlinear magnon interactions at nanoscale wavelengths and investigations of emerging magnetic materials such as altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 该展望（Perspective）综述了介于约30至300 rad/μm波矢区间短波长自旋波（spin waves）测量难题的五种新兴实验技术，比较其互补能力并提出未来发展方向。
AI.motivation: 短波长自旋波对磁子学（magnonics）器件小型化与交换主导磁化动力学研究至关重要，但该中间波矢区间长期缺乏可行的实验手段，激发与探测均存在困难。
AI.method: 采用展望（Perspective）形式，先指出光学与微波技术受限于布里渊区中心（Brillouin-zone centre），非弹性中子、电子及共振硬X射线散射（resonant hard x-ray scattering）虽覆盖全布里渊区但能量分辨率不足；随后评述五种新兴方法：米氏增强布里渊光散射（Mie-enhanced Brillouin light scattering）、色心磁测量（colour-centre magnetometry）、磁子动量显微（magnon momentum microscopy）、极紫外瞬态光栅光谱（extreme-ultraviolet transient-grating spectroscopy）与时间分辨扫描透射X射线显微（time-resolved scanning transmission x-ray microscopy）。
AI.result: 五种技术在磁子频率、局域杂散场（local stray fields）、实空间动力学与动量空间分布方面提供互补信息，且对相干与非相干激发的灵敏度各异；文中逐项讨论了各技术的物理原理、已验证能力、当前局限与发展前景。
AI.conclusion: 该综述比较了各技术的主要优势与适用场景，给出针对不同科学问题的实用要求，并指出提升灵敏度、空间与时间分辨率以及扩展频率与波矢覆盖范围的机遇；这些进展有望支持纳米尺度波长下非线性磁子相互作用（nonlinear magnon interactions）的系统研究与交错磁体（altermagnets）等新兴磁性材料的探索。

title: Spreading the Damage: How Heterogeneity Delocalizes Fracture in Polymer Networks
comment: The authors Saleh Assadi and Zachary White have contributed equally to this work
summary: Fracture in polymer networks is strongly influenced by how network architecture and topology organize damage in space. Although these materials can sustain large deformations under homogeneous loading, they often fail in a brittle and flaw-sensitive manner once defects are present. Here we show that network heterogeneity is one key architectural parameter controlling this transition. Using a discrete mesoscale network model that explicitly resolves strand-level prestretch, force transmission, and irreversible bond scission, we demonstrate that heterogeneity in prestretch and strand lengths broadens crack-induced deformation, delocalizes bond rupture, and enlarges the fracture process zone. In polydisperse networks, increasing contour-length disorder broadens the prestretch distribution and systematically increases both toughness and the intrinsic length scale governing flaw sensitivity. Bimodal networks amplify this mechanism further through combined contrasts in prestretch and strand lengths, producing the largest damage zones and the highest toughness among the architectures studied. Inspired by the results, we derive a scaling estimate relating the emergent fracture-active length to the spatial range of crack-induced deformation and the logarithmic spread of strands' remaining stretch to rupture.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过离散介观网络模型（discrete mesoscale network model）揭示：聚合物网络（polymer networks）中预拉伸与链段长度的非均匀性（heterogeneity）可扩展裂纹诱导变形区、使键断裂去局域化，从而系统提升韧性（toughness）并增大固有缺陷敏感长度尺度。
AI.motivation: 聚合物网络虽能承受大变形，但一旦存在缺陷便易发生脆性、缺陷敏感的断裂，其背后由网络结构与拓扑如何空间组织损伤的机制尚不明确。作者旨在识别控制“均匀承载—缺陷敏感脆断”转变的关键结构参数。
AI.method: 采用离散介观网络模型（discrete mesoscale network model），显式解析链段级预拉伸（strand-level prestretch）、力传递（force transmission）与不可逆键断裂（irreversible bond scission），并对比多分散（polydisperse）与双峰（bimodal）等不同网络架构。
AI.result: 预拉伸与链段长度的非均匀性扩展了裂纹诱导变形、使键断裂去局域化并增大断裂过程区（fracture process zone）。多分散网络中轮廓长度无序度增加会拓宽预拉伸分布，并系统性提升韧性与控制缺陷敏感性的固有长度尺度；双峰网络因预拉伸与链段长度的双重对比而放大该机制，获得最大损伤区与最高韧性。
AI.conclusion: 网络非均匀性是控制断裂模式转变的关键结构参数。作者据此推导出一个标度估计（scaling estimate），将涌现的断裂活跃长度与裂纹诱导变形的空间范围及链段断裂前剩余拉伸的对数展宽联系起来。

title: Molecular-Level Evaluation of the Thermodynamic Properties of Charged Solutions from Submolar to Molar Ion Concentrations
summary: The accurate estimation of the ionic activity coefficients is paramount for the characterization of the electrochemical reactions driving energy storage processes as well as the biological mechanisms involving ATP hydrolysis. The numerical evaluation of the ionic activity coefficients by computational methods is rendered difficult by the infinite dilution limit involved in the integral identity between the Helmholtz free energy and the equation of state of the electrolyte. By combining a recently introduced self-consistent Debye-Huckel formalism and its analytically tractable low density limit, we develop a computationally efficient approach enabling the accurate calculation of the free energy and the related thermodynamic functions of aqueous electrolytes over a broad range of ionic concentration and electrostatic coupling strength. Via comparison with numerical simulations and experimental data, it is shown that our approach can predict the salt dependence of the Helmholtz free energy, the entropy, and the ionic activity coefficients from the electrostatically driven submolar ion concentrations to the hard-core dominated molar density regime.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种结合自洽德拜-休克尔形式与其低密度解析极限的计算高效方法，可在宽广离子浓度与静电耦合强度范围内准确计算水溶液电解质的自由能及相关热力学函数，包括离子活度系数。
AI.motivation: 离子活度系数（ionic activity coefficients）的准确估计对刻画驱动储能过程的电化学反应以及涉及 ATP 水解的生物机制至关重要。然而，通过计算方法对其进行数值评估存在困难，根源在于亥姆霍兹自由能（Helmholtz free energy）与电解质状态方程（equation of state）之间的积分恒等式涉及无限稀释极限（infinite dilution limit）。
AI.method: 将新近引入的自洽德拜-休克尔形式（self-consistent Debye-Hückel formalism）与其可解析处理的低密度极限（low density limit）相结合，构建出一种计算高效的方法，用以计算水溶液电解质的自由能及相关热力学函数。
AI.result: 通过与数值模拟（numerical simulations）和实验数据（experimental data）的比较显示，该方法能够预测亥姆霍兹自由能、熵（entropy）以及离子活度系数随盐浓度的变化，覆盖从静电主导的亚摩尔离子浓度区间到硬核主导的摩尔密度区间。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在宽广的离子浓度与静电耦合强度（electrostatic coupling strength）范围内实现了对水溶液电解质自由能及相关热力学函数的准确计算，其预测结果与数值模拟和实验数据相符，可用于跨越静电主导与硬核主导的不同浓度区域。

title: Extreme anharmonicity determines the superionic transition in the prototypical antifluorite Li$_2$O
summary: Superionic conductors are promising electrolyte candidates for all-solid-state batteries, thanks to their liquid-like ionic mobility. In the prototypical lithium-ion oxide superionic conductor with antifluorite structure, the high-temperature transition to the fast-ion regime has long been attributed to volume-driven harmonic phonon softening. However, this quasi-harmonic picture neglects the strong lattice anharmonicity inherent to the fast-ion regime, leaving the microscopic origin of the transition unresolved. Here, we apply non-perturbative lattice dynamics combined with a first-principles-accurate machine-learning interatomic potential to study the phase transition in Li$_2$O. We demonstrate that anharmonicity, rather than volume expansion alone as commonly assumed, plays the decisive role in determining the transition temperature and the underlying mechanism. Finally, we analyze the spectral properties using the time-dependent self-consistent harmonic approximation, revealing the breakdown of the quasi-particle picture in this material. The spectral function and the infrared response provide signtures of the phase transition that can be investigated experimentally using inelastic neutron or X-ray scattering and infrared spectroscopy. All these results establish the extreme anharmonicity of Li$_2$O near the superionic regime and provide a lattice-dynamic framework for understanding and engineering the fast-ion transition in this type of materials.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合非微扰晶格动力学与第一性原理精度的机器学习原子间势，研究反萤石结构Li₂O中超离子相变的微观起源，指出强非谐性而非单纯体积膨胀决定转变温度与机制，并揭示准粒子图像在该材料中失效。
AI.motivation: 超离子导体（superionic conductors）因类液态离子迁移率而成为全固态电池（all-solid-state batteries）的候选电解质。以反萤石（antifluorite）结构为代表的锂离子氧化物超离子导体，其高温快离子转变长期被归因于体积驱动的谐声子软化（volume-driven harmonic phonon softening），但该准谐（quasi-harmonic）图像忽略了快离子区固有的强晶格非谐性（lattice anharmonicity），使相变微观起源悬而未决。
AI.method: 采用非微扰晶格动力学（non-perturbative lattice dynamics），结合具备第一性原理精度的机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potential），研究Li₂O中的相变；并使用含时自洽谐近似（time-dependent self-consistent harmonic approximation）分析光谱性质。
AI.result: 结果表明，非谐性而非通常假设的单纯体积膨胀，在决定转变温度及其底层机制中起决定性作用。光谱函数（spectral function）与红外响应（infrared response）给出相变特征信号，可通过非弹性中子或X射线散射（inelastic neutron or X-ray scattering）及红外光谱（infrared spectroscopy）进行实验检验；同时揭示该材料中准粒子（quasi-particle）图像的失效。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果确立了Li₂O在超离子区附近的极端非谐性，并为理解与调控此类材料的快离子转变提供了晶格动力学框架。

title: An empirical model for deriving information on ion dynamics from $μ$SR data via the conventional Kubo-Toyabe function analysis
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures (including those in Supplemental Material)
summary: We present an empirical model that analytically relates the parameters of the extended Kubo-Toyabe (KT) function $G_z^{\rm EA}(t;Δ,ν_{\rm i},Q)$, which describes muon spin relaxation ($μ$SR) induced by jump diffusion of ions using the Edwards-Anderson parameter $Q$, to those of the conventional KT function $G_z^{\rm KT}(t;Δ_{\rm KT},ν_{\rm KT})$ that serves as an approximation of $G_z^{\rm EA}(t)$. The proposed formulae successfully reproduce the anomalous temperature dependences of the linewidth $Δ_{\rm KT}(T)$ and the fluctuation rate $ν_{\rm KT}(T)$ which are artifacts observed upon analyzing $μ$SR data on ion diffusion using $G_z^{\rm KT}(t)$. Applying this model to $Δ_{\rm KT}$ and $ν_{\rm KT}$ published in the literature of battery materials yields activation energy $E_{\rm i}$ and pre-exponential factor $ν_{\rm i0}$ in the Arrhenius equation for ion diffusion, $ν_{\rm i}(T)=ν_{\rm i0} e^{-E_{\rm i}/kT}$, that are in excellent agreement with those deduced using other techniques, transforming peculiar artifacts into a powerful diagnostic tool.

AI.tldr: 提出一个经验模型，将扩展Kubo-Toyabe函数与常规Kubo-Toyabe函数的参数解析关联，把μSR数据分析中出现的虚假异常温度依赖转化为提取离子扩散活化能的可靠工具。
AI.motivation: 使用常规Kubo-Toyabe函数分析离子扩散的μSR数据时，会出现线宽与涨落率的异常温度依赖，这些被视为分析假象（artifact），此前缺乏可解释并加以利用的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建经验模型，将描述跳跃扩散诱导muon自旋弛豫的扩展KT函数G_z^EA(t;Δ,ν_i,Q)（含Edwards-Anderson参数Q）的参数，与作为其近似的常规KT函数G_z^KT(t;Δ_KT,ν_KT)的参数进行解析关联。
AI.result: 所提公式成功再现了Δ_KT(T)与ν_KT(T)的异常温度依赖；将该模型应用于文献中电池材料的Δ_KT与ν_KT数据，得到的Arrhenius方程ν_i(T)=ν_i0 e^{-E_i/kT}中的活化能E_i与指前因子ν_i0与其他技术所推结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该模型把原本被视为异常的分析假象转变为强有力的诊断工具，可用于从μSR数据中可靠提取离子扩散参数。

title: Deformation-induced spectral softening drives phase separation on non-spherical membranes
summary: Models of curvature-driven membrane sorting couple composition directly to membrane bending elasticity. Here we show that shape deformations can destabilize a homogeneous state without this composition-dependent mechanical coupling. We analyze the eigenspectrum of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on deformed spheres analytically, and verify it numerically. As the deformation amplitude increases, the spectral degeneracy breaks, and the lowest nonzero eigenvalue decreases substantially. Using Cahn-Hilliard dynamics, we show that this eigenvalue softening provides a purely geometric route to phase separation.

AI.tldr: 该研究证明，即使不存在组分依赖的力学耦合，膜的形状形变本身即可通过几何机制使均匀态失稳并诱导相分离。作者解析求解变形球面上的 Laplace-Beltrami 算子本征谱并数值验证，发现随形变幅度增大谱简并破缺、最低非零本征值显著降低，进而借助 Cahn-Hilliard 动力学显示该本征值软化（eigenvalue softening）构成一条纯几何的相分离路径。
AI.motivation: 既有曲率驱动膜分选（curvature-driven membrane sorting）模型通常将组分直接与膜弯曲弹性（bending elasticity）耦合，即假定相分离需依赖组分-力学耦合。该研究旨在检验是否存在不依赖此类耦合的替代机制，即形状形变本身能否驱动失稳。
AI.method: 解析分析变形球面（deformed spheres）上 Laplace-Beltrami 算子的本征谱（eigenspectrum），并进行数值验证；在此基础上采用 Cahn-Hilliard 动力学（Cahn-Hilliard dynamics）考察本征值软化对相分离的影响。
AI.result: 随形变幅度增加，谱简并（spectral degeneracy）发生破缺，最低非零本征值（lowest nonzero eigenvalue）显著减小；该本征值软化在 Cahn-Hilliard 动力学下可导致相分离。
AI.conclusion: 形状形变可在缺乏组分依赖力学耦合的情况下破坏均匀态稳定性，本征值软化提供了一条纯几何（purely geometric）的相分离途径，拓展了曲率驱动膜分选的理论框架。

title: Nonrelativistic Optically-Induced Spin Torque in Noncollinear Magnets
summary: Manipulating spin using contactless and non-invasive optical approaches is one of the forefront topic in the modern spintronic science and technology. Prior studies on optically-induced spin reorientation usually scales with spin-orbit coupling strength, setting a limitation on composing heavy elements. In this work, we extend such a limit into nonrelativistic regime by exploring noncollinear magnetic configuration. Using a general spin group-theoretical investigation, we show how the symmetric operators in both spin and lattice spaces control the spin torque and quantum geometry of Bloch wavefunction--including both quantum metric and Berry curvature. We describe their site-resolved spin symmetries and unravel their selection rules. Furthermore, we adopt a Kagomé lattice model and a realistic material family to showcase the local spin torque under light irradiation. Since the nonrelativistic spin splitting usually spans on the order of electron-volt, significantly larger than typical spin-orbit induced splitting, the nonrelativistic light-induced spin torque is concomitantly much stronger. This work extends the previous opto-spintronics from relativistic to nonrelativistic limit, significantly broadening its realization platform.

AI.tldr: 该工作将光学诱导自旋重取向的实现条件从相对论（relativistic）极限拓展至非相对论（nonrelativistic）极限，通过非共线磁构型与自旋群论揭示对称算符对自旋力矩及量子几何的调控，并证明非相对论光致自旋力矩显著更强。
AI.motivation: 既有光学诱导自旋重取向研究通常依赖于自旋轨道耦合（spin-orbit coupling）强度，从而在材料选择上受限于重元素。本文旨在突破该限制，探索非相对论区域内的光致自旋调控可能性。
AI.method: 采用普适的自旋群论（spin group-theoretical）分析，考察自旋空间与晶格空间中的对称算符如何控制自旋力矩（spin torque）以及布洛赫波函数的量子几何（quantum geometry，含量子度规 quantum metric 与贝里曲率 Berry curvature），并给出位点分辨的自旋对称性及其选择定则；进一步以 Kagomé 晶格模型与真实材料家族展示光照下的局域自旋力矩。
AI.result: 非相对论自旋劈裂（nonrelativistic spin splitting）通常可达电子伏特量级，远大于典型的自旋轨道诱导劈裂，因此非相对论光致自旋力矩相应显著更强；Kagomé 晶格模型与真实材料体系验证了光照下的局域自旋力矩。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将光自旋电子学（opto-spintronics）由相对论极限拓展至非相对论极限，显著拓宽了其实现平台与材料选择范围。

title: Electronic Structure of a Delafossite Oxide CuAlO$_2$ in Comparison with CuCrO$_2$
summary: We investigated the electronic structure of a delafossite oxide CuAlO$_2$ in comparison with CuCrO$_2$, using vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) and hard x-ray (HX) photoemission spectroscopy (PES) and band structure calculations within the local-density approximation +$U$ scheme. Cu 3$p\! -\! 3d$ resonant PES and Cu $2p$ core-level HX-PES give concrete evidence that the Cu valence in CuAlO$_2$ is monovalent, which makes a sharp contrast to CuCrO$_2$ that showed contradictory results depending upon probing methods [Yokobori \textit{et al.}, Phys. Rev. B \textbf{87}, 195124 (2013)]. We further noticed weak but detectable satellite structures due to Cu$^{2+}$ state in the Cu $2p$ HX-PES spectrum of CuCrO$_2$, surprisingly, without an observable main peak due to the Cu$^{2+}$ state. Comparisons between the valence-band HX-PES spectra and the band structure calculations revealed a significant amount of the Cu $4s$ and Al $3s$/Cr $4s$ states in the valence band. The above results can reasonably be explained by the Cu $3d, 4s-$Cr $3d$ charge transfer model that we previously proposed in the above paper, thereby demonstrating the critical role of empty $3d$ orbitals in the electronic structure of the copper delafossite oxides.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合真空紫外（VUV）与硬X射线（HX）光电子能谱（PES）及 LDA+U 能带计算，比较了铜铁矿氧化物 CuAlO₂ 与 CuCrO₂ 的电子结构，确认 CuAlO₂ 中 Cu 为一价，并验证了此前提出的 Cu 3d,4s–Cr 3d 电荷转移模型。
AI.motivation: CuCrO₂ 的 Cu 价态在不同探测手段下给出相互矛盾的结果，需通过多种互补谱学方法澄清铜铁矿氧化物中 Cu 的价态与电子结构起源。
AI.method: 采用真空紫外（vacuum ultraviolet, VUV）与硬X射线（hard x-ray, HX）光电子能谱（photoemission spectroscopy, PES），包括 Cu 3p–3d 共振 PES 与 Cu 2p 芯能级 HX-PES，并配合局域密度近似加 U（local-density approximation + U, LDA+U）方案的能带结构计算。
AI.result: Cu 3p–3d 共振 PES 与 Cu 2p 芯能级 HX-PES 表明 CuAlO₂ 中 Cu 为一价；CuCrO₂ 的 Cu 2p HX-PES 中观察到 Cu²⁺ 的弱卫星结构却无可观测的主峰；价带 HX-PES 与能带计算对比显示价带中含有可观的 Cu 4s 与 Al 3s/Cr 4s 成分。
AI.conclusion: 上述结果可由此前提出的 Cu 3d,4s–Cr 3d 电荷转移模型（charge transfer model）合理解释，表明空的 3d 轨道在铜铁矿氧化物电子结构中起关键作用。

title: High-mobility spin transport mediated by indirect excitons in a van der Waals heterostructure
summary: Efficient spin transport with high spin mobility is of both fundamental and practical significance for spintronics. Spin can be transferred by moving particles. However, particle scattering limits spin transfer and prevents high spin mobilities. In this work, we study the kinetics of spin transport mediated by a quantum system of indirect excitons (IXs) in a van der Waals heterostructure composed of atomically thin transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). This spin transfer mechanism allows for the realization of efficient spin transport characterized by a high spin mobility reaching 10$^5$ cm$^2$/(eV$\cdot$s), which is orders of magnitude higher than that achieved via standard diffusive spin transport in TMD materials. The suppression of IX scattering enables high-mobility spin transport.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究范德华异质结中间接激子（indirect excitons, IXs）介导的自旋输运动力学，通过抑制激子散射实现高达10^5 cm^2/(eV·s)的自旋迁移率，比TMD材料中标准扩散自旋输运高出数个量级。
AI.motivation: 高效自旋输运与高自旋迁移率对自旋电子学（spintronics）兼具基础与应用意义。自旋可随粒子运动而转移，但粒子散射会限制自旋转移并阻碍高自旋迁移率的实现。
AI.method: 在由原子级厚度过渡金属硫属化物（transition-metal dichalcogenides, TMDs）构成的范德华异质结（van der Waals heterostructure）中，研究由间接激子（indirect excitons, IXs）量子系统介导的自旋输运动力学。
AI.result: 该自旋转移机制可实现高效自旋输运，自旋迁移率达到10^5 cm^2/(eV·s)，比TMD材料中标准扩散自旋输运（diffusive spin transport）高出数个量级。
AI.conclusion: IX散射的抑制是实现高迁移率自旋输运的关键机制，表明基于IX介导的自旋转移可在TMD范德华异质结中实现高效自旋输运。

title: Vibrational Fingerprints of Competing Structural and Polar Phases in CuInP2S6
summary: Layered van der Waals CuInP2S6 crystals exhibit a rich sequence of temperature- and pressure-driven phase transitions, giving rise to multiple structural phases with distinct physical properties. Despite extensive experimental and theoretical efforts, unambiguous identification of these phases remains challenging because of their structural similarities and complex vibrational responses. In this work, we employ first-principles density functional theory calculations to systematically investigate the vibrational properties of the reference paraelectric C2/c and P-31c phases and their corresponding dynamically stable ferroelectric Cc and P31c phases, as well as the antiferroelectric P-1 and P-3 phases. From calculated phonon spectra and symmetry analysis, we determine the Raman- and infrared-active modes of each candidate structure and identify characteristic vibrational fingerprints that enable their phase determination through vibrational spectroscopy. Furthermore, using Porto notation, we establish polarization- and crystal-orientation-dependent Raman selection rules for different backscattering geometries and identify the modes that are expected to emerge or vanish under specific experimental configurations. Thus, our results provide a comprehensive theoretical framework for interpreting Raman and infrared measurements of CuInP2S6 and for reliably identifying its competing structural, ferroelectric, and antiferroelectric phases across temperature- and pressure-driven phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过第一性原理密度泛函理论计算，系统研究CuInP2S6各候选相（顺电C2/c、P-31c，铁电Cc、P31c，反铁电P-1、P-3）的振动性质，建立可用于振动光谱相鉴别的特征指纹与拉曼选择定则。
AI.motivation: 层状范德瓦尔斯CuInP2S6晶体存在丰富的温度与压力驱动相变，形成多种结构与物理性质各异的相；但因各相结构相似、振动响应复杂，其相的无歧义指认仍具挑战，亟需可靠的光谱识别依据。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（density functional theory, DFT）计算，系统考察参考顺电相C2/c与P-31c、对应的动力学稳定铁电相Cc与P31c，以及反铁电相P-1与P-3的振动性质。
AI.result: 基于声子谱与对称性分析，确定各候选结构的拉曼（Raman）与红外（infrared）活性模式，识别可用于相指认的特征振动指纹；并以Porto记号建立不同背散射几何下依赖极化与晶体取向的拉曼选择定则（Raman selection rules），指出在特定实验构型下应出现或消失的模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为CuInP2S6的拉曼与红外测量提供统一的理论解释框架，并支持在温度与压力驱动相变中可靠识别其竞争性结构相、铁电相与反铁电相。

title: Few-Magnon Universality beyond Contact Interactions in Long-Range Spin Chains
summary: Quantum few-body systems exhibit a rich variety of phenomena that provide fundamental insights into universality. A paradigmatic example is the Efimov effect, in which an infinite tower of three-body bound states emerges with binding energies forming a geometric sequence. Motivated by advances in trapped-ion systems, recent theoretical work has predicted that the Efimov effect can arise in certain long-range quantum spin chains, where magnons exhibit a general dispersion $ε_k=u|k|^z$ with $z\in(0.52,0.88)$ and interact through a contact potential. Nevertheless, whether Efimov universality persists in the presence of experimentally relevant long-range interactions between magnons remains unexplored. In this work, we address this issue by investigating the two- and three-magnon problems with a model interaction potential $V(x)=V_0/(1+|x|^β)$. Our results demonstrate that few-body universality persists for any $β>1$: In the two-magnon sector, the low-energy expansion of the scattering matrix near a two-body resonance agrees with the universal form predicted by contact-interaction theory. The three-magnon bound-state spectrum exhibits Efimov scaling, with a scaling factor consistent with the theory. We further highlight the experimental relevance of our model, which can be readily realized in trapped-ion systems. Our results pave the way for quantum simulations of universal few-body physics beyond the traditional paradigm of nonrelativistic particles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长程相互作用下磁振子（magnon）少体问题，采用模型势 V(x)=V₀/(1+|x|^β)，证明对任意 β>1，二体与三体普适性（universality）依然保持，包括 Efimov 标度行为，并指出该模型可在囚禁离子（trapped-ion）系统中实现。
AI.motivation: 量子少体系统（quantum few-body systems）为普适性提供基础洞见，Efimov 效应是其典型范例，且近期理论预言其在长程量子自旋链中可借磁振子实现。然而，磁振子间实际存在的长程相互作用是否破坏 Efimov 普适性尚属未解问题。
AI.method: 构建带长程相互作用的模型势 V(x)=V₀/(1+|x|^β)，在该势下求解二磁振子与三磁振子问题，并与接触相互作用（contact interaction）理论所预言的普适形式进行对比。
AI.result: 对任意 β>1，少体普适性均得以保持：二磁振子能区中，二体共振附近的散射矩阵（scattering matrix）低能展开与接触相互作用理论的普适形式一致；三磁振子束缚态谱表现出 Efimov 标度，标度因子与理论相符。
AI.conclusion: Efimov 普适性在实验相关的长程相互作用下依然稳健；该模型易于在囚禁离子系统中实现，为超越传统非相对论粒子（nonrelativistic particles）范式的普适少体物理量子模拟开辟了路径。

title: Length-scale dependence of collective time reparameterization in swap dynamics
summary: Swap Monte Carlo dramatically accelerates the equilibration of deeply supercooled liquids while preserving the equilibrium Boltzmann distribution. Recent work has argued that swap and other accelerated algorithms act by reparameterizing time: different dynamics follow the same slow relaxation process, but with different clocks. Here we test this idea in a continuously polydisperse glass former. We confirm that mean collective overlaps satisfy an approximate time reparameterization, in agreement with earlier results. However, the associated clock depends systematically on the collective probe length and on the relaxation stage. Thus the observed collective collapse does not define a unique, observable-independent material time. Over the numerically accessible $α$-relaxation regime, swap changes not only the rate of relaxation, but also its length-scale dependence. The resulting collective reparameterization is therefore only approximate and does not establish an exact dynamical equivalence between swap and reference relaxation.

AI.tldr: 在连续多分散玻璃形成体中，交换蒙特卡洛（swap Monte Carlo）虽能使集体重叠函数近似满足时间重参数化（time reparameterization），但所对应的"时钟"依赖探针长度与弛豫阶段，故不存在唯一的、与观测量无关的材料时间（material time），交换算法与参考弛豫之间不构成精确的动力学等价。
AI.motivation: 近期工作提出交换蒙特卡洛及其他加速算法通过"时间重参数化"起作用，即不同动力学遵循同一慢弛豫过程但使用不同时钟。本文旨在连续多分散玻璃形成体中检验该观点是否成立，特别是集体塌缩能否定义唯一的材料时间。
AI.method: 采用连续多分散（continuously polydisperse）玻璃形成体模型，测量平均集体重叠（mean collective overlaps），检验交换动力学与参考动力学之间是否存在近似的时间重参数化，并分析所关联时钟对集体探针长度（probe length）与弛豫阶段的依赖关系。
AI.result: 平均集体重叠确实近似满足时间重参数化，与先前结果一致；然而所关联的时钟系统性地依赖于集体探针长度和弛豫阶段。在数值可及的α弛豫（α-relaxation）区间内，交换不仅改变弛豫速率，还改变其长度尺度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 观察到的集体塌缩（collective collapse）并不能定义一个唯一的、与观测量无关的材料时间。所得的集体重参数化仅为近似，无法确立交换与参考弛豫之间的精确动力学等价（dynamical equivalence）。

title: Chirally pinned flat bands, helical minibands, and bias-controlled topology of Jackiw-Rebbi states in a periodically modulated Dirac mass texture
summary: Flat bands amplify interactions into correlated phases, and topological bound states are robust by principle; combining the two in a model that is both exactly analyzable and experimentally accessible is therefore especially desirable. Here we show that a square-lattice model with a slowly modulated Dirac mass texture, $m(x)=m+m_0\cos(2πx/L)$ with $L$ up to hundreds of sites, provides such a setting, without engineered geometries, lattice-scale textures, or long-range hoppings. Exact nesting reduces the problem, independently at each transverse momentum $k_y$, to a $1+1$ dimensional Dirac Hamiltonian with a position-dependent mass: every simple zero of $m(x)$ binds Jackiw-Rebbi zero modes, and the two walls of a period form an effective Su-Schrieffer-Heeger ring. The model interpolates between a chirally pinned flat band at large $L$, a helical miniband whose nodes are enforced by a boundary phase of the ring, and a bias-dimerized regime in which the sign of the bias sets a winding number. A central result is that the miniband bandwidth is not a single scale: a max-min measurement conflates three widths of different origin, the helical height $W_{\rm JR}$ exponential in the period, the zone-edge upturn $W_{\rm edge}\propto L^{-2/3}$ dominating at large $L$, and a bias bump exponential in $L$, so the flat band is robust against bias in the thermodynamic limit. We analyze two lattice realizations, a two-orbital model with modulated inter-orbital hybridization and a single-orbital bond-order texture sharing the nodal physics while leaving the van Hove points gapless, and propose experiments on cold-atom superlattices, Kekule-ordered graphene, STM designer lattices, and microwave arrays.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一个方形晶格（square lattice）模型，通过缓慢调制的狄拉克质量织构（Dirac mass texture）在同一框架内同时实现平带（flat band）与拓扑束缚态（topological bound state），并给出可精确解析、可由多种平台实现的方案。
AI.motivation: 平带可放大相互作用并导致关联相（correlated phases），拓扑束缚态在原理上具有鲁棒性；但将二者结合于既可精确解析又易于实验实现的模型仍属稀缺，因此需要一个无需人工几何、晶格尺度织构或长程跃迁的可行方案。
AI.method: 在方形晶格中引入缓慢调制的狄拉克质量织构 m(x)=m+m₀cos(2πx/L)（L 可达数百格点）。利用精确嵌套（exact nesting），将问题在每个横向动量 k_y 上独立约化为带位置依赖质量的 1+1 维狄拉克哈密顿量（Dirac Hamiltonian）；m(x) 的每个单零点束缚 Jackiw-Rebbi 零模，一个周期内的两壁构成有效的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 环。作者分析了两种晶格实现：调制轨道间杂化的双轨道模型，以及单轨道键序织构。
AI.result: 模型在大 L 极限下插值于手性钉扎平带（chirally pinned flat band）、由环的边界相位强制节点的螺旋微带（helical miniband）与偏压二聚化（bias-dimerized）区域（偏压符号决定缠绕数 winding number）之间。核心发现为微带带宽并非单一尺度：max-min 测量混合了三种来源不同的宽度——周期指数依赖的螺旋高度 W_JR、在大 L 下主导的带边抬升 W_edge∝L^(−2/3)，以及指数依赖于 L 的偏压鼓包，故平带在热力学极限（thermodynamic limit）下对偏压稳健。两种实现共享节点物理，但单轨道键序织构保持范霍夫点（van Hove points）无能隙。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为平带与拓扑束缚态的结合提供了可解析且可实验的平台，并提出在冷原子超晶格（cold-atom superlattice）、Kekulé 有序石墨烯（Kekule-ordered graphene）、STM 设计晶格（STM designer lattices）与微波阵列（microwave arrays）上的实验方案。

title: Self-Avoidance Governs Re-entrant Coil-Globule Transition of Inertial Active Brownian Ring Polymers
summary: Active matter systems composed of self-propelled entities exhibit a wide range of out-of-equilibrium phase behaviors and collective dynamics. Assemblies of active particles, e.g., in a linear structure, are particularly interesting, as they exhibit an intriguing interplay between activity and geometrical restrictions due to self-avoidance and entanglements. Using Langevin dynamics simulations of an active Brownian ring polymer with translational and rotational inertia, we uncover an inertia-driven re-entrant coil-globule transition in the absence of any attractive interactions. We show that rotational inertia plays a paramount role, leading, in the globular state, to spontaneous, nonzero, radially outward polarization of the active forces. Self-avoidance and entanglements break the rotational symmetry of active beads and effectively stabilize the globular states. The transition becomes increasingly sharp with increasing rotational inertia, yielding highly compact globular conformations at intermediate activities, whereas at high activity the polymer re-expands into a coil state. Scaling of the radius of gyration reveals crossovers from self-avoiding, phantom-like to compact-globular structures. Further, rotational inertia enhances transport properties, with an intermediate activity-induced Rouse-type bead diffusion and a long-time diffusion coefficient displaying a power-law dependence on the moment of inertia. Our study establishes a purely inertia-induced mechanism for controlling the collapse of active polymers, arising from spontaneous active-force polarization and self-avoidance.

AI.tldr: 通过含平动与转动惯性的活性布朗环状聚合物（active Brownian ring polymer）的朗之万动力学（Langevin dynamics）模拟，揭示了一种无吸引相互作用下由惯性驱动的重入线圈-球状转变（re-entrant coil-globule transition），其中转动惯性起主导作用。
AI.motivation: 活性物质（active matter）系统表现出丰富的非平衡相行为；线性结构的活性粒子组装体因自回避（self-avoidance）与缠结带来的活性与几何限制相互作用而尤具研究价值。本文旨在探究惯性（尤其是转动惯性）如何调控活性聚合物的构象转变。
AI.method: 采用含平动与转动惯性的活性布朗环状聚合物的朗之万动力学模拟，考察在无任何吸引相互作用情形下的构象与动力学行为。
AI.result: 发现转动惯性在球状态中导致活性力的自发非零径向向外的极化；自回避与缠结打破活性珠子的转动对称性并有效稳定球状态。随转动惯性增大转变愈发尖锐，中等活性下形成高度致密的球状构象，而高活性下聚合物重新展开为线圈态。回转半径（radius of gyration）标度显示从自回避的类幻影结构到致密球状结构的交越。转动惯性还增强输运性质，出现中等活性诱导的类 Rouse 珠子扩散，长时扩散系数对惯性矩呈幂律依赖。
AI.conclusion: 本研究确立了一种纯由惯性诱导的活性聚合物坍缩控制机制，其源自活性力的自发极化与自回避效应。

title: Field-driven phase transition crossover in kagome antiferromagnet Mn$_{3-x}$Co$_x$Sn
summary: Mn$_3$Sn exhibits a complex magnetic phase diagram with multiple symmetry-breaking phenomena. Minute electron doping at the Mn site breaks the kagome lattice symmetry in Mn$_3$Sn. In this work, we exploited this to tune the order of the magnetic phase transition using magnetocaloric effect in Mn$_{3-x}$Co$_x$Sn single crystals. Pristine Mn$_3$Sn shows metallic behaviour with a spin-reorientation transition at 278 K, which shifts to 175 K upon Co doping. Additionally, Co doping also induces a weak-ferromagnetic transition near $\approx 210$ K. The effect of Co doping results inverse to conventional magnetocaloric effect, with enhanced magnetic entropy change. Further, the scaled entropy change reveals a field-driven magnetic phase transition crossover from first order to second order in Mn$_{2.75}$Co$_{0.25}$Sn crystal. Based on experimental data, a new phase diagram is constructed, depicting the field evolution of various magnetic orders.

AI.tldr: 通过 Co 掺杂调控 Mn$_3$Sn 的 kagome 晶格对称性与磁相变性质，结合磁热效应（magnetocaloric effect）研究发现场驱动的一级到二级相变交叉，并构建了新的磁相图。
AI.motivation: Mn$_3$Sn 具有包含多种对称性破缺现象的复杂磁相图，而 Mn 位微量的电子掺杂会破坏其 kagome 晶格对称性。作者利用这一特性，尝试通过掺杂调控磁相变的有序性（即相变级数），以系统研究其磁性与相变行为。
AI.method: 采用 Mn$_{3-x}$Co$_x$Sn 单晶样品，通过磁热效应测量来探测磁相变，并结合比例化熵变（scaled entropy change）分析相变的级数特征，进而构建相图。
AI.result: 未掺杂 Mn$_3$Sn 呈金属行为，在 278 K 出现自旋重取向转变（spin-reorientation transition），Co 掺杂后移至 175 K，并在约 210 K 附近诱导弱的铁磁转变（weak-ferromagnetic transition）。Co 掺杂产生的效应与传统磁热效应相反，磁熵变（magnetic entropy change）增强；比例化熵变揭示 Mn$_{2.75}$Co$_{0.25}$Sn 中存在场驱动的从一级到二级磁相变交叉（crossover）。
AI.conclusion: 基于实验数据构建了新的相图，刻画了各磁有序态随磁场的演化，表明 Co 掺杂可有效调控 Mn$_3$Sn 的磁相变级数及磁熵变行为。

title: Orbital cancellation and reentrant localization in a quasiperiodic trimer ladder
summary: Uniform orbital detuning can restore spatial extent even as quasiperiodic modulation strengthens. In a trimer ladder with fixed hoppings and orbital modulation signs, increasing detuning and modulation amplitude together drives successive avoided crossings that redistribute orbital weights, suppressing the projected onsite potential in both lower molecular bands while leaving the third strongly modulated. Complete-band participation scaling supports two reentrant high-participation windows, with wave-packet propagation corroborating spatial recovery at representative controls over the studied sizes and times. These diagonal cancellations leave residual interband modulation, which generates a self-energy whose magnitude depends on the molecular level separation. Gaussian quadrature improves convergence of closed-walk determinant estimates used to cross-check energy-resolved attenuation. Comparing the coupled and decoupled ladders under the same finite-size participation criterion shows that restoring the full off-diagonal modulation narrows both sampled windows, with a larger absolute contraction of the second.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示：在三聚体梯（trimer ladder）中同步增大均匀轨道失谐（uniform orbital detuning）与准周期调制（quasiperiodic modulation）幅度，可经由连续避免交叉（avoided crossings）重新分配轨道权重，从而恢复空间延展性并形成两个重入高参与窗口。
AI.motivation: 通常准周期调制增强会压缩波函数的空间延展（局域化），本文关注是否存在通过均匀轨道失谐逆转该局域化趋势的机制，即"恢复空间延展"的可行性。
AI.method: 采用固定跃迁与轨道调制符号的三聚体梯模型，同步调节失谐与调制幅度；以完整能带参与度标度（complete-band participation scaling）和波包传播（wave-packet propagation）作为判据，并用高斯求积（Gaussian quadrature）改进闭路行列式估计的收敛性，以交叉校验能量分辨衰减。
AI.result: 连续避免交叉抑制了两个低分子能带的投影在位势（projected onsite potential），而第三能带仍保持强调制；出现两个重入高参与窗口，波包传播在研究尺度与时间内证实空间恢复。对角项消除后残留的带间调制产生依赖分子能级间距的自能（self-energy）。在相同有限尺寸参与度判据下，恢复完整非对角调制使两个窗口均变窄，且第二个窗口收缩的绝对值更大。
AI.conclusion: 均匀轨道失谐可抵消准周期调制的局域化效应，实现空间延展的恢复；该恢复由对角消除机制主导，并受残余带间调制（自能）与完整非对角调制强度的影响，后者会压缩恢复窗口。

title: Defining Thixotropy
summary: Originally coined 100 years ago to represent a shear-reversible sol-gel transition, the range of the term "thixotropy" has gradually expanded to encompass time-dependent changes in viscosity. Since this risks confusing "thixotropy" with ordinary nonlinear viscoelastic behavior, in this work we seek simple, historically faithful, quantifiable, and experimentally testable definitions of "thixotropy" that avoid this confusion. By analysing both historical tradition and published experimental data, we arrive at three complementary definitions. Definition 0 provides an idealized, purely inelastic reference useful primarily for recognizing thixotropy in a constitutive equation. Definitions 1 and 2, which are more practical, require, respectively, unusually large strains to reach steady state, and unbounded growth of the material relaxation time during rest. Definition 1 can apply in either shear-rate or stress-controlled modes, with the latter encompassing the so-called "viscosity bifurcation." These criteria are tested across diverse materials that we identify as thixotropic based on their responses clearly exceeding their viscoelastic reference scales. The framework is deliberately phenomenological and does not require specific microscopic mechanisms, allowing diverse materials to be described within a common rheological language, as is typical for rheological terminology. We believe that these definitions provide a practical framework for assigning thixotropy a more definite place in rheological taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"触变性（thixotropy）"一词外延不断扩张、易与普通非线性黏弹性（nonlinear viscoelasticity）混淆的问题，通过分析历史传统与已发表实验数据，提出三个互补的可量化、可实验检验的定义，并给出统一的现象学（phenomenological）判定框架。
AI.motivation: "触变性"最初用于描述剪切可逆的溶胶-凝胶转变（sol-gel transition），其后逐渐泛指黏度（viscosity）随时间的变化，存在将其与普通非线性黏弹性行为相混淆的风险。作者希望寻找简单、符合历史本义、可量化且可实验检验的定义，以避免这一混淆。
AI.method: 综合分析历史传统与已发表的实验数据，由此推导出三个互补的定义：定义0为理想化的纯非弹性（purely inelastic）参照，主要用于在本构方程（constitutive equation）中识别触变性；定义1与定义2更具实用性，分别要求达到稳态需异常大的应变（strain），以及静止期间材料松弛时间（relaxation time）的无界增长。定义1可适用于剪切速率控制或应力控制模式，后者涵盖所谓"黏度分叉（viscosity bifurcation）"。作者在多种被判定为触变性的材料上检验了这些判据，其判据依据是材料响应明显超过其黏弹性参照尺度。
AI.result: 所提出的判据在多种材料上得到检验，这些材料因其响应显著超出黏弹性参照尺度而被识别为具有触变性。该框架被刻意设定为现象学的，不依赖特定微观机制，从而使不同材料能在共同的流变学（rheological）语言下描述。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在流变学分类体系（rheological taxonomy）中为触变性确立更明确的位置提供了实用基础，并符合流变学术语通常采用现象学描述的传统。

title: Wilson-loop formulations of the spin polarization and the spin Chern number
summary: In this paper, we derive the spin polarization and the spin Chern number in momentum and real spaces in terms of the Wilson loop in each spin sector. For these derivations, the spin matrix in the subspace of occupied or unoccupied states is generalized by the unitary rotation to prevent the spectral gap from closing. In the presence of a finite spin gap, the spin eigenvectors recompose the eigenstates of the Hamiltonian in two spin sectors. A dimensional reduction leads to the charge polarization in each spin sector in terms of the Wilson loop along the effective Brillouin zone (BZ) in one dimension (1D). A linear combination of the charge polarizations defines the spin polarization, which naturally quantifies the spin Chern number in momentum space. It is also shown that the spin Chern number is directly derived from the local Wilson loops on a discrete 2D BZ. The theoretical treatment is further generalized for real space in a supercell framework, which can deal with ordered and disordered systems in a unified manner. In this framework, the spin Chern number in real space is formulated in terms of the Wilson loop around the BZ boundary. These formulations are used to numerically evaluate topological phases in the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model. Numerical results show an equivalence of the spin Chern number and the ${\mathbb{Z}_2}$ index.

AI.tldr: 本文基于 Wilson loop（威尔逊环），在动量空间与实空间推导自旋极化（spin polarization）与自旋陈数（spin Chern number），并推广至可统一处理有序与无序系统的超胞框架，在 Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang 模型中验证自旋陈数与 Z2 指数的等价性。
AI.motivation: 自旋极化与自旋陈数是刻画拓扑绝缘体等体系拓扑性质的关键量，需要一种能在动量空间与实空间统一表述、且适用于有序与无序系统的推导框架。作者以 Wilson loop 为核心工具，试图给出自旋陈数的严格定义与可计算形式。
AI.method: 通过幺正旋转（unitary rotation）推广占据或非占据态子空间中的自旋矩阵，以避免谱隙（spectral gap）闭合；在有限自旋隙下，自旋本征矢重组哈密顿量本征态为两个自旋扇区（spin sectors）。利用维数约化（dimensional reduction），将各扇区的电荷极化（charge polarization）表示为沿一维有效布里渊区（effective Brillouin zone, BZ）的 Wilson loop，并由电荷极化的线性组合定义自旋极化。进一步将处理推广到超胞（supercell）框架以描述实空间，用 BZ 边界附近的 Wilson loop 表述实空间自旋陈数。
AI.result: 推导表明，自旋极化自然量化了动量空间中的自旋陈数；自旋陈数亦可由离散二维 BZ 上的局域 Wilson loop 直接得到；在实空间超胞框架下，自旋陈数由 BZ 边界周围的 Wilson loop 表述。对 Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang 模型的数值计算显示，自旋陈数与 Z2 指数等价。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以 Wilson loop 为基础，在动量空间与实空间给出自旋极化与自旋陈数的一致表述，并能统一处理有序与无序系统；数值结果支持自旋陈数与 Z2 指数在 BHZ 模型中的等价性。

title: Symmetry Condition and Mechanism for the Anomalous Hall Effect in Odd-Parity Magnets
summary: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in unconventional magnets has attracted considerable attention. A giant AHE has recently been observed in the candidate $p$-wave magnet Gd$_3$(Ru$_{1-δ}$Rh$_δ$)$_4$Al$_{12}$ [Nature 646, 837(2025)], while its theoretical interpretation invokes a spontaneous magnetization to break time-reversal symmetry ($\mathcal{T}$), although the magnetic order itself already breaks $\mathcal{T}$. Consequently, the microscopic origin of the AHE in odd-parity magnets (OPMs) remains an open question. Here we establish the symmetry condition and microscopic mechanism for the AHE in OPMs. Since the OPM order is classified by the spin group whereas the AHE is governed by the magnetic group, the AHE is allowed only when the magnetic point group is ferromagnetic; conversely, it is forbidden whenever the effective time reversal $\mathcal{T}τ$ (with $τ$ a fractional translation), which is essential to the realization of the OPM, is preserved. Microscopically, OPMs generically host a hidden Zeeman field (HZF) rooted in this intrinsic $\mathcal{T}$ breaking, and its interplay with spin-orbit coupling (SOC) generates the AHE without any external field. We demonstrate this picture with models on the square, honeycomb, and kagome lattices. In particular, a square-lattice helimagnet with sublattice-resolved SOC maps exactly onto an anisotropic Rashba--Zeeman model, whose Zeeman term is nothing but the HZF and directly yields the AHE. Our results establish the symmetry condition for the AHE in OPMs and identify the HZF--SOC interplay as a general route to realize it.

AI.tldr: 该工作确立了奇宇称磁体（odd-parity magnets, OPMs）中反常霍尔效应（anomalous Hall effect, AHE）的对称性条件与微观机制：AHE 仅在磁点群为铁磁型时允许，其微观起源为内禀时间反演破缺所导致的隐藏塞曼场（hidden Zeeman field, HZF）与自旋轨道耦合（spin-orbit coupling, SOC）的相互作用。
AI.motivation: 非传统磁体中的 AHE 受到广泛关注，近期在候选 p 波磁体 Gd$_3$(Ru$_{1-\delta}$Rh$_\delta$)$_4$Al$_{12}$ 中观测到巨大 AHE，但其理论解释诉诸自发磁化破缺时间反演，而磁序本身已破缺 $\mathcal{T}$，因此 OPMs 中 AHE 的微观起源仍是未解问题。
AI.method: 从对称性分析出发，区分 OPM 序（由自旋群分类）与 AHE（由磁群支配），并考察有效时间反演 $\mathcal{T}\tau$（$\tau$ 为分数平移）的保持情况；同时在方格、蜂窝与 kagome 格子上构建模型以展示微观图像。
AI.result: AHE 仅在磁点群为铁磁型时被允许，当实现 OPM 所必需的有效时间反演 $\mathcal{T}\tau$ 保持时则被禁止；微观上 OPMs 普遍存在源于内禀 $\mathcal{T}$ 破缺的 HZF，其与 SOC 相互作用在无外场条件下产生 AHE；其中带子格分辨 SOC 的方格螺旋磁体可精确映射为各向异性 Rashba–Zeeman 模型，其 Zeeman 项即 HZF 并直接给出 AHE。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了 OPMs 中 AHE 的对称性条件，并指出 HZF–SOC 相互作用是实现该效应的普适途径。

title: Pressure Evolution of the Superconducting Order Parameter of Kagome Superconductor CsV3Sb5
summary: Kagome superconductors AV3Sb5 (A = K, Rb, Cs) offer an outstanding platform for exploring the interplay among charge-density-wave (CDW) order, superconductivity (SC), and nontrivial topological electronic states. For CsV3Sb5, moderate hydrostatic pressure induces a double-dome superconducting phase diagram while monotonically suppressing the CDW phase, which signals an unconventional coupling between SC and CDW. Nevertheless, the microscopic nature of the pressure-modulated superconducting state and its relationship with CDW order remain poorly understood. Here we employ soft directional point-contact spectroscopy (SDPCS), combined with superconducting resistive measurements, to probe the superconducting order parameter of CsV3Sb5 under hydrostatic compression. Our anisotropic PCAR measurements resolve two distinct s-wave superconducting gaps along the c-axis and a strongly anisotropic gap within the ab plane. Two-band Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk (BTK) fits to the c-axis spectra yield a large gap satisfying 2Delta1/kBTc > 3.52 and a small gap with 2Deltas/kBTc < 3.52. The spectral-weight-averaged coupling ratio 2Deltaavg/kBTc is enhanced in the pressure window between P1 and P2, suggesting that pressure-induced modifications of the low-energy electronic structure may contribute to the evolution of superconductivity. For ab-plane junctions, the superconducting gap anisotropy is gradually suppressed above P1, accompanied by the emergence of a pronounced peak-dip-hump structure suggestive of enhanced coupling between superconducting quasiparticles and a bosonic excitation. These results shed new light on the intricate entanglement between CDW and SC in kagome superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用软定向点接触谱（SDPCS）结合电阻测量，探测静水压（hydrostatic pressure）下CsV3Sb5的超导序参量，发现沿c轴存在两个s波能隙、ab面内存在强各向异性能隙，且谱权平均耦合比在P1–P2压力窗口增强。
AI.motivation: Kagome超导体AV3Sb5是研究电荷密度波（CDW）、超导（SC）与拓扑电子态相互作用的平台；CsV3Sb5在中等静水压下呈现双穹顶超导相图并单调抑制CDW，暗示二者非常规耦合，但其压力调控下超导态的微观本质及与CDW的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用软定向点接触谱（SDPCS）并结合超导电阻测量，在静水压条件下探测CsV3Sb5的超导序参量；对c轴谱进行双带Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk（BTK）拟合，并分析ab面结的各向异性。
AI.result: 各向异性PCAR测量区分出沿c轴的两个s波超导能隙及ab面内的强各向异性能隙；c轴双带BTK拟合给出大能隙满足2Δ1/kBTc > 3.52、小能隙满足2Δs/kBTc < 3.52；谱权平均耦合比2Δavg/kBTc在P1与P2之间的压力窗口内增强；ab面结中能隙各向异性在P1以上逐渐被抑制，并伴随出现峰-谷-峰（peak-dip-hump）结构。
AI.conclusion: 压力诱导的低能电子结构变化可能促成超导性的演化；ab面峰-谷-峰结构暗示超导准粒子与玻色型激发（bosonic excitation）耦合增强。结果揭示了kagome超导中CDW与SC之间复杂的纠缠关系。

title: Universal Boolean Computation in Negatively Coupled Circle Map Lattices
summary:
We investigate the computational capabilities of a one-dimensional lattice of negatively
  coupled circle maps in its traveling wave regime. We interpret propagating waves as information carriers and exploit their interactions to implement Boolean logic. The logical states are encoded by the propagation direction of the traveling waves, while the presence or absence of a wave at a designated output location represents the logical output. Using controlled wave collisions, we demonstrate the realization of NAND and NOR gates along with other basic gates. Since NAND and NOR operations are functionally complete, the results establish that the traveling wave regime of the negatively coupled circle-map lattice supports universal Boolean computation in principle. The demonstrated logical operations remain valid over a finite range of the coupling strength εand map parameter ω, indicating robustness of the computational scheme to parameter variations. Our results therefore demonstrate that computational functionality can emerge from the collective nonlinear dynamics of a coupled map lattice, providing a con- nection between the dynamical properties of traveling wave states and collision based information processing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究负耦合圆映射（circle map）一维格点在行波区（traveling wave regime）的计算能力，将传播波作为信息载体，利用波的碰撞实现布尔逻辑（Boolean logic），并通过实现NAND与NOR等门证明该体系原则上支持通用布尔计算（universal Boolean computation）。
AI.motivation: 探索耦合映射格点（coupled map lattice）的集体非线性动力学能否产生计算功能，并建立行波态的动力学性质与基于碰撞的信息处理之间的联系。目前对负耦合圆映射格点行波区计算能力的研究尚不明确，故作者在行波区中考察其布尔计算潜力。
AI.method: 将传播行的波视为信息载体，利用波之间的相互作用实现布尔逻辑：逻辑态由行波的传播方向编码，逻辑输出由指定输出位置是否存在波表示；通过受控波碰撞（controlled wave collisions）来构建逻辑门。
AI.result: 实现了NAND和NOR门以及其他基本门；由于NAND与NOR在功能上是完备的（functionally complete），因此该行波区原则上支持通用布尔计算。所实现的逻辑操作在耦合强度ε与映射参数ω的有限范围内保持有效，表明计算方案对参数变化具有鲁棒性（robustness）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明计算功能可从耦合映射格点的集体非线性动力学中涌现，从而将行波态的动力学性质与基于碰撞的信息处理建立了联系。

title: Dynamical-state switching controls active microrod navigation in porous media
summary: Adaptive search and travel strategies enable biological swimmers to explore complex environments, but remain difficult to encode in minimal synthetic microswimmers. Here, we unveil multiple dynamical and orientational states of rod-like Janus microswimmers actuated via electric fields: planar active, oriented chiral and persistent rods. We discover a hidden dynamical state after pre-orienting them, which allows us to switch on demand from strong chiral to persistent motion. We harness this phenomenological orientation and chirality switch for exploration in microstructured porous arrays. Here, strong chirality promotes local scanning but drives circular trapping and poor net displacement, whereas the pre-aligned dynamical state enables efficient obstacle sorting, and trap escape. Comparing experiments with simulations of active Brownian particles in the very same experimentally-extracted obstacle geometries, we quantify navigation efficiency via first-passage time statistics, revealing how chirality tuning optimizes the trade-off between local exploration and long-range transport.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示棒状Janus微泳体（Janus microswimmers）在电场驱动下存在多种动力学与取向状态，并利用预取向引发的隐藏态实现手性（chirality）与持续运动的按需切换，从而优化在多孔微结构中的导航效率。
AI.motivation: 生物泳动体（biological swimmers）的自适应搜索与移动策略可探索复杂环境，但难以在极简合成微泳体中实现，因此需要寻找可编码此类策略的合成方案。
AI.method: 通过电场驱动棒状Janus微泳体，识别其平面活性、定向手性与持续运动等状态，并在预取向（pre-orienting）后获得隐藏动力学态；结合微结构多孔阵列（microstructured porous arrays）实验与在相同实验提取障碍几何中进行的活性布朗粒子（active Brownian particles）模拟。
AI.result: 强手性促进局部扫描（local scanning），但导致圆周俘获（circular trapping）与净位移差；预对齐动力学态可实现高效障碍分选（obstacle sorting）与陷阱逃逸（trap escape）。通过首次通过时间（first-passage time）统计量化导航效率，表明手性调优可优化局部探索与长程输运之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 手性可在强手性与持续运动间按需切换，该现象学取向与手性开关为微泳体在复杂微结构中的探索与运输提供了可调机制。

title: Derjaguin-corrected Kelvin equation for finite open slits
summary: We formulate a Derjaguin-corrected Kelvin equation for phase transitions in finite open slits. In such pores, capillary condensation is modified by the finite wall length because the condensed phase is bounded by two terminal menisci pinned at the slit ends. Starting from the macroscopic generalized Kelvin equation, we introduce a scaling approximation which replaces the implicit edge-contact-angle condition by a closed analytic expression while preserving the exact limiting behaviours. We then incorporate mesoscopic wetting-layer contributions into the finite-slit free-energy balance. The single-wall contribution naturally separates into a planar Derjaguin term and a residual finite-length correction controlled by the competition between the wall length $H$ and the parallel correlation length $ξ_\parallel$. The resulting equation reduces to the standard Derjaguin-Kelvin equation for infinitely long slits and to the macroscopic finite-slit Kelvin equation when adsorbed layers are absent. Explicit forms are derived for long-ranged dispersion forces and for short-ranged forces. The theory is tested using classical density functional theory for finite slits with attractive Lennard-Jones walls and hard walls, corresponding respectively to capillary condensation and its drying analogue, capillary evaporation. The Derjaguin-corrected theory substantially improves on the purely macroscopic prediction, capturing both the correct infinite-slit limit and the observed dependence on wall length. For the short-ranged hard-wall system, the agreement with DFT remains nearly quantitative even for very narrow slits.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种经 Derjaguin 修正的 Kelvin 方程，用于描述有限开放狭缝中的毛细凝聚与毛细蒸发，加入介观润湿层贡献并引入标度近似，理论在长程与短程力情形下均与经典密度泛函理论结果吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 有限开放狭缝（finite open slits）中凝聚相被钉扎在狭缝两端的端部弯月面（terminal menisci）所限定，壁面长度有限会改变毛细凝聚行为，而经典宏观理论未能刻画这一有限长度效应，故需建立更精确的描述框架。
AI.method: 从宏观广义 Kelvin 方程（generalized Kelvin equation）出发，引入标度近似（scaling approximation），用闭合解析表达式替代隐式的边缘接触角条件（edge-contact-angle condition），并保持精确极限行为；随后将介观润湿层（mesoscopic wetting-layer）贡献纳入有限狭缝自由能平衡，单壁贡献分离为平面 Derjaguin 项与受壁长 H 和并行关联长度 ξ∥ 竞争控制的残余有限长度修正。分别给出长程色散力与短程力的显式形式，并用经典密度泛函理论（classical density functional theory, DFT）对吸引 Lennard-Jones 壁与硬壁狭缝进行检验。
AI.result: 所得方程在无限长狭缝极限下退化为标准 Derjaguin-Kelvin 方程，在无吸附层时退化为宏观有限狭缝 Kelvin 方程。与 DFT 对比显示，Derjaguin 修正理论显著优于纯宏观预测，既能捕捉正确的无限狭缝极限，又能再现观察到的壁长依赖性；对于短程硬壁体系，即使在极窄狭缝下与 DFT 的结果仍近乎定量一致。
AI.conclusion: 将 Derjaguin 修正、标度近似与介观润湿层自由能贡献相结合，可构建兼顾有限壁长效应与经典极限的统一方程，为有限狭缝中的毛细凝聚及其干燥类比（毛细蒸发）提供定量可靠的预测工具。

title: Angle-Resolved Photoemission as a Sensitive Probe of Surface Quality: Sputtered versus Annealed Cu(001)
summary: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) requires a well-ordered surface, whose quality is routinely judged from low-energy electron diffraction (LEED) and x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). We compare LEED, XPS, and ARPES of a Cu(001) single crystal measured in situ at four stages of surface preparation: as-prepared, after aging for 24 h at 6 K, after Ar$^+$ sputtering, and after annealing. The sputtered and annealed surfaces show nearly identical $(1\times1)$ LEED patterns and Cu 2$p$ core levels, but the sputtered surface yields a momentum-independent ARPES spectrum, and the band dispersion recovers after annealing. We attribute this contrast to how each probe responds to sputtering-induced defects: LEED reflects the average lattice, which remains periodic, whereas ARPES reflects the electronic states, whose crystal momentum is no longer well defined. Our results indicate that a sharp LEED pattern and clean core-level spectra do not guarantee a surface suitable for ARPES.

AI.tldr: 该文对比了Cu(001)单晶在四种表面制备阶段下的LEED、XPS与ARPES结果，发现溅射后表面虽保持清晰(1×1) LEED图样与干净Cu 2p芯能级谱，却丧失动量依赖的能带色散，说明常规表面表征无法保证样品适用于ARPES。
AI.motivation: ARPES（角分辨光电子能谱，angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy）对表面有序度要求严格，而实践中通常以LEED（低能电子衍射，low-energy electron diffraction）和XPS（X射线光电子能谱，x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy）判断表面质量。该研究旨在检验这些常规判据是否足以保证表面适用于ARPES。
AI.method: 对Cu(001)单晶在四种制备阶段（as-prepared、6 K下老化24 h、Ar+溅射、退火）进行原位LEED、XPS与ARPES测量，并比较各阶段结果差异。
AI.result: 溅射表面与退火表面呈现几乎相同的(1×1) LEED图样和Cu 2p芯能级，但溅射表面的ARPES谱与动量无关；经退火后能带色散（band dispersion）恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该对比归因于各探测手段对溅射缺陷响应机制不同：LEED反映仍保持周期性的平均晶格，而ARPES反映电子态，其晶体动量（crystal momentum）已不再良好定义。结果表明，锐利LEED图样与干净芯能级谱并不能保证表面适用于ARPES。

title: Thermal softening of the yield stress in glasses with different stability
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to J. Phys. A: Mathematical and Theoretical to its Focus Collection "Driven Amorphous Matter: Deformation, Activity, Aging and Memory"
summary: The yielding of amorphous solids has been extensively studied in the athermal limit, but the influence of thermal fluctuations is much less understood, in particular for glasses of different stability. Using molecular dynamics simulations of a model glass where the swap Monte Carlo algorithm can be employed, we study the yield stress at finite temperature and shear rate, both in steady flow and at shear start-up, over a broad range of glass stability. Thermal fluctuations soften both the dynamic yield stress in steady state and the start-up yield stress. In all cases, the temperature dependence is compatible with the $T^{2/3}$ law expected for thermally activated yielding near a saddle-node instability, with no systematic dependence of the exponent on stability or shear rate. Extrapolations to zero temperature recover the athermal yield stresses. The amplitude of the softening at start-up, by contrast, depends strongly on stability: highly stable glasses are much less sensitive to temperature than poorly annealed ones. A description of yielding at finite temperature must therefore account explicitly for the stability of the glass.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用可施加交换蒙特卡洛（swap Monte Carlo）算法的模型玻璃进行分子动力学模拟，考察有限温度与剪切速率下的屈服行为，覆盖广泛的玻璃稳定性范围。结果显示热涨落会软化稳态与启动剪切屈服应力，其温度依赖符合鞍结失稳附近热激活屈服预期的 \(T^{2/3}\) 规律，且启动阶段的软化幅度强烈依赖玻璃稳定性。
AI.motivation: 非晶固体的屈服（yielding）研究多局限于无热（athermal）极限，热涨落的影响尚不清楚，尤其对具有不同稳定性的玻璃缺乏系统认识。该工作旨在填补有限温度下玻璃稳定性对屈服应力影响这一空白。
AI.method: 采用可应用交换蒙特卡洛（swap Monte Carlo）算法的模型玻璃，进行分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，在有限温度与剪切速率下研究稳态流动（steady flow）与剪切启动（shear start-up）两种情形的屈服应力，并跨越广泛的玻璃稳定性范围。
AI.result: 热涨落同时软化稳态动态屈服应力与启动屈服应力。所有情形下温度依赖均与鞍结失稳（saddle-node instability）附近热激活屈服所预期的 \(T^{2/3}\) 规律相符，且该指数不随稳定性或剪切速率呈现系统性变化；外推至零温可恢复无热屈服应力。启动阶段的软化幅度则强烈依赖稳定性，高稳定性玻璃对温度的敏感性远低于退火不足的玻璃。
AI.conclusion: 有限温度下的屈服描述必须显式考虑玻璃的稳定性，因为启动阶段软化的幅度对稳定性高度敏感，而 \(T^{2/3}\) 标度则不依赖于稳定性与剪切速率。

title: Decoupling Trap States in Amorphous Oxide Semiconductor Transistor Using a Conductive-Semiconducting-Conductive MOS Structure
summary: We propose a novel amorphous oxide semiconductor (AOS)-based conductive-semiconducting-conductive (CSC) MOS test structure to effectively sense, discriminate, and analyze distinct trap-induced conductance losses in AOS transistors. In conventional test structures, non-ideal metal-AOS contacts convolute the conductance loss generated by various trap states. The CSC architecture mitigates these contact-related artifacts, enabling the decoupling of interface states and shallow states. Furthermore, the contributions from leakage, series resistance, and device-geometry effects are identified and calibrated. Our results yield bias-resolved trap profiles and reveal three distinct regimes: (1) In the depletion region, interface states dominate the conductance loss. These states exhibit sub-microsecond time constants and their density increases slightly with deeper depletion, which is associated with donor-like states. (2) From weak to moderate accumulation, shallow states become the primary contributor, displaying a Gaussian-like volumetric density-of-states distribution with response times spanning from microseconds to nanoseconds. (3) In the strong accumulation regime, interface states regain dominance with an increased state quantity, while their time constants remain invariant. These bias-resolved profiles clarify how different trap populations impact AOS transistors under distinct operating conditions, providing intuitive metrics for understanding reliability degradation. Consequently, the CSC structure offers a simple, scalable, and robust platform for trap characterization in AOS transistors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种非晶氧化物半导体（AOS）基的导电-半导体-导电（CSC）MOS 测试结构，用于解耦并表征 AOS 晶体管中不同陷阱引起的电导损失，并给出去偏压分辨的陷阱分布与三种工作区规律。
AI.motivation: 传统测试结构中非理想的金属-AOS 接触（contact）会与各类陷阱态（trap states）产生的电导损失相互卷积，难以区分界面态与浅态等不同陷阱来源，故需一种可抑制接触伪影的结构以实现有效解耦。
AI.method: 设计 CSC（conductive-semiconducting-conductive）MOS 测试结构以缓解接触相关伪影；在此基础上解耦界面态（interface states）与浅态（shallow states），并识别与校准漏电（leakage）、串联电阻（series resistance）及器件几何效应（device-geometry effects）的贡献。
AI.result: 获得偏压分辨（bias-resolved）的陷阱分布，并揭示三个区制：耗尽区由界面态主导，其时间常数达亚微秒量级且密度随耗尽加深略增（与施主型态相关）；弱至中等积累区由浅态主导，呈类高斯体密度分布，响应时间从微秒至纳秒；强积累区界面态重新主导且态数量增加，但时间常数保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 该偏压分辨分布阐明了不同陷阱群体在各类工作条件下对 AOS 晶体管的影响，为理解可靠性退化（reliability degradation）提供直观指标；CSC 结构为 AOS 晶体管陷阱表征提供简单、可扩展且稳健的平台。

title: Thermally Enhanced Pseudo-Goldstone Spin Gap in the Isotropic Helimagnet ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$
summary: In magnetically ordered systems, the spin gap in the magnon spectrum is normally expected to decrease on warming and close at the transition out of the long-range order. The presence of a pseudo-Goldstone gap is commonly associated with nonlinear terms in spin-wave theory. However, its precise origin and detailed properties can vary and remain under debate. Here we show by means of inelastic neutron scattering that the pseudo-Goldstone gap in the Heisenberg helimagnet ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$ exhibits an atypical, nonmonotonic temperature dependence: the gap increases over much of the ordered phase before closing near $T_\mathrm{N}$. These results align with recent spin-dynamic simulations based on an effective quartic potential in an isotropic system~[Phys. Rev. B \textbf{113}, L220411 (2026)]. As the pseudo-Goldstone spin gap in ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$ is dominated by quantum effects at subkelvin temperatures, its characteristic growth on warming is caused by thermal fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 在螺旋磁体（helimagnet）ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$中，非弹性中子散射（inelastic neutron scattering）测量显示赝戈德斯通隙（pseudo-Goldstone gap）随升温先增大、直至 $T_\mathrm{N}$ 附近才闭合，呈非单调温度依赖，与基于各向同性体系有效四次势（quartic potential）的自旋动力学模拟一致。
AI.motivation: 在磁有序体系中，磁振子谱（magnon spectrum）中的自旋隙通常预期随升温而减小，并在长程有序转变处闭合；赝戈德斯通隙常被归因于自旋波理论（spin-wave theory）中的非线性项，但其确切起源与性质仍有争议，故需实验厘清。
AI.method: 采用非弹性中子散射（inelastic neutron scattering）测量海森堡螺旋磁体（Heisenberg helimagnet）ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$中的赝戈德斯通隙随温度的演化，并与近期基于各向同性体系中有效四次势（quartic potential）的自旋动力学模拟结果进行对比。
AI.result: ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$的赝戈德斯通隙表现出非典型、非单调（nonmonotonic）的温度依赖：在有序相的大部分温区中隙随升温而增大，仅在 $T_\mathrm{N}$ 附近闭合；该结果与近期自旋动力学模拟相符。
AI.conclusion: 由于 ZnCr$_2$Se$_4$的赝戈德斯通自旋隙在亚开尔文（subkelvin）温度下由量子效应主导，其升温时隙增大的特征源自热涨落（thermal fluctuations）。

title: Photon echo from Maki-Thompson interference in a fluctuating s-wave superconductor
summary: We study theoretically the nonlinear optical response of a fluctuating s-wave superconductor driven by two successive terahertz pulses. We show that the response exhibits a photon echo signal that arises from the quantum interference between the time-reversed electron and hole trajectories in the Maki-Thompson process. By contrast, the transport of the fluctuating Cooper pairs responsible for the Aslamazov-Larkin conductivity does not generate an echo. The photon echo signal can be readily measured using terahertz two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy, highlighting its potential to distinguish different fluctuation conductivity mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本论文理论研究了由两个连续太赫兹脉冲驱动的涨落 s 波超导体的非线性光学响应，发现其中存在源于 Maki-Thompson 过程中时间反演电子-空穴轨迹量子干涉的光子回波信号。
AI.motivation: 涨落超导体中存在多种涨落电导机制（如 Maki-Thompson 与 Aslamazov-Larkin 过程），亟需一种可区分这些机制的光谱学判据。太赫兹二维相干光谱（terahertz two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy）具备探测此类非线性响应的潜力，故有必要从理论上厘清各机制的信号特征。
AI.method: 采用理论方法研究涨落 s 波超导体在双脉冲太赫兹驱动下的非线性光学响应，并分别分析 Maki-Thompson 过程与 Aslamazov-Larkin 电导所对应的贡献。
AI.result: 响应中出现光子回波（photon echo）信号，其来源于 Maki-Thompson 过程中时间反演（time-reversed）电子与空穴轨迹之间的量子干涉；相比之下，负责 Aslamazov-Larkin 电导的涨落库珀对（fluctuating Cooper pairs）输运不产生回波。
AI.conclusion: 该光子回波信号可通过太赫兹二维相干光谱便捷测量，说明该手段具有区分不同涨落电导机制的潜力。

title: Modelling the dynamics of the martensitic transformation in Ni$_2$MnGa with machine-learning force-fields
summary: The martensitic transformations in stoichiometric Ni$_2$MnGa and related Heusler alloys are governed by a delicate interplay between electronic structure, magnetism, and lattice dynamics. While density functional theory (DFT) has successfully mapped the energy landscape of modulated martensites, it remains computationally prohibitive for capturing finite-temperature dynamics across relevant length and time scales. Here, we bridge this gap by constructing DFT-trained machine-learning force-fields (ML-FF) interpolated from ab initio molecular dynamics. We demonstrate that ML-FF trained on DFT data can reproduce key features of Ni$_2$MnGa, including the soft TA$_2$ phonon and a preference for nanotwinned martensites. Using classical molecular dynamics simulations, we explore the impact of adaptive nanotwinning on the austenite-martensite transition, which facilitates the dynamics of both, forward and backward transformation. We demonstrate, that the negative twin boundary energy along the entire transformations path predicted by DFT for $T=0$, supports the formation of ordered modulated martensites at finite temperatures. Our results pave the way for large-scale simulations of magnetic shape memory alloys with near-DFT accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过构建基于密度泛函理论（density functional theory, DFT）训练的机器学习力场（machine-learning force-fields, ML-FF），在近DFT精度下实现了对Ni$_2$MnGa马氏体相变的大尺度有限温度分子动力学模拟，揭示了自适应纳米孪晶对正反向相变的促进作用以及负孪晶界能对有序调制马氏体形成的支撑作用。
AI.motivation: Ni$_2$MnGa及相关Heusler合金的马氏体相变（martensitic transformations）受电子结构、磁性与晶格动力学之间微妙相互作用的支配。DFT虽能刻画调制马氏体的能量景观，但在捕捉相关长度与时间尺度上的有限温度动力学方面计算代价过高，亟需跨越该计算瓶颈的方法。
AI.method: 从从头算分子动力学（ab initio molecular dynamics）出发，构建经DFT数据训练的机器学习力场（ML-FF）作为插值模型，并利用经典分子动力学（classical molecular dynamics）模拟研究自适应纳米孪晶（adaptive nanotwinning）对奥氏体-马氏体相变（austenite-martensite transition）的影响。
AI.result: 基于DFT数据训练的ML-FF能够重现Ni$_2$MnGa的关键特征，包括软TA$_2$声子（soft TA$_2$ phonon）以及对纳米孪晶马氏体的偏好。模拟显示自适应纳米孪晶可促进正向与反向相变的动力学过程；DFT在$T=0$下预测的沿整个相变路径的负孪晶界能（negative twin boundary energy）支撑了有限温度下有序调制马氏体的形成。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为大尺度、近DFT精度的磁性形状记忆合金（magnetic shape memory alloys）模拟开辟了路径。

title: Deterministic positioning accuracy of B centers in hBN by electron irradiation
summary: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) is a promising material platform for quantum technologies, enabling both the realization of nanophotonic devices and the hosting of point defects that act as high-quality single-photon emitters (SPEs). Among these defects, B centers, which reproducibly emit at 436 nm, can be generated individually at predefined positions using electron beam irradiation, a crucial capability for top-down quantum photonics. Yet, the spatial accuracy of emitter creation strongly conditions the potential applications. Here, we generate arrays of individual B centers in a scanning electron microscope (SEM) with in-situ cathodoluminescence (CL) monitoring. We characterize the sources of random deviations from the target positions to identify the limitations to their deterministic positioning. In particular, we measure the distance between the electron beam and the emitter at the moment the emitter is created based on CL mapping. This approach provides a direct estimation of the spatial extent of the beam-emitter interaction. We find this contribution to be the main constraint to the emitter fabrication accuracy, yielding a standard deviation of 27 nm. Additional contributions, primarily from the finite density of UV-emitting carbon dimer precursors, increase the overall positional standard deviation to 40 nm. Our results highlight the possible improvements to the B center creation technique to reach sub-10 nm accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究在扫描电子显微镜（SEM）中结合原位阴极发光（CL）监测，制备六方氮化硼（hBN）中单个B色心阵列，定量分析其随机定位偏差来源，测得束-发射体相互作用导致27 nm标准差，碳二聚体前驱体密度使总体标准差增至40 nm，并指出可达亚10 nm精度的改进方向。
AI.motivation: hBN是量子技术（quantum technologies）的有前景材料平台，既能实现纳米光子器件，又能承载作为高质量单光子发射体（SPE）的点缺陷。其中B色心（B centers）可在预定位置逐一生成，对自上而下量子光子学（top-down quantum photonics）至关重要，但发射体生成的空间精度限制了其应用潜力，故需明确定位偏差的来源与限制因素。
AI.method: 采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）配合原位阴极发光（CL）监测，在hBN中生成单个B色心阵列；通过CL成像（CL mapping）测量发射体生成瞬间电子束与发射体之间的距离，以直接估计束-发射体相互作用的空间范围，并刻画偏离目标位置的各随机偏差来源。
AI.result: 束-发射体相互作用（beam-emitter interaction）的空间范围是发射体制备精度的主要约束，其标准差为27 nm；来自紫外发射碳二聚体前驱体（carbon dimer precursors）有限密度的附加贡献使总体定位标准差增至40 nm。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了B色心生成技术（B center creation technique）的可改进方向，即有望将定位精度提升至亚10 nm（sub-10 nm）水平。

title: Molecule-intercalated van der Waals Josephson junctions uncover complex multiband superconductivity
summary: Intercalation of molecular species provides a route to tailor the electronic structure in van der Waals superconductors, yet intercalated compounds have rarely been integrated into phase-sensitive quantum devices. Here, we realize hybrid molecular Josephson junctions based on TaS2/NbSe2 heterostructures. Selective intercalation of the TaS2 electrode induces monolayer-like Ising superconductivity, while the junctions exhibit asymmetric Fraunhofer interference, field-induced and spontaneous Josephson diode effects. The zero-field diode disappears upon reversing the electrode stacking and re-emerges after intercalating the lower NbSe2 electrode. These findings indicate that the hybrid superconducting electrode hosts unconventional superconductivity underlying the nonreciprocal transport, while molecular intercalation acts as a tuning knob for its internal phase structure. This behavior is consistent with a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking multiband superconducting state characterized by a nontrivial relative phase between superconducting condensates. Our results establish hybrid molecular Josephson junctions as a quantum-device platform for phase-sensitive investigation and integration of molecularly engineered superconductors, opening opportunities to uncover and engineer unconventional superconducting phases.

AI.tldr: 该工作实现了基于 TaS2/NbSe2 异质结构的杂化分子约瑟夫森结（hybrid molecular Josephson junction），通过分子插层（intercalation）诱导单层类 Ising 超导电性，并观测到非对称 Fraunhofer 干涉、场诱导及自发约瑟夫森二极管效应（Josephson diode effect），指示出时间反演对称破缺（time-reversal-symmetry-breaking）的多带超导态。
AI.motivation: 分子插层（intercalation）虽可用于调控范德瓦尔斯超导体（van der Waals superconductor）的电子结构，但插层化合物很少被集成到相敏量子器件（phase-sensitive quantum device）中。该研究旨在将分子插层超导体引入相敏约瑟夫森器件，以探测其内部相位结构。
AI.method: 构建基于 TaS2/NbSe2 异质结构的杂化分子约瑟夫森结，对 TaS2 电极进行选择性插层以诱导单层类 Ising 超导电性（Ising superconductivity），并通过反转电极堆叠顺序及对下层 NbSe2 电极插层来对比测量二极管效应。
AI.result: 器件表现出非对称 Fraunhofer 干涉（asymmetric Fraunhofer interference）、场诱导与自发约瑟夫森二极管效应（Josephson diode effect）；零场二极管效应在反转电极堆叠后消失，并在对下层 NbSe2 电极插层后重新出现。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明杂化超导电极承载着导致非互易输运（nonreciprocal transport）的非常规超导电性，分子插层可作为调控其内部相位结构的旋钮；该行为与具有非平庸相对相位的、时间反演对称破缺的多带超导态一致。杂化分子约瑟夫森结由此成为分子工程超导体相敏研究与集成的量子器件平台。

title: Emergence of Nonlocal Hydrodynamics in Many-Body Radiative Heat Transport
