summary: We develop a nonlocal hydrodynamic theory of radiative heat transport in many-body systems by coarse graining their microscopic electrodynamic interactions. Long-range radiative exchange naturally generates a spatially nonlocal constitutive relation in which the heat current at a given position depends on temperature gradients over an extended region, while energy conservation retains its local conservative form. Fourier transport emerges as a controlled long-wavelength limit when the interaction kernel has a finite second spatial moment. When this moment fails to converge, spatial nonlocality survives coarse graining and gives rise to non-Fourier transport. The resulting framework establishes a systematic bridge between discrete many-body fluctuational electrodynamics and a continuous description of radiative heat transport.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过粗粒化多体微观电动力学相互作用，建立了一个描述辐射热输运的非局域流体力学理论，揭示长程辐射交换导致空间非局域本构关系，并区分了傅里叶输运与非傅里叶输运的判据。
AI.motivation: 多体系统中的辐射热输运通常由离散的涨落电动力学（fluctuational electrodynamics）描述，缺乏与连续介质理论之间的系统联系，该文旨在弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 对微观电动力学相互作用进行粗粒化（coarse graining），构建非局域流体力学理论；引入具有有限二阶空间矩的相互作用核（interaction kernel）刻画空间非局域本构关系，同时保持能量守恒的局域形式。
AI.result: 长程辐射交换产生空间非局域（spatially nonlocal）本构关系，热流依赖于扩展区域内的温度梯度；当相互作用核具有有限二阶空间矩时，傅里叶输运（Fourier transport）作为受控长波极限出现；当该矩不收敛时，空间非局域性在粗粒化后留存，导致非傅里叶输运（non-Fourier transport）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在离散多体涨落电动力学与辐射热输运的连续描述之间建立了系统性的桥梁。

title: Scalable Quantum Monte Carlo for Shannon-Rényi Entropy: An Experiment-visitable Probe of Quantum Phases and Criticality
summary: The Shannon-Rényi (SR) entropy characterizes the probability distribution of many-body wave functions in a chosen basis and is directly accessible from single-shot measurement snapshots in cold-atom experiments, yet its theoretical evaluation in interacting systems carries exponential cost. Here we construct a field-theoretic spacetime manifold for the SR entropy in which $q$ replicas are glued at the imaginary-time boundaries, recasting it as a ratio of generalized partition functions amenable to large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulation. On this basis we develop a reweight-annealing framework with two complementary strategies: a virtual-parameter scheme interpolating between unglued and fully glued limits via binomial-weighted partial gluing, and a real-parameter scheme using a physical coupling constant as the annealing variable within stochastic series expansion. Both reduce the computational cost from exponential to polynomial. Most importantly, we establish for the first time a finite-size scaling theory for the SR entropy near a quantum critical point, $S_q=a(g)L^2+S_q^0\left((g-g_c)L^{1/ν}\right)$; data collapse of its first derivative yields the correlation-length exponent $ν$ for both the O(3) and Ising universality classes, realized in the spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ columnar dimerized Heisenberg model and the bilayer Heisenberg-Ising model. The same simulations extract the Goldstone-mode count $N_G=2$ and the $Z_2$ ground-state degeneracy $\ln 2$ from subleading terms. These results elevate the SR entropy to a standalone, order-parameter-free diagnostic of quantum criticality with the same scaling status as the entanglement entropy, and close the loop between theory and quantum simulation by enabling quantitative benchmarking of experimental snapshots from state-of-the-art quantum simulators.

AI.tldr: 该工作为 Shannon-Rényi（SR）熵构建场论时空流形（spacetime manifold），将其重写为广义配分函数之比并借助量子蒙特卡洛（quantum Monte Carlo）实现多项式代价计算，同时首次建立量子临界点附近的有限尺度标度理论（finite-size scaling theory）。
AI.motivation: SR 熵可刻画选定基底下多体波函数的概率分布，并可直接由冷原子（cold-atom）实验的单次测量快照获取；但相互作用的系统中其理论计算存在指数级代价。因此需要发展可扩展到大规模数值模拟的高效计算方法与相应的标度理论。
AI.method: 构建 SR 熵的场论时空流形：在虚时边界处黏合 q 个副本（replica），把 SR 熵改写为广义配分函数之比以适配大规模量子蒙特卡洛；在此基础上提出重加权退火（reweight-annealing）框架，含两种策略——以二项式加权部分黏合在未黏合与完全黏合极限间插值的虚拟参数方案，以及随机级数展开（stochastic series expansion）中以物理耦合常数为退火变量的实参数方案。
AI.result: 两种方案将计算代价从指数级降至多项式级；首次建立量子临界点附近 SR 熵的有限尺度标度形式 S_q=a(g)L^2+S_q^0((g-g_c)L^{1/ν})，其一次导数的数据坍缩（data collapse）给出 O(3) 与 Ising 普适类（universality class）的关联长度指数 ν，分别在半整数……在 spin-1/2 柱状二聚化 Heisenberg 模型与双层 Heisenberg-Ising 模型中实现；同一模拟还从次领头项提取 Goldstone 模式数 N_G=2 与 Z_2 基态简并度 ln 2。
AI.conclusion: 结果将 SR 熵提升为一种无需序参量（order-parameter-free）的量子临界性诊断量，其标度地位与纠缠熵（entanglement entropy）相当；并通过支持对先进量子模拟器实验快照的定量基准测试，闭合了理论与量子模拟之间的回路。

title: Superconductivity from altermagnetic fluctuations: the crucial role of sublattice polarization
summary: Unconventional superconductivity in correlated systems often appears in the vicinity of a magnetically ordered state. This situation is also relevant for altermagnets, characterized by a nonrelativistic spin-split electronic structure in the presence of Néel order. Many proposed altermagnetic candidates, however, never cross the magnetic instability. We study superconductivity arising from altermagnetic fluctuations in such systems and show that the sublattice polarization (SLP) of the normal-state bands plays a pivotal role in determining the superconducting state. SLP, an inherent property of altermagnetic band structures that persists even without magnetic order, prevents Cooper pairs from forming between different sublattices. This suppresses pairing mediated by the nearest-neighbor antiferromagnetic exchange, which favors spin-singlet superconductivity, and leaves longer-range same-sublattice bonds dominant. When the next-nearest-neighbor exchange is ferromagnetic, as expected for frustration-free Néel order, this results in spin-triplet superconductivity. This mechanism is fundamentally different from that in altermagnets with long-range Néel order, where the spin-split Fermi surfaces favor equal-spin pairing. Finally, when longer-range interactions in the disordered phase instead favor singlet pairing, SLP leads to singlet states with characteristic properties distinct from nearest-neighbor pairing states.

AI.tldr: 该文研究在未越过磁不稳定性（magnetic instability）的交替磁体（altermagnet）候选体系中，由交替磁涨落（altermagnetic fluctuations）所诱导的超导电性（superconductivity），指出正常态能带的亚晶格极化（sublattice polarization, SLP）是决定超导配对态的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 非常规超导（unconventional superconductivity）常出现在磁有序态附近，交替磁体在具备奈尔序（Néel order）时具有非相对论性自旋劈裂电子结构，但许多候选材料并未真正跨越磁不稳定性，因此需要理解此类体系中超导如何由交替磁涨落产生。
AI.method: 通过研究交替磁涨落诱导的超导电性，分析正常态能带的亚晶格极化（SLP）对配对通道的约束作用，比较最近邻反铁磁交换、次近邻铁磁交换以及更长程相互作用下的配对结果。
AI.result: SLP作为交替磁能带的固有属性、即使在无磁有序时仍存在，会阻止不同亚晶格之间形成库珀对（Cooper pairs）；这抑制了由最近邻反铁磁交换主导的自旋单重态（spin-singlet）配对，使同亚晶格的长程键占优。当次近邻交换为铁磁（符合无阻挫奈尔序的预期）时，产生自旋三重态（spin-triplet）超导；该机制与具有长程奈尔序的交替磁体不同，后者依赖自旋劈裂费米面促进等自旋配对。若无序相中的长程相互作用偏好单重态配对，则SLP导致具有区别于最近邻配对态特征的单重态。
AI.conclusion: 亚晶格极化（SLP）在无长程磁序的交替磁涨落体系中起决定性作用，其通过限制跨亚晶格配对，可导致自旋三重态或特征独特的单重态超导，为理解磁不稳定性附近的非常规超导提供不同于长程奈尔序交替磁体的机制。

title: Optically driven ultrafast lattice contraction in a topological crystalline insulator
summary: The ability to dynamically control topological order remains a central challenge in the exploration of quantum materials. Here, we investigate the lattice and electronic response of the topological crystalline insulator (TCI) Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$Se to ultrafast optical excitation using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (tr-ARPES) in combination with X-ray diffraction (XRD) and first-principles calculations. Static XRD measurements establish the lattice constant as the key control parameter for the topological transition, with a critical value $a_\mathrm{c}=6.073$ Åseparating the normal-insulator and topological phases. Despite generating electronic temperatures far above the topological-to-normal transition temperature $T_\mathrm{c}$, optical excitation in the TCI phase does not induce a phase transition. Instead, it drives an ultrafast lattice contraction of $Δa \approx -0.45$ pm within less than 1 ps that counteracts thermal expansion and prevents the system from reaching $a_\mathrm{c}$. The optical excitation therefore pushes the system deeper into the topological phase, providing a direct explanation for the absence of an optically driven transition. Total-energy calculations reveal that this behavior originates from the band inversion in the topological regime, which reverses the character of the photoinduced charge transfer and transiently strengthens atomic bonding. These findings identify band inversion as a mechanism that fundamentally alters the nonequilibrium lattice response, with general implications for ultrafast optical control of topological materials.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用时间与角度分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES）、X射线衍射（XRD）及第一性原理计算，揭示拓扑晶体绝缘体（TCI）Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$Se在超快光激发下不发生拓扑相变，反而因能带反转引发的晶格收缩而更深地进入拓扑相。
AI.motivation: 动态调控拓扑有序（topological order）是量子材料研究的核心挑战之一，而超快光激发是否以及如何驱动拓扑相变尚不清楚。该工作旨在探究TCI Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$Se对超快光激发的晶格与电子响应。
AI.method: 采用时间与角度分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES）结合X射线衍射（XRD）与第一性原理计算，系统研究Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$Se的晶格与电子响应。静态XRD用于确定拓扑转变的关键控制参数，总能量计算用于揭示光诱导晶格行为的微观起源。
AI.result: 静态XRD确定晶格常数是关键控制参数，临界值$a_\mathrm{c}=6.073$ Å分隔正常绝缘体相与拓扑相。尽管光激发产生远高于相变温度$T_\mathrm{c}$的电子温度，TCI相中并未发生相变，而是出现小于1 ps内约$Δa \approx -0.45$ pm的超快晶格收缩，抵消热膨胀并使系统无法达到$a_\mathrm{c}$。总能量计算表明，该行为源于拓扑区内的能带反转（band inversion），其反转了光诱导电荷转移的特性并瞬时增强原子键合。
AI.conclusion: 能带反转是一种从根本上改变非平衡晶格响应的机制，使光激发将系统进一步推入拓扑相，从而直接解释了光驱动相变缺失的原因。该机制对拓扑材料的超快光学调控具有普遍意义。

title: Theoretical Investigation of Oxygen-Vacancy Diffusion in SrTiO$_3$ using Neural Network Potentials
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. to be submitted in The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
summary: Oxygen-vacancy formation and diffusion play important roles in determining the electronic and atomic transport properties of SrTiO$_3$ (STO). Accurate analysis of such point defects requires sufficiently large-scale and long-time molecular dynamics (MD) simulations; however, direct investigations of oxygen-vacancy dynamics using {\it ab initio} MD (AIMD) based on density functional theory (DFT) are limited to relatively small systems and short time scales because of their high computational cost. In this study, we develop a neural network potential (NNP) for pristine and oxygen-deficient STO using a reference dataset generated from AIMD simulations. The trained NNP model accurately reproduces the DFT reference energies, atomic forces, and virials for both pristine STO and STO containing an oxygen vacancy. The NNP also reproduces the supercell-size dependence of the total energies and oxygen-vacancy formation energies, including the formation energy extrapolated to the dilute limit. Large-scale and long-time MD simulations using the NNP (NNP-MD) are then performed to investigate oxygen-vacancy diffusion. The resulting oxygen-vacancy diffusion coefficients show substantially better agreement with experimental data than those obtained from conventional classical MD simulations. An Arrhenius analysis yields an oxygen-vacancy migration enthalpy of 0.64 eV, in close agreement with the experimental value of 0.67 eV. These results demonstrate that NNPs trained on first-principles data provide an accurate and computationally efficient framework for investigating defect formation and long-time vacancy transport in perovskite oxides.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于第一性原理分子动力学（AIMD）数据训练神经网络势（NNP），用于描述纯净及缺氧 SrTiO₃（STO），并以大规模、长时长的 NNP-MD 模拟准确刻画氧空位扩散行为。
AI.motivation: 氧空位的形成与扩散决定 SrTiO₃ 的电子与原子输运性质，但基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的从头算分子动力学（AIMD）受计算成本限制，仅能处理较小体系与较短时间尺度，难以直接研究氧空位动力学。
AI.method: 利用 AIMD 模拟生成参考数据集，训练适用于纯净与缺氧 STO 的神经网络势（NNP）；验证其对 DFT 参考能量、原子力、维里（virial）及超胞尺寸依赖性的再现能力，并用该 NNP 进行大规模、长时长分子动力学（NNP-MD）模拟以研究氧空位扩散。
AI.result: 训练后的 NNP 准确再现了纯净与含氧空位 STO 的 DFT 参考能量、原子力与维里，也再现了总能量和氧空位形成能的超胞尺寸依赖性（含外推至稀释极限的形成能）。NNP-MD 得到的氧空位扩散系数与实验数据的一致性显著优于传统经典 MD；Arrhenius 分析给出氧空位迁移焓为 0.64 eV，与实验值 0.67 eV 接近。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于第一性原理数据训练的 NNP 为研究钙钛矿氧化物（perovskite oxides）中的缺陷形成与长时程空位输运提供了兼具准确性与计算效率的框架。

title: Bogoliubov excitations of a Bose-Einstein condensate in the presence of the non-Hermitian skin effect
summary: The non-Hermitian skin effect is one of the most remarkable topological features of non-conservative physics. It causes a macroscopic accumulation of states at the boundaries of a confined system, opening new ways for controlling and directing waves in non-Hermitian settings. This effect has recently been observed in experiments with Bose-Einstein condensates of exciton polaritons and ultracold bosonic quantum gases. The underlying physics is captured by a mean-field Hamiltonian with a trapping potential and an imaginary gauge field. While prior work has examined the effect of the imaginary gauge field term on the condensate itself, its effect on the collective excitations on top of the condensate remained unexplored. Here, we develop a new theory for the Bogoliubov excitations in a non-Hermitian framework and systematically study their spectrum across different interaction regimes. By analysing the position expectation values, we find that while the repulsive interactions oppose the localisation of the condensate due to the skin effect, the excitations remain strongly affected by the imaginary gauge field. As a consequence, in the presence of harmonic confinement, we predict a strong shift in the dipole oscillation frequency, which can be observed in experiments. This is in contrast to Hermitian systems, where this frequency is fixed by the trap dimensions. Furthermore, we develop a consistent second-quantised field theory of the collective excitations in this non-Hermitian system. Strikingly, we find that a second-quantised treatment removes the shift of the dipole oscillation frequency entirely. This intriguing discrepancy between the two theoretical approaches to the treatment of elementary excitations in a non-Hermitian system can be resolved in experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非厄米（non-Hermitian）框架下玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensate, BEC）元激发（Bogoliubov excitations）的新理论，系统研究不同相互作用区间下的激发谱。发现排斥相互作用抑制凝聚体的趋肤（skin effect）局域化，但激发仍强烈受虚规范场（imaginary gauge field）影响，并预测偶极振荡频率（dipole oscillation frequency）的显著移动。
AI.motivation: 非厄米趋肤效应（non-Hermitian skin effect）已在激子极化激元（exciton polaritons）与超冷玻色量子气体的BEC实验中被观测到，其物理可由含束缚势（trapping potential）与虚规范场的平均场哈密顿量描述。然而既有工作仅关注虚规范场对凝聚体本身的影响，其对凝聚体之上集体激发（collective excitations）的作用尚未被探索。
AI.method: 建立非厄米框架下Bogoliubov激发的新理论，系统计算不同相互作用区间下的激发谱，并通过分析位置期望值考察局域化行为；进一步构建该非厄米系统中集体激发的自洽二次量子化场论（second-quantised field theory）。
AI.result: 排斥相互作用抵抗趋肤效应导致的凝聚体局域化，但激发仍强烈受虚规范场影响。在谐振束缚（harmonic confinement）下，预测偶极振荡频率出现可在实验中观测的显著移动，而厄米（Hermitian）系统中该频率由陷阱尺度固定。引入二次量子化处理后，该偶极振荡频率移动被完全消除。
AI.conclusion: 平均场与二次量子化两种理论方法对非厄米系统元激发的处理存在有趣分歧，该分歧可通过实验加以检验与解决。

title: Interlayer Registry Controls Polar Topology in Twisted Bilayer h-BN
summary: Twisting van der Waals bilayers creates a moir'e stacking field with periodically varying local interlayer registry, enabling spatially patterned polarization. However, a systematic understanding of how this registry-controlled polar topology evolves with twist angle, temperature, and mechanical strain is still lacking. Here, using first-principles-trained deep-potential molecular dynamics simulations, we show that spatially varying interlayer registry governs the polarization texture and can be directly tuned by twist and relative layer deformation. As the twist angle decreases, the moir'e polarization texture evolves from compact, nearly circular vortex-like patterns to extended triangular AB/BA domains. This crossover arises from enhanced lattice relaxation at small twist angles, which expands low-energy, oppositely polarized AB/BA regions and confines in-plane polarization mainly to domain boundaries. Despite this reconstruction, the local in-plane winding remains tied to interlayer registry and persists up to 1000 K, indicating robust topology against thermal fluctuations. We further show that the mechanical response is dictated by whether deformation changes the relative registry: homogeneous deformation of both layers produces only weak distortions, whereas layer-selective deformation strongly reconstructs the moiré polarization texture. A mismatch-matrix registry-mapping model is developed to capture this response, explaining deformation-induced changes in vortex radii at larger twist angles and triangular-domain geometry at smaller twist angles. These results identify interlayer registry as the central control parameter for forming and tuning moir'e polar topology in twisted bilayer h-BN.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过第一性原理训练的深度势分子动力学模拟，揭示扭转双层h-BN中界面配准（interlayer registry）是控制莫尔极化拓扑的核心参数，其极化织构随扭转角、温度与机械应变呈现可调的演化与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 扭转范德华双层可产生周期性变化的界面配准场并实现空间图案化极化，但配准所控制的极性拓扑如何随扭转角、温度和机械应变系统地演化仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理训练深度势（deep potential）的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，研究扭转双层h-BN，并建立失配矩阵配准映射（mismatch-matrix registry-mapping）模型刻画力学响应。
AI.result: 随扭转角减小，莫尔极化织构从紧凑近圆形涡旋状图案演化为扩展的三角形AB/BA畴；该转变源于小扭转角下增强的晶格弛豫，扩张低能、相反极化的AB/BA区并将面内极化限制在畴界。局部面内绕数与界面配准相关，并在高达1000 K仍保持。均匀变形仅产生弱畸变，而层选择性变形强烈重构莫尔极化织构。
AI.conclusion: 界面配准被确认为扭转双层h-BN中形成与调控莫尔极性拓扑的中心控制参数，配准映射模型可解释大扭转角下涡旋半径变化与小扭转角下三角畴几何。

title: Real-space obstruction control of the shift current in two-dimensional Quantum Spin Hall insulators
summary: The search for materials exhibiting a large bulk photovoltaic effect has recently expanded to low-band-gap systems capable of operating in the infrared regime, with potential applications in optoelectronics. Among the microscopic mechanisms contributing to this phenomenon, the shift current is one of the dominant sources of photocurrent generation. Owing to its geometric origin, the shift current is not only determined by the optical transition probability but also by the real-space displacement associated with the optical excitation, making non-centrosymmetric materials with obstructed electronic wave functions particularly promising candidates. In this work, using a tight-binding model of a quantum spin Hall insulator on a triangular lattice, we investigate the nonlinear photocurrent across trivial, quantum spin Hall, and higher-order topological insulating phases. We show that obstructed topological phases exhibit a substantially enhanced shift-current response, despite the similar electronic band structure. We identify the origin of this enhancement in optical transitions between states belonging to distinct Wannier-center sectors, which allow for a large real-space displacement upon photoexcitation and, depending on the topological phase, control the sign of the shift current. Our results extend the search for controllable bulk photovoltaic effects to materials characterized by real-space electronic obstruction and identify indenene, a monolayer of In on SiC(0001), as a promising candidate for realizing this phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 该工作基于三角晶格量子自旋霍尔绝缘体的紧束缚模型，研究了平庸相、量子自旋霍尔相与高阶拓扑绝缘相中的非线性光电流。结果显示，具有受阻电子波函数的拓扑相展现显著增强的位移电流（shift current），其来源为不同 Wannier 中心扇区之间的光学跃迁。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于将大块光伏效应（bulk photovoltaic effect）的探索扩展至可在红外波段工作的低带隙（low-band-gap）体系，并寻找新的微观机制与材料候选。位移电流因具有几何起源，不仅取决于光学跃迁概率，还取决于光激发引起的实空间位移，因此非中心对称且电子波函数受阻的材料被视为有前景的候选。
AI.method: 采用三角晶格上量子自旋霍尔绝缘体（quantum spin Hall insulator）的紧束缚模型（tight-binding model），系统考察非线性光电流在三类相中的行为：平庸相（trivial phase）、量子自旋霍尔相与高阶拓扑绝缘相（higher-order topological insulating phase）。
AI.result: 在电子能带结构相似的条件下，受阻拓扑相（obstructed topological phases）表现出大幅增强的位移电流响应。增强的来源被归结为分属不同 Wannier 中心扇区（Wannier-center sectors）的态之间的光学跃迁，此类跃迁允许较大的实空间位移，并可依拓扑相的不同控制位移电流的符号。
AI.conclusion: 结果将可控大块光伏效应的材料探索拓展至以实空间电子受阻（real-space electronic obstruction）为特征的材料类别，并指出 indenene（SiC(0001) 上的 In 单层）为实现该现象的有前景候选材料。

title: Activity-Induced Structural and Dynamical Heterogeneity in Colloidal Gels
summary: Active gels are intrinsically non-equilibrium materials whose structural and dynamical heterogeneity emerges from the interplay of attractive interactions, thermal fluctuations, and self-propulsion. We investigate a model active gel, simulated using large-scale Brownian dynamics simulations, to explore the effects of temperature $T$, active force strength $f_0$, persistence timescale $τ_p$, and active particle concentration $ρ_a$. We characterize the structure of the evolving gel network through morphological analysis, while dynamical changes are quantified by the relaxation timescale and dynamical heterogeneity (DH). We show that an optimal choice of activity parameters yields a percolating gel network with faster gelation and larger voids and clusters, enhancing mechanical stability. Conversely, the structural relaxation timescale and DH decrease with increasing activity, indicating enhanced particle rearrangements and reduced spatial correlations of mobile and immobile regions. An effective temperature ($T_\text{eff}$) framework for colloidal gels maps structural quantities and relaxation timescales in an active gel onto those of a passive gel. More interestingly, the growth of DH with increasing swim force can also be described by the same effective-temperature framework, in stark contrast to observations in active glasses. Our findings show that, in colloidal gels, temperature and active force compete, giving rise to similar structural ordering and, consequently, similar DH at the same $T_\text{eff}$. These findings highlight the crucial role of structural ordering in governing DH in active colloidal gels, as compared to active glasses.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过大规模布朗动力学（Brownian dynamics）模拟活性凝胶（active gel），揭示温度、活性力强度、持续时间和活性粒子浓度对凝胶网络结构、弛豫时间与动力学异质性（dynamical heterogeneity, DH）的影响，并证明有效温度（effective temperature, T_eff）框架可统一描述被动凝胶与活性凝胶的结构与动力学行为。
AI.motivation: 活性凝胶是本质非平衡（non-equilibrium）材料，其结构与动力学异质性源于吸引相互作用、热涨落与自驱动的耦合，但活性参数如何调控凝胶网络结构及动力学异质性尚待系统阐明。
AI.method: 采用大规模布朗动力学模拟构建活性凝胶模型，系统改变温度 T、活性力强度 f_0、持续时间尺度 τ_p 与活性粒子浓度 ρ_a；通过形貌分析刻画凝胶网络结构，并利用弛豫时间尺度与动力学异质性量化动力学变化，进而引入有效温度框架进行映射分析。
AI.result: 存在最优活性参数组合可实现渗透凝胶网络，伴随更快凝胶化、更大的空洞与团簇，从而增强力学稳定性；随活性增加，结构弛豫时间尺度与 DH 均下降。有效温度框架可将活性凝胶的结构量与弛豫时间尺度映射至被动凝胶；DH 随游动力（swim force）的增长同样可由该框架描述，这与活性玻璃（active glasses）中的观察结果形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 在胶体凝胶中，温度与活性力相互竞争，在相同 T_eff 下产生相似的结构有序度与相近的 DH；相较活性玻璃，结构有序化在调控活性胶体凝胶的动力学异质性中起关键作用。

title: Probing quantum nonlinear phononics in multilayer graphene with time-resolved Raman scattering
summary: Coherently driven phonons are conventionally described classically. Nonlinear phonon-phonon interactions, however, allow an infrared drive to reshape the fluctuation spectrum and generate substantial nonthermal enhancement of phonon fluctuations, motivating a description beyond the coherent displacement alone. We benchmark classical and semiclassical approximations against the full quantum theory and find that the semiclassical treatment substantially improves agreement with the quantum dynamics. We propose nonequilibrium spontaneous Raman scattering as a sensitive probe of these effects and apply our framework to recent experiments suggesting quantum nonlinear phononics involving the $\mathrm{E}_{1u}$ and $\mathrm{E}_{2g}$ modes in multilayer graphene. At very strong pump fields, driving the $\mathrm{E}_{1u}$ mode significantly modifies the $\mathrm{E}_{2g}$ Raman spectrum; however, reproducing the reported response at experimental field strengths requires accounting for pump-induced Raman matrix element dynamics or alternative energy pathways into the $\mathrm{E}_{2g}$ mode. Our findings extend nonlinear phononics beyond average atomic displacements to the dynamics of lattice fluctuations, highlighting the interplay between coherent motion and quantum correlations in driven materials.

AI.tldr: 该工作将非线性声子学（nonlinear phononics）从平均位移描述拓展到晶格涨落动力学，借助半经典近似对标量子理论，并提出非平衡自发拉曼散射（nonequilibrium spontaneous Raman scattering）作为探测手段，同时评估多层石墨烯实验中的量子非线性声子响应。
AI.motivation: 相干驱动声子（coherently driven phonons）传统上以经典方式描述，但非线性声子-声子相互作用（nonlinear phonon-phonon interactions）可使红外驱动重塑涨落谱并产生显著的非热声子涨落增强，仅用相干位移不足以刻画。因此需要超越单一相干位移的描述框架。
AI.method: 将经典与半经典近似（classical and semiclassical approximations）与完整量子理论（full quantum theory）进行基准对比；提出以非平衡自发拉曼散射作为敏感探针；并将该框架应用于多层石墨烯中涉及 E1u 与 E2g 模式的近期实验。
AI.result: 半经典处理相对经典近似显著改善与量子动力学的符合度。在极强泵浦场下，驱动 E1u 模式会明显改变 E2g 拉曼谱；但在实验场强下复现所报道响应，需考虑泵浦诱导的拉曼矩阵元动力学（Raman matrix element dynamics）或进入 E2g 模式的替代能量通道。
AI.conclusion: 研究将非线性声子学推广至晶格涨落动力学层面，凸显驱动材料中相干运动（coherent motion）与量子关联（quantum correlations）之间的相互作用。

title: Tailored VxOy Metal--Insulator-Transition Oxides for Temperature-Triggered Smart Insulation in Superconducting Coils
comment: Submitted to Superconductor Science and Technology
summary: Smart insulation is a turn-to-turn layer that insulates in normal operation and conducts only near a hot spot. It could combine the fast ramping of insulated coils with the passive energy dump of non-insulated coils. Metal-insulator transition (MIT) oxides are natural candidates, but the only one tested in a coil so far, V2O3, switches at 150-170 K, far above the 30-70 K window useful for REBCO magnets. We explore the vanadium-oxygen system to lower the transition. TGA redox processing produced multi-phase powders with an effective transition near 127 K, about 25 K below V2O3. Hydrothermal V3O7, hydrated or annealed, was far too resistive and showed no usable transition. V2O3-epoxy specimens provided a robust reference and an acceptance criterion. Cryogenic measurements revealed a reproducible thermal hysteresis, and the measured specific heat of V2O3 corrects earlier model inputs by close to two orders of magnitude. A first electro-thermal model reproduces current sharing through the smart-insulation layer. Doped V2O3 and V8O15 are identified as the next targets.

AI.tldr: 该工作探索钒-氧（vanadium-oxygen）体系以降低智能绝缘（smart insulation）金属-绝缘体转变（metal-insulator transition, MIT）温度，TGA 氧化还原处理获得有效转变温度约 127 K 的多相粉末，较 V2O3 低约 25 K。
AI.motivation: 智能绝缘层可在正常运行中绝缘、仅在热点附近导电，从而结合绝缘线圈的快速爬升与非绝缘线圈的被动能量泄放优势。金属-绝缘体转变氧化物是天然候选材料，但迄今唯一在线圈中测试的 V2O3 转变温度为 150-170 K，远高于 REBCO 磁体适用的 30-70 K 窗口。
AI.method: 探索钒-氧体系以降低转变温度；采用 TGA 氧化还原（redox）处理制备多相粉末；对水热法（hydrothermal）制备的 V3O7（水合或退火）进行测试；以 V2O3-环氧树脂样品作为稳健参照与验收标准；开展低温测量与比热测量，并建立首个电-热（electro-thermal）模型。
AI.result: TGA 氧化还原处理得到有效转变温度约 127 K 的多相粉末，比 V2O3 低约 25 K；水热 V3O7（水合或退火）电阻过高且无可用的转变。低温测量显示可重复的热滞后（thermal hysteresis）；V2O3 实测比热将早期模型输入修正近两个数量级；首个电-热模型复现了通过智能绝缘层的电流共享（current sharing）。
AI.conclusion: V2O3-环氧树脂样品提供了稳健参照与验收标准，并据此筛选材料。掺杂 V2O3 与 V8O15 被确定为下一步目标。

title: Admittance extraction of quantum dot arrays for charge sensing
summary: This work demonstrates admittance extraction of quantum dot arrays using a rate equation frame- work matching experimental reflectometry measurements. Using a semiclassical rate equation, we consider a perturbation of the source/drain chemical potential to model reflectometry readout in a quantum dot array. This is a time-dependent extension of the rate equation which has been employed in literature for pumped arrays of quantum dots and capacitance extractions. Here we extend this to a double quantum dot for admittance extraction. The simulations are calibrated us- ing Fermi-Hubbard parameters extracted from experimental data, which it is then shown to closely approximate to.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在速率方程（rate equation）框架下对量子点阵列（quantum dot array）进行导纳提取（admittance extraction），通过与实验反射测量（reflectometry）结果匹配来验证模型。
AI.motivation: 反射测量（reflectometry）被用于量子点阵列读出，但缺乏与实验测量相匹配的导纳提取理论框架。既有速率方程多用于泵浦阵列与电容提取，尚未扩展至导纳提取与双量子点情形。
AI.method: 采用半经典（semiclassical）速率方程，对源/漏化学势（source/drain chemical potential）施加微扰，以建模量子点阵列中的反射测量读出。该方法为速率方程的时间依赖（time-dependent）扩展，并推广至双量子点（double quantum dot）。模拟使用从实验数据提取的费米-哈伯德（Fermi-Hubbard）参数进行校准。
AI.result: 经费米-哈伯德参数校准后，模拟结果与实验数据表现出高度接近（closely approximate）。
AI.conclusion: 半经典时间依赖速率方程可实现对量子点阵列（含双量子点）的导纳提取，且其校准模型能较好地重现实验反射测量结果。

title: Solubility of poorly soluble species in bulk and nanopores from grand-canonical Wang-Landau sampling
summary: Poorly soluble species can have mean populations below one in small systems such as nanopores. In this regime, the grand-potential minimum, which identifies the most probable particle number, differs from the ensemble-averaged solute loading. We use grand-canonical Wang-Landau sampling (GCWLS) to calculate the density of states $Ω(N_\mathrm{A}, N_\mathrm{B})$ for a binary Lennard-Jones mixture of solute B in solvent A, both in bulk and in slit pores. One set of GCWLS simulations gives ensemble averages over a range of chemical potentials, whereas conventional grand-canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulation requires a separate simulation at each state point. Independent GCMC simulations confirm the GCWLS ensemble averages. The solvent number distribution is nearly Gaussian, whereas the dilute solute distribution is skewed and Poisson-like. The most probable solute number therefore lies below the ensemble-averaged loading $\langle N_\mathrm{B}\rangle$ and is zero whenever $\langle N_\mathrm{B}\rangle<1$. Reading the solute loading from the grand-potential minimum underestimates it and can falsely indicate that no solute is present. Defining the oversolubility as $\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}=x_\mathrm{B}^{\mathrm{conf}}/x_\mathrm{B}^{\mathrm{bulk}}$, where $x_\mathrm{B}$ is the solute mole fraction, we find $\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}\approx12$ in a pore of 3.5 particle diameters width when both wall interactions are repulsive. Adding wall-solute attraction moderately raises it to $\approx13$, whereas wall-solvent attraction lowers it to $\approx3.4$. This comparison shows that the wall-solvent interaction controls most of the enhancement. As the pore widens, $\mathcal{O}_\mathrm{B}$ decreases toward unity. In bulk and in nanopores alike, the solubility of poorly soluble species should be obtained from ensemble averages rather than from grand-potential minima.

AI.tldr: 该工作采用巨正则 Wang-Landau 采样（grand-canonical Wang-Landau sampling, GCWLS）计算二元 Lennard-Jones 混合物在体相与狭缝孔（slit pore）中的态密度 Ω(N_A, N_B)。结果揭示难溶组分（poorly soluble species）在纳米孔内其最可几粒子数低于系综平均负载，且其分布呈偏斜的类泊松（Poisson-like）形态。
AI.motivation: 在纳米孔等小体系中，难溶组分的平均粒子数可低于 1，此时以巨势（grand potential）极小值定义的最可几粒子数与系综平均负载不一致。若按巨势极小值读取溶质负载，会低估实际负载，甚至错误判断体系内不存在溶质。
AI.method: 使用巨正则 Wang-Landau 采样（GCWLS）计算溶剂 A 中溶质 B 的二元 Lennard-Jones 混合物态密度 Ω(N_A, N_B)，覆盖体相与狭缝孔两种情形；并以独立的巨正则 Monte Carlo（grand-canonical Monte Carlo, GCMC）模拟验证 GCWLS 所得的系综平均。同时定义过溶解度（oversolubility）O_B = x_B^conf / x_B^bulk 以量化孔内富集。
AI.result: 一次 GCWLS 模拟即可给出多个化学势（chemical potential）下的系综平均，而传统 GCMC 需在每个状态点单独模拟。溶剂数目分布近似高斯（Gaussian），稀溶质分布偏斜且类泊松，故最可几溶质数低于系综平均负载 ⟨N_B⟩，且当 ⟨N_B⟩ < 1 时为零。宽度为 3.5 个粒子直径的孔中，两壁均为排斥作用时 O_B ≈ 12；增加壁-溶质吸引使其温和升至 ≈ 13，而壁-溶剂吸引则使其降至 ≈ 3.4；孔变宽时 O_B 趋近于 1。
AI.conclusion: 壁-溶剂相互作用（wall-solvent interaction）主导了孔内溶解度增强效应。无论在体相还是纳米孔中，难溶组分的溶解度应由系综平均而非巨势极小值获得。

title: Nontrivial topological properties from the cooperation of static perturbations and Floquet fields in type-II semi-Dirac semimetals
summary: In this work, we present a comprehensive theoretical study for the topological and anomalous transport properties of type-II SDSMs under three scenarios, i.e., static symmetry-breaking perturbations, periodic Floquet driving by two-frequency orthogonally polarized light (TFOPL), and their cooperative effects in the hybrid scenario. We first show that a static mass $m_z$ opens a bulk gap and drives the system into a Chern insulator with Chern number $C^{\rm per}=\pm 2\,{\rm sgn}(m_z)$. In comparison, TFOPL alone only shifts the positions of Dirac points and cannot open a full gap. Nevertheless, it produces a Berry curvature odd in the $x$-direction, yielding a finite Berry curvature dipole (BCD) along $x$ proportional to the sine of the initial phase, while the $y$-component vanishes. The hybrid scenario, by contrast, exhibits a remarkably rich phenomenology. Specifically, its gap-closure criterion becomes cubic and thus admits up to three real roots when the effective parameter along the $x$-direction is negative, thereby producing multiple light-tunable gap-closing points and a series of topological phase transitions. In particular, the BCD exhibits a double-peak structure with strong enhancement near gap-closing manifolds and synchronized sign reversal of the full vector under external tuning. We further analyze the anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC), anomalous Nernst conductivity (ANC), and anomalous thermal Hall conductivity (ATHC). The AHC and ATHC exhibit quantized plateaus that serve as signatures of Chern-insulator phases, while the ANC, being a Fermi-surface probe, provides complementary local information and can identify light-induced gaps even when global topological invariants remain unchanged. Taken together, these results offer useful insights into the topological properties of 2D type-II SDSMs and related systems.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究第二类自旋-狄拉克半金属（type-II SDSMs）在静态对称破缺、双频正交偏振光（TFOPL）驱动及二者混合情形下的拓扑与反常输运性质，揭示混合情形下出现三次型能隙闭合判据、多重拓扑相变与贝里曲率偶极（BCD）双峰增强等丰富现象。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于系统理解第二类自旋-狄拉克半金属（type-II SDSMs）在静态扰动与周期性光驱动等不同机制下的拓扑相与反常输运响应，并探索二者协同作用可能带来的新物理。
AI.method: 采用综合性理论分析，分别考察三种情形：静态对称破缺微扰、双频正交偏振光（TFOPL）的周期性 Floquet 驱动，以及二者的混合情形；并计算陈数、贝里曲率偶极（BCD）、反常霍尔电导（AHC）、反常能斯特电导（ANC）与反常热霍尔电导（ATHC）。
AI.result: 静态质量 m_z 打开体能隙并驱动系统进入陈绝缘体，陈数为 C^per=±2 sgn(m_z)；单独的 TFOPL 仅移动狄拉克点位置而不打开全能隙，但产生沿 x 方向为奇的贝里曲率与正比于初相正弦的有限 BCD，y 分量消失。混合情形中能隙闭合判据变为三次型，当 x 方向有效参数为负时最多有三个实根，产生多个光可调能隙闭合点与一系列拓扑相变；BCD 呈双峰结构且在能隙闭合流形附近强烈增强，并伴随全矢量在外场调控下的同步符号反转。AHC 与 ATHC 呈现可作为陈绝缘体相标志的量子化平台，而 ANC 作为费米面探针提供互补局域信息，即使全局拓扑不变量不变也能识别光诱导能隙。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果有助于深入理解二维第二类自旋-狄拉克半金属（type-II SDSMs）及相关体系的拓扑性质，并表明反常输运量可作为区分不同拓扑相与识别光诱导能隙的有效探针。

title: Topological Chiral Superconductivity from Doping Correlated Charge Transfer Insulator with Orbital Magnetism
summary: Topological chiral superconductivity has been extensively studied from the perspective of electronic structures in momentum space, while its emergence from real-space processes in strongly interacting systems remains largely unexplored. Here, we study a doped charge-transfer insulator in a strongly repulsive spinless-fermion model with three sublattices and $2π$ flux per unit cell. Combining perturbative analysis, exact diagonalization, and density matrix renormalization group simulations, we establish a topological superconducting ground state with $p+ip$ symmetry. In the large charge-transfer gap limit, chiral charge-transfer excitations generate a correlated-hopping process that provides a microscopic mechanism for electron pairing and its chiral structure. The chiral superconductivity persists into the smaller-gap regime, where chiral excitonic two-particle bound state can emerge. Our results establish a concrete real-space route to topological chiral superconductivity upon doping strongly interacting charge-transfer insulators with orbital magnetism.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究强关联无自旋费米子模型（three sublattices，每原胞 2π 磁通）中掺杂电荷转移绝缘体（charge-transfer insulator）的基态，结合微扰分析、精确对角化（exact diagonalization）与密度矩阵重整化群（density matrix renormalization group, DMRG），确立了具有 p+ip 对称性的拓扑超导基态，并提出由手性电荷转移激发诱导的关联跃迁（correlated-hopping）作为电子配对的实空间微观机制。
AI.motivation: 拓扑手性超导（topological chiral superconductivity）此前多从动量空间电子结构角度研究，而强相互作用体系中的实空间（real-space）生成机制尚不明确。该工作旨在为掺杂强关联电荷转移绝缘体中的手性超导提供实空间路径。
AI.method: 研究采用强排斥无自旋费米子（spinless-fermion）模型，含三个子晶格（three sublattices）与每原胞 2π 磁通；方法上结合微扰分析、精确对角化（exact diagonalization）与密度矩阵重整化群（density matrix renormalization group）数值模拟。
AI.result: 在大电荷转移能隙（charge-transfer gap）极限下，手性电荷转移激发产生关联跃迁过程，为电子配对及其手性结构提供微观机制；手性超导性可延续至较小能隙区间，此区间可出现手性激子两粒子束缚态（chiral excitonic two-particle bound state）。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了在具有轨道磁性（orbital magnetism）的强关联电荷转移绝缘体中，通过掺杂实现拓扑手性超导的一条具体实空间路径。

title: Confinement-deconfinement transitions in the dimer-loop models on two-dimensional non-bipartite lattices
summary: Recent work [Kundu, Damle, Phys. Rev. X 15, 011018 (2025)] has demonstrated that a class of $S=1$ kagome lattice antiferromagnets with competing anisotropies can exhibit unusual low-temperature behavior that is best described in terms of the statistical mechanics of an interesting interpolation between the fully-packed dimer model and the fully-packed loop model on the bipartite honeycomb lattice. On this and other bipartite lattices in two and three dimension, such fully-packed dimer-loop models generically have two distinct power-law correlated Coulomb phases, both of which admit a low-energy description in terms of a fluctuating divergence-free polarization vector field [Phys. Rev. X 15, 011018 (2025); arXiv:2510.11607]. The transition between these phases corresponds to a confinement transition for the $Z_2$ part of the corresponding $U(1)$ flux [Phys. Rev. X 15, 011018 (2025); arXiv:2510.11607]. Here we demonstrate that a variant of such a topological confinement transition can also exist in dimer-loop models on non-bipartite lattices such as the kagome and triangular lattices although the low-energy description does not feature any conserved $U(1)$ flux. In these non-bipartite dimer-loop models, both phases are short-range correlated liquids, and the topological distinction between them is in terms of a $Z_2$-valued winding number instead of the flux of a divergence-free polarization field. In spite of this key difference, this transition appears to be in the same Ising universality class as the analogous transition of the bipartite dimer-loop models. These kagome and triangular lattice dimer-loop models correspond respectively to the low-energy limit of a class of $S=1$ antiferromagnets with competing anisotropies on the ruby lattice comprising a corner-sharing arrangement of fully-frustrated squares and a lattice of corner-sharing fully-frustrated hexagons.

AI.tldr: 该文研究非二分晶格（non-bipartite lattice）上的二聚体-环模型（dimer-loop model），证明其中可存在一种拓扑禁闭相变（topological confinement transition），尽管低能描述中不存在守恒的 $U(1)$ 通量。
AI.motivation: 近期工作表明，具有竞争各向异性的 $S=1$ kagome 反铁磁体（antiferromagnet）可用二分蜂窝晶格上全填充二聚体模型与全填充环模型之间的插值统计力学（statistical mechanics）来描述，且二分晶格上的此类模型通常具有两个幂律关联的库仑相（Coulomb phase）。本文旨在探究此类拓扑禁闭相变能否推广至非二分晶格。
AI.method: 在 kagome 晶格与三角晶格（triangular lattice）等非二分晶格上构造二聚体-环模型的变体，并分析其低能有效描述与相变性质，与二分晶格模型的情形进行对比。
AI.result: 在非二分二聚体-环模型中，两个相均为短程关联液体（short-range correlated liquid），其拓扑区分由 $Z_2$ 值的绕数（winding number）而非无散度极化场的通量给出；尽管存在这一关键差异，该相变似乎与二分模型的类似相变同属 Ising 普适类（Ising universality class）。
AI.conclusion: 非二分晶格上的二聚体-环模型可实现拓扑禁闭相变的变体，其相变普适类与二分情形一致，拓扑区分机制则由通量转变为绕数。这些 kagome 与三角晶格模型分别对应红宝石晶格（ruby lattice）上一类 $S=1$ 竞争各向异性反铁磁体的低能极限。

title: Domain-wall-to-domain interconversion in a polar conducting oxide
summary: Domain walls in ferroic crystals are topological defects with a symmetry distinct from the domain interior, allowing them to display functionalities that are otherwise forbidden in the host material. Despite their unique properties, domain walls are strictly confined to two-dimensional interfaces, which hinders unveiling their true nature and limits their applicability. Here, we demonstrate reversible dimensionality control by expanding nanoscale domain walls into three-dimensional functional regions in polar epitaxial tungsten trioxide ($\text{WO}_3$). This domain-wall-to-domain interconversion is enabled by the conducting, non-polar domain walls adopting the parent-phase structure. An alternating electric field applied through a scanning probe tip induces localized heating, which expands this domain-wall phase into the adjacent polar domains. This approach enables reversible spatial control to switch between mutually exclusive properties of domains (polarity) and domain walls (conductivity), offering a new paradigm for reconfigurable oxide electronics.

AI.tldr: 该研究在极性外延三氧化钨（tungsten trioxide, WO₃）中，通过扫描探针施加交变电场诱导局域加热，将二维畴壁（domain wall）可逆地扩展为三维功能区域，实现畴壁相与极性畴之间的相互转换。
AI.motivation: 铁性晶体中的畴壁（domain wall）是拓扑缺陷（topological defect），具有与畴内部不同的对称性，可呈现母体材料所不允许的功能；但其严格局限于二维界面，限制了对本征性质的认识与器件应用。
AI.method: 利用导电且非极性的畴壁采用母相结构的特性，通过扫描探针针尖施加交变电场产生局域加热，使畴壁相向相邻极性畴扩展，实现畴壁到畴（domain-wall-to-domain）的相互转换。
AI.result: 实现了纳米尺度畴壁向三维功能区域的可逆维度调控（dimensionality control），可在畴的极性（polarity）与畴壁的导电性（conductivity）这两种互斥性质之间进行可逆空间切换。
AI.conclusion: 该维度调控与畴壁-畴相互转换为可重构氧化物电子学（reconfigurable oxide electronics）提供了一种新范式。

title: Destructive Interference of a Charge Density Wave in the Skyrmion Magnet GdRu2Si2
summary: In skyrmion magnets, charge density waves induce higher-order exchange interactions that can select multi-Q ground states. Using resonant X-ray scattering and neutron diffraction, we measure temperature-dependent spin-charge coupling in GdRu2Si2. A minimal Landau model with one critical exponent and two ordering temperatures reproduces all six observed order parameters. Spin-density wave components of the multi-Q ground state drive charge ordering, but the onset of a magnetic helix suppresses it via destructive interference.

AI.tldr: 该研究在 GdRu2Si2 中通过共振 X 射线散射与中子衍射测量自旋-电荷耦合，发现一个含单一临界指数与两个有序温度的最小 Landau 模型可复现全部六个观测到的序参量，并揭示螺旋磁序对电荷序的抑制机制。
AI.motivation: 在斯格明子磁体（skyrmion magnets）中，电荷密度波（charge density wave）诱导的高阶交换相互作用（higher-order exchange interactions）被认为可筛选多 Q 基态（multi-Q ground states），但其自旋与电荷耦合的实验证据与唯象描述仍不充分。
AI.method: 采用共振 X 射线散射（resonant X-ray scattering）与中子衍射（neutron diffraction），测量 GdRu2Si2 中随温度变化的自旋-电荷耦合；并构建一个仅含单一临界指数（critical exponent）与两个有序温度的最小 Landau 模型进行拟合。
AI.result: 该最小 Landau 模型可复现实验中全部六个观测到的序参量（order parameters）。多 Q 基态的自旋密度波（spin-density wave）分量驱动电荷有序，而磁螺旋（magnetic helix）的出现通过相消干涉（destructive interference）抑制该电荷有序。
AI.conclusion: GdRu2Si2 中的自旋-电荷耦合可由极简 Landau 描述刻画；多 Q 基态的自旋密度波分量与磁螺旋在电荷序形成上呈现驱动与抑制的竞争关系。

title: Colloid-Colloid Interactions Impact Network Morphology of Confined Colloidal Drying Patterns
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 1 table. Submitted to the Journal of Chemical Physics
summary: Colloidal suspensions that are confined between two closely spaced plates and left to evaporate slowly form maze-like labyrinth patterns in the final stage of evaporation. The fingers in these patterns form bifurcations and occasionally loops, which we may quantify with a skeletonization method. We compare drying patterns formed with two different salt concentrations in the droplet which changes the screening length and therefore the effective colloid interactions. We find that the junctions generally follow Murray's law for optimal transport networks, and that the typical bifurcation angles peak around 53. Screened droplets additionally show more loopy networks, and is characterized by bands of transversal fingers before merging into a central non-fingering colloidal aggregate. Our observations suggest that colloid-colloid interactions can strongly influence the large-scale topology of the pattern while leaving the local geometry of the individual fingers unchanged.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过骨架化（skeletonization）方法量化蒸发胶体悬浮液形成的迷宫状（maze-like labyrinth）图案，发现分叉节点大体遵循Murray定律（Murray's law），典型分叉角约53°，而盐浓度（屏蔽长度，screening length）主要改变网络的宏观拓扑（如环状结构增多）而非单个指状结构的局部几何。
AI.motivation: 夹在两块紧密平行板之间并缓慢蒸发的胶体悬浮液会在蒸发末期形成迷宫状图案，其指状结构（fingers）会分叉并偶有成环，但此类图案的定量表征及其与胶体相互作用的关系尚待厘清。研究动机在于通过改变盐浓度以调节屏蔽长度与有效胶体相互作用，考察其对图案结构的影响。
AI.method: 采用骨架化（skeletonization）方法量化指状结构的分叉与成环特征；对比液滴中两种不同盐浓度下的干燥图案，以改变屏蔽长度（screening length）及由此决定的有效胶体相互作用（effective colloid interactions）。分析中考察了节点（junctions）规律、典型分叉角分布以及网络拓扑特征。
AI.result: 分叉节点总体遵循最优输运网络（optimal transport networks）的Murray定律，典型分叉角峰值约在53°。经屏蔽的液滴额外表现出更多成环（loopy）网络，其特征是在汇入中心非指状胶体聚集体（non-fingering colloidal aggregate）之前存在横向指状结构带（bands of transversal fingers）。
AI.conclusion: 观察结果表明，胶体-胶体相互作用可强烈影响图案的大尺度拓扑（large-scale topology），而单个指状结构的局部几何（local geometry）保持不变。

title: 1/f frequency-noise reduction in nanomechanical resonators by dissipation dilution
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures; Supporting information: 7 pages, 3 figures
summary: The frequency noise of a resonant nanomechanical sensor is well understood down to its thermomechanical limit, but the longest useful averaging time is set by a flicker, or $1/f$, frequency-noise floor whose origin has remained unknown. We show that this floor is the thermal noise of the tension. By the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, the tension of a resonator with fixed ends fluctuates by an amount set by the loss angle of its material; for structural damping, these fluctuations produce $1/f$ frequency noise with a flicker coefficient $h_{-1}=E k_{\mathrm{B}} T/(2πVσ_0^2 Q_{\mathrm{el}})$, with $Q_{\mathrm{el}}$ the intrinsic loss under elongation, that contains no free parameter and is diluted by the tensile stress $σ_0$ in the same way as damping is in dissipation dilution. Silicon nitride strings and membranes from 30 to 340~nm thickness follow the predicted volume scaling, the predicted $σ_0^{-2}$ dilution across resonators and within stress-engineered strings, and the predicted thickness dependence, which places noise-active two-level systems in the volume and at the surfaces of the resonators, all at the absolute level set by the independently measured intrinsic loss. The same relation accounts for published data between 78 and 296~K; below 78~K, the loss measured at the resonance no longer represents the loss probed by the noise, marking the limit of the structural-damping assumption. Dissipation dilution therefore lowers the $1/f$ floor, and the longest useful integration time of a resonant sensor is set by its prestress, volume, temperature, and intrinsic loss angle.

AI.tldr: 该工作表明，谐振式纳米机械传感器（resonant nanomechanical sensor）中的1/f频率噪声（1/f frequency noise）本底源自张力的热噪声（thermal noise of the tension），并给出无自由参数的闪烁系数（flicker coefficient）表达式，被氮化硅弦与薄膜的厚度、应力与体积标度关系所验证。
AI.motivation: 此前对谐振纳米机械传感器的频率噪声理解仅到热机械极限（thermomechanical limit），而限制最长有效平均时间（averaging time）的1/f频率噪声本底来源不明，该本底决定了传感器的可用积分时间上限。因此需要确定该噪声本底的物理起源并给出定量描述。
AI.method: 基于涨落耗散定理（fluctuation-dissipation theorem），将固定端谐振器的张力涨落与其材料损耗角（loss angle）关联；在结构阻尼（structural damping）假设下推导由此产生的1/f频率噪声及其闪烁系数表达式。随后用厚度30至340 nm的氮化硅（silicon nitride）弦和薄膜进行检验，考察其对体积、张应力σ0（含应力工程弦内部）与厚度的标度关系，并与独立测得的内禀损耗对比。同时用78至296 K的已发表数据做验证。
AI.result: 推导得到的闪烁系数 h_{-1}=E k_B T/(2πVσ_0^2 Q_el) 不含自由参数，其中Q_el为伸长下的内禀损耗；氮化硅弦与薄膜符合预测的体积标度、跨谐振器及应力工程弦内的σ0^{-2}稀释关系以及厚度依赖，表明噪声活跃的双能级系统（two-level systems）分布于谐振器体积与表面，且噪声绝对水平由独立测得的内禀损耗决定。该关系可解释78至296 K的已发表数据。
AI.conclusion: 1/f频率噪声本底即张力的热噪声，其大小由预张应力（prestress）、体积、温度与内禀损耗角决定；耗散稀释（dissipation dilution）同样降低1/f本底。低于78 K时，谐振处测得的损耗不再代表噪声所探测的损耗，标志着结构阻尼假设的适用极限。

title: Emergent Spinorial Structure in Mesoscopic Irreversible Thermodynamics
summary: We reconstruct a geometry of thermodynamic coordinates from transport coefficients within a mesoscopic canonical model. Self-adjoint flux observables determine a compatible evolution generator containing symmetric and antisymmetric transport coefficients. When the Hermitian transport tensor is positive, an exact graded first-order factorization reproduces this generator on its scalar sector. Its commutators define a spectral distance whose metric depends only on the symmetric tensor. Gradients of the antisymmetric tensor can change the evolution while leaving the metric unchanged. The construction allows coordinate-dependent coefficients. In the constant Onsager regime, a Clifford representation gives the same distance and an algebra fixed by the transport matrix. Published transport data for a $\mathrm{Bi_2Te_3}$ film give a principal-distance ratio of approximately $2.12$ in normalized coordinates at $ZT\simeq0.68$. We also examine a separate quadratic entropy-production observable and distinguish its discrete spectrum from the spectrum of the evolution generator. The spinorial representation adds no physical spin degrees of freedom.

AI.tldr: 本文在介观正则模型中由输运系数重构热力学坐标的几何结构：自伴通量可观测量确定含对称与反对称输运系数的演化生成元，其交换子给出仅依赖对称张量的谱距离；对Bi₂Te₃薄膜数据得到归一化主距离比约2.12（ZT≈0.68）。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于从输运系数出发构建热力学坐标的几何描述，并厘清对称与反对称输运成分在演化与度量中的不同角色。摘要未给出更具体的背景陈述。
AI.method: 采用介观正则模型（mesoscopic canonical model），以自伴通量可观测量（self-adjoint flux observables）构造兼容的演化生成元（evolution generator）；在厄米输运张量（Hermitian transport tensor）正定条件下，用精确的分级一阶因子化（graded first-order factorization）在标量扇区复现生成元；由交换子定义谱距离，并在恒定昂萨格（Onsager）情形下引入克利福德表示（Clifford representation）。
AI.result: 谱距离的度量仅依赖对称输运张量；反对称张量的梯度可改变演化而不改变度量。构造允许坐标依赖的系数；恒定昂萨格情形下克利福德表示给出相同距离及由输运矩阵固定的代数。对已发表的Bi₂Te₃薄膜输运数据，在归一化坐标下得到主距离比约2.12，对应ZT≈0.68。另考察独立的二次熵产生可观测量，并区分其离散谱与演化生成元的谱；旋量表示不引入额外物理自旋自由度。
AI.conclusion: 该构造将输运系数与热力学坐标几何相联系，指出度量由对称张量决定而反对称部分影响演化，并在具体材料数据上给出定量距离比。旋量表示仅作数学工具，不增加物理自旋自由度。

title: Impact of shear and dilational membrane viscosities on capsule shape and dynamics under shear flow: a theoretical study
summary: In artificial (micro)capsules or cells such as red blood cells for example, the two-dimensional (2D) rheology of the membrane (or the shell) is viscoelastic and not only elastic. The deformation and inclination of such a capsule are theoretically studied under shear and extensional flows. The membrane mechanics is described by the Kelvin-Voigt model: the 2D dissipation with the Boussinesq-Scriven law associated to specific dilational and shear Boussinesq numbers $Bq_d$ and $Bq_d$ respectively while the elastic constitutive law is either Hookean, strain-softening (neoHookean) or strain-hardening (Skalak). The dynamics depends on the elastic capillary number $Ca$, the Poisson ratio (or $C$ in Skalak law), the viscosity ratio $λ$, the nonlinearities included in the constitutive law and both boussinesq numbers. Three dynamics are identified in the limit of weak deformations: a tank-treading motion in the limit of small elastic capillary number with a characteristic time depending on $λ$, $Bq_s$ and $Bq_d$, an oscillation without any elasticity and a damped oscillation leading to a tank-treading motion in the limit of large Boussinesq numbers. In all cases, both shear and dilational 2D dissipations contribute differently leading to non-trivial results. In the case of a Skalak law with $C=1$, $Bq=Bq_s=Bq_d$ and $Bq>>λ$, the deformations in the limits $Ca<<1$, $Bq=O(1)$ and $Ca=O(1)$, $Bq>>1$ determined in the seminal work of \cite{barthes1985role} are recovered.

AI.tldr: 该研究在剪切流与拉伸流下理论分析了人工微胶囊（如红细胞）膜的二维黏弹性（viscoelastic）力学行为，采用 Kelvin-Voigt 模型耦合 Boussinesq-Scriven 耗散律与 Hookean、neoHookean、Skalak 三种弹性本构，识别出三类变形动力学。
AI.motivation: 人工（微）胶囊及红细胞等体系的膜或壳层二维流变学（2D rheology）本质为黏弹性而非纯弹性，既有理论多侧重弹性描述，故需要纳入二维耗散以刻画其变形与倾角行为。
AI.method: 膜力学由 Kelvin-Voigt 模型描述：弹性本构取 Hookean、应变软化（strain-softening，neoHookean）或应变硬化（strain-hardening，Skalak）；二维耗散由 Boussinesq-Scriven 律给出，对应膨胀与剪切 Boussinesq 数（Boussinesq numbers）$Bq_d$、$Bq_s$。动力学依赖弹性毛细数（elastic capillary number）$Ca$、泊松比（或 Skalak 律中的 $C$）、黏度比 $λ$、本构非线性及两个 Boussinesq 数。
AI.result: 在小变形极限下识别出三种动力学：小弹性毛细数下特征时间依赖 $λ$、$Bq_s$、$Bq_d$ 的坦克履带运动（tank-treading motion）；无弹性的振荡；以及大 Boussinesq 数下导致坦克履带运动的阻尼振荡（damped oscillation）。剪切与膨胀二维耗散贡献不同，产生非平凡结果。
AI.conclusion: 在 Skalak 律取 $C=1$、$Bq=Bq_s=Bq_d$ 且 $Bq\gg λ$ 时，$Ca\ll 1$、$Bq=O(1)$ 与 $Ca=O(1)$、$Bq\gg 1$ 两种极限下的变形结果与 Barthes 等的经典工作一致，表明该框架可退化复现既有结论。

title: Transport Determines Spectral Distance in Mesoscopic Thermodynamics
summary: We derive a distance between thermodynamic states from a positive Hermitian transport tensor within a mesoscopic canonical model. An exact first-order factorization of the evolution generator gives a commutator norm and the metric $G=2g^{-1}$, where $g$ denotes the symmetric transport tensor. Gradients of the antisymmetric tensor can change the evolution, but they leave this distance unchanged. The construction allows coordinate-dependent coefficients. For constant Onsager coefficients, a Clifford representation gives the same metric. In a two-channel thermoelectric system, the ratio of normalized principal distances is $\sqrt{1+ZT}+\sqrt{ZT}$. Transport coupling thus fixes the anisotropy of this metric. The construction requires neither an independent metric nor a physical spin variable.

AI.tldr: 该论文在中观正则模型中，从正厄米输运张量导出热力学状态之间的距离，得到度量 $G=2g^{-1}$，并证明反对称张量梯度不改变该距离。在双通道热电系统中，归一化主距离之比为 $\sqrt{1+ZT}+\sqrt{ZT}$。
AI.motivation: 旨在从输运张量本身构造热力学状态的距离度量，而无需引入独立度量或物理自旋变量，从而将输运耦合与度量各向异性联系起来。
AI.method: 在中观正则模型（mesoscopic canonical model）中，对演化生成元（evolution generator）进行精确一阶因子化，得到对易子范数（commutator norm）与度量 $G=2g^{-1}$；对常数昂萨格系数（Onsager coefficients）采用克利福德表示（Clifford representation）。
AI.result: 反对称张量的梯度可改变演化但不改变该距离；构造允许坐标依赖系数；常数昂萨格系数下克利福德表示给出相同度量；双通道热电系统中归一化主距离之比为 $\sqrt{1+ZT}+\sqrt{ZT}$。
AI.conclusion: 输运耦合决定了该度量的各向异性，且该构造不依赖独立度量或物理自旋变量。

title: Engineering Ferroelectric Phases in BaTiO$_3$ Films via Buffer-Layer Induced Misfit Strain Reversal
summary: Controlling ferroelectric phase symmetry through strain engineering is crucial for tailoring polarization topology and functional properties in oxide-based devices. Here, we show that a thin conductive buffer layer can override substrate-induced strain in BaTiO$_3$ (BTO) films on MgO. Although the lattice parameter of MgO(001) would be expected to induce tensile misfit strain, in 500~nm BaTiO$_3$ films the thermal-expansion mismatch dominates, resulting in effective compressive stress upon cooling. Inserting a 50-nm La$_{0.67}$Sr$_{0.33}$MnO$_3$ (LSMO) buffer layer reverses the effective strain state from compressive to tensile. Using temperature-dependent polarized Raman spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction, and piezoresponse force microscopy, we reveal an unconventional phase sequence upon cooling: paraelectric $\rightarrow$ orthorhombic ($\textit{aa}$-phase, $\sim$407 K) $\rightarrow$ monoclinic ($\textit{r}$-phase, $\sim$300-345 K), characterized in-plane and tilted polarization components. The LSMO layer not only serves as a bottom electrode but also modifies the strain state, while interfacial charge redistribution induces a built-in electric field, evidenced by self-polarization and asymmetric PFM hysteresis. These findings highlight the critical role of conductive buffer layers in controlling ferroelectric symmetry and enabling oxide heterostructures with tailored polarization textures for low-power spintronics, tunable microwave devices, and neuromorphic computing.

AI.tldr: 在 MgO 衬底上的 BaTiO₃ 薄膜中，热膨胀失配导致有效压应力；插入 50 nm LSMO 缓冲层可将有效应变由压转为拉，并诱发电场与异常相序。
AI.motivation: 通过应变工程调控铁电相对称性对氧化物器件中的极化拓扑与功能特性至关重要，但衬底诱导应变往往受其他机制干扰，需要新的调控手段。
AI.method: 在 MgO(001) 上生长 500 nm BaTiO₃ 薄膜，并插入 50 nm La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃（LSMO）缓冲层；采用变温偏振拉曼光谱（polarized Raman spectroscopy）、X 射线衍射（X-ray diffraction）与压电力显微镜（piezoresponse force microscopy, PFM）进行表征。
AI.result: 尽管 MgO(001) 晶格参数预期产生拉伸失配应变，但 500 nm BTO 薄膜中热膨胀失配主导，冷却时形成有效压应力；插入 LSMO 后有效应变由压转拉。冷却过程中观察到异常相序：顺电（paraelectric）→正交（orthorhombic，aa 相，约 407 K）→单斜（monoclinic，r 相，约 300–345 K），并伴随面内与倾斜极化分量。
AI.conclusion: LSMO 层既作底电极又改变应变状态，界面电荷重分布产生内建电场（由自极化与不对称 PFM 回线佐证）；导电缓冲层在控制铁电对称性、构建定制极化织构的氧化物异质结构方面具有关键作用，可服务低功耗自旋电子学、可调微波器件与神经形态计算。

title: Quantum Ising transition on the Cayley tree: boundary criticality, universality, and an effective Bethe line
summary: We investigate quantum criticality in the transverse-field Ising model on finite Cayley trees and demonstrate that their extensive boundary fundamentally changes the nature of the quantum phase transition compared with the infinite, boundary-free Bethe lattice. Using tree tensor-network simulations for systems with up to $N=12286$ sites, we identify a boundary-driven continuous transition at $h_x^c\approx1.76$, distinct from the mean-field Bethe-lattice transition at $h_x^c\approx2.23$. We characterize this transition through finite-size scaling of the magnetization and magnetic susceptibility and extract a consistent set of critical exponents. By introducing next-nearest-neighbor interactions, we demonstrate the robustness of the extracted critical exponents, providing numerical argument for the Ising boundary universality class on the Cayley tree. Furthermore, we show that the physics of the boundary-free Bethe lattice can be efficiently recovered on a finite Cayley tree by fine-tuning a local boundary field. The resulting \textit{effective Bethe line}, whose existence is tied to the mean-field nature of the bulk transition, effectively screens the extensive boundary and restores both the critical point and the mean-field critical scaling of the infinite Bethe lattice.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用树张量网络模拟有限Cayley树上的横场Ising模型，揭示其大量边界导致与无边界Bethe晶格截然不同的量子相变，并通过调节边界场恢复Bethe晶格的平均场行为。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探究有限Cayley树的大量边界是否从根本上改变量子相变性质，以区分其与无限、无边界Bethe晶格的平均场行为差异。
AI.method: 采用树张量网络（tree tensor-network）模拟，处理最多N=12286个格点，对磁化强度与磁化率进行有限尺寸标度分析，并引入次近邻相互作用进行检验。
AI.result: 识别出边界驱动的连续相变，临界场约为h_x^c≈1.76，区别于Bethe晶格的平均场转变h_x^c≈2.23；提取出相互一致的临界指数，并证明其在次近邻相互作用下的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了Cayley树上Ising边界普适类的数值证据；通过微调局域边界场可高效恢复无边界Bethe晶格物理，形成“有效Bethe线”，屏蔽大量边界并恢复其临界点与平均场临界标度。

title: Information Entropy as a Sensitive Diagnostic of Relaxation Dynamics in a Quasiperiodic Mott Insulator
summary: We study the nonequilibrium dynamics of a bosonic Mott insulator following a sudden quench from a periodic to a quasiperiodic lattice. Using ab initio multiconfigurational (MCTDHB) continuum many-body dynamics, we characterize the evolution through momentum distributions, fragmenta- tion, correlation functions, and information entropy. We find that melting of Mott correlations does not necessarily imply relaxation of the many-body state. In the weakly interacting regime, the initial Mott-like correlation undergo recurrent melting and partial recovery, while the information entropy displays large, intermittent fluctuations within the simulated time window. In contrast, a strongly interacting and fully fragmented Mott insulator retains its characteristic Mott correla- tions, up to partial distortions, while the many-body information entropy approaches a well-defined stationary regime plateau with comparatively small fluctuations. These results indicate that Mott- correlation dynamics and many-body relaxation can be dissociated in this finite system and support the use of information entropy, evaluated in the multiconfigurational representation, as a sensitive complementary diagnostic of nonequilibrium relaxation.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用多组态含时 Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov（MCTDHB）连续多体动力学，考察玻色 Mott 绝缘体（bosonic Mott insulator）在周期晶格突变为准周期晶格（quasiperiodic lattice）后的非平衡动力学（nonequilibrium dynamics），揭示 Mott 关联融化与多体弛豫（many-body relaxation）可相互解耦。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探究突变淬火（sudden quench）后 Mott 关联的演化是否必然伴随多体态的弛豫，并寻找能够灵敏刻画非平衡弛豫的互补诊断量。
AI.method: 采用从头算多组态（ab initio multiconfigurational）MCTDHB 连续多体动力学方法，通过动量分布（momentum distributions）、碎片化（fragmentation）、关联函数（correlation functions）与信息熵（information entropy）刻画演化过程。
AI.result: 弱相互作用区初始 Mott 类关联出现反复融化与部分恢复，信息熵在模拟时间窗口内呈现大幅间歇涨落；强相互作用且完全碎片化的 Mott 绝缘体则保留其特征 Mott 关联（仅有部分畸变），多体信息熵趋于稳定的定常平台且涨落较小。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在该有限体系中 Mott 关联动力学与多体弛豫可被解耦，并支持将多组态表象下计算的信息熵作为非平衡弛豫的灵敏互补诊断量。

title: Self-phoresis on a one-dimensional periodic domain
summary: We study the spontaneous motion and collective dynamics of self-phoretic particles on a one-dimensional periodic domain. The particles act as localized chemical sources (of a particle-dependent strength) of a field and the particles themselves respond to the gradients of the field they generate (with a particle-dependent phoretic mobility). The chemical field itself diffuses and evaporates. For a single particle, we derive the exact threshold for spontaneous propulsion and establish the emergence of stable constant-velocity states near onset through a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation. We then consider an active source coupled to a non-emitting tracer and determine the conditions for slipping and stable phase-locked motion. For two mutually coupled sources, the stationary antipodal configuration can lose stability through either a pitchfork or a Hopf bifurcation, depending on the relative source strengths and phoretic mobilities. We determine the competing instability thresholds and compare them with direct numerical simulations of the coupled particle-field equations. Beyond onset, the resulting translating and oscillatory states provide qualitative counterparts to modes of motion observed experimentally for camphor disks in annular water channels. These results connect the onset of individual propulsion, tracer entrainment, and collective motion within a common analytically tractable framework.

AI.tldr: 本文在一维周期域内研究自泳动（self-phoretic）粒子的自发运动与集体动力学，粒子作为局部化学源并响应自身生成的场梯度。通过解析推导与数值模拟，统一刻画了单粒子推进起爆、示踪粒子夹带及双粒子集体不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 实验中对樟脑盘（camphor disks）在环形水槽中的运动模式已有观测，但个体推进起爆、示踪粒子夹带与集体运动之间缺乏统一的、可解析处理的理论框架，本文旨在建立该联系。
AI.method: 构建一维周期域上耦合粒子-场方程：粒子为粒子依赖强度的局部化学源，并依粒子依赖的泳动迁移率（phoretic mobility）响应场梯度；化学场自身扩散并蒸发。采用解析推导（分岔分析）结合直接数值模拟进行验证。
AI.result: 单粒子情形：导出自发推进的精确阈值，并确立近阈稳定匀速态经超临界叉式分岔（supercritical pitchfork bifurcation）出现。源-惰性示踪粒子：确定滑移与稳定锁相运动的条 件。双相互耦合源：静止对跖（antipodal）构型可经叉式分岔或Hopf分岔失稳，取决于相对源强度与泳动迁移率；给出竞争性失稳阈值并与数值模拟比较。逾阈后出现平移态与振荡态。
AI.conclusion: 逾阈后的平移态与振荡态在定性上对应环形水槽中樟脑盘的实验运动模式，表明个体推进起爆、示踪粒子夹带与集体运动可在同一解析可处理框架内统一描述。

title: Molecular Precursor Chemistry Shapes Early-Stage Reaction Pathways in Nitrogen-Doped Carbon Nanotube Synthesis
summary: The structural characteristics of carbon nanotubes are usually discussed in terms of processes occurring during nanotube nucleation and subsequent growth from an already formed catalyst nanoparticle. Here, we show that their structural trajectory can begin much earlier, within the first nanoseconds of precursor decomposition and catalyst formation. We combine experiment and reactive molecular dynamics to compare nitrogen-free CNT synthesis with two closely related aromatic nitrogen precursors, pyridine and pyrazine, containing one and two nitrogen atoms per molecule, respectively. Experimentally, both nitrogen-containing precursors promote bamboo-like CNT formation and produce substantially more structurally disordered CNTs than the nitrogen-free reference. Notably, nitrogen incorporation does not scale simply with the amount of nitrogen supplied, demonstrating a strong contribution from precursor chemistry. Reactive molecular dynamics reveals that nitrogen-containing precursors significantly modify local Fe-carbon and Fe-SiO2 interactions during catalyst evolution, while pyridine and pyrazine exhibit distinct decomposition pathways, with pyrazine showing significantly greater decomposition within the simulated timescale. These results demonstrate that precursor chemistry influences the local chemical environment and early catalyst evolution, highlighting its potential role in the initial stages of CNT growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合实验与反应分子动力学（reactive molecular dynamics）表明，碳纳米管（carbon nanotubes, CNTs）的结构特征在催化剂形成的最初纳秒阶段即受前驱体化学（precursor chemistry）影响，而不仅由成核与生长过程决定。
AI.motivation: 传统上碳纳米管的结构特征多从纳米管成核及其在已形成催化剂纳米颗粒上的后续生长过程来解释；本文旨在揭示结构演化轨迹可能起始得更早，即在前驱体分解与催化剂形成的最初纳秒内。
AI.method: 将无氮碳纳米管合成与两种结构相近的芳香含氮前驱体（吡啶 pyridine 与吡嗪 pyrazine，每分子分别含一个和两个氮原子）进行对比，结合实验与反应分子动力学（reactive molecular dynamics）模拟。
AI.result: 实验中，两种含氮前驱体均促进竹节状（bamboo-like）碳纳米管形成，并产生结构无序程度显著更高的碳纳米管；氮的掺入量并不随供氮量简单变化，说明前驱体化学具有强烈贡献。反应分子动力学显示，含氮前驱体显著改变催化剂演化过程中的局部 Fe–碳与 Fe–SiO2 相互作用，且吡啶与吡嗪呈现不同的分解路径，其中吡嗪在模拟时间尺度内分解程度明显更高。
AI.conclusion: 前驱体化学通过影响局部化学环境与早期催化剂演化，在碳纳米管生长的初始阶段发挥潜在重要作用。

title: Trust-Limited Machine-Learning-Accelerated Nudged Elastic Band Calculations for Small-Polaron Hopping in Rutile TiO2
summary: Nudged elastic band (NEB) calculations of small-polaron hopping are demanding because nuclear motion is coupled to a self-consistent localized electronic state. Near the charge-transfer region, slow self-consistent-field convergence, localization switching, and competing electronic solutions complicate surrogate-assisted optimization. We develop a Gaussian-process-assisted NEB workflow for this regime and demonstrate electron small-polaron hopping in rutile TiO2 using spin-polarized density functional theory with a Hubbard U correction (DFT+U ) with SIESTA. A joint energy-force Gaussian process (GP) with a Matérn covariance model advances the elastic band, while active-atom root-mean-square and maximum-atom displacement limits constrain surrogate motion relative to evaluated configurations. Reaching these limits triggers first-principles sampling without requiring full surrogate convergence. Three independently DFT-verified 96-atom [001] calculations using 11, 13, and 15 images and different surrogate settings and GP parameterizations yield barriers of 0.1645, 0.1637, and 0.1640 eV, respectively, spanning 0.793 meV. In the 15-image calculation, repeated central-image sampling activates a separately calibrated local GP during surrogate optimization. Final full-band DFT verification gives a maximum projected NEB force of 0.0346 eV/Å. A 324-atom calculation yields a lower barrier of 0.1302 eV, indicating supercell sensitivity and demonstrating feasibility at larger GP observation dimension. The workflow combines controlled surrogate extrapolation, targeted charge-transfer-region interpolation, and independent DFT verification to obtain polaron migration pathways, emphasizing reproducible barriers and full-band force convergence.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种高斯过程（Gaussian process, GP）辅助的微动弹性带（nudged elastic band, NEB）工作流，用于处理小极化子（small polaron）跳跃中电子态与核运动耦合带来的收敛困难，并在金红石型 TiO2 中以 DFT+U 验证其可复现性与全带受力收敛性。
AI.motivation: 小极化子跳跃的 NEB 计算因核运动与自洽局域电子态耦合而代价高昂；在电荷转移（charge-transfer）区域附近，自洽场收敛缓慢、局域化切换与竞争性电子解使代理模型（surrogate）辅助优化难以稳定进行。因此需要一个能在此类困难区域可控推进并保持结果可复现的优化流程。
AI.method: 采用自旋极化密度泛函理论加 Hubbard U 修正（DFT+U）与 SIESTA，构建能量-力联合高斯过程（GP）并使用 Matérn 协方差模型推进弹性带；通过活性原子均方根位移与最大原子位移阈值约束代理运动相对已评估构型的位置。达到阈值即触发第一性原理采样，无需代理完全收敛；并在重复采样中心图像时激活单独校准的局部 GP，最终以全带 DFT 验证。
AI.result: 三次独立 DFT 验证的 96 原子 [001] 计算（分别使用 11、13、15 个图像及不同代理设置与 GP 参数化）给出的势垒为 0.1645、0.1637 和 0.1640 eV，跨度仅 0.793 meV；15 图像计算中最终全带 DFT 验证的最大投影 NEB 力为 0.0346 eV/Å。324 原子计算得到更低的势垒 0.1302 eV，表明存在超胞（supercell）敏感性，并证明在更大 GP 观测维度下的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流将受控的代理外推（surrogate extrapolation）、针对电荷转移区域的定向插值与独立的 DFT 验证相结合，用于获得极化子迁移路径，并强调势垒结果的可复现性与全带受力收敛。

title: Magnetic properties and excitation spectrum of the S = 1/2 three-legged spin ladder, LiMoOP2O7
summary: We report a comprehensive experimental study including density functional theory calculations detailing the magnetic ground state of the $S = 1/2$ Mo$^{5+}$ pyrophosphate, LiMoOP2O7, and its magnetic excitations. Neutron powder diffraction measurements confirm the $P2_1/n$ structural model which is comprised of a three-legged ladder of distorted Mo$^{5+}$ octahedra. Magnetometry and specific heat reveal a long-range magnetic ordering transition at $T_\textrm{N} = 3.5$~K and a field-induced transition at $μ_{0}$H$_\textrm{c}$ = 1 T. This zero-field long-range magnetic order was determined to be a commensurate $κ= 0$ order with an ordered moment that is reduced from the full $S = 1/2$ magnetic moment by 30%. Through inelastic neutron scattering measurements and density functional theory calculations, we define the minimal microscopic model and resolve the spin Hamiltonian up to the seventh leading exchange parameter, resulting in a model with dominant antiferromagnetic leg interactions, weaker ferromagnetic rung interactions, and a significant interlayer ferromagnetic coupling.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合中子散射实验与密度泛函理论（density functional theory, DFT）计算，确定LiMoOP2O7中Mo5+（S=1/2）的磁性基态与磁激发，揭示其三角形三腿梯子结构中的长程磁有序及主导交换相互作用。
AI.motivation: 针对S=1/2的Mo5+焦磷酸盐LiMoOP2O7的磁性基态与磁激发缺乏系统认识，本文旨在通过综合实验与理论计算明确其磁有序性质与自旋哈密顿量。
AI.method: 采用中子粉末衍射（neutron powder diffraction）确认P21/n结构模型，结合磁化测量与比热研究相变，并通过非弹性中子散射（inelastic neutron scattering）与密度泛函理论计算解析自旋哈密顿量。
AI.result: 中子粉末衍射确认其为畸变Mo5+八面体构成的三腿梯子结构；磁化与比热显示TN=3.5 K的长程磁有序及μ0Hc=1 T的场诱导相变；零场有序为κ=0公度序，有序矩较满S=1/2矩减少30%；确定最小微观模型并解析至第七阶主导交换参数。
AI.conclusion: LiMoOP2O7的自旋哈密顿量以反铁磁腿内相互作用为主，梯级相互作用为较弱的铁磁性，并存在显著的层间铁磁耦合。

title: Mutual linearity from classical response theory
summary: We unify known mutual-linearity relations for Markov jump processes and chemical reaction networks within a common framework based on classical finite-response theory. In a Markov jump process, an exact finite-response identity shows that all stationary probability changes share a common factor when the rates of one edge change. Eliminating this factor gives the relations between probabilities, observables, and currents, even far from equilibrium. We also explain how the same argument applies when one coefficient of a linear system changes and recovers the known relations in Laplace space and between stationary complex activities in chemical reaction networks.

AI.tldr: 该文基于经典有限响应理论（classical finite-response theory），将马尔可夫跳跃过程（Markov jump process）与化学反应网络（chemical reaction network）中已知的互线性关系（mutual-linearity relations）统一到同一框架下，并借助有限响应恒等式解释其成立机制。
AI.motivation: 马尔可夫跳跃过程与化学反应网络中已有若干互线性关系，但此前彼此独立、缺乏统一解释。该文旨在为这些关系提供一个共同的理论框架，说明其来源具有一致性。
AI.method: 采用经典有限响应理论。对马尔可夫跳跃过程，当单条边（edge）的速率改变时，导出精确的有限响应恒等式（finite-response identity），表明所有稳态概率（stationary probability）变化共享同一因子；通过消去该因子，得到概率、（可观测量）observables与流（currents）之间的关系。随后将同一论证推广至线性系统（linear system）某一系数变化的情形。
AI.result: 得到的概率、可观测量与流之间的关系在远离平衡（far from equilibrium）时仍然成立。同一论证可复现已有的拉普拉斯空间（Laplace space）关系，以及化学反应网络中稳态复活度（stationary complex activities）之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 经典有限响应理论可为马尔可夫跳跃过程与化学反应网络中的互线性关系提供统一推导，且不依赖近平衡假设，从而将分散的已知结果纳入同一解释框架。

title: Mutual information across the commensurate--incommensurate crossover and near the Kosterlitz--Thouless point of the spin-$\tfrac12$ $J_1$--$J_2$ Heisenberg chain
summary: What quantum mutual information adds to conventional correlation functions is often unclear. We study the spin-1/2 $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg chain, using DMRG on infinite chains and periodic rings and an SU(2) decomposition of the mutual information into correlation channels. For singlet ground states the two-site mutual information is an exact function of the spin correlator, so any additional content must come from blocks. In the dimerized phase, blocks resolve bond-energy correlations in the SU(2)-scalar channel without an independent asymptotic length: singlet and triplet correlation lengths agree to about 1%. The scalar channel dominates block mutual information at large distances in the commensurate regime up to $J_2/J_1=0.40$, but falls to a few percent beyond the disorder point, which coincides numerically with the Majumdar-Ghosh point $J_2/J_1=1/2$; the structure-factor peak splits only at the Lifshitz point $J_2/J_1=0.520622(2)$. On the gapless side we compare block mutual information on rings extrapolated to infinite size with the two-interval prediction of SU(2)$_1$ conformal field theory across the Kosterlitz-Thouless point $J_2/J_1=0.241167$. There, for block lengths $l\le6$, the correction decays as $l^{-p}$ with $p=1.96$-$2.07$, and any logarithmic term is at least 60 times smaller than in the Heisenberg chain. Expanding in the marginal coupling (from level spectroscopy) the first-order coefficient is consistent with $l^{-2}$ scaling and the second-order coefficient is positive for $x\le1/4$, suggesting that the mutual information relative to the field-theory value becomes stationary at the KT point for large blocks. The scalar-channel share approaches 1/4 at small cross ratio $x$, as expected from SO(4) symmetry; under two stated assumptions its first-order response to the coupling is $(3/8)\ln x-5/8$ at small $x$, matched by the $l=4$ data within 1-3% at $x\le1/9$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自旋-1/2 $J_1$-$J_2$ 海森堡链中量子互信息（quantum mutual information）相对于常规关联函数的额外信息内容，通过 DMRG（密度矩阵重整化群）与 SU(2) 通道分解，揭示二聚相中块互信息可分辨键能关联，并刻画无能隙侧的共形场论修正与标量通道占比。
AI.motivation: 量子互信息相较传统关联函数（correlation functions）究竟提供哪些额外信息尚不清晰，尤其在强关联自旋链中缺乏系统性的通道级分析。
AI.method: 采用无限链与周期性环上的 DMRG 计算，并对互信息作 SU(2) 分解为不同关联通道；对环状体系外推至无限尺寸，并与 SU(2)$_1$ 共形场论（conformal field theory）的双区间预言及能级谱学给出的边缘耦合展开进行对比。
AI.result: 单态基态下两点互信息是自旋关联函数的精确函数，额外内容来自块；二聚相中标量通道可分辨键能关联，单态与三重态关联长度约差 1%；标量通道在 $J_2/J_1=0.40$ 以内主导远距块互信息，无序点后降至百分之几，且数值上与 Majumdar-Ghosh 点 $J_2/J_1=1/2$ 重合；结构因子峰仅在 Lifshitz 点 $J_2/J_1=0.520622(2)$ 处分裂。无能隙侧 $l\le6$ 时修正以 $l^{-p}$（$p=1.96$-$2.07$）衰减，对数项至少比海森堡链小 60 倍；标量通道占比在小交比 $x$ 下趋近 1/4。
AI.conclusion: 块互信息的 SU(2) 通道分解能区分不同物理机制；在 KT 点 $J_2/J_1=0.241167$ 附近，相对于场论值的互信息随块尺寸增大趋于稳定，且标量通道响应在小 $x$ 下与 SO(4) 对称性预期一致。

title: Microscopic Modeling of Interlayer Tunneling in Twisted Bilayer Cuprates
summary: The field of twistronics, recently extended to twisted bilayer cuprate systems, has generated considerable interest due to the prediction of $d+id'$ states close to a $45^\circ$ twist, as suggested by multiple experimental probes. Theoretical studies of these systems using a variety of models and many-body theoretical techniques have revealed multiple competing order parameters. The large variability in experimental results and theoretical predictions demands an accurate microscopic model for these systems, in particular a more realistic description of the interlayer tunneling. In this study, we fit the in-plane hopping and compute the interlayer tunneling amplitudes by calculating the orbital overlap between $d_{x^2-y^2}$ wave functions at each site of the twisted square-lattice model. We observe sign-changing tunneling amplitudes, a strong twist-angle dependence of the direct tunneling term, and long-range tunneling amplitudes that often dominate over direct tunneling. We investigate the band structure, Fermi surfaces, and spectral functions in comparison with those obtained from the phenomenological model and find a substantial redistribution of spectral weight that modifies the competition between different superconducting ground states. We determine the phase diagram as a function of twist angle, filling, and direct tunneling strength, which is controlled by the $c$-axis distance between the monolayers, and observe a reduction in the region of time-reversal-symmetry-breaking (TRSB) $d+id'$ states compared with the phenomenological model. Finally, we investigate the Josephson critical current across the phase diagram and find strongly suppressed critical currents close to a $45^\circ$ twist, consistent with experimental observations.

AI.tldr: 通过基于轨道重叠的第一性原理式拟合，构建比唯象模型更真实的扭转双层铜氧化物微观模型，发现层间隧穿幅值变号、长程隧穿主导及谱重重新分布，并据此给出相图与约瑟夫森临界电流结果。
AI.motivation: 扭转电子学（twistronics）已扩展至扭转双层铜氧化物体系，多种实验探针预测在接近45°扭转角时出现d+id'态，但实验与理论结果差异较大，亟需精确的微观模型，尤其是对层间隧穿（interlayer tunneling）的更真实描述。
AI.method: 在扭转方晶格模型（twisted square-lattice model）中，通过计算各格点d_{x^2-y^2}波函数之间的轨道重叠，拟合面内跃迁（in-plane hopping）并算出层间隧穿幅值；随后计算能带结构、费米面与谱函数，并与唯象模型（phenomenological model）对比，进而确定相图并研究约瑟夫森临界电流（Josephson critical current）。
AI.result: 隧穿幅值呈现符号变化，直接隧穿项（direct tunneling term）对扭转角有强依赖，长程隧穿幅值常超过直接隧穿；谱重发生显著重新分布，改变了不同超导基态之间的竞争；相较唯象模型，时间反演对称破缺（time-reversal-symmetry-breaking, TRSB）的d+id'态区域缩小；在接近45°扭转角处约瑟夫森临界电流被强烈压制，与实验观测一致。
AI.conclusion: 更真实的层间隧穿描述会显著改变谱重分布与基态竞争，使TRSB d+id'相的区域小于唯象模型预测，且能自然再现45°附近临界电流的压制，表明微观隧穿细节对扭转铜氧化物相图与输运性质具有决定性影响。

title: First-fracture kinetics in periodic chains: from free-energy landscapes and dynamical recrossing to absolute rates
comment: 18-page article with 12 figures and supplementary information. Code and supporting data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23318388
summary: The nearly collinear configuration of highly stretched polymer chains before fracture motivates one-dimensional models. At fixed extension, stretching one bond redistributes length among the others, coupling rupture to the whole chain. In this work, I develop a framework for fracture-healing rates in periodic Morse chains, combining deterministic theories, equilibrium simulations and a quasi-deterministic approach using equilibrium fluxes and barrier-top trajectories. Constrained-partition calculations closely reproduce simulated populations and intact-state tensions. An intact-reservoir potential of mean force (PMF) supplies the first-fracture surface probability, while recrossing corrects the attempt flux without a rate-fitted prefactor. Independent rate tests identify an operational chain-length boundary for accurate two-state kinetics; failed-return durations decrease relative to population relaxation as chains grow. Kramers-Grote-Hynes (KGH), nonlinear reactive-flux and equilibrium rates show excellent agreement in this regime. KGH predicts rates away from coexistence and a chain-dependent local activation length dominated by the barrier response. Rates decrease approximately exponentially before declining more gently for longer chains: barrier growth dominates, additional fracture sites partly compensate, and transmission varies more weakly. Beyond coexistence, long chains can fracture practically irreversibly because healing becomes too rare to observe. Projected committor crossings, where the configuration-averaged probability of reaching the fractured core first is one half, lie near site-PMF maxima, although configurations at equal bond length retain different fracture probabilities. Multiple fractures remain negligible near coexistence through at least $N=50$. The framework could supply state-dependent rates to mesoscopic fracture models of polymer networks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高度拉伸聚合物链的近共线构型，建立周期性Morse链中断裂-愈合速率（fracture-healing rates）的理论框架，结合确定性理论、平衡模拟与准确定性方法，给出状态依赖速率并可用于介观聚合物网络断裂模型。
AI.motivation: 高度拉伸聚合物链在断裂前呈近共线构型，这促使采用一维模型描述。由于固定伸长下拉伸某一化学键会重新分配长度，断裂过程与整条链耦合，因此需要建立能够刻画断裂-愈合速率及其链长依赖的理论框架。
AI.method: 工作结合确定性理论、平衡模拟（equilibrium simulations）以及基于平衡通量（equilibrium fluxes）和势垒顶部轨迹（barrier-top trajectories）的准确定性方法；采用约束配分（constrained-partition）计算、完整储库势平均力（potential of mean force, PMF）与再穿越（recrossing）修正尝试通量，并进行独立速率测试与Kramers-Grote-Hynes（KGH）分析。
AI.result: 约束配分计算可再现模拟布居与完整态张力；PMF给出首次断裂面概率，再穿越修正无需速率拟合前因子。独立速率测试确定了准确两态动力学的链长边界；随链增长失败返回时长相对布居弛豫缩短。KGH、非线性反应通量（nonlinear reactive-flux）与平衡速率在该区域高度一致。速率在共存附近随链长近似指数下降、更长链趋于平缓；KGH预言远离共存的行为及由势垒响应主导的链依赖局域激活长度。共存的另一侧，长链断裂近乎不可逆，愈合太罕见而无法观测。投影committor穿越点位于位点PMF极大值附近，相等键长构型仍具不同断裂概率；至少至$N=50$，多重断裂在共存附近可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可提供状态依赖速率并服务于聚合物网络（polymer networks）的介观断裂模型，同时揭示链长对断裂-愈合动力学与两态近似适用范围的边界。

title: First-Principles Calculations of the Electron-Hole-Pair Creation Energy in Semiconductors and Dielectrics
summary: We present first-principles calculations of the electron-hole-pair creation energy in semiconductors and dielectrics, focusing in particular on AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2. We have employed density functional theory (DFT) to calculate the band structure, density-functional perturbation theory to obtain the phonon dispersion, and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) to calculate the electron energy loss function (via the dielectric function). We performed full-band Monte Carlo simulations of electron thermalization for energies up to ~100 eV and calculated the average energy required to excite an electron-hole pair. We calculated pair-creation energies of approximately 12.2, 6.5, 7.3, 3.10, and 16.7 eV/pair for AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2, respectively. These values are in good agreement with measured data, with the largest discrepancy being that of Si (about 14.9% lower than the accepted experimental value of ~3.6 eV/pair). To improve the agreement for Si, we used the GW approach and the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) to calculate the quasiparticle shifts of the electronic band structure and the dielectric function, respectively. Finally, using the GW/BSE data, we calculated a creation energy of ~3.50 eV/pair. We find that the marked improvement in the accuracy of the calculated creation energy, when using the GW/BSE approach, is primarily attributable to the slight decrease in the magnitude of the electron energy-loss function when using the GW/BSE approach for energies below ~10-15 eV. Overall, it is clear that the competition between phonon emission and ionization near the intersection of the phonon scattering and ionization rates is largely responsible for determining the value of the creation energy, with the other major factor being the location and shape of the plasmon peak in the energy-loss function.

AI.tldr: 本文采用第一性原理方法（DFT、TDDFT、GW/BSE 及全带蒙特卡洛模拟）计算 AlN、3C-SiC、4H-SiC、Si 与 SiO2 中电子-空穴对（electron-hole pair）的激发能，结果与实验吻合良好，其中 Si 采用 GW/BSE 后精度显著提升。
AI.motivation: 半导体与介电材料中电子-空穴对激发能（pair-creation energy）的精确预测对理解电子热化与电离过程具有重要意义，而现有计算与实验值之间仍存在偏差。本文旨在通过多方法结合的第一性原理计算，系统评估并改进该能量的预测精度，尤其针对误差最大的 Si。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算能带结构，密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）获取声子色散，含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）经介电函数求电子能量损失函数；并开展能量至约 100 eV 的全带蒙特卡洛（full-band Monte Carlo）电子热化模拟。针对 Si，进一步使用 GW 方法与 Bethe-Salpeter 方程（BSE）分别计算准粒子能带修正与介电函数。
AI.result: 计算得到 AlN、3C-SiC、4H-SiC、Si 与 SiO2 的对激发能分别约为 12.2、6.5、7.3、3.10 与 16.7 eV/pair，与实测数据吻合良好；最大偏差出现在 Si，比公认实验值（约 3.6 eV/pair）低约 14.9%。改用 GW/BSE 数据后，Si 的激发能计算值约为 3.50 eV/pair。
AI.conclusion: 采用 GW/BSE 后 Si 激发能精度的显著提升，主要归因于在约 10–15 eV 以下能量范围内电子能量损失函数幅值的轻微减小。总体而言，声子发射与电离在声子散射率与电离率交点附近的竞争，是决定激发能数值的主要因素，另一关键因素则是能量损失函数中等离激元峰（plasmon peak）的位置与形状。

title: Emergent low-energy thermodynamics and universal $B/T$ scaling in $α$-RuCl$_3$
summary: Quantum spin liquids are exotic states of matter in which strongly interacting spins remain disordered down to zero temperature and host fractionalized excitations. This has motivated an extensive search for their realization in materials. Among candidate systems, $α$-RuCl$_3$ has drawn particular attention as a platform for the quantum spin liquid proposed by Kitaev, in which the low-energy excitations in applied magnetic fields are interpreted as itinerant Majorana fermions and local flux excitations. However, conflicting experimental signatures have cast doubt on whether a Kitaev quantum spin liquid-like state is really the right starting point to interpret the low-energy states in $α$-RuCl$_3$, motivating a closer look at the nature of these excitations. Here we report an extensive high field study of specific heat up to 35 T on $α$-RuCl$_3$.
