Separating the two requires measuring the lattice distortion as a function of excitation density, over a range spanning the low densities of a solar cell under sunlight and the much higher densities used in most ultrafast experiments. On this basis, we propose experiments that can clarify how photogenerated carriers behave in lead-halide perovskites.

AI.tldr: 该文质疑铅卤钙钛矿（lead-halide perovskites）中“光生载流子以大极化子（large polaron）形式运动并借此屏蔽缺陷”的主流图像，指出三项新发现动摇了这一观点，并提出通过测量晶格畸变随激发密度的变化来厘清载流子行为。
AI.motivation: 主流观点认为铅卤钙钛矿中的光生载流子以大极化子形式运动，其伴随的晶格畸变可屏蔽载流子与带电缺陷的相互作用，从而解释缺陷容忍性（defect tolerance）。三项近期发现对该图像构成挑战，需要重新审视极化子形成与缺陷容忍性之间的因果联系。
AI.method: 本文为观点与分析性论述：综合时间分辨结构探测（time-resolved structural probes）、不同维度（3D 至 2D）钙钛矿的载流子-晶格耦合（carrier-lattice coupling）比较、缺陷容忍性的首次直接检验以及新输运数据，并提出针对性的后续实验方案。
AI.result: 第一，时间分辨结构探测虽已直接测得光致晶格畸变，但计算显示仅晶格热运动即可提高载流子有效质量（effective mass），而该质量增加此前被视为极化子证据，故载流子周围晶格畸变是否为极化子仍不明确。第二，材料由 3D 减薄至 2D 时载流子-晶格耦合增强；Ruddlesden-Popper 与 Dion-Jacobson 两类 2D 钙钛矿经不同通道耦合，其行为差异由主导耦合通道而非仅由晶格刚度决定。第三，缺陷容忍性的首次直接检验并未指向极化子屏蔽，作者将其归因于柔软而无序的晶格；新输运数据显示极化子屏蔽降低载流子间散射，但不能证明其保护载流子免受缺陷影响。
AI.conclusion: 即使极化子形成得以确立，也不能据此确立极化子是缺陷容忍性的成因。区分二者需在跨越太阳光照下太阳能电池的低激发密度与多数超快实验所用高激发密度的范围内，测量晶格畸变随激发密度的函数关系；据此提出可澄清铅卤钙钛矿中光生载流子行为的实验方案。

title: Orthoexciton-to-paraexciton conversion rate in Cu$_2$O at sub-Kelvin temperatures
summary: We measured the conversion rate from 1s orthoexcitons to 1s paraexcitons in Cu$_2$O below 1 K using a dilution refrigerator. To determine the conversion rate, we performed time-resolved luminescence spectroscopy of 1s orthoexcitons and 1s paraexcitons confined in a strain-induced trap potential. From the time evolution of the $Γ$$_3$$^{-}$-LO-phonon-assisted luminescence of 1s orthoexcitons, we obtained a conversion rate of $5.9 \times 10^7$ s${^{-1}}$ at a mixing-chamber temperature of 64 mK under an applied stress of 2.2 kbar. Between 64 and 800 mK, the conversion rate depends only weakly on temperature, and it is less than half of the value of $1.6 \times 10^8$ s${^{-1}}$ reported at 2 K under the same applied stress. The conversion rate therefore continues to decrease below 2 K, contrary to the previous expectation that it becomes nearly constant below about 1.7 K. We discuss these results in terms of the momentum distribution of orthoexcitons, which does not reach equilibrium with the lattice during the conversion at these low temperatures. These findings call for a theory that accounts for both the small magnitude of the conversion rate and its weak temperature dependence below 1 K.

AI.tldr: 该研究在低于1 K的稀释制冷机（dilution refrigerator）条件下测量了Cu$_2$O中1s正激子（orthoexciton）向1s仲激子（paraexciton）的转化率，发现其随温度持续下降，与既有预期相悖。
AI.motivation: 此前预期该转化率在约1.7 K以下趋于恒定，但缺乏低于1 K的低温实验验证，故需测量极低温下转化率的温度依赖行为。
AI.method: 采用稀释制冷机，结合时间分辨发光光谱（time-resolved luminescence spectroscopy），测量应变诱导势阱（strain-induced trap potential）中1s正激子的$Γ_3^-$-LO声子辅助发光随时间的演化。
AI.result: 在混合室温度64 mK、外加应力2.2 kbar下得到转化率为$5.9 \times 10^7$ s$^{-1}$；在64至800 mK间转化率对温度依赖较弱，且低于同应力下2 K处报道的$1.6 \times 10^8$ s$^{-1}$。
AI.conclusion: 转化率在2 K以下持续减小，与先前近恒定的预期相反；作者以正激子动量分布（momentum distribution）在转化过程中未与晶格达到平衡来解释，并呼吁建立能同时解释转化率数值偏小及低于1 K时温度依赖微弱的新理论。

title: Colossal Spin--Lattice--Charge Coupling in Noncollinear Ferrimagnetic NbMnX$_2$ ($X$ = S, Se, Te) Monolayers
summary: Noncollinear ferrimagnets combine a net magnetic moment with internal spin degrees of freedom, creating opportunities to couple magnetic, mechanical, thermal, and electronic responses. Using first-principles calculations, symmetry analysis, atomistic spin simulations, and transport modeling, we identify stable NbMnX$_2$ ($X$ = S, Se, Te) monolayers with noncollinear ferrimagnetic ground states and Curie temperatures up to 313 K. Competing exchange, Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interactions, and magnetic anisotropy produce field-responsive canted states that couple strongly to the lattice and charge carriers. Magnetization rotation changes the elastic modulus of NbMnTe$_2$ by up to 36\%, while lattice entropy substantially enhances the near-room-temperature magnetocaloric response of NbMnS$_2$ and NbMnSe$_2$. In NbMnSe$_2$, rotation restores a mirror-protected crossing, continuously closes an approximately 0.13 eV gap, and produces a conductivity-based anisotropic magnetoresistance ratio up to 10,000\% at 100 K. The combined results establish noncollinear NbMnX$_2$ monolayers as a multifunctional platform for two-dimensional spintronics, nanomechanics, and thermal control.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合第一性原理（first-principles）计算、对称性分析、原子尺度自旋模拟与输运建模，识别出具有非共线亚铁磁（noncollinear ferrimagnetic）基态的单层 NbMnX$_2$（X = S, Se, Te），居里温度（Curie temperature）最高达 313 K，并揭示其磁-力-热-电多功能耦合特性。
AI.motivation: 非共线亚铁磁体（noncollinear ferrimagnets）同时具备净磁矩与内部自旋自由度，为磁、力、热、电响应的耦合提供可能，但稳定存在且具室温相关物性的二维材料平台仍待探索。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算、对称性分析、原子尺度自旋模拟（atomistic spin simulations）以及输运建模（transport modeling），研究 NbMnX$_2$ 单层中交换作用、Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya 相互作用（Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interactions）与磁各向异性（magnetic anisotropy）的竞争。
AI.result: NbMnX$_2$ 单层具非共线亚铁磁基态，居里温度最高 313 K；外场可诱导倾斜态（canted states）并强烈耦合晶格与载流子。NbMnTe$_2$ 磁化转动使弹性模量（elastic modulus）变化达 36\%；晶格熵增强 NbMnS$_2$ 与 NbMnSe$_2$ 的近室温磁热（magnetocaloric）响应。NbMnSe$_2$ 中转动恢复镜像保护的交叉点（mirror-protected crossing），连续关闭约 0.13 eV 带隙，并在 100 K 产生高达 10,000\% 的基于电导的各向异性磁阻比（anisotropic magnetoresistance ratio）。
AI.conclusion: 非共线 NbMnX$_2$ 单层被确立为面向二维自旋电子学（two-dimensional spintronics）、纳米力学（nanomechanics）与热控制（thermal control）的多功能平台。

title: ARES: a plane-wave density-functional-theory code in Rust
summary: ARES (Ab initio atomic mateRial modEling Software at JLU) is a plane-wave density-functional-theory (DFT) code written entirely in Rust as a layered 22-crate workspace. It supports norm-conserving pseudopotentials and the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method with the local-density approximation (LDA) and Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functionals, Γ-only and explicit k-point sampling, smearing and mixing, forces, stress, relaxation, band structures, densities of states (DOS) and dispersion corrections; execution is serial or MPI-distributed over k-point pools, band groups and plane-wave rows. The code's distinguishing engineering choice is its validation apparatus. Every numerical component is checked against Quantum ESPRESSO driven from the same physical and numerical inputs, and the comparison is organized as numbered fixtures kept in the repository whose reference data is regenerated by a script instead of being captured once. On six materials spanning a semiconductor, three metals and two two-dimensional systems, band energies within one electronvolt of the Fermi level agree with the reference to a median below 0.4 meV. The pseudopotentials the code reads are validated against all-electron reference data as well: the median delta factor is 0.696 meV/atom over all 65 paired elements. Restrictions are stated with the capabilities: two functionals, no spin-polarized or spin-orbit path, a stress implementation with an explicit scope, and no accelerator execution.

AI.tldr: ARES 是吉林大学开发的平面波密度泛函理论（density-functional theory, DFT）软件，以 Rust 编写为 22 个 crate 的分层工作区，其核心特色是系统化的验证机制：所有数值组件均与 Quantum ESPRESSO 在同输入条件下对比，并以可再生成参考数据的编号夹具（fixture）组织。
AI.motivation: 论文动机在于提供一款全 Rust、分层的平面波 DFT 代码，并将可复现、可再生成的验证体系作为其区别于同类实现的核心工程选择，以提升数值正确性的可核查性。
AI.method: 采用模守恒赝势与投影缀加波（projector augmented-wave, PAW）方法，支持 LDA 与 PBE 泛函、Γ 点与显式 k 点采样、展宽与混合、力、应力、弛豫、能带结构、态密度（density of states, DOS）与色散修正；执行方式为串行或基于 MPI 在 k 点池、能带组与平面波行上分布。验证上逐组件对照 Quantum ESPRESSO，使用同一物理与数值输入，并以仓库内编号夹具保存、由脚本重新生成参考数据。
AI.result: 在涵盖一个半导体、三种金属与两个二维体系的六种材料上，费米能级 1 eV 范围内的能带能量与参考值一致，中位偏差低于 0.4 meV；所读取赝势亦对照全电子参考数据验证，65 组配对元素的中位 delta 因子为 0.696 meV/atom。
AI.conclusion: ARES 在多种材料与赝势上实现了与参考实现的高精度一致性，同时明确声明其能力边界：仅支持两种泛函、无自旋极化与自旋轨道路径、应力实现范围有明确限定，且不支持加速器执行。

title: Imaging atomic-scale surface structure and superconducting gap of the misfit layered compound (SnS)1.17NbS2
summary: Superlattices of van der Waals-coupled two-dimensional materials offer a platform for engineering electronic band structure and fostering emergent quantum states. Misfit layered compounds provide naturally assembled superlattices, in which crystallographically distinct two-dimensional subsystems coexist within a single bulk crystal. Therein, the presence of both commensurate and incommensurate lattice directions introduces structural modulation, which might alter real-space electronic orders such as superconductivity. Here, we investigate the atomic-scale surface structure and local superconductivity of the misfit layered compound (SnS)1.17NbS2 using structural characterization, electrical transport, and low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM). While X-ray diffraction and cross-sectional scanning transmission electron microscopy confirm the bulk misfit structure, STM resolves large SnS- and NbS2-terminated terraces, where the surface atomic registry differs from the bulk misfit structure. Furthermore, tunnelling spectroscopy at 2 K reveals nearly identical superconducting gaps on both terminations, and the spatial variation of the gap shows no visible modulation that corresponds to the misfit lattice. These results establish an atomic-scale picture of the surface structure and superconducting states of this naturally assembled misfit heterostructure.

AI.tldr: 对天然失配层状化合物（misfit layered compound）(SnS)1.17NbS2 的表面原子结构与局域超导性进行原子尺度研究：体相失配结构经 XRD 与截面 STEM 确认，但 STM 显示表面原子配准与体相不同，且 2 K 隧穿谱在两个终止面上给出近乎相同的超导能隙，未见与失配晶格对应的空间调制。
AI.motivation: 范德华（van der Waals）耦合二维材料超晶格可用于能带工程与新兴量子态调控；失配层状化合物提供天然自组装超晶格，其中共格（commensurate）与非共格（incommensurate）晶格方向共存所导致的结构调制可能改变实空间电子序（如超导）。因此需要厘清此类天然失配异质结的表面结构与局域超导态。
AI.method: 结合结构表征、电输运测量与低温扫描隧道显微镜/隧穿谱（STM，2 K）对 (SnS)1.17NbS2 进行表征：以 X 射线衍射（XRD）和截面扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）确认体相失配结构，用 STM 分辨表面终止面与原子配准，并以隧穿谱测量超导能隙及其空间分布。
AI.result: XRD 与截面 STEM 确认了体相失配结构；STM 分辨出大面积 SnS 与 NbS2 终止的平台（terrace），其表面原子配准不同于体相失配结构。2 K 下隧穿谱在两个终止面上均观测到近乎相同的超导能隙，且能隙的空间变化未显示与失配晶格对应的可见调制。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了该天然自组装失配异质结表面结构与超导态的原子尺度图像：尽管体相存在失配结构调制，表面配准发生重构，且局域超导能隙在两种终止面上保持近乎一致、无显著实空间调制。

title: Conformal soft modes at elastic instabilities
summary: In case a crystal is close to a continuous elastic phase transition, pronounced critical fluctuations emerge. We show that on the level of linear elasticity theory the displacement vector for these critical modes obeys a condition reminiscent of the conformal Killing equation. For an isostructural instability, four critical modes arise corresponding to one dilation and three special conformal transformations. At crystal symmetry-breaking instabilities, the critical fluctuations include a continuum of modes even for crystals with finite size. For certain cases, these comprise the conformal transformations associated with two-dimensional Minkowski space. These results have implications for critical elastic phenomena as well as for extremal mechanical metamaterials.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，接近连续弹性相变的晶体中，临界涨落的位移场在线性弹性理论层面满足类似共形Killing方程的条件，并由此得到与膨胀及特殊共形变换对应的临界模式，进而关联临界弹性现象与极端力学超材料。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于理解晶体接近连续弹性相变（continuous elastic phase transition）时显著临界涨落（critical fluctuations）的理论结构，并将弹性临界行为与共形几何及力学超材料（mechanical metamaterials）联系起来。
AI.method: 方法基于线性弹性理论（linear elasticity theory），考察临界模式的位移矢量（displacement vector），证明其满足类似共形Killing方程（conformal Killing equation）的条件，并按等结构不稳定性与对称破缺不稳定性分类讨论。
AI.result: 结果显示：对于等结构不稳定性（isostructural instability），出现四个临界模式，分别对应一个膨胀（dilation）与三个特殊共形变换（special conformal transformations）；在晶体对称破缺不稳定性（symmetry-breaking instability）下，即使晶体尺寸有限，临界涨落也包含连续模式谱，某些情形下涵盖与二维Minkowski空间相关的共形变换。
AI.conclusion: 结论指出这些结果对临界弹性现象（critical elastic phenomena）以及极端力学超材料（extremal mechanical metamaterials）具有启示意义。

title: WannierSTM: Efficient superconducting scanning-probe spectroscopy from maximally localized Wannier functions
summary: We present a Python-based program that combines maximally localized Wannier functions-based first-principles electronic structure with the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism to enable efficient simulations of scanning tunneling microscopy (STM). The workflow builds upon standard density functional theory packages to construct compact transport Hamiltonians that preserve the properties of realistic materials. Superconductivity is incorporated via an effective pairing potential within the Nambu-spinor formalism, while coupling to the STM tip and substrate electrodes is treated using the wide-band limit approximation. Within this formulation, transport quantities such as current-voltage characteristics and differential conductance are evaluated in a closed analytical form. This avoids explicit numerical energy integrations and enables rapid spectroscopic calculations over broad parameter spaces. The framework provides a unified and computationally efficient approach for modeling superconducting hybrid nanostructures with spin-orbit coupling, magnetic textures, and spin polarization. Representative applications in spin chains, two-dimensional and molecular magnets on a superconductor demonstrate its robust capabilities for both simple model systems and realistic ab initio molecular structures relevant to modern STM experiments.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一个基于 Python 的程序，将最大局域化瓦尼尔函数（maximally localized Wannier functions）第一性原理电子结构与非平衡格林函数（nonequilibrium Green's function）形式结合，实现高效的扫描隧道显微镜（scanning tunneling microscopy, STM）模拟，并支持超导杂化纳米结构的谱学计算。
AI.motivation: 旨在为含自旋轨道耦合（spin-orbit coupling）、磁织构与自旋极化的超导杂化纳米结构提供统一且计算高效的 STM 建模途径，同时兼顾真实材料性质与现代 STM 实验相关的从头算分子结构。
AI.method: 以标准密度泛函理论（density functional theory）软件包为基础，构建保持真实材料性质的紧致输运哈密顿量；超导性通过 Nambu 旋量（Nambu-spinor）形式下的有效配对势（effective pairing potential）引入，针尖与衬底电极耦合采用宽能带极限近似（wide-band limit approximation）处理，输运量以闭合解析形式求解。
AI.result: 电流-电压特性与微分电导等输运量可获得闭合解析结果，避免显式数值能量积分，从而支持在宽广参数空间内快速进行谱学计算；在自旋链、二维与分子磁体/超导体体系上的代表性应用验证了其能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为同时包含自旋轨道耦合、磁织构和自旋极化的超导杂化纳米结构建模提供了一种统一、计算高效的方法，适用于简单模型系统与真实从头算分子结构。

title: Thermal stability and structural ordering of thick Co$_2$MnAl films grown on MgO and Si substrates
summary: While most studies on Co$2$MnAl (CMA) focus on the ultrathin regime for spintronic junctions, applications scaling with magnetic volume--such as Anomalous Nernst Effect (ANE) energy harvesters, integrated power inductors, and magnetic MEMS--require significantly thicker films. In this work, 750 nm thick CMA films were grown on MgO (001) and Si substrates to establish a roadmap for their thermal integration. Structural analysis reveals that B2 ordering is optimized on MgO at 600 $^\circ$C, which is important for functional devices. In contrast, samples on Si substrates exhibit a disorder transition toward the A2 phase, closely linked to diffusion-driven degradation processes. Above 500 $^\circ$C, Si interdiffusion into the Heusler layer triggers the formation of interfacial silicides and Kirkendall voids, leading to microcracking, electrical resistivity jumps, and a final fully disordered A2 phase. Despite the Mn-poor stoichiometry (Co$2.25$Mn$0.7$Al$1.05$), the films maintain a robust saturation magnetization of ~600 emu/cm$^3$, consistent with recent theoretical models for off-stoichiometric Heusler alloys. These results define the processing windows for integrating thick CMA layers into multifunctional CMOS-compatible platforms.

AI.tldr: 该工作针对磁体积缩放型应用（如反常能斯特效应能量收集器、集成功率电感、磁MEMS），在MgO(001)与Si衬底上生长750 nm厚Co2MnAl（CMA）薄膜，建立了其热集成工艺窗口路线图。结果表明MgO上600 °C可实现最优B2有序化，而Si上超过500 °C发生Si互扩散，形成界面硅化物与Kirkendall空洞，导致微裂纹、电阻率跃升并最终转变为完全无序A2相。尽管Mn贫配比（Co2.25Mn0.7Al1.05），薄膜仍保持约600 emu/cm³的饱和磁化强度。
AI.motivation: 既有Co2MnAl（CMA）研究多聚焦于自旋电子结用超薄薄膜，而依赖磁体积缩放的器件（反常能斯特效应能量收集器、集成功率电感、磁MEMS）需要显著更厚的膜层。因此需要明确厚CMA薄膜在不同衬底上的热稳定性与集成工艺窗口。该研究旨在为厚CMA层融入多功能CMOS兼容平台建立工艺路线图。
AI.method: 在MgO(001)与Si衬底上生长750 nm厚的CMA薄膜，并对其进行结构与电学表征，以评估热集成行为。通过结构分析考察B2有序化与A2相转变随温度的变化，并结合电阻率与显微分析揭示界面反应与退化机制。
AI.result: MgO衬底上600 °C时B2有序化达到最优，对功能器件具有重要意义；Si衬底样品则出现向A2相的无序转变，与扩散驱动的退化过程密切相关。500 °C以上，Si向Heusler层互扩散，引发界面硅化物与Kirkendall空洞形成，进而导致微裂纹、电阻率跃升，最终形成完全无序的A2相。尽管配比为Mn贫的Co2.25Mn0.7Al1.05，薄膜仍保持约600 emu/cm³的饱和磁化强度，与近期非化学计量Heusler合金的理论模型相符。
AI.conclusion: 研究界定了将厚CMA层集成到多功能CMOS兼容平台中的工艺窗口。MgO衬底有利于获得最优B2有序化，而Si衬底在500 °C以上因Si互扩散与界面硅化物、Kirkendall空洞形成而快速退化至A2相。厚CMA薄膜在Mn贫配比下仍具备稳健的饱和磁化强度，支持其面向磁体积缩放型应用的集成潜力。

title: Field-free Magnetoacoustic Nonreciprocity via Exchange-bias Engineering
summary: Nonreciprocal wave propagation is essential for directional signal processing and isolation. Magnetoacoustic systems are attractive platforms for nonreciprocal devices because of their small footprint and passive operation. However, pronounced nonreciprocity typically requires an external bias field,limiting device miniaturization and integration. Here, we demonstrate field-free magnetoacoustic nonreciprocity in an IrMn/FeGaB/Cu/FeGaB multilayer integrated with a shear-horizontal-wave delay line. Exchange-bias engineering stabilizes a remanent magnetic state with broken time-reversal and spatial-inversion symmetries while tailoring the spin-wave dispersion to achieve resonant magnetoacoustic coupling at zero field. The normalized isolation reaches 21 dB/mm, with its sign programmable by the field-sweep history. Further numerical optimization predicts a zero-field normalized isolation of 91 dB/mm by increasing the dynamical magnetic asymmetry. Our work establishes exchange-bias engineering as a promising route toward compact RF isolators and circulators and as a general strategy for realizing magnetoacoustic devices without external magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 该工作在外加偏置场为零的条件下，于 IrMn/FeGaB/Cu/FeGaB 多层膜与剪切水平波（shear-horizontal wave）延迟线集成结构中实现了磁声（magnetoacoustic）非互易传播，归一化隔离度达 21 dB/mm，并通过数值优化预测可达 91 dB/mm。
AI.motivation: 非互易波传播（nonreciprocal wave propagation）对定向信号处理与隔离器至关重要；磁声系统因小尺寸与无源工作而具吸引力，但其显著非互易性通常依赖外部偏置场，限制了器件小型化与集成。
AI.method: 采用 IrMn/FeGaB/Cu/FeGaB 多层膜与剪切水平波延迟线集成，利用交换偏置工程（exchange-bias engineering）稳定具有时间反演与空间反演对称性破缺的剩余磁态，并在零场下通过调控自旋波色散（spin-wave dispersion）实现共振磁声耦合。
AI.result: 实现零场磁声非互易性，归一化隔离度（normalized isolation）达 21 dB/mm，其符号可由场扫描历史（field-sweep history）编程；数值优化表明，通过增大动态磁不对称性，零场归一化隔离度预计可达 91 dB/mm。
AI.conclusion: 交换偏置工程可作为实现紧凑型射频隔离器与环形器（RF isolators and circulators）的有前景路径，并为无外部磁场的磁声器件提供通用策略。

title: Direct view of exciton and carrier dynamics in twisted bilayer graphene
summary: Twisted bilayer graphene (tBLG) on H-intercalated SiC (twist angle of $9 \pm 1^{\circ}$) is studied by position\mbox{-}, time\mbox{-}, and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). Both graphene layers are hole doped, with a Dirac-point offset of 30~meV. Time-resolved ARPES near the van Hove singularity reveals a spectral feature within the hybridization-induced band gap, together with excited electrons in the conduction band. The in-gap feature exhibits distinct dynamics, and its binding energy and $k$-space location are consistent with the proposed non-hydrogenic ``ghost-Fano'' exciton arising from destructive interference between two nearly degenerate excitonic channels. Near the Dirac points, the twist separates the largely layer-polarized Dirac cones in momentum space, providing direct layer selectivity. We find markedly different peak electronic temperatures in the two graphene layers, even though their subsequent cooling dynamics are very similar. We attribute this to an ultrafast interlayer redistribution of electronic energy, driven by an interlayer electric field that arises from the different doping in the layers.

AI.tldr: 利用位置、时间与角度分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）研究生长于氢插层SiC上的扭角双层石墨烯（tBLG，扭角9±1°），在杂化诱导带隙内观测到与理论预言的"ghost-Fano"激子相符的带隙内（in-gap）谱特征，并揭示两层间电子温度的显著差异及超快层间能量再分布。
AI.motivation: 扭角双层石墨烯中电子关联与激子效应是核心议题，但杂化诱导带隙内是否存在非氢原子型激子、以及层间电子能量如何转移，缺乏直接的动量与时间分辨实验证据。该工作旨在通过时间分辨ARPES在动量与能量空间直接探测这些现象。
AI.method: 在H插层SiC衬底上制备扭角为9±1°的tBLG，采用位置分辨、时间分辨与角度分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）在范霍夫奇点（van Hove singularity）附近及狄拉克点（Dirac point）附近进行测量；利用扭角导致的层极化狄拉克锥在动量空间分离实现层选择性探测。
AI.result: 两层石墨烯均为空穴掺杂，狄拉克点偏移约30 meV。时间分辨ARPES在杂化诱导带隙内观测到带隙内谱特征，同时导带中存在激发电子；该带隙内特征具有独特动力学，其结合能与k空间位置与提出的非氢原子型"ghost-Fano"激子（源于两个近简并激子通道之间的相消干涉）相符。在狄拉克点附近，扭角将层极化狄拉克锥在动量空间分离，实现直接层选择。两层表现出显著不同的峰值电子温度，但后续冷却动力学十分相似。
AI.conclusion: 带隙内谱特征被归因于非氢原子型"ghost-Fano"激子，为tBLG中的激子物理提供了直接实验证据。两层峰值电子温度的显著差异被归因于超快的层间电子能量再分布，其驱动力为源于两层不同掺杂的层间电场。

title: Knowledge-Guided Construction of Machine Learning Potentials for Reactive Behavior in Energetic Materials
summary: Energetic materials involve multiple interactions, making reliable machine-learning potentials (MLPs) difficult to construct without extensive datasets. Here, we enhance the ability of the neural network interatomic potential (NNAP) to describe molecular systems using sphmulti, a refined spherical-harmonic basis set that combines extra radial basis with element-specific chemical weighting in each radial channel. We further integrate hyperactive learning, farthest-point sampling, and iterative sufficiency criteria with knowledge-guided key events, enabling the NNAP to retain essential information for describing the material system. For 3,3'-diamino-4,4'-azoxyfurazan, the resulting NNAP is trained on only 13,680 configurations yet captures key properties, including the isomerization barrier, pyrolysis activation energy, and shock Hugoniot behavior. NNAP-driven molecular dynamics simulations further reveal that pyrolysis proceeds through furazan-ring opening followed by chain reactions, whereas shock loading induces anisotropic hydrogen transfer driven by interlayer structural deformations. This work enables efficient and reliable MLPs for energetic materials.

AI.tldr: 提出改进的球形谐波基组 sphmulti 并结合主动学习策略，使神经网络原子间势（NNAP）在仅 13,680 个构型上即可可靠描述含能材料，并揭示其热解与冲击响应机制。
AI.motivation: 含能材料（energetic materials）涉及多重相互作用，常规条件下构建可靠的机器学习势（machine-learning potentials, MLPs）通常依赖大规模数据集，数据成本高。因此需要提升势函数对分子体系的描述能力并降低数据需求。
AI.method: 提出精细球形谐波基组 sphmulti，在每个径向通道中结合额外径向基函数与元素特定的化学权重；并将超活跃学习（hyperactive learning）、最远点采样（farthest-point sampling）、迭代充分性判据与知识引导的关键事件相结合，用于 NNAP 的训练数据构建与筛选。
AI.result: 针对 3,3'-二氨基-4,4'-偶氮氧化呋咱（3,3'-diamino-4,4'-azoxyfurazan），所得 NNAP 仅用 13,680 个构型训练，即可捕获异构化势垒（isomerization barrier）、热解活化能（pyrolysis activation energy）与冲击 Hugoniot 行为等关键性质。
AI.conclusion: NNAP 驱动的分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟表明：热解经由呋咱环开环及后续链式反应进行；冲击加载则因层间结构变形诱发各向异性氢转移。该工作为含能材料提供了高效可靠的 MLPs 构建途径。

title: Hydrogen partial pressure as a key parameter in the reactive sputtering of photochromic YHO thin films
summary: Oxygen-containing yttrium hydride (YHO) thin films were synthesised by reactive magnetron sputtering over a wide range of hydrogen-to-argon gas flow ratios (H2/Ar) during yttrium hydride deposition, followed by post-oxidation in air. The deposition process was monitored in situ by plasma optical emission spectroscopy. X-ray diffraction reveals a strong dependence of crystallographic texture on the H2/Ar ratio: highly <100>-textured films formed at low H2/Ar ratios progressively evolve into more polycrystalline microstructures with slightly reduced crystallite size as the hydrogen content increases. The optical transmittance gradually decreases from approximately 85 % to 70 % as the H2/Ar ratio is raised to 0.6, followed by a sharp drop at higher hydrogen contents. The photochromic contrast of 690-820 nm thick YHO films, measured after 10 min of illumination with a solar simulator, decreases from 14 % to 7 % as the H2/Ar ratio increases from 0.08 to 0.60. Thinner films (360-490 nm) exhibit a similar but less pronounced trend. Bleaching kinetics, analysed using a double-exponential model, indicate faster recovery, with effective bleaching time constants of approximately 1-15 min for films deposited at H2/Ar < 0.25. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals higher oxygen incorporation in films deposited at lower H2/Ar ratios, deviating from the commonly reported correlation between oxygen content and photochromic response in YHO. These results demonstrate that low hydrogen partial pressure during reactive sputtering is advantageous for achieving higher optical transparency, enhanced photochromic contrast, and faster bleaching kinetics in YHO thin films.

AI.tldr: 通过反应磁控溅射（reactive magnetron sputtering）在不同氢氩流量比（H2/Ar）下沉积含氧氢化钇（YHO）薄膜并经空气后氧化处理发现，低 H2/Ar 比有利于获得高光学透明度、增强的光致变色对比度（photochromic contrast）与更快的漂白动力学（bleaching kinetics）。
AI.motivation: 探明 H2/Ar 气流比（即氢分压）如何调控 YHO 薄膜的晶体织构、光学透明性与光致变色响应，并检验氧气含量与光致变色响应之间的常见关联是否成立。
AI.method: 采用反应磁控溅射（reactive magnetron sputtering）在宽范围 H2/Ar 比下沉积 YHO 薄膜，随后在空气中后氧化；利用等离子体发射光谱（plasma optical emission spectroscopy）原位监测沉积过程，并用 X 射线衍射（X-ray diffraction）、光学透射、太阳光模拟器光照实验及 X 射线光电子能谱（X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy）进行表征。
AI.result: 织构随 H2/Ar 升高由强 <100> 织构向多晶（polycrystalline）微结构演变并伴随微晶尺寸略减；透射率由约 85% 降至 70%（H2/Ar 升至 0.6），更高氢含量时急剧下降。690-820 nm 厚膜的光致变色对比度随 H2/Ar 从 0.08 增至 0.60 而由 14% 降至 7%，较薄膜（360-490 nm）趋势相似但更弱；H2/Ar < 0.25 的薄膜有效漂白时间常数约为 1-15 min。低 H2/Ar 沉积的薄膜氧掺入更高，偏离了常报道的氧含量与光致变色响应的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 反应溅射过程中较低的氢分压有利于 YHO 薄膜获得更高光学透明度、更强光致变色对比度与更快漂白动力学。

title: Evolution of dense liquid marbles under light tapping
summary: Liquid marbles interface is composed by a dense network of grains trapped by capillarity at their surface. The mix of capillarity and granular character make their interfaces remarkable, allowing non wetting, high mobility and strong robustness which are a basis for numerous applications. A canonical experiment showing out of equilibrium nature of granular material is the so called tapping experiment, where a dry granular medium under vertical vibration reorganize an evolve toward a denser final state function of the vibration amplitude In this paper we explore the out of equilibrium nature of densely covered liquid marbles by measuring their shape, compaction and stresses evolution under vertical vibration. We show that liquid marble do indeed reorganize when submitted to taps, leading to higher internal pressure and lower effective surface tension.

AI.tldr: 本文研究密集覆盖颗粒的液态弹珠（liquid marble）在垂直振动下的非平衡行为，发现其经拍击（tapping）后发生重组，内部压强升高、有效表面张力降低。
AI.motivation: 液态弹珠界面由毛细作用（capillarity）捕获的密集颗粒网络构成，兼具毛细与颗粒特性，具备非润湿、高流动性和强鲁棒性。干颗粒介质在垂直振动下的拍击实验是展示其非平衡本质的经典实验，本文据此探究液态弹珠的非平衡特性。
AI.method: 通过测量密集覆盖液态弹珠在垂直振动下的形状、压实程度与应力演化，考察其非平衡行为。
AI.result: 液态弹珠在受到拍击时确实发生重组，导致内部压强升高、有效表面张力（effective surface tension）降低。
AI.conclusion: 液态弹珠的界面呈现非平衡颗粒介质的特征，其拍击响应表现为内部应力增强与有效表面张力下降。

title: Tellurium trioxide as an n-type wide-gap semiconductor with ultrahigh work functions from first principles
summary: The exploration of next-generation wide-gap semiconductors with extreme work functions is highly desirable for the continued advancement of electronic and optoelectronic devices. By using first principles calculations, we show that \b{eta}-TeO3, with a wide band gap exceeding 3 eV, emerges as a promising n-type semiconductor exhibiting ultrahigh work functions of up to ~8 eV. Intentionally or unintentionally incorporated interstitial H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, and Zn impurities and substitutional F impurities are identified as shallow donors, whereas O vacancies act as minor carrier-compensating defects that locally trap electrons at neighbouring Te sites. The work function is evaluated across a series of low-index nonpolar surfaces. The presence of ordered O vacancies is energetically favoured on these surfaces and tends to reduce the corresponding work functions. These findings underscore the significance of precise control over the O chemical potential to suppress surface O-vacancy formation, thereby preserving the exceptional electronic performance of \b{eta}-TeO3 associated with ultrahigh work functions. Collectively, the results highlight the potential of \b{eta}-TeO3 for hole injection/extraction/transport layers as well as transparent electrodes for applications such as light-emitting devices and photovoltaic cells, while providing useful guidance on carrier doping and surface tuning for these practical applications through elucidating the effects of the point-defect and surface configurations on the electronic properties.

AI.tldr: 基于第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），β-TeO₃ 被证明是一种带隙超过 3 eV、功函数高达约 8 eV 的 n 型宽带隙半导体候选材料，其间隙杂质与 F 替位为浅施主，而 O 空位会降低功函数。
AI.motivation: 电子与光电器件（electronic and optoelectronic devices）的持续发展需要具有极端功函数的下一代宽带隙半导体（wide-gap semiconductors），但此类材料稀缺，因此探索新型高功函数宽带隙半导体具有重要价值。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（first principles calculations），考察 β-TeO₃ 的能带与功函数，分析间隙杂质（interstitial impurities）H、Li、Na、Cu、Mg、Zn 及替位 F 杂质、O 空位等点缺陷，并评估一系列低指数非极性表面（low-index nonpolar surfaces）上的功函数。
AI.result: β-TeO₃ 带隙超过 3 eV，功函数最高约 8 eV；间隙杂质与替位 F 为浅施主（shallow donors），O 空位为次要的载流子补偿缺陷（carrier-compensating defects），在邻近 Te 位点局域俘获电子；有序 O 空位在这些表面能量上更有利并倾向于降低功函数。
AI.conclusion: 精确控制 O 化学势（O chemical potential）以抑制表面 O 空位形成，是保持 β-TeO₃ 超高功函数优异电子性能的关键；该材料有望用于空穴注入/提取/传输层（hole injection/extraction/transport layers）及透明电极（transparent electrodes），并可指导载流子掺杂与表面调控。

title: Organisation and aggregation of calcium carbonate ions in water via molecular simulation
summary: Crystallisation of calcium carbonate (CaCO$_3$) in aqueous solutions is essential for carbon dioxide sequestration and the sustainable production of calcium carbonate materials, which are widely used in industry and increasingly explored for novel applications. While crystallisation is often analysed within the framework of classical nucleation theory, CaCO$_3$ and other ionic crystals often form through amorphous precursor phases, motivating the need for alternative descriptions. In this work, we investigate the relationship between the formation of the first CaCO$_3$ coordination sphere, a fundamental unit of local ordering, and ionic aggregation using two complementary simulation approaches: on-the-fly probability-enhanced sampling (OPES) and asynchronous and infinite-swap replica exchange transition interface sampling ($\infty$RETIS). OPES was used to explore free-energy landscapes, whereas $\infty$RETIS was used to determine reaction kinetics. We studied systems at two levels of supersaturation, between which the formation of the first coordination sphere exhibited distinct kinetic behaviour. These differences were found to be linked to concentration-dependent ionic aggregation. At lower concentration, aggregation remains limited, whereas higher concentration promotes extensive spinodal-like aggregation. For both concentrations, the first coordination sphere forms within the pre-formed clusters through one of two distinct pathways: either within a cluster close to the minimum size required for its formation, or within larger amorphous aggregates whose size and structure depend on concentration. The coexistence of these pathways at both levels of supersaturation reveals the multifaceted nature of early-stage CaCO$_3$ crystallisation and highlights the importance of differentiating ionic aggregation and organisation.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合 OPES 与 ∞RETIS 两种模拟方法，研究碳酸钙（CaCO₃）水溶液中第一配位球形成与离子聚集的关系，揭示两条共存形成路径及其对浓度的依赖性。
AI.motivation: CaCO₃ 结晶对二氧化碳封存（carbon dioxide sequestration）与碳酸钙材料可持续生产至关重要，但经典成核理论（classical nucleation theory）难以描述经由无定形前驱相（amorphous precursor phases）的离子晶体形成过程，因此需要替代性描述框架。
AI.method: 采用两种互补模拟方法：即时概率增强采样（on-the-fly probability-enhanced sampling, OPES）用于探索自由能景观（free-energy landscapes），以及异步无限交换副本交换过渡界面采样（asynchronous and infinite-swap replica exchange transition interface sampling, ∞RETIS）用于确定反应动力学（reaction kinetics）；在两种过饱和度（supersaturation）水平下开展研究。
AI.result: 两种过饱和度下第一配位球形成呈现不同动力学行为，差异与浓度依赖的离子聚集（ionic aggregation）相关：低浓度时聚集受限，高浓度时促进广泛的类旋节线聚集（spinodal-like aggregation）。第一配位球在预形成团簇内通过两条路径之一形成——靠近形成所需最小尺寸的团簇内，或尺寸与结构依赖浓度的较大无定形聚集体内。
AI.conclusion: 两条路径在两种过饱和度下的共存揭示了早期 CaCO₃ 结晶的多面性，并强调区分离子聚集与离子组织（organisation）的重要性。

title: Local-resolvent formulation and assessment of linear-scaling Kohn-Sham calculations
summary: Kohn-Sham density-functional theory is expensive because it needs orbitals that extend over the whole system. For insulators this can be avoided by using only the diagonal of the one-electron resolvent, $g(\mathbf{r},z)=\langle\mathbf{r}|(z-\hat h)^{-1}|\mathbf{r}\rangle$, at a few complex energies $z$. We call the scheme local-resolvent density-functional theory (LRes-DFT). The density and the band energy are linear in $g$, so neither orbitals nor a kinetic-energy functional are needed. The complex energies are $M$ equally spaced points on a circle that encloses the occupied levels, offset by half a spacing so that no point lies on the real axis. Summing the resolvent over them is equivalent to occupying each level with $1/(1+u^M)$, where $u$ is the level's energy measured from the circle's center in units of its radius. This is a smooth step that is near 1 inside the circle and near 0 outside, and it stays between 0 and 1 for every $M$. If the circle moves with the chemical potential, forces at fixed electron number are exact. Gauss-Legendre and Zolotarev rules need fewer points when the gap is small. In three dimensions we use eigenpairs of small windows around each molecule instead of resolvents. This is divide-and-conquer (DC) with a different occupation function, and it is as accurate as DC with Fermi-Dirac occupations. For H$_2$ molecular crystals of up to 1024 electrons it agrees with Kohn-Sham to $2.5\times10^{-7}$ Ha per electron. On one core it is slower than dense diagonalization below about 500 electrons and 3.5 times faster at 1024 electrons. It loses accuracy for disordered or compressed systems and for diffuse basis functions.

AI.tldr: 提出局域预解式密度泛函理论（local-resolvent density-functional theory, LRes-DFT）：用少数复能量处单电子预解式的对角元替代全局轨道，构建仅依赖预解式的密度与能带能表达式，并在 H₂ 分子晶体上验证其精度与线性标度潜力。
AI.motivation: Kohn-Sham 密度泛函理论（Kohn-Sham density-functional theory, KS-DFT）因需要覆盖整个体系的轨道而计算昂贵。对绝缘体，仅使用单电子预解式（one-electron resolvent）的对角元即可避免轨道计算，从而规避动能泛函与轨道的需求。
AI.method: 在环绕占据能级的圆上取 M 个等间距复能量点（偏移半个间距，使其不落在实轴上），对预解式对角元求和，等效于以 1/(1+u^M) 占据各能级，形成平滑台阶函数。圆随化学势移动时，固定电子数下的力精确；小带隙可用 Gauss-Legendre 与 Zolotarev 规则减少点数。三维实现采用每个分子小窗口的本征对，形成具有不同占据函数的 divide-and-conquer（DC）方案。
AI.result: 该方法对 H₂ 分子晶体（至多 1024 电子）与 KS-DFT 的一致度达每电子 2.5×10⁻⁷ Ha。单核计算中，约 500 电子以下慢于密集对角化（dense diagonalization），1024 电子时快 3.5 倍；精度与采用 Fermi-Dirac 占据的 DC 相当。
AI.conclusion: LRes-DFT 无需轨道与动能泛函，可在绝缘体中获得近精确的力与高精度密度。其局限在于对无序或压缩体系以及弥散基函数会损失精度。

title: Effects of the choice of the exchange-correlation functional on high-temperature superconductivity predictions in covalent-cage M(BN)5 family
summary: The recent experimental synthesis of covalent cage superconductors has ignited hopes for ambient-pressure high-temperature superconductivity, while the computational strategy for discovering new materials poses challenges for accurately estimating superconducting properties. Here, we quantified the response of electron-phonon coupling (EPC) properties in M(BN)5 superconductors to different exchange-correlation (XC) effects using high-throughput first-principles calculations. We found that the metallic covalent bonds responsible for superconductivity exhibit anomalously high sensitivity to functional selection uncertainty, distinguishing them from conventional superconductors mediated by metallic bonding. The widely used PBE functional systematically overestimates lattice volumes, inducing phonon softening, enhanced EPC, and consequent Peierls instability. In contrast, PBEsol, which is more accurate through enhanced treatment of short-range interactions, eliminates imaginary frequencies in Rb(BN)5 that appear at the PBE level, yielding an outstanding superconducting critical temperature (Tc) of 113 K at ambient pressure and 138 K at 2 GPa. Enhanced electron localization and short-range correlation in covalent bonds manifest through dual mechanisms: phonon hardening at the lattice scale and band widening at the electronic scale, which collectively suppress Peierls distortion and delocalize antibonding states. Pressure-dependent analysis reveals that compression attenuates phonon discrepancies between XC functionals, whereas electronic properties remain notably sensitive to XC-induced perturbations of fine electronic bands near the Fermi level.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过高通量第一性原理计算，量化了M(BN)5笼状超导体中电子-声子耦合对交换-关联泛函选择的异常敏感性，并证明PBEsol泛函预测Rb(BN)5在常压下具有113 K的超导临界温度。
AI.motivation: 共价笼状超导体的实验合成激发了常压高温超导的期望，但准确估算超导性质的计算策略仍面临挑战，尤其是交换-关联效应带来的不确定性。
AI.method: 采用高通量第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），量化M(BN)5超导体中电子-声子耦合（electron-phonon coupling, EPC）性质对不同交换-关联（exchange-correlation, XC）效应的响应，并开展压力依赖分析。
AI.result: PBE泛函系统性高估晶格体积，引发声子软化、EPC增强及Peierls不稳定性；PBEsol消除PBE层面出现的Rb(BN)5虚频，给出常压113 K、2 GPa下138 K的超导临界温度（Tc）。增强的电子局域化与短程关联通过晶格尺度声子硬化与电子尺度能带展宽的双重机制抑制Peierls畸变并使反键态离域。
AI.conclusion: 对M(BN)5超导性负责的金属性共价键对泛函选择不确定性表现出异常高敏感性，区别于金属键介导的传统超导体；压缩可减弱不同XC泛函间的声子差异，而电子性质对费米能级附近精细电子带的XC扰动仍高度敏感。

title: Non-Hermitian Statistical Geometry
comment: 17 pages of main text, 34 pages of Supplemental Material; 12 figures in total
summary: Particle exchange in two dimensions gives rise to quantum statistics beyond the boson-fermion dichotomy, with central roles in fractional quantum Hall physics, topological quantum computation, and strongly correlated quantum matter. In conventional topological phases, microscopic exchange geometry is compressed into rigid braid and fusion data. We develop a theory of non-Hermitian statistical geometry in which relaxing Hermiticity softens these exchange data into a larger complex space of spectral and relative-geometric degrees of freedom. For two adjacent braid generators, a single projective exchange spectrum is insufficient: their relative eigenline geometry supplies an additional gauge-invariant modulus. On the generic irreducible two-channel branch, braid consistency locks these coordinates through an exact spectrum-geometry relation. Using Riesz projectors and Kato transport, we realize this geometry in a five-arm Kitaev-Majorana network and test spectral and relative-geometric responses in an independent two-dimensional four-vortex Kitaev model. Finite-time dynamics tests the exchange operation, microscopic fusion sewing tests its composition across fusion descriptions, and matched-spectrum controls isolate the role of relative geometry. Nonzero projective Kato curvature shows that braid-consistent, fusion-coherent exchange can depend on the control path. Non-Hermiticity thus exposes exchange geometry, braid consistency re-locks it, fusion coherence further constrains it, and projective flatness determines when geometric exchange becomes intrinsically topological.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非厄米统计几何（non-Hermitian statistical geometry）理论，将传统拓扑相中刚性的编织（braid）与融合（fusion）数据软化为复空间中的谱几何自由度，并揭示投影平坦性决定几何交换何时成为内禀拓扑。
AI.motivation: 二维粒子交换产生超越玻色-费米二分的量子统计，在分数量子霍尔物理、拓扑量子计算与强关联量子物质中居核心地位。传统拓扑相将微观交换几何压缩为刚性编织与融合数据，缺乏对交换几何本身自由度的刻画。
AI.method: 通过放宽厄米性（Hermiticity）构建非厄米统计几何框架，引入相邻编织生成元间的相对本征线几何模量，并利用 Riesz 投影算符（Riesz projectors）与 Kato 输运（Kato transport）在五臂 Kitaev-Majorana 网络与二维四涡旋 Kitaev 模型中实现与检验该几何。
AI.result: 单一投影交换谱不足，相对本征线几何提供额外规范不变模量；在一般不可约双通道分支上，编织一致性通过精确谱-几何关系锁定坐标。非零投影 Kato 曲率（projective Kato curvature）表明编织一致、融合相干的交换可依赖于控制路径，匹配谱对照可分离相对几何的作用。
AI.conclusion: 非厄米性暴露交换几何，编织一致性将其重新锁定，融合相干性进一步约束之，而投影平坦性（projective flatness）决定几何交换何时成为内禀拓扑。该框架为拓扑量子计算与强关联量子物质提供了超越刚性编织数据的统计几何视角。

title: High-throughput screening of Heusler alloys for thermoelectrics combining machine-learned densities of states and first-principles transport
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables; Supplementary Information (21 pages) included
summary: Thermoelectrics turn waste heat into electricity, but finding new ones requires transport calculations too costly for whole databases. Searches therefore choose what to calculate from the electronic density of states (DOS), increasingly predicted by machine learning, yet such choices are rarely tested. We test them on all 106,235 Heusler structures in the DXMag database, screening 51,257 on density-functional spectra and 54,978 on neural-network predictions, and judging both by 3,625 band-structure and transport calculations. A DOS-derived Seebeck indicator ranks most compounds passing every transport and stability test within the top 1% of their population, and ten of the eleven established half-Heusler thermoelectrics calculated pass. Predicted spectra lose most band gaps, unnoticed by spectral-similarity metrics, yet still rank passing compounds near the top. The screen certifies 80 computational candidates, 61 without reported measurements. Computed or predicted, the DOS can choose what to calculate; only a band structure shows whether a gap exists.

AI.tldr: 该工作以 DXMag 数据库中全部 106,235 个 Heusler 结构为对象，检验基于电子态密度（density of states, DOS）的筛选策略是否可靠；结果表明 DOS 导出的 Seebeck 指标可将通过全部输运与稳定性测试的化合物排在前 1%，即使使用神经网络预测谱（丢失多数带隙）仍有效，最终筛出 80 个计算候选材料。
AI.motivation: 寻找新热电（thermoelectric）材料需要进行成本高昂的输运计算（transport calculations），难以覆盖整个材料数据库；因此搜索流程常以电子态密度（DOS）为依据决定计算哪些体系，其中 DOS 越来越多由机器学习预测，但此类筛选选择的有效性很少被验证。
AI.method: 在 DXMag 数据库中全部 106,235 个 Heusler 结构上开展测试：其中 51,257 个基于密度泛函（density-functional）谱筛选，54,978 个基于神经网络（neural-network）预测筛选，并以 3,625 次能带结构（band-structure）与输运计算作为评判标准。
AI.result: 由 DOS 导出的 Seebeck 指标（Seebeck indicator）能将大多数通过全部输运与稳定性测试的化合物排在其所属群体的前 1%；在计算得到的 11 个已确立半赫斯勒（half-Heusler）热电材料中有 10 个通过筛选。预测谱虽然丢失了大部分带隙（band gaps）且谱相似性（spectral-similarity）指标未能察觉，但仍能把通过的化合物排在接近前列。筛选共确认 80 个计算候选材料，其中 61 个尚无报道的测量数据。
AI.conclusion: 无论是计算得到还是预测得到的 DOS，均可用于决定"计算什么"；但只有能带结构才能判断是否存在带隙。这提示基于 DOS 的高通量筛选（high-throughput screening）在排序上可行，但带隙判定的可靠性仍需依赖能带结构计算。

title: Orientation-Resolved Nanoindentation of Single Crystal Ti-15Mo: Inverted Elastic Anisotropy and Yield-Onset Behavior Beyond Simple CRSS Predictions
summary: Ti-15Mo (wt%) is a well-established $β$-stabilized alloy whose mechanical response is strongly governed by phase stability and deformation mechanisms that operate at the single-grain scale. Because these intragranular mechanisms are intrinsically anisotropic, understanding the orientation dependence of the elastic and plastic response is critical to the texture-engineered processing of wrought components. Here, we quantify the nanomechanical anisotropy of single-crystal Ti-15Mo by combining EBSD with nanoindentation to correlate hardness, indentation modulus, strain rate sensitivity, and indentation yield response with the crystallographic surface normal near $\langle111\rangle,\langle124\rangle,\langle011\rangle,\langle023\rangle$, and $\langle013\rangle$ directions. While the modulus anisotropy is small (~10%), contrary to the prediction for a cubic crystal with A>1, orientations near $\langle111\rangle$ exhibit the lowest moduli. Yield onset is likewise softest near $\langle111\rangle$ and spans 41%, while hardness spans only 6.6% and follows neither the modulus nor the yield ordering. The alloy also exhibits yield behavior not captured by the simple CRSS/Schmid-factor models evaluated here. Strain-rate-jump tests yield V*=18-31b$^3$, consistent with kink-pair-nucleation-controlled plasticity; based on V*, the orientations separate into two groups suggestive of glide-dominated versus twin/transformation-participating response. We reveal an inversion of the elastic anisotropy expected for a homogeneous cubic $β$-phase and an orientation-dependent yield-onset response that is not reproduced by the simple Schmid-factor models examined here. Retained athermal $ω$ is proposed as the contributor because $β\rightarrowω$ collapse occurs on {111}$_β$ planes and may provide anelastic compliance through the reversible $ω\rightarrowβ$ transformation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过EBSD与纳米压痕（nanoindentation）联用，量化单晶Ti-15Mo的纳米力学各向异性，揭示弹性各向异性反转及取向依赖的屈服起始行为，并提出残余无热ω相为潜在机制来源。
AI.motivation: Ti-15Mo作为β稳定合金，其力学响应受单晶尺度相稳定性与变形机制控制，且这些晶内机制本质上各向异性；因此理解弹性与塑性响应的取向依赖性对织构工程化加工至关重要。
AI.method: 结合电子背散射衍射（EBSD）与纳米压痕，将硬度、压痕模量、应变速率敏感性（strain rate sensitivity）及压痕屈服响应与近⟨111⟩、⟨124⟩、⟨011⟩、⟨023⟩、⟨013⟩方向的晶体学表面法向相关联，并进行应变速率跳跃（strain-rate-jump）测试以获取激活体积V*。
AI.result: 模量各向异性较小（约10%），但与A>1立方晶体的预测相反，近⟨111⟩取向模量最低；屈服起始在近⟨111⟩最软且跨度达41%，硬度跨度仅6.6%且顺序既不随模量也不随屈服；V*=18-31b³，符合扭折对形核（kink-pair-nucleation）控制塑性，并据此将取向分为滑移主导与孪生/相变参与两组。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了均质立方β相预期弹性各向异性的反转，以及简单Schmid因子模型无法复现的取向依赖屈服起始响应；提出残余无热ω相因β→ω塌缩发生于{111}β面并提供可逆ω→β相变的无弹柔度，作为上述现象的贡献因素。

title: Quantitative Impact of Occupation Smearing Methods on Conventional Superconductivity: from Electronic Structure through Lattice Dynamics to Electron-Phonon Coupling
summary: In first-principles calculations of metallic systems, the discrete electronic mesh in the Brillouin zone necessitates a smearing function and its width (e.g., the widely used 0.02 Ry Methfessel-Paxton scheme) to enforce continuity of energy and occupation at the Fermi surface. However, the quantitative impact of such empirical parameters on phonon-mediated superconductivity has long been overlooked, leading to their habitual selection by mere convention. Here, using hexahydride CsH6 as a benchmark, we systematically investigate the magnitude and propagation mechanism of smearing-induced errors against the parameter-free optimized tetrahedron method. Long-tailed smearing delocalizes the occupation window, causing substantial Fermi-level shifts, flattening of the density of states, and hardening phonon modes, thereby weakening electron-phonon coupling. Conversely, short-tailed smearing suffers from insufficient sampling, producing density-of-states oscillations and enhanced Fermi-surface nesting; via amplified electronic screening and Peierls instabilities, this softens acoustic modes and generates imaginary frequencies, causing CsH6 to be dynamically unstable and discarded. However, the optimized tetrahedron method reveals that CsH6 is dynamically stable under ambient pressure with a remarkable superconducting transition temperature of 121 K. To prevent subjective empirical parameters from obscuring theoretically promising high-temperature superconductors, we derive a simple scaling relation for the smearing width, applicable to different smearing functions, from the free-electron-gas model, offering an objective, precise, and efficient protocol for parameter selection in high-throughput screening.

AI.tldr: 以 CsH6 为基准，系统对比涂抹（smearing）方法与无参数优化四面体法（optimized tetrahedron method）对声子介导超导电性（phonon-mediated superconductivity）计算的影响，发现经验涂抹参数会通过多重机制显著扭曲结果，甚至导致对高压超导体的误判；作者提出普适的涂抹宽度标度关系（scaling relation）作为客观选参方案。
AI.motivation: 金属体系第一性原理计算中，布里渊区（Brillouin zone）离散电子网格需引入涂抹函数及宽度（如常用的 0.02 Ry Methfessel-Paxton 方案）以在费米面处保证能量与占据的连续性，但该经验参数对声子介导超导电性的定量影响长期被忽视，往往仅凭惯例选取，可能掩盖真实的高温超导候选材料。
AI.method: 以六氢化物 CsH6 为基准体系，对照无参数的优化四面体法，系统考察涂抹诱导误差的大小及其传播机制；并从自由电子气模型（free-electron-gas model）出发推导涂抹宽度的标度关系。
AI.result: 长尾涂抹使占据窗口离域化，导致费米能级显著偏移、态密度（density of states）平坦化与声子模硬化，从而削弱电子-声子耦合（electron-phonon coupling）；短尾涂抹则采样不足，产生态密度振荡与费米面嵌套（Fermi-surface nesting）增强，经放大的电子屏蔽与 Peierls 不稳定性软化声学模并产生虚频，使 CsH6 被判为动力学不稳定而遭剔除。优化四面体法表明 CsH6 在常压下动力学稳定，超导转变温度达 121 K。
AI.conclusion: 经验涂抹参数可能遮蔽理论上有前景的高温超导体；所推导的、适用于不同涂抹函数的宽度标度关系，为高通量筛选（high-throughput screening）提供了客观、精确、高效的参数选取协议。

title: Unexpected stabilization of a single-$q$ charge density wave in pristine 1T-TiSe$_2$
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in Nature Communications. Supplementary Information is not included in this arXiv version and is available with the published article at https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-78072-0
summary: Over the past decade, studies revisiting the classical charge-density-wave system 1T-TiSe$_2$, long understood to host the $2 \times 2$ triple-$q$ order with equivalent subcomponents, have suggested that these subcomponents may not be identical, challenging a 50-year-old paradigm. Here, we demonstrate not only that these subcomponents are non-identical but also that they develop sequentially rather than simultaneously. By tracking folded-band features, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals that a unidirectional $2 \times 1$ single-$q$ order stabilizes first, while the other two components emerge sequentially at lower temperatures, completing the triple-$q$ phase. Our free-energy analysis explains this hierarchy through repulsive coupling among the three subcomponents, as supported by first-principles calculations incorporating phonon anharmonicity. Consequently, the three subcomponents are inequivalent in both phase and amplitude. These results reconcile reported symmetry breaking and differing characteristic temperatures and establish a framework in which ostensibly simple, high-symmetry charge-density order emerges from temperature-dependent competition and cooperation among inequivalent subcomponents.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过角分辨光电子能谱（angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, ARPES）追踪折叠能带特征，表明 1T-TiSe$_2$ 的 $2\times2$ 三-$q$（triple-$q$）电荷密度波（charge-density-wave, CDW）序中三个子分量并不同时形成，而是以单向 $2\times1$ 单-$q$（single-$q$）序先稳定、其余两个分量在更低温度依次出现的顺序发展。
AI.motivation: 过去十年对经典 CDW 体系 1T-TiSe$_2$ 的重新研究提示，其长期被认为等价的 $2\times2$ 三-$q$ 序子分量可能并不相同，从而对延续 50 年的范式提出挑战；本文旨在直接验证这一非等价性及其形成时序。
AI.method: 采用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）追踪折叠能带（folded-band）特征以确定各子分量的形成顺序；结合自由能（free-energy）分析解释有序出现的层级性，并辅以包含声子非谐性（phonon anharmonicity）的第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）加以支持。
AI.result: ARPES 显示先形成单向 $2\times1$ 单-$q$ 序，另外两个分量在更低温度依次出现，最终完成三-$q$ 相；自由能分析将这一层级归因于三个子分量之间的排斥耦合（repulsive coupling），第一性原理计算亦支持该机制；因此三个子分量在相位（phase）和振幅（amplitude）上均不等价。
AI.conclusion: 该结果调和了此前报道的对称性破缺（symmetry breaking）与不同特征温度（characteristic temperatures）的矛盾，并建立一个框架：表面上简单、高对称的电荷密度序源于不等价子分量之间随温度变化的竞争与协同。

title: MINFF: A Family of Classical Force Fields for Minerals with Tunable Angle Terms
comment: 63 pages, 7 figures and 3 tables in the main text. Supporting information (included in the same file) has 19 pages with 9 figures and 5 tables. Parameters, reference structures, misc. scripts and topology generators available via https://github.com/mholmboe/minff and https://www.atomipy.io
summary: Atomistic simulations of minerals are limited by the accuracy and transferability of the force field. We introduce MINFF, a force field family for layered and non-layered oxides and hydroxides of M being Si, Al, Fe, Mg, Ca, Ti, Li and F. MINFF has no M-O bond terms. Instead M-O distances follow from electrostatics and dispersion, while a single harmonic angle term on all M-O triplets controls coordination geometry. Metal charges are DDEC6 charges from reference mineral structures, and oxygen charges are assigned by nearest-neighbour charge smearing, covering basal, apical, hydroxyl and edge sites and sites adjacent to isomorphous substitutions. The oxygen Lennard-Jones parameters are based on the OPC3 water model and change by less than 5% when re-optimised per mineral, so compatibility with OPC3 and related ion-pair potentials is measured rather than assumed. Metal Lennard-Jones parameters were fitted to unit-cell metrics, bond distances and angles, both synchronously across more than 30 reference minerals (general, GMINFF) and for individual minerals (tailored, TMINFF), each at four angle force constants (0, 250, 500 and 1500 kJ/mol/rad^2). With angle terms, MINFF reproduces experimental unit-cells metrics to within 0.5% and atom-type distances and angles to within 0.7-1.4% and 0.1-0.4%, with Global Instability Index values as low as 0.11, below those of CLAYFF (0.34) and INTERFACE (0.21). A moderate angle constant reproduces the stiff in-plane and soft shear elastic constants of phyllosilicates and improves the Kaolinite librational bands, and in hydrated Na-Montmorillonite MINFF gives the lowest residual factor against the 2W 00l pattern of the models tested. The general and tailored sets at four angle stiffnesses give direct control over the transferability-fidelity trade-off. Topologies can be generated with the atom (MATLAB) and atomipy (Python) libraries and at www.atomipy.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MINFF 力场家族，用于 Si、Al、Fe、Mg、Ca、Ti、Li 和 F 的层状与非层状氧化物/氢氧化物原子尺度模拟。该力场不含 M-O 键项，而由静电与色散决定 M-O 距离，并以单一谐波角项控制配位几何。其通用版（GMINFF）与定制版（TMINFF）在四种角力常数下可调控可迁移性-保真度权衡，并在晶胞参数、全局不稳定指数及蒙脱石衍射等方面优于 CLAYFF 与 INTERFACE。
AI.motivation: 矿物原子尺度模拟（atomistic simulations）受制于力场（force field）的精度与可迁移性（transferability）。现有力场在层状与非层状氧化物、氢氧化物体系中难以兼顾精度与跨矿物适用性，且与常用水模型及离子对势（ion-pair potentials）的兼容性多属假定而非实测。
AI.method: 提出 MINFF 力场家族：取消 M-O 键项，M-O 距离由静电与色散（dispersion）导出，仅对所有 M-O 三元组施加单一谐波角项控制配位几何。金属电荷采用参考矿物结构的 DDEC6 电荷，氧电荷经最近邻电荷涂抹（charge smearing）分配，覆盖基面、顶端、羟基与边缘位点及同晶取代邻位。氧的 Lennard-Jones 参数基于 OPC3 水模型，逐矿物重优化时变化小于 5%。金属 LJ 参数分别以跨 30 余种参考矿物的同步拟合（general, GMINFF）与单矿物拟合（tailored, TMINFF）获得，各在 0、250、500 和 1500 kJ/mol/rad² 四种角力常数下进行。
AI.result: 含角项时，MINFF 将实验晶胞参数复现至 0.5% 以内，原子类型距离与角度分别复现至 0.7–1.4% 与 0.1–0.4%，全局不稳定指数（Global Instability Index）最低达 0.11，低于 CLAYFF（0.34）与 INTERFACE（0.21）。中等角力常数可复现层状硅酸盐（phyllosilicates）刚性的面内与软剪切弹性常数，并改善高岭石（kaolinite）的摇摆振动带；在含水 Na-蒙脱石（Na-Montmorillonite）中，MINFF 相对 2W 00l 图谱给出所测模型中最低的残差因子。
AI.conclusion: 通用与定制参数集在四种角刚度下提供了对可迁移性-保真度权衡（transferability-fidelity trade-off）的直接控制。拓扑可通过 atom（MATLAB）与 atomipy（Python）库及 www.atomipy.io 生成，便于实际应用与部署。

title: Zeeman spin quantum geometry and intrinsic gyrotropic spin current
summary: We uncover an intrinsic gyrotropic spin current (IGSC) driven solely by an oscillating magnetic field, arising from the spin version of Zeeman quantum geometry. Using the density matrix formalism, we derive the IGSC in the low-frequency clean limit, in terms of the Zeeman spin quantum metric and the Zeeman spin Berry curvature. The effect is studied in a minimal Rashba-Dresselhaus model that also supports intrinsic gyrotropic charge currents from the Zeeman Berry curvature. The spin and charge currents exhibit a $π/2$ phase shift and are found to be perpendicular to each other for certain parameter ranges. This not only enables spin current detection but also opens pure spin current channels for energy-efficient spintronics. We further observe that these currents switch directions between longitudinal and transverse relative to the applied field, depending on the relative strength of Rashba and Dresselhaus interactions.

AI.tldr: 该工作揭示了一种仅由振荡磁场驱动的内禀回旋自旋流（intrinsic gyrotropic spin current, IGSC），其根源为自旋版本的塞曼量子几何（Zeeman quantum geometry）。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探索由振荡磁场单独驱动的自旋流机制，借助自旋版塞曼量子几何拓展对量子几何效应的理解，并为自旋流探测与节能自旋电子学提供新途径。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵形式（density matrix formalism），在低频干净极限（low-frequency clean limit）下，以塞曼自旋量子度规（Zeeman spin quantum metric）和塞曼自旋贝里曲率（Zeeman spin Berry curvature）表示推导出 IGSC；并在一个同时支持塞曼贝里曲率内禀回旋电荷流的最小 Rashba-Dresselhaus 模型中进行分析。
AI.result: 自旋流与电荷流呈现 π/2 相位差，在特定参数区间内二者互相垂直；此外，电流相对于外加场的方向会在纵向与横向之间切换，其依赖于 Rashba 与 Dresselhaus 相互作用的相对强度。
AI.conclusion: 该效应不仅可实现自旋流探测，还为节能自旋电子学开辟了纯自旋流通道；纵向与横向电流方向的可切换性由 Rashba-Dresselhaus 相互作用相对强度决定。

title: Molecular-Dynamics Verification of Effective Gravity under Heat Conduction
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Two supplemental movies are provided as ancillary files
summary: We test the effective-gravity prediction of global thermodynamics using standard molecular dynamics of a two-dimensional Lennard-Jones fluid. Under weak heat conduction with the lower boundary hotter than the upper boundary, the transition between liquid below gas and liquid above gas shifts from zero to finite downward gravity. Using independently measured equilibrium saturation pressures, we calculate the shift predicted by global thermodynamics and find agreement with the observed transition shift. The transition occurs at zero effective gravity, where the hydrostatic pressure difference balances the saturation-pressure difference between the two boundaries. The hysteresis response under heat conduction also agrees with the equilibrium response when plotted against effective gravity. These results establish the predictive power of global thermodynamics for nonequilibrium structure formation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过二维Lennard-Jones流体的分子动力学模拟，验证了全局热力学（global thermodynamics）对有效重力（effective gravity）的预测能力。结果显示，在弱热传导条件下，液-气共存态转变发生在有效重力为零处，与理论预测一致。
AI.motivation: 旨在检验全局热力学是否能预测非平衡条件下的结构形成（nonequilibrium structure formation），特别是有效重力对相变位置的影响。
AI.method: 采用标准分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟二维Lennard-Jones流体，在下边界较热、上边界较冷的弱热传导条件下，独立测量平衡饱和压力（equilibrium saturation pressures），并据此计算全局热力学所预测的转变位移。
AI.result: 液在气下与液在气上的转变随向下重力从零移动至有限值；预测的转变位移与观测结果一致。转变发生在有效重力为零处，此时静水压差（hydrostatic pressure difference）与两边界间的饱和压差相平衡。热传导下的滞后（hysteresis）响应在以有效重力为坐标时也与平衡响应一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了全局热力学对非平衡结构形成的预测能力。

title: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures; Supplemental Material: 22 pages, 9 figures, appended
summary: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. Fitting this model to the data yields an excited transition state lifetime of a few femtoseconds. These results identify transition selectivity, rather than a thermalized total carrier density, as a key factor controlling coherent-phonon generation in semiconductors excited near a band gap.

AI.tldr: 该研究以碲（tellurium）为对象，系统测量并第一性原理计算了带隙附近激发波长对相干声子（coherent phonon）产生的影响，发现全对称 A₁ 模的相干振幅随波长跨带隙变化很弱，与热化载流子（thermalized carrier）模型预期不符；研究提出由光学矩阵元与动量/能带相关形变势（deformation potential）加权的跃迁选择性预热门控力模型来解释，拟合给出约几飞秒的激发跃迁态寿命，表明跃迁选择性而非热化总载流子密度是控制相干声子产生的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 超快激光激发半导体载流子常产生全对称相干光学声子，传统上以热化瞬态载流子布居（thermalized transient carrier population）来解释。该工作旨在检验这一既有理解是否成立，尤其是带隙附近激发时的波长依赖行为。
AI.method: 在碲中围绕电子带隙（electronic band gap）选择激发波长，开展超快激光驱动相干声子产生的系统性测量，并进行第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），考察光子能量依赖；同时构建基于跃迁分辨的预热力（prethermal force）模型，以光学矩阵元（optical matrix elements）及能带与动量相关 A₁ 形变势（deformation potentials）加权，并与数据拟合。
AI.result: 与假设热化载流子布居的模型预期相反，当波长跨带隙调谐时，全对称 A₁ 模的相干振幅仅发生弱变化。实测光谱依赖可由跃迁分辨的预热力模型再现，拟合得到激发跃迁态寿命（excited transition state lifetime）为几飞秒。
AI.conclusion: 在带隙附近激发的半导体中，控制相干声子产生的关键因素是跃迁选择性（transition selectivity），而非热化的总载流子密度（thermalized total carrier density）。

title: Phonon-Mediated Superconductivity near Phase Boundaries in Rhombohedral Multilayer Graphene
summary: The recent observation of superconductivity in untwisted multilayer graphene has sparked intense interest in its microscopic origin. As the displacement field and carrier density are varied, superconductivity emerges in several distinct regions with different temperature and magnetic-field responses. This behavior has been attributed to the presence of distinct electronic phases, raising the possibility that different superconducting regions originate from different microscopic mechanisms. While purely electronic pairing mechanisms have been extensively explored, an in-depth examination of phonon-mediated superconductivity is still missing. Here, we solve the coupled selfconsistent Migdal-Eliashberg equations using input from first-principles calculations and incorporating interaction-driven symmetry breaking of the electronic ground state. Varying the carrier density and displacement field, we reproduce the experimentally observed superconducting regions with comparable superconducting properties such as gap and $T_c$ and predict additional, as-yet undiscovered superconducting phases. Our findings exemplify that several superconductivity regions in rhombohedral graphene can be satisfactorily explained by phonon-mediated pairing.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用第一性原理结合自洽 Migdal-Eliashberg 方程，证明菱面体（rhombohedral）多层石墨烯中多个超导区域可由声子介导配对（phonon-mediated pairing）解释。
AI.motivation: 未扭转多层石墨烯（untwisted multilayer graphene）中超导性的微观起源尚存争议；随位移场与载流子密度变化出现多个温度与磁场响应不同的超导区域，暗示可能存在多种微观机制，而纯电子配对机制已被广泛研究，声子介导超导（phonon-mediated superconductivity）尚缺乏深入考察。
AI.method: 求解耦合的自洽 Migdal-Eliashberg 方程（self-consistent Migdal-Eliashberg equations），输入来自第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），并纳入相互作用驱动的电子基态对称性破缺（interaction-driven symmetry breaking）。
AI.result: 通过改变载流子密度与位移场，重现了实验观测到的超导区域，其超导性质如能隙（gap）与临界温度（$T_c$）相当；同时预测了尚未发现的额外超导相。
AI.conclusion: 菱面体石墨烯（rhombohedral graphene）中若干超导区域可由声子介导配对得到满意解释，表明该机制在多区域超导现象中具有重要地位。

title: Role of dissipation dilution in achieving high mechanical quality factors in van der Waals resonators
summary: Dissipation dilution has driven a revolution in the quality factors ($Q$) of top-down nanomechanical resonators. Yet it has not been leveraged for van der Waals (vdW) materials. Here we report quality factors up to $372{,}000\pm37{,}000$ in monolayer MoS$_2$ drums at 4 K, nearly an order of magnitude beyond the previous best for any vdW material at this temperature, enabled by a clean, polymer-free exfoliation technique. We develop a dissipation-dilution model for circular drums and analyze the contributing intrinsic and extrinsic dissipation mechanisms. The MoS$_2$ monolayer exhibits a dilution factor of order $1,000$, establishing sub-nanometer-thin resonators as ultimate dilution materials. The intrinsic quality factor, however, is limited by surface losses at atomic thickness. Conversely, multilayer drums show a lower dilution factor but a high intrinsic quality factor, on par with established top-down materials of similar dimensions, both resulting from the increased thickness. A two-level-system analysis of the temperature-dependent damping confirms this bulk-versus-surface picture and provides first insight into its microscopic origin. Our results identify dissipation dilution as the governing mechanism for high-$Q$ mechanical vdW resonators. Combined with strategies such as soft clamping or stress engineering, they establish atomically thin resonators as a platform for ultrahigh-$Q$ quantum transduction and sensing.

AI.tldr: 该工作报告了单层 MoS$_2$ 鼓膜谐振器在 4 K 下高达 $372{,}000\pm37{,}000$ 的品质因数，较此前任何范德华材料的最佳值提升近一个数量级，归因于无聚合物的清洁剥离技术，并建立了耗散稀释（dissipation dilution）模型。
AI.motivation: 耗散稀释已推动自上而下（top-down）纳米机械谐振器品质因数的革命，但尚未被应用于范德华（van der Waals, vdW）材料。本文旨在将该机制引入此类原子级薄谐振器以提升其品质因数。
AI.method: 采用洁净、无聚合物（polymer-free）的剥离技术制备单层 MoS$_2$ 鼓膜，建立圆形鼓膜的耗散稀释模型，分析固有（intrinsic）与外在（extrinsic）耗散机制，并对温度依赖的阻尼进行两能级系统（two-level-system）分析。
AI.result: 单层 MoS$_2$ 鼓膜在 4 K 下品质因数达 $372{,}000\pm37{,}000$，稀释因子约为 $1{,}000$；其固有品质因数受原子厚度下的表面损耗限制，而多层鼓膜虽稀释因子较低，但固有品质因数高，可与同尺寸的成熟自上而下材料相当。
AI.conclusion: 耗散稀释被确认为高 $Q$ 机械范德华谐振器的主导机制；结合软钳位（soft clamping）或应力工程等策略，原子级薄谐振器可作为超高 $Q$ 量子换能与传感平台。

title: A Topological Spin on Racetrack Memory
summary: Magnetic racetrack memory requires localized carriers that combine rapid motion, resistance to perturbations and a detectable signal. Here we show how a 360° domain wall in a hollow ferromagnetic tube combines these properties within a single continuous magnetic shell. Two successive magnetization reversals form a bound object whose surrounding domains point in the same direction. Analytical energetics and micromagnetic simulations establish its finite separation, recovery from tested perturbations and current driven transport without microscopic Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction or a maintaining field. The texture's winding resists unwinding while radial rotation carries an energy cost, providing a specific control over stability. Relative rotation of the constituent spins accounts quantitatively for additional displacement during current onset. The wall supports motion at hundreds of metres per second, with transient velocities approaching one kilometre per second at stronger drive. A prepared seven-bit pattern retains its carriers and local readout contrast after pulsed transport and recovery. Curved-track and differential-current tests identify radial stiffness and drive uniformity as controls for intact motion. These results establish a physical basis for fast, locally distinguishable tubular magnetic bits and identify a continuous switching pathway that can be targeted by tailored excitation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出在中空铁磁管中利用360°畴壁（360° domain wall）作为单一连续磁壳内的局域载体，兼具高速运动、抗扰动与可探测信号，为赛道存储器（racetrack memory）提供物理基础。
AI.motivation: 磁性赛道存储器（magnetic racetrack memory）需要同时满足快速运动、抗扰动和信号可探测的局域载流子，而现有方案在单一连续结构中难以兼顾这些特性。
AI.method: 采用解析能量学（analytical energetics）与微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），研究中空铁磁管中360°畴壁的结构、能量代价与电流驱动输运；开展曲面轨道（curved-track）与差分电流（differential-current）测试以识别径向刚度与驱动均匀性对完整运动的影响。
AI.result: 该束缚结构具有有限间距，可从扰动中恢复，并在无微观Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与无维持场的条件下实现电流驱动输运；速度可达数百米每秒，强驱动下瞬态速度接近1 km/s；制备的七位（seven-bit）图案在脉冲运输与恢复后仍保持载流子与局域读出对比度。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了快速、局域可分辨的管状磁比特（tubular magnetic bits）的物理基础，并指出可通过定制激励（tailored excitation）靶向的连续翻转路径。

title: Transition-Metal-Induced Uniaxial Anisotropy in YFe$_3$
summary: Achieving uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy while preserving high magnetization and thermal stability remains a central challenge in the development of Fe-rich permanent magnets. YFe$_3$ is a promising candidate owing to its saturation magnetization and Curie temperature, but its intrinsic easy-plane anisotropy limits its potential for permanent-magnet applications. Here, we show that selective transition-metal substitution drives an easy-plane-to-easy-axis transition in YFe$_3$. Systematic first-principles screening identifies V, Nb, and Ta as effective dopants, with YFe$_{2.33}$Ta$_{0.67}$ exhibiting a large uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy of 2.3~MJ/m$^{3}$. Calculated exchange interactions and atomistic Monte Carlo simulations show that the enhanced anisotropy is achieved while preserving robust ferromagnetic order and high thermal stability. Micromagnetic simulations further reveal that YFe$_{2.33}$Ta$_{0.67}$ exhibits the highest coercivity and strongest resistance to irreversible demagnetization, whereas YFe$_{2.33}$V$_{0.67}$ achieves a comparable maximum energy product at 300~K. Experimental characterization of V-alloyed YFe$_3$ shows that the YFe$_3$ phase can be retained at low nominal V concentrations (1-3 at.\%) under the employed synthesis and heat-treatment conditions, whereas higher V contents lead to increasingly multiphase samples. Concentration-dependent MAE calculations reveal a sign reversal between approximately 11 and 14~at.\% V, marking the transition from easy-plane to uniaxial easy-axis anisotropy. Consistent with this concentration dependence, electron backscatter diffraction and Kerr microscopy reveal in-plane magnetic domain structures in the experimentally accessible low-V regime. Therefore, our work offers a promising approach to tuning the magnetocrystalline anisotropy of YFe$_3$ while retaining high Curie temperatures.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过第一性原理筛选与多尺度模拟，发现V、Nb、Ta的选择性过渡金属替代可在YFe₃中驱动易面到易轴的磁晶各向异性转变，并保持高铁磁有序温度与热稳定性，实验上亦观察到低V含量下YFe₃相可保留。
AI.motivation: 在富铁永磁体（Fe-rich permanent magnets）开发中，兼具单轴磁晶各向异性（uniaxial magnetocrystalline anisotropy）、高磁化强度与热稳定性仍是核心难题。YFe₃因饱和磁化强度与居里温度（Curie temperature）具潜力，但其本征易面各向异性（easy-plane anisotropy）限制了永磁应用。
AI.method: 采用系统性第一性原理筛选（first-principles screening）识别有效掺杂元素，并结合交换相互作用计算、原子尺度蒙特卡洛模拟（atomistic Monte Carlo simulations）与微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulations）。实验方面对V合金化YFe₃进行表征，使用电子背散射衍射（electron backscatter diffraction）与克尔显微镜（Kerr microscopy），并进行浓度依赖的磁晶各向异性能（MAE）计算。
AI.result: 筛选确定V、Nb、Ta为有效掺杂元素，其中YFe₂.₃₃Ta₀.₆₇具有2.3 MJ/m³的大单轴磁晶各向异性能。模拟显示其保持稳健铁磁有序与高热稳定性，并具最高矫顽力与最强抗不可逆退磁能力；YFe₂.₃₃V₀.₆₇在300 K下获得可比的最大磁能积。实验表明低名义V浓度（1-3 at.%）下YFe₃相可保留，更高V含量导致多相样品增多。MAE计算显示约11-14 at.% V间发生符号反转，标志易面到单轴易轴转变；电子背散射衍射与克尔显微镜在低V区间观察到面内磁畴结构。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了一种在保持高居里温度的同时调控YFe₃磁晶各向异性的可行途径，为富铁永磁体设计提供了有前景的策略。

title: Accurately Generalizing Deep-Learning Hamiltonian Methods to Plane-Wave Density Functional Theory
summary: Deep neural networks that predict density functional theory (DFT) Hamiltonians from material structures offer a route to efficient electronic-structure calculations. However, extending localized atomic-orbital (AO) Hamiltonian learning to plane-wave (PW) calculations with hybrid functionals requires a compact AO representation that preserves the effects of nonlocal operators. Here we propose a projectability-guided construction of nonorthogonal AO Hamiltonians from a small, selected set of PW eigenstates and eigenvalues. High-projectability states are retained, and selected higher-energy states complete the AO subspace, avoiding an empirical shift and its arbitrary contribution to the learning targets. Because the construction uses PW eigenstates and eigenvalues, it incorporates nonlocal contributions present in the reference calculation without explicitly reconstructing their AO matrix elements. Benchmarks for MoS2 and sodium phases show accurate reproduction of PW bands with smaller AO bases than real-space reconstruction. The resulting PBE and HSE Hamiltonians can be learned by equivariant neural networks, connecting PW reference calculations with electronic-structure prediction. This approach broadens the range of PW DFT calculations available for AO Hamiltonian learning and enables compact, accurate training targets for developing more widely applicable electronic-structure models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以可投影性（projectability）为导向的方法，从少量筛选的平面波（plane-wave, PW）本征态与本征值构建非正交原子轨道（atomic-orbital, AO）哈密顿量，从而将含非局域算符的混合泛函 PW 计算纳入 AO 哈密顿量学习框架。
AI.motivation: 从材料结构预测密度泛函理论（density functional theory, DFT）哈密顿量的深度神经网络可加速电子结构计算，但将局域 AO 哈密顿量学习扩展到采用混合泛函（hybrid functionals）的 PW 计算时，需要一种能保留非局域算符效应的紧凑 AO 表示。
AI.method: 采用可投影性导向的构建方式：保留高可投影性（high-projectability）态，并由选定的高能态补全 AO 子空间，从而避免经验性平移（empirical shift）及其对学习目标的任意贡献；由于构建基于 PW 本征态与本征值，可纳入参考计算中的非局域贡献而无需显式重构其 AO 矩阵元。
AI.result: 在 MoS2 与钠（sodium）相的基准测试中，该方法以比实空间重构（real-space reconstruction）更小的 AO 基组准确重现 PW 能带；所生成的 PBE 与 HSE 哈密顿量可由等变神经网络（equivariant neural networks）学习。
AI.conclusion: 该方法拓宽了可用于 AO 哈密顿量学习的 PW DFT 计算范围，并为开发适用性更广的电子结构模型提供了紧凑且准确的训练目标。

title: Charge-selective topological locking and ultraslow coarsening in magnetoelastic media
comment: 7 pages + 3 figures (main text), and 14 pages + 2 movies (supplemental material)
summary: We demonstrate that the symmetry of magnetoelastic coupling governs the topological organization of composite defects and can qualitatively alter phase-ordering kinetics. In a two-dimensional theory of an in-plane magnetic vector coupled to elastic strain, we find that integer magnetic vortices bind pairs of elementary elastic half-defects. Isotropic magnetostriction produces a core-induced elastic winding independent of the magnetic charge, giving defect binding without charge locking and leaving the magnetic sector with essentially XY-like coarsening. In contrast, quadrupolar magnetoelastic coupling locks magnetic and elastic defect charges: continuous rotational symmetry favors $q_φ=q_θ$, whereas crystalline anisotropy can reverse the locking to $q_φ=-q_θ$. We reveal that both locking sectors display anomalously slow vortex annihilation: defect density shows a power-law decay $t^{-2/5}$, while the average defect-velocity scales as $t^{-4/5}$. These results are consistent with a dynamic exponent $z\simeq 5$. We show that this coarsening slowdown is associated with large anisotropic elastic friction. An adiabatic elimination of the elastic field reveals that isotropic magnetostriction merely renormalizes local magnetic interactions, whereas orientational coupling induces effective nonlocal interactions between magnetic spins. Our experimentally testable results thus establish magnetoelastic coupling symmetry as a means of controlling defect topology and ordering kinetics.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示磁弹耦合（magnetoelastic coupling）的对称性决定复合缺陷（composite defects）的拓扑组织，并可定性改变相序动力学（phase-ordering kinetics）。四方型耦合导致磁荷与弹性格点锁定，产生异常缓慢的涡旋湮灭；各向同性磁致伸缩则不锁定电荷，表现为近XY型粗化。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探究磁弹耦合对称性如何控制缺陷拓扑与相序动力学，尤其是复合缺陷的组织规律及其对粗化行为的定性影响。
AI.method: 采用二维平面内磁矢量与弹性应变耦合的理论框架，分析整数磁涡旋与基本弹性半缺陷（half-defects）的结合，并通过对弹性场的绝热消元（adiabatic elimination）考察有效磁相互作用。
AI.result: 各向同性磁致伸缩产生与磁荷无关的芯致弹性绕数，形成无电荷锁定的缺陷结合，磁扇区呈近XY型粗化；四极型耦合则锁定磁荷与弹性格点（连续旋转对称偏好q_φ=q_θ，晶格各向异性可翻转为q_φ=-q_θ）。两锁定扇区均表现为异常缓慢的涡旋湮灭，缺陷密度按t^{-2/5}幂律衰减，平均缺陷速度标度为t^{-4/5}，与动态指数z≃5一致。粗化减速与大的各向异性弹性摩擦（elastic friction）相关：各向同性磁致伸缩仅重整化局域磁相互作用，取向耦合则诱导磁自旋间的有效非局域相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 磁弹耦合对称性可作为控制缺陷拓扑与有序动力学的途径，且相关结果具备实验可检验性。

title: Ionic gradients shape the spatial organization and dynamics of supramolecular polymers
summary: Living supramolecular materials such as microtubules and actin filaments assemble and function in dynamic, heterogeneous environments, subject to chemical concentration gradients. Their rapid and precise response to such gradients---via aggregation, disassembly, or autonomous motion---underlies the fine spatiotemporal control typical of living systems. Reproducing such responsiveness in synthetic materials is a central challenge in materials science and requires a molecular-level understanding of how gradients couple to supramolecular structure and dynamics, which remains difficult to access experimentally. To this end, we combine implicit-solvent coarse-grained molecular dynamics (MD) with the constant chemical potential MD (C$μ$MD) technique to investigate, at molecular resolution, the coupling of two prototypical supramolecular polymer models with externally imposed ionic concentration gradients. Despite their contrasting responses to homogeneous ionic conditions, both systems undergo pronounced spatial reorganization under the gradient, generating regions of locally enhanced supramolecular activity that are inaccessible to homogeneous systems with the same overall content of self-assembling species. Crucially, the local supramolecular dynamics is largely determined by the local concentrations, consistent with the formation of local quasi-equilibria: this direct connection between spatial composition and supramolecular activity emerges as a common governing principle across the two models. These findings shed light on the spatially complex supramolecular response that can be triggered by chemical gradients, and show how a single gradient simulation can encode this response across a continuous range of local chemical environments, thus providing a general strategy to investigate and design materials operating under spatially heterogeneous conditions.

AI.tldr: 通过隐式溶剂粗粒化分子动力学（coarse-grained molecular dynamics, MD）结合恒化学势MD（constant chemical potential MD, CμMD），在分子分辨尺度研究了两种超分子聚合物模型（supramolecular polymer models）对外加离子浓度梯度（ionic concentration gradient）的响应。结果表明，两个体系在梯度下均发生显著空间重组，其局域超分子动力学主要由局域浓度决定，符合局域准平衡（local quasi-equilibria）的形成。
AI.motivation: 生命体系中的超分子材料（如微管、肌动蛋白丝）在动态、异质且存在化学浓度梯度的环境中组装与行使功能，其快速精确响应是生命系统精细时空调控的基础。在合成材料中复现此类响应性是材料科学的核心挑战，且需要在分子层面理解梯度如何与超分子结构和动力学耦合，而这在实验上难以获取。
AI.method: 采用隐式溶剂粗粒化分子动力学（implicit-solvent coarse-grained molecular dynamics）与恒化学势分子动力学（constant chemical potential MD, CμMD）技术，以分子分辨率考察两种典型超分子聚合物模型与外部施加离子浓度梯度之间的耦合。
AI.result: 尽管两个体系对均一离子条件（homogeneous ionic conditions）的响应形成对比，但在梯度下二者均发生明显的空间重组（spatial reorganization），产生局域增强的超分子活性区域，这些区域在具有相同自组装物种总量的均一体系中无法获得。关键在于，局域超分子动力学在很大程度上由局域浓度决定，与局域准平衡（local quasi-equilibria）的形成相一致。
AI.conclusion: 空间组成与超分子活性之间的直接关联，在两个模型中均表现为共同的支配原则（governing principle）。研究揭示了化学梯度可触发的空间复杂超分子响应，并表明单次梯度模拟即可编码跨连续局域化学环境的响应，为研究与设计在空间异质条件下工作的材料提供了通用策略。

title: Reversible Magneto-ionic Modification of Metallic Magnetic Thin Films
summary: Magnetic multilayers with structural inversion asymmetry, perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA), and large Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) are widely studied for magnetic domain wall- and skyrmion-based data processing applications. In this work, we report a controlled, nonvolatile, but reversible local modification of such a system by electrically driven oxygen migration through the metallic film structure by using ionic liquid gating. Our findings provide direct evidence for the modification of the oxidation state at the heavy metal (HM)/ferromagnet (FM) interface. As a result, we observed changes in fundamental magnetic properties, such as an increase in the effective anisotropy constant (Keff) and coercive field (Hc) with oxidation, and a decrease with the reduction of oxygen ions. Positive gate voltages relative to the thin film extract oxygen ions from the magnetic layer, significantly reducing the domain nucleation field. In contrast, negative voltages drive oxygen ions into the magnetic layer, leading to a reversible increase in the extent of domain wall pinning near saturation. We observe a corresponding decrease in the magnetic moment and DMI, with negative voltage reducing both. This magneto-ionic modulation in fully metallic structures is beneficial for spintronic device applications, particularly in field-programmable domain wall and skyrmion devices.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用离子液体门控（ionic liquid gating）通过电场驱动氧离子在金属薄膜中迁移，实现对具有结构反演不对称、垂直磁各向异性（perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, PMA）和强Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）的磁性多层结构的非易失、可逆局域磁性调控，为自旋电子器件应用提供依据。
AI.motivation: 磁性多层结构在磁畴壁（domain wall）和斯格明子（skyrmion）数据处理应用中受到广泛关注，因此需要一种可控、非易失且可逆的局域磁性调控手段。
AI.method: 采用离子液体门控，通过电场驱动氧离子在金属薄膜结构中迁移，对重金�属（heavy metal, HM）/铁磁体（ferromagnet, FM）界面的氧化态进行调控。
AI.result: 获得重金属/铁磁体界面氧化态改变的直接证据；氧化使有效各向异性常数（Keff）与矫顽场（Hc）增大，氧离子还原则使其减小。正栅压从磁性层抽取氧离子，显著降低畴成核场；负栅压将氧离子驱入磁性层，导致接近饱和时畴壁钉扎程度可逆增加。负栅压同时降低磁矩与DMI。
AI.conclusion: 这种全金属结构中的磁离子调控（magneto-ionic modulation）有利于自旋电子器件应用，尤其适用于可场编程的畴壁与斯格明子器件。

title: Curie-Weiss cell fluid model: Fitting to experimental critical-point data
summary: We examine how the Curie--Weiss cell fluid model can be quantitatively related to real fluids by determining its microscopic parameters from experimental critical-point data for water, carbon dioxide, and three polyol ester lubricants (POE5, POE7, and POE9). The microscopic parameters of the model are determined from the experimental values of the critical temperature and critical density: the global attraction coupling constant is fixed by the critical temperature, and the cell volume by the critical density. The critical pressure then follows as an independent model prediction, deviating from experimental values by 10--41$\%$ across the studied substances. Varying the ratio of local repulsion to global attraction $f=J_2/J_1$ over a wide range has only a weak effect on this deviation. For $f\geq1$, the model's critical compressibility factor lays within a narrow range $Z_c\approx0.382-0.386$, remaining close to the mean-field van der Waals value $Z_c=3/8=0.375$ and consistently overestimating experimental values. The best agreement with experiment is obtained for the polyol ester lubricants and improves along the POE5--POE7--POE9 series with increasing molar mass, suggesting that multiple-occupancy cell fluid models are well suited to systems of large molecules, particularly soft-matter systems with bounded interaction potentials. We further show that generalizing the model by introducing a temperature- and phase-dependent effective attraction allows it to describe a triple point and to reproduce the broad range of critical-to-triple temperature ratios $T_c/T_{\mathrm{tr}}$ characteristic of real fluids.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过实验临界点数据确定 Curie–Weiss 元胞流体模型（cell fluid model）的微观参数，检验其定量描述真实流体的能力，并以温度与相依赖的有效吸引项推广模型以刻画三相点。
AI.motivation: 旨在考察 Curie–Weiss 元胞流体模型能否与真实流体建立定量联系，明确其在软物质与大分子体系中的适用性，并扩展其对三相点行为与临界—三相温度比（critical-to-triple temperature ratio）的描述能力。
AI.method: 以水、二氧化碳及三种多元醇酯润滑剂（POE5、POE7、POE9）的实验临界温度与临界密度确定模型微观参数：全局吸引耦合常数由临界温度固定，元胞体积由临界密度确定；并以 f=J2/J1（局部排斥与全局吸引之比）为变量扫描，考察临界压强偏差与临界压缩因子；进一步引入温度与相依赖的有效吸引项对模型进行推广。
AI.result: 临界压强作为独立模型预言与实验相差 10–41%；改变 f 仅对该偏差产生弱影响。当 f≥1 时，临界压缩因子（critical compressibility factor）落在窄区间 Zc≈0.382–0.386，接近平均场 van der Waals 值 Zc=3/8=0.375，并系统高估实验值。与实验最吻合的是多元醇酯润滑剂，且随 POE5–POE7–POE9 摩尔质量增大而改善。推广后的模型可描述三相点，并再现真实流体较宽的 Tc/Ttr 范围。
AI.conclusion: 多重占据元胞流体模型（multiple-occupancy cell fluid model）更适用于大分子体系，尤其是具有有界相互作用势的软物质系统；但临界压强与临界压缩因子存在系统性偏差，需通过引入温度与相依赖的有效吸引项加以改进。

title: The role of dependency range in thermally coupled superconducting networks
summary: Interdependent networks can be highly fragile because dependency links amplify local failures into cascades that trigger global collapse. Much of the theoretical understanding comes from geometric network models, where dependency range is imposed externally and coupling strength is distance independent, and it is unclear how these insights apply to real materials, where interdependence arises from physical transport. Here we study thermally coupled amorphous superconducting networks, in which dependencies emerge from current redistribution and heat-mediated interactions governed by thermal diffusivity. Using an experimentally calibrated model of resistively shunted Josephson junctions, we show the system reproduces the three canonical transition regimes: continuous, nucleation-dominated, and mixed-order.
